38	## Architecture
39	
40	The executable path is deliberately shallow:
41	
42	```text
43	cmd/dev/main.go
44	  -> cli.Execute()
45	  -> cli.NewRootCommandWithIO()
46	  -> App.Load()
47	  -> Cobra command handler
48	  -> domain package(s)
49	```
50	
51	`internal/cli` assembles commands, parses flags, invokes services, and renders output. Keep policy out of command handlers; it belongs in independently testable domain packages:
52	
53	- `config` owns defaults, TOML overlays, validation, and XDG paths.
54	- `gitx` is the Git porcelain boundary and canonicalizes repository identity through the shared Git common directory.
55	- `task` persists only human intent Git cannot derive: task mode/state, owner, next action, and runtime hints. Lifecycle callers use exact-record revisions and locked compare-and-update/delete transactions rather than treating a previously read task as current.
56	- `wt` owns managed linked-worktree creation, placement, provisioning plans, and safe removal. Runtimes never create or manage Git worktrees; they surface checkout or experiment paths selected and validated by the calling `dev` flow, including managed, external, or adopted worktrees and non-Git Try directories.
57	- `runtime` abstracts Herdr, tmux, Zellij, and the no-multiplexer backend. Handles are backend-qualified hints and must be checked against live checkout coverage before reuse.
58	- `taskflow` is the UI-agnostic lifecycle authority: it separates recorded intent, typed live observations, immutable guarded plans, approvals, and partial result ledgers. Apply locks and reloads task/Git/worktree/runtime/artifact/remote identity, then rejects stale authority before mutation.
59	- `repo` discovers and deduplicates repositories; `inventory` joins repositories, Git state, tasks, all registered worktrees, and live runtime data. CLI listings and UI projections consume this joined view.
60	- `flowtui` is an independent Bubble Tea model for the preview `dev flow` repository state-machine UI. It receives repository reads and taskflow Plan/Apply callbacks; do not embed it in or add a mode to the dashboard's `tui` model.
61	- `catalog` stores stable repository/Try identity and personal metadata. `experiment` owns Try creation, archive/restore, and graduation, including intent records and rollback/reconciliation around moves.
62	- `note` stores multiple repository thoughts as durable Markdown keyed by catalog ID and maintains a rebuildable SQLite FTS index. It is distinct from task context and the catalog's single metadata summary.
63	- `tui` owns Bubble Tea state/rendering only. `internal/cli/tui.go` injects callbacks to the same services used by non-interactive commands.
64	- `stats` is durable SQLite data; `diskusage`, note FTS, and forge/gitignore data are regenerable caches. Do not treat stats as cache.
65	- `forge` wraps optional `gh`, `glab`, and Azure CLI integrations and must degrade to local Git behavior when they are unavailable.
66	- `sshhost` owns bounded static discovery of the active user OpenSSH Include closure, canonical files under `~/.ssh/dev.d`, public-key selection/generation/bootstrap, fresh authentication proofs, and the explicit handoff into dev fleet. OpenSSH and plain `ssh -G` remain semantic authority; dev reads foreign host definitions but never rewrites them, copies private keys, weakens host-key policy, or treats every alias as a fleet member.
67	- `fleet` merges the user-authored primary `remotes.toml` with strict dev-owned `remotes.d/ssh-<alias>.toml` registrations. Remote `dev` state remains host-local. `remote_os` selects target semantics: POSIX uses the shell launcher, while Windows uses an encoded PowerShell launcher that accepts only hidden fleet helpers, preserves sync stdin, and never applies controller path rules to remote paths.
68	
69	The principal task start flow spans `internal/cli/start.go`, `start_flow.go`, `gitx`/`wt`, `runtime`, and `task`: resolve the canonical repository and explicit base, create or select the checkout, provision/open it, then persist and annotate the task. Task-backed park/resume/completion/retirement and exact unmanaged Adopt/Remove policy belong in `taskflow`; CLI commands, the dashboard, `sweep`, and `flowtui` are adapters. Preserve report-before-apply and no-data-loss ordering, including the isolated compatibility paths that have not migrated to taskflow.
70	
71	State is split intentionally:
72	
73	- Git remotes/branches are durable code truth.
74	- Worktrees are disposable local checkouts.
75	- Runtime sessions are per-host and re-derivable.
76	- Task TOML and catalog assets hold only intent/identity that Git cannot answer.
77	- Repository quick-note Markdown is durable sidecar data; `notes.db` is only its disposable search index.
78	- `stats.db` is durable observation data; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/*` is disposable.
79	- The user's OpenSSH configuration is durable connection truth. Dev owns only its exact top-level `Include ~/.ssh/dev.d/*.conf` and structurally valid fragments in `~/.ssh/dev.d`; key bootstrap sends public material only and has no private-key transfer or remote-key revocation lifecycle.
80	- Fleet intent is the merged primary `remotes.toml` plus generated sibling `remotes.d` fragments. A generated fragment exists only after explicit `dev ssh setup --fleet` and a fresh ordinary alias login; controller caches and each remote machine's paths/tasks/runtime remain re-derivable or host-local.
81	
82	## Behavioral contracts
83	
84	- Task modes are `worktree`, `branch`, and `direct`; lifecycle states are `hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done`. READY/REVIEW/MERGED/RETIRED are action readiness or result milestones, never extra persisted states.
85	- Persisted intent, observed facts, and guarded action plans are separate layers. Unknown, failed, skipped, loading, or stale observations never become a false clean/closed fact.
86	- Use an explicit base for branch/worktree creation. Do not infer a safe base from whichever branch happens to be checked out.
87	- Never nest a managed worktree inside a repository. Removing a worktree does not remove its branch, and dirty removal stays opt-in.
88	- Cold parking requires committed, pushed, reconstructible work before runtime/worktree cleanup.
89	- A taskflow Plan is bound to the exact task revision and repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact identities shown at Plan time. Apply must lock, reload, and revalidate those identities; a changed revision or authority produces a stale-plan result with no new effect.
90	- Managed rows receive only legal mode/state lifecycle actions. An unmanaged linked checkout may be adopted by metadata-only task creation or removed only when exact, clean, unclaimed, non-harness, and branch-preserving; canonical, harness-owned, ambiguous/conflicting, locked, prunable, or incompletely observed rows fail closed for destructive actions.
91	- Local repository refresh must not contact remotes. Fetching refs and querying a forge are explicit network actions, and review evidence is run-local manual evidence limited to portable existence/state/draft/URL/provider/time fields; never infer review decisions or checks.
92	- Reconciliation flows such as `sweep`, command-level `adopt`, and bootstrap organization plans report before applying changes. Direct actions such as `wt rm`, `tries archive`, and `cache clear` mutate immediately after their own safety checks; do not treat them as previews. `dev flow` is plan-first regardless of the adapted command's normal CLI interaction.
93	- Raw Git and configured external tools remain outside dev-mediated locks, revalidation, and safety guarantees. Existing expert CLI flags remain compatibility surface even when the preview flow deliberately omits them.
94	- A recognized agent in a canonical checkout occupies it regardless of whether its status is working, idle, done, or unknown. Shared-writer overrides require coordinated disjoint ownership.
95	- A parallel launch target is only the exact root pane returned for a newly created first-class Herdr worktree; reused/fallback/unverified surfaces fail closed.
96	- `dev ls --json` is an external automation contract. Add fields rather than renaming/removing existing fields; apply the same compatibility care to other documented structured output.
97	- Quick notes attach to the canonical repository through catalog identity. Markdown is durable, note deletion requires confirmation, and clearing/rebuilding note FTS must never delete source files.
98	- SSH initialization is report-before-apply; managed host changes are confined to canonical dev-owned fragments. Full bootstrap requires an explicit existing key or explicit generation, registers fleet only behind `--fleet`, and reports interrupted remote installation as unknown rather than pretending to roll it back.
99	- Filesystem transitions must retain path traversal/symlink, same-filesystem, source revalidation, and rollback/reconciliation checks.
100	
101	## Versioning and changelog
102	
103	The current published baseline is `v0.2.4` (2026-09-01). The CLI version authority is an immutable `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` Git tag:
104	
105	- `Makefile` derives development builds with `git describe --tags --match 'v[0-9]*' --always --dirty` and injects `internal/cli.Version` through `-ldflags`. The `--match` filter is load-bearing: any other tag in the repository (a `backup/` or `rescue/` marker, say) must never become `--version`.
106	- `go install ...@version` recovers the module version from Go build information.
107	- `pyproject.toml` version `0.0.0` belongs only to the MkDocs environment and is not the CLI version.
108	
109	Every user-visible feature must be added to `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` as part of the feature change. Do not publish or describe a feature build under an older release's version; a release containing new compatible behavior must receive a newer version. Decide from public compatibility impact rather than blindly from the commit type.
110	
111	**When to release.** A tag is not an occasional ceremony; it is how a downstream binary learns it is stale. `go install ...@latest` resolves to the newest tag, so anything merged but untagged is invisible outside this repository.
112	
113	- A landed branch that stands alone is released immediately: bump the patch during `0.x` (`v0.1.x`) and tag it as the last step of landing.
114	- A landed branch belonging to an announced milestone accumulates in `[Unreleased]`; the milestone closes with a minor bump (`v0.2.0`).
115	- Never let `[Unreleased]` grow past one milestone's worth of work. `v0.1.0` to `v0.1.11` were tagged retroactively on 2026-08-29 precisely because 38 commits accumulated with no release.
116	
117	**What downstream gets.** Every release from `v0.2.0` forward publishes platform binaries and `SHA256SUMS` alongside the GitHub release, and `dev doctor` reports the running version so a user can compare without leaving the terminal. A release that ships neither leaves `dev --version` as the only signal, which is what the freshness work exists to fix.
118	
119	For a release:
120	
121	1. Move the relevant `[Unreleased]` entries into `## [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD` and update comparison links.
122	2. Update version-pinned install examples when the documented recommended release changes.
123	3. Push `main` first. `release.yml` asserts the tagged commit is an ancestor of `origin/main`, so a tag pushed ahead of its branch fails validation.
124	4. Tag the exact commit on `main` as `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`; never move or reuse a published tag. Never push `backup/*` or `rescue/*` tags — a tag reachable from a commit that predates the `--match` filter breaks the workflow's `./dev --version` assertion.
125	5. Let `.github/workflows/release.yml` run CI, verify `./dev --version`, build the platform matrix, create the GitHub release, and publish the matching Homebrew formula. The repository secret `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` must be a fine-grained token with Contents write access to `daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap`; a tap publication failure fails the release job so it can be retried instead of leaving Homebrew users stale.
126	
127	If the Homebrew step needs a retry or an older stable release needs a one-time backfill, run `gh workflow run publish-homebrew.yml -f version=vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. The manual workflow verifies that the release exists and republishes only the formula; it does not create or move a tag or GitHub release.
128	
129	Stable release tags only are accepted by the current workflow; prerelease tags are not supported.
130	
131	## Keep implementation, skill, and docs aligned
132	
133	`internal/skill/dev-cli/` is shipped product surface, not incidental prose: `internal/skill/skill.go` embeds the entire tree in the binary. A code change is incomplete when the bundled skill or public documentation still describes old behavior.
134	
135	| Change | Required synchronization |
136	|---|---|
137	| Cobra command name, `Use`, `Short`, flag, or global option | Run `make skill-sync`, inspect `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/commands.md`, then run `make skill-check`. Never edit the generated block by hand. |
138	| Task modes/states/defaults or lifecycle preconditions | Update `SKILL.md`, `references/task-lifecycle.md`, README, embedded help, relevant English and zh-TW workflow/mental-model/compatibility pages, and transition tests. |
139	| Worktree placement, provisioning, include rules, strategies, or safety checks | Update `references/worktree-ownership.md`, README/public worktree docs, config examples, and focused `wt` tests. |
140	| Runtime protocol, fallback order, activation, agent collision, exact-pane launch, or cleanup behavior | Update `references/runtime-herdr.md`, `references/parallel-agents.md`, compatibility docs, and runtime/lifecycle tests. Keep the boundary clear: `dev start` prepares a checkout/runtime surface; it does not launch an agent. |
141	| Bootstrap scan/layout/index/move behavior | Update `references/bootstrap.md`, public bootstrap docs, and bootstrap tests. |
142	| Config fields/defaults or structured output | Update generated command help where applicable, authored reference pages and both locales, examples, and compatibility tests. |
143	| Quick-note storage, identity, search, structured output, or TUI behavior | Update README, embedded help, `SKILL.md`, `references/notes.md`, and paired English/zh-TW mental-model, workflow, TUI, commands/config, compatibility, and freshness pages. |
144	| Any user-visible feature or fix | Update `CHANGELOG.md`; update README/help/MkDocs/skill wherever they make the affected claim. |
145	
146	`make skill-check` proves only that generated command syntax matches the Cobra tree. It cannot detect drift in lifecycle semantics, JSON schemas, safety claims, examples, README, embedded help, or authored skill references; review those manually. Because the skill is compiled with `go:embed`, rebuild after any skill edit before testing the bundled output.
147	
148	English and zh-TW MkDocs pages are maintained as a pair. Run the strict documentation checks above after changing either locale, navigation, snippets, or freshness metadata.

```text
401	// New builds the dashboard.
402	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
403		in := textinput.New()
404		in.CharLimit = 200
405		cloneSpinner := spinner.MiniDot
406		cloneSpinner.FPS = 200 * time.Millisecond
407	
408		m := Model{
409			actions:            actions,
410			rows:               rows,
411			repos:              repos,
412			input:              in,
413			remoteCloneSpinner: spinner.New(spinner.WithSpinner(cloneSpinner)),
414			width:              100,
415			height:             30,
416			firstViewReady:     make(chan struct{}),
417			firstViewOnce:      &sync.Once{},
418		}
419		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
420			m.toolGeneration = 1
421		}
422		if rows != nil {
423			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
424		}
425		if repos != nil {
426			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
427		}
428		return m
429	}

495	// Init implements tea.Model.
496	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
497		commands := []tea.Cmd{textinput.Blink}
498		if m.initialLoad {
499			commands = append(commands, m.reload())
500		}
501		if len(m.actions.Tools) > 0 {
502			commands = append(commands, m.probeTools())
503		}
504		if m.actions.LoadRemoteCache != nil {
505			commands = append(commands, m.loadRemoteCache())
506		}
507		if m.actions.LoadFleetCache != nil {
508			commands = append(commands, m.loadFleetCache())
509		}
510		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
511			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
512		}
513		return tea.Batch(commands...)
514	}

676	func traceOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
677		switch {
678		case err == nil:
679			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
680		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
681			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
682		default:
683			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
684		}
685	}
686	
687	func snapshotValid[T any](rows []T, err error) bool {
688		return !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && (err == nil || rows != nil)
689	}
690	
691	func batchCommands(commands ...tea.Cmd) tea.Cmd {
692		filtered := commands[:0]
693		for _, command := range commands {
694			if command != nil {
695				filtered = append(filtered, command)
696			}
697		}
698		switch len(filtered) {
699		case 0:
700			return nil
701		case 1:
702			return filtered[0]
703		default:
704			return tea.Batch(filtered...)
705		}
706	}

708	func (m Model) signalFirstView() {
709		if m.firstViewOnce != nil && m.firstViewReady != nil {
710			m.firstViewOnce.Do(func() { close(m.firstViewReady) })
711		}
712	}

714	func (m Model) runAfterFirstView() tea.Cmd {
715		return func() tea.Msg {
716			select {
717			case <-m.baseContext().Done():
718				return nil
719			case <-m.firstViewReady:
720				m.actions.AfterFirstView(m.baseContext())
721				return nil
722			}
723		}
724	}

726	func (m Model) loadRemoteCache() tea.Cmd {
727		generation := m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).generation
728		return func() tea.Msg {
729			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUICacheRemoteRead, perftrace.Fields{
730				View: perftrace.ViewRemote, Generation: generation,
731			})
732			result := m.actions.LoadRemoteCache(m.baseContext())
733			finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
734			return remoteCacheMsg{generation: generation, result: result}
735		}
736	}

743			})

754		return func() tea.Msg {
755			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTools, perftrace.Fields{Generation: generation})
756			jobs := make(chan int, len(tools))
757			for index := range tools {
758				jobs <- index
759			}
```

```text
19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
20	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}
38	
39	func (m Model) listPreambleLines() int {
40		lines := 1 // the table header, or the one-line empty/loading state
41		switch m.view {
42		case ViewRemote:
43			if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.visibleRemotes()) > 0 {
44				lines++
45			}
46		case ViewSkills:
47			if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading && len(m.visibleSkills()) > 0 {
48				lines++
49			}
50		case ViewMCP:
51			if m.viewLoad(ViewMCP).loading && len(m.visibleMCP()) > 0 {
52				lines++
53			}
54		}
55		return lines
56	}

58	func lineCount(s string) int {
59		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
60		if s == "" {

62		}

86		b.WriteString("\n")
87	
88		switch m.view {
89		case ViewRepos:
90			b.WriteString(m.renderRepos())
91		case ViewFleet:
92			b.WriteString(m.renderFleet())
93		case ViewTries:
94			b.WriteString(m.renderTries())
95		case ViewRemote:
96			b.WriteString(m.renderRemotes())
97		case ViewSkills:
98			b.WriteString(m.renderSkills())
99		case ViewMCP:
100			b.WriteString(m.renderMCP())
101		default:
102			b.WriteString(m.renderTasks())
103		}
104	
105		b.WriteString("\n")
106		b.WriteString(m.renderDetail())
107		b.WriteString("\n")
108		b.WriteString(m.renderFooter())
109		return b.String()
110	}

112	func (m Model) renderStats() string {
113		var b strings.Builder
114		title := "repo activity"
115		if m.stats != nil && m.stats.Repo != "" {
116			title = m.stats.Repo + " activity"
117		}
118		b.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  HEATMAP  "+title) + "\n\n")
119		if m.err != nil {
120			b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n")
121		} else if m.stats == nil {
122			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Loading activity…") + "\n")
123		} else if m.stats.Seconds == 0 {
124			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No activity recorded for this repository.\n"))
125			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Press b to backfill only this repo from Git history.\n"))
126		} else {
127			b.WriteString(m.stats.Heatmap)
128			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n  %s   %d active days   %s → %s\n",
129				styleOK.Render(humanSeconds(m.stats.Seconds)), m.stats.ActiveDays,
130				m.stats.Since.Format("2006-01-02"), m.stats.Until.Format("2006-01-02"))
131		}
132		b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("b backfill this repo · r reread stats · H / esc back · q quit"))
133		return b.String()
134	}
135	
136	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
137		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
138		if d < time.Hour {
139			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
140		}
141		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
142	}

144	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
145	// is another one — is never in doubt.
146	func (m Model) renderHeader() string {
147		build := func(compact, summary bool) string {
148			short := map[View]string{
149				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
150				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
151			}
152			var tabs []string
153			for _, view := range Views {
154				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
155				if compact {
156					name = short[view]
157				}
158				label := name
159				if !compact {
160					label = " " + name + " "
161				}
162				if view == m.view {
163					tabs = append(tabs, styleSelected.Render(label))
164				} else {
165					tabs = append(tabs, styleDim.Render(label))
166				}
167			}
168			line := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + strings.Join(tabs, styleDim.Render("│"))
169			if summary {
170				line += "   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary())
171			}
172			if m.filter != "" {
173				line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter)
174			}
175			return line
176		}
177		line := build(false, true)
178		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
179			line = build(false, false)
180		}
181		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
182			line = build(true, false)
183		}
184		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
185			line = styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + styleSelected.Render(strings.ToUpper(m.view.String()))
186			if m.filter != "" {
187				available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(line) - 4
188				if available > 1 {
189					line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
190				}
191			}
192		}
193		return line + "\n"
194	}

196	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
197	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
198	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
199		h := m.listHeight()
200		if n <= h {
201			return 0, n
202		}
203		from = m.at() - h/2
204		if from < 0 {
205			from = 0
206		}
207		if from+h > n {
208			from = n - h
209		}
210		return from, from + h
211	}

213	const (
214		taskRepoBreakpoint = 97
215		taskRepoWidth      = 16
216	)
217	
218	func (m Model) renderTasks() string {
219		rows := m.visibleTasks()
220		if len(rows) == 0 {
221			return m.emptyTasks()
222		}
223		nameW, branchW, nextW := m.columnWidths()
224		showRepo := m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint
225	
226		headers := []string{
227			fitCell("TASK", nameW),
228			fitCell("STATE", 6),
229		}
230		if showRepo {
231			headers = append(headers, fitCell("REPO", taskRepoWidth))
232		}
233		headers = append(headers,
234			fitCell("BRANCH", branchW),
235			fitCell("GIT", 16),
236			fitCell("AGE", 5),
237			fitCell("NEXT", nextW),
238		)
239	
240		var b strings.Builder
241		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
242	
243		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
244		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
245			r := rows[i]
246			cells := []string{
247				fitCell(r.Task.Title(), nameW),
248				fitCell(r.Task.State.Label(), 6),
249			}
250			if showRepo {
251				cells = append(cells, fitCell(r.Task.Repo, taskRepoWidth))
252			}
253			cells = append(cells,
254				fitCell(r.Task.Branch, branchW),
255				fitCell(gitColumn(r), 16),
256				fitCell(shortAge(r), 5),
257				fitCell(nextColumn(r), nextW),
258			)
259			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
260			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, colourState(r.Task.State, line)))
261		}
262		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
263		return b.String()
264	}

266	func (m Model) renderRepos() string {
267		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
268		if len(items) == 0 {
269			if m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading {
270				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
271			}
272			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
273				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
274		}
275		columns := m.repoColumns()
276	
277		var b strings.Builder
278		var headers []string
279		for _, c := range columns {
280			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
281		}
282		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
283	
284		from, to := m.window(len(items))
285		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
286			item := items[i]
287			r := item.Repo
288			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
289			for _, c := range columns {
290				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
291			}
292			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
293			styled := line
294			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
295				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
296					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
297				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
298					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
299					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
300				}
301			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
302				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
303			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
304				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
305			}
306			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
307		}
308		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
309		return b.String()
310	}
311	
312	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
313		r := item.Repo
314		checkout, child := item.checkout()
315		if !child {
316			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
317				marker := "▸ "
318				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
319					marker = "▾ "
320				}
321				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
322			}
323			if name == "live" {
324				return parentLiveColumn(r)
325			}
326			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
327		}
328	
329		switch name {
330		case "repo":
331			connector := "├─ "
332			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
333				connector = "└─ "
334			}
335			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
336			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
337				label = checkout.Branch()
338			}
339			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
340				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
341			}
342			return connector + label
343		case "branch":
344			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
345				return branch
346			}
347			return "(detached)"
348		case "git":
349			switch {
350			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
351				return "prunable"
352			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
353				return "locked"
354			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
355				return "?"
356			default:
357				return checkout.Status.Summary()
358			}
359		case "live":
360			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
361		case "latest":
362			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
363		case "worktrees":
364			return "—"
365		case "tasks":
366			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
367				return "?"
368			}
369			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
370		case "notes":
371			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
372				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
373			}
374			return "—"
375		case "category":
376			return "—"
377		case "path":
378			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
379		}
380		return ""
381	}
382	
383	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
384		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
385			return "?"
386		}
387		sessions := r.Sessions()
388		if len(sessions) == 0 {
389			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
390		}
391		if len(sessions) > 1 {
392			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
393		}
394		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
395		if status != "" {
396			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
397		}
398		return r.Runtime
399	}
400	
401	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
402		if runtimeErr != nil {
403			return "?"
404		}
405		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
406			return "closed"
407		}
408		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
409			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
410		}
411		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
412			return runtimeName + ":" + status
413		}
414		return runtimeName
415	}
416	
417	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
418		if len(tasks) == 0 {
419			return "—"
420		}
421		counts := map[task.State]int{}
422		for _, t := range tasks {
423			counts[t.State]++
424		}
425		var parts []string
426		for _, state := range task.States {
427			if counts[state] > 0 {
428				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
429			}
430		}
431		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
432	}
433	
434	type repoColumnSpec struct {
435		name, header string
436		width, min   int
437	}
438	
439	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
440		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
441		if len(names) == 0 {
442			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
443		}
444		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
445			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
446			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
447			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
448			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
449			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
450			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
451			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
452			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
453			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
454			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
455			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
456			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
457		}
458		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
459		for _, name := range names {
460			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
461				columns = append(columns, c)
462			}
463		}
464		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
465		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
466		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
467		for _, c := range columns {
468			total += c.width
469		}
470		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
471			for i := range columns {
472				if columns[i].name != preferred {
473					continue
474				}
475				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
476				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
477				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
478				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
479					columns[i].width--
480					total--
481				}
482			}
483			if total <= m.width {
484				break
485			}
486		}
487		return columns
488	}
489	
490	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
491		switch name {
492		case "repo":
493			return r.Repo.Display()
494		case "branch":
495			if r.Repo.Bare {
496				return "(bare)"
497			}
498			return r.Status.Branch
499		case "git":
500			if r.Repo.Bare {
501				return "—"
502			}
503			return r.Status.Summary()
504		case "remote":
505			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
506				return "?"
507			}
508			return r.Topology.Summary()
509		case "size":
510			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
511		case "live":
512			if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
513				return "?"
514			}
515			if !r.Live {
516				return "—"
517			}
518			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
519				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
520			}
521			return r.Runtime
522		case "latest":
523			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
524		case "worktrees":
525			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
526				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
527			}
528			return "—"
529		case "tasks":
530			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
531				return "?"
532			}
533			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
534				return tasks
535			}
536			return "—"
537		case "notes":
538			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
539				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
540			}
541			return "—"
542		case "category":
543			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
544				return r.Repo.Category
545			}
546			return "—"
547		case "path":
548			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
549		}
550		return ""
551	}
552	
553	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
554		if at.IsZero() {
555			return "—"
556		}
557		d := time.Since(at)
558		switch {
559		case d < time.Hour:
560			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
561		case d < 24*time.Hour:
562			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
563		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
564			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
565		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
566			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
567		default:
568			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
569		}
570	}
571	
572	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
573		s = pad(s, width)
574		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
575			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
576		}
577		return s
578	}

580	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
581		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
582			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
583		}
584		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
585		if len(rows) == 0 {
586			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
587				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
588			}
589			if m.filter != "" {
590				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
591			}
592			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
593		}
594		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
595		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
596		if descW < 12 {
597			descW = 12
598		}
599	
600		var b strings.Builder
601		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
602			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
603		}
604		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
605			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
606		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
607		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
608			r := rows[i]
609			pending := m.remoteCloneTargets(r)
610			local := "—"
611			if pending {
612				local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " repo"
613				if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRunning {
614					local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " clone"
615				}
616			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
617				local = "inspect"
618			} else if r.Cloned() {
619				local = "yes"
620				if r.LocalKind != "" {
621					local = string(r.LocalKind)
622					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
623						local = "repo"
624					}
625				}
626			}
627			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
628			if vis == "" {
629				vis = "—"
630			}
631			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
632				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
633				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
634			styled := line
635			if r.Cloned() || pending {
636				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
637			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
638				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
639			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
640				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
641			}
642			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
643		}
644		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
645		return b.String()
646	}
647	
648	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
649		rows := m.visibleFleet()
650		if len(rows) == 0 {
651			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
652				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
653			}
654			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
655				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
656			}
657			if !m.showLocalFleet {
658				for _, row := range m.fleet {
659					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
660						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
661					}
662				}
663			}
664			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
665		}
666		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
667		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
668		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
669		if pathW < 12 {
670			pathW = 12
671		}
672		var b strings.Builder
673		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
674			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
675		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
676		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
677			row := rows[i]
678			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
679			if row.Repository != nil {
680				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
681				if row.Repository.Live {
682					live = row.Repository.Runtime
683					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
684						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
685					}
686				}
687				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
688			}
689			state := string(row.State)
690			if row.FromCache {
691				state = "stale"
692			}
693			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
694				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
695				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
696			styled := line
697			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
698				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
699			} else if row.State != "ok" {
700				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
701			}
702			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
703		}

707	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {

718				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"

722	
723		var headers []string
724		var values func(agentskill.Skill) []string
725		switch {
726		case m.width >= 110:
727			repoW, scopeW, skillW, installW, updateW, agentW := 16, 7, 20, 9, 10, 20
728			sourceW := max(12, m.width-96)
729			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW), fitCell("SOURCE", sourceW)}
730			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
731				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW), fitCell(skillSource(row), sourceW)}
732			}
733		case m.width >= 82:
734			repoW, scopeW, installW, updateW := 16, 7, 9, 10
735			flex := max(28, m.width-54)
736			skillW, agentW := flex/2, flex-flex/2
737			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW)}
738			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
739				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW)}
740			}
741		default:
742			repoW, updateW := 14, 10
743			skillW := max(12, m.width-30)
744			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW)}
745			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
746				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW)}
747			}
748		}
749	
750		var b strings.Builder
751		if state.loading {
752			message := "Showing installed skills while refreshing…"
753			if m.skillsChecking {
754				message = "Showing installed skills while checking sources…"
755			}
756			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render(message) + "\n")
757		}
758		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
759		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
760		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
761			row := rows[i]
762			line := strings.Join(values(row), "  ")
763			styled := line
764			switch row.UpdateStatus {
765			case agentskill.UpdateAvailable, agentskill.UpdateMissing, agentskill.UpdateFailed:
766				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
767			case agentskill.UpdateCurrent:
768				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
769			case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
770				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
771			}
772			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
773		}
774		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
775		return b.String()
776	}

863	func dashCell(value string) string {
864		if value == "" {
865			return "—"
866		}
867		return value
868	}
869	
870	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
871		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
872		for _, policy := range row.Policies {
873			part := string(policy.Kind)
874			if policy.Value != "" {
875				part += ":" + policy.Value
876			}
877			if policy.Count > 0 {
878				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
879			}
880			parts = append(parts, part)
881		}
882		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
883	}
884	
885	func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration, maxWidth int) string {
886		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
887		for index, credential := range row.Credentials {
888			part := string(credential.Kind)
889			if credential.Name != "" {
890				part += ":" + credential.Name
891			}
892			candidate := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), parts...), part), ", ")
893			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > maxWidth {
894				remaining := len(row.Credentials) - index
895				if len(parts) == 0 {
896					if remaining == 1 {
897						return pad(part, maxWidth)
898					}
899					return pad(fmt.Sprintf("%s, +%d", part, remaining-1), maxWidth)
900				}
901				return pad(strings.Join(parts, ", ")+fmt.Sprintf(", +%d", remaining), maxWidth)
902			}
903			parts = append(parts, part)
904		}
905		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
906	}

908	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
909		var parts []string
910		for _, item := range []struct {
911			label string
912			n     int
913		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
914			if item.n > 0 {
915				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
916			}
917		}
918		if len(parts) == 0 {
919			return "—"
920		}
921		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
922	}

955	
956	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
957		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
958			return "—"
959		}
960		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
961		switch {
962		case d < 24*time.Hour:
963			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
964		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
965			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
966		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
967			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
968		default:
969			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
970		}
971	}

1000	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
1001		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
1002		if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
1003			fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
1004		}
1005		avail := m.width - fixed
1006		if avail < 40 {
1007			avail = 40
1008		}
1009		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1010		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1011		next = avail - name - branch
1012		if next < 10 {
1013			next = 10
1014		}
1015		return name, branch, next
1016	}

1018	// renderDetail shows what does not fit in the table — the reason to have a
1019	// dashboard rather than a listing.
1020	func (m Model) renderDetail() string {
1021		switch m.mode {
1022		case modeFilter:
1023			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("filter ") + m.input.View() +
1024				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to keep it · esc to clear")
1025		case modeEditNext:
1026			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("next action ") + m.input.View() +
1027				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to save · esc to cancel")
1028		case modeConfirmPark:
1029			row, _ := m.currentTask()
1030			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("park "+row.Task.Title()) +
1031				"\n  next: " + m.input.View() +
1032				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to park (session closes, worktree stays) · esc to cancel")
1033		case modeStartTask:
1034			r, _ := m.currentRepo()
1035			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("start work in "+r.Repo.Name) +
1036				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
1037				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to create the branch, worktree and session · esc to cancel")
1038		case modeStartDirect:
1039			r, _ := m.currentRepo()
1040			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("track direct work in "+r.Repo.Name) +
1041				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
1042				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to track the current branch; no branch/worktree is created · esc to cancel")
1043		case modeConfirmClone:
1044			r := m.remoteClonePrompt
1045			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("clone "+r.Repo.FullName) +
1046				"\n  to: " + contract(filepath.Join("<project_root>", r.Repo.Name)) +
1047				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter clone and stay · o clone and open · esc cancel")
1048		case modeConfirmSkillUpdate:
1049			row := m.skillUpdateTarget
1050			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("update "+string(row.Scope)+" skill "+row.Name) +
1051				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to update this skill · esc to cancel")
1052		case modeCopy:
1053			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("copy ") +
1054				"y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths" +
1055				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("press a second key · esc to cancel")
1056		}
1057	
1058		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
1059			lines := []string{
1060				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("host"), row.Host),
1061				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("state"), row.State),
1062			}
1063			if row.Repository != nil {
1064				lines = append(lines,
1065					fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("path"), contract(row.Repository.Path)),
1066					fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("branch"), row.Repository.Branch),
1067					fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("git  "), row.Repository.Status.Breakdown()),
1068				)
1069				if len(row.Repository.RemoteIdentities) > 0 {
1070					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("remote"), strings.Join(row.Repository.RemoteIdentities, ", ")))
1071				}
1072				if row.Repository.Live {
1073					live := strings.TrimSpace(row.Repository.Runtime + " " + row.Repository.RuntimeHandle)
1074					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
1075						live += " · " + row.Repository.AgentStatus
1076					}
1077					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("live"), styleLive.Render(live)))
1078				}
1079			}
1080			if row.Error != "" {
1081				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("note "), styleDrift.Render(row.Error)))
1082			}
1083			return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
1084		}
1085		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
1086			lines := []string{
1087				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("repo"), dashCell(row.Repository)),
1088				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("scope "), row.Scope),
1089				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("agent "), row.Agent),
1090				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("config"), contract(row.ConfigPath)),
1091				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("source"), mcpSource(row)),
1092				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("state "), mcpDeclarationState(row)),
1093				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("type  "), row.Transport),
1094			}
1095			if row.LocalProjectPath != "" {
1096				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("project"), contract(row.LocalProjectPath)))
1097			}
1098			if row.Required != nil {
1099				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %t", styleDim.Render("required"), *row.Required))
1100			}
1101			if row.Trusted != nil {
1102				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %t", styleDim.Render("trusted "), *row.Trusted))
1103			}
1104			if summary := mcpPolicySummary(row); summary != "" {
1105				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("policies"), summary))
1106			}
1107			if row.Endpoint != "" {
1108				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("target"), row.Endpoint))
1109			}
1110			if row.Command != "" {
1111				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("command"), row.Command))
1112			}

1115			}

1117			if summary := mcpCredentialSummary(row, credentialWidth); summary != "" {
1118				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("credentials"), summary))
1119			}
1120			if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
1121				parts := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
1122				for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
1123					parts[i] = string(redaction)
1124				}
1125				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("redacted"), strings.Join(parts, ", ")))
1126			}
1127			if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
1128				parts := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
1129				for i, item := range row.Coverage {
1130					parts[i] = string(item.Code)
1131				}

1133			}
1134			return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
1135		}
1136		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
1137			lines := []string{
1138				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("scope  "), row.Scope),
1139				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("root   "), contract(row.ScopeRoot)),
1140				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("path   "), contract(row.Path)),
1141				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("managed"), row.ManagedBy),
1142				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("agents "), strings.Join(row.Agents, ", ")),
1143				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("update "), row.UpdateStatus),
1144			}
1145			if row.Source != "" {
1146				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("source "), row.Source))
1147			}
1148			if row.SourceURL != "" {
1149				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("url    "), row.SourceURL))
1150			}
1151			if row.UpdateDetail != "" {

1153			}
1154			return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
1155		}
1156	
1157		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
1158			lines := []string{
1159				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("path"), contract(r.Item.Live.CurrentPath)),
1160				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s · %s", styleDim.Render("state"), r.Item.Phase, r.Where()),
1161			}
1162			lines = append(lines, sizeDetailLines(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)...)
1163			if r.Item.Live.Status != nil && r.Item.Live.Status.Dirty() {
1164				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("git  "), r.Item.Live.Status.Breakdown()))
1165				if types := r.Item.Live.Status.TypeBreakdown(); types != "" {
1166					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("types"), types))
1167				}
1168			} else if r.Item.Live.Repo != nil {
1169				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("git  "), tryGitSummary(r)))
1170			}
1171			if r.Item.Live.Repo != nil {
1172				if r.TopologyErr != nil {
1173					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("remote"), styleErr.Render("unknown: "+r.TopologyErr.Error())))
1174				} else {
1175					remoteSummary := r.Topology.Summary()
1176					if !r.Topology.HasRemote() {
1177						remoteSummary = styleDrift.Render(remoteSummary + " — local Git has no remote backup")
1178					}
1179					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("remote"), remoteSummary))

1525	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1526	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1527	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1528		if width < 20 {
1529			width = 20
1530		}
1531		var lines []string
1532		cur := ""
1533		for _, it := range items {
1534			candidate := it
1535			if cur != "" {
1536				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1537			}
1538			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1539				lines = append(lines, cur)
1540				cur = it
1541				continue
1542			}
1543			cur = candidate
1544		}
1545		if cur != "" {
1546			lines = append(lines, cur)
1547		}
1548		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1549	}

1568	func shortAge(r inventory.Row) string {
1569		d := r.Age()
1570		switch {
1571		case d <= 0:
1572			return "—"
1573		case d.Hours() < 24:
1574			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
1575		case d.Hours() < 24*14:
1576			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
1577		case d.Hours() < 24*60:
1578			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1579		default:
1580			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1581		}
1582	}
1583	
1584	func colourState(s task.State, line string) string {
1585		switch s {
1586		case task.Hot:
1587			return styleHot.Render(line)
1588		case task.Warm:
1589			return styleWarm.Render(line)
1590		case task.Cold:
1591			return styleCold.Render(line)
1592		case task.Done:
1593			return styleDone.Render(line)
1594		}
1595		return line
1596	}
1597	
1598	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1599	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1600	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1601		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1602			return s
1603		}
1604		var b strings.Builder
1605		used := 0
1606		for _, r := range s {
1607			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1608			if used+w > n-1 {
1609				break
1610			}
1611			b.WriteRune(r)
1612			used += w
1613		}
1614		return b.String() + "…"
1615	}
1616	
1617	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
1618		if v < lo {
1619			return lo
1620		}
1621		if v > hi {
1622			return hi
1623		}
1624		return v
1625	}
```

```text
153	func (m Model) focusOverlayField(index int) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
154		if m.overlay.fieldCount == 0 {
155			return m, nil
156		}
157		if index < 0 {
158			index = m.overlay.fieldCount - 1
159		}
160		if index >= m.overlay.fieldCount {

162		}
163		for fieldIndex := 0; fieldIndex < m.overlay.fieldCount; fieldIndex++ {
164			m.overlay.fields[fieldIndex].input.Blur()

170	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
171		switch m.overlay.kind {
172		case overlayHelp:
173			switch message.String() {
174			case "esc", "?", "q":
175				m.overlay = overlayState{}
176			}
177			return m, nil
178	
179		case overlayTryMenu:
180			switch message.String() {
181			case "esc", "q":
182				m.overlay = overlayState{}
183				return m, nil
184			case "j", "down":
185				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
186					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
187				}
188				return m, nil
189			case "k", "up":
190				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
191					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
192				}
193				return m, nil
194			case "enter":
195				if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
196					return m, nil
197				}
198				action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
199				row := m.overlay.target
200				switch action {
201				case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
202					return m.openTryForm(action, row)
203				case TryArchive:
204					return m.openTryConfirmation(action, row)
205				case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
206					m.overlay = overlayState{}
207					m.status = string(action) + " in progress…"
208					return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: action, ID: row.Item.ID})
209				}
210			}
211			return m, nil
212	
213		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
214			switch message.String() {
215			case "esc":
216				m.overlay = overlayState{}
217				m.err = nil
218				return m, nil
219			case "tab", "down":
220				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
221			case "shift+tab", "up":
222				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
223			case "enter":
224				return m.submitTryOverlay()
225			}
226			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
227			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
228			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
229			return m, command
230		}
231		return m, nil
232	}
233	
234	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
235		value := func(key string) string {
236			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
237				if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
238					return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
239				}
240			}
241			return ""
242		}
243		if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
244			row := m.overlay.repoTarget
245			tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
246			note := value("note")
247			m.overlay = overlayState{}
248			m.err = nil
249			m.status = "updating repository metadata…"
250			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
251		}
252	
253		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
254		switch m.overlay.action {
255		case TryCreate:
256			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
257			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
258				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
259				return m, nil
260			}
261			gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
262			if !ok {
263				m.err = fmt.Errorf("git init must be yes or no")
264				return m, nil
265			}
266			request.NoGit = !gitInit
267		case TryMark:
268			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
269			request.Note = value("note")
270		case TryRestore:
271			request.To = value("to")
272		case TryGraduate:
273			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
274		case TryArchive:
275			if value("confirm") != "YES" {
276				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
277				return m, nil
278			}
279		default:
280			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
281			return m, nil
282		}
283		m.overlay = overlayState{}
284		m.err = nil
285		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
286		return m, m.applyTry(request)
287	}

289	func (m Model) renderOverlay() string {
290		var builder strings.Builder
291		builder.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  "+strings.ToUpper(m.overlay.title)) + "\n\n")
292		switch m.overlay.kind {
293		case overlayHelp:
294			builder.WriteString("  navigation\n")
295			builder.WriteString("    j/k, arrows move · ctrl+d/u page · g/G first/last · tab/h/l switch view\n")
296			builder.WriteString("    / filter · 0 clear · r reload · esc close/clear/quit · q quit\n\n")
297			builder.WriteString("  TASKS   enter open · n add note · N notes · p park · c next · 1/2/3 state · a done\n")
298			builder.WriteString("  REPOS   enter open · n add note · N notes · space worktrees · m metadata · y copy · s worktree task · d direct task · O/R sort\n")
299			builder.WriteString("  FLEET   enter Herdr/SSH open · e edit remotes.toml · r refresh · read-only Git overview\n")
300			builder.WriteString("  TRY     enter open · n create · space actions · a history · O/R sort\n")
301			builder.WriteString("  REMOTE  enter open local · n/N notes when cloned · c clone (enter stay / o open)\n")
302			builder.WriteString("  SKILLS  a interactive add · c check updates · u update selected\n")
303			builder.WriteString("  MCP     static declarations only · r reload\n\n")
304			builder.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render("? / esc / q close help"))
305	
306		case overlayTryMenu:
307			builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n  %s\n\n", m.overlay.target.Item.DisplayName(), contract(m.overlay.target.Item.Live.CurrentPath)))
308			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.optionCount; index++ {
309				prefix := "  "
310				line := fmt.Sprintf("%-12s %s", m.overlay.options[index], m.overlay.optionLabels[index])
311				if index == m.overlay.optionIndex {
312					prefix = "▸ "
313					line = styleSelected.Render(line)
314				}
315				builder.WriteString(prefix + line + "\n")
316			}
317			builder.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("j/k choose · enter continue · esc cancel"))
318	
319		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
320			if m.overlay.target.Item.ID != "" {
321				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n  %s\n\n", m.overlay.target.Item.DisplayName(), contract(m.overlay.target.Item.Live.CurrentPath)))
322			} else if m.overlay.repoTarget.Repo.Path != "" {
323				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  %s\n  %s\n\n", m.overlay.repoTarget.Repo.Display(), contract(m.overlay.repoTarget.Repo.Path)))
324			}
325			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
326				marker := "  "
327				if index == m.overlay.fieldIndex {
328					marker = "▸ "
329				}
330				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s%-10s %s\n", marker, m.overlay.fields[index].label+":", m.overlay.fields[index].input.View()))
331			}
332			if m.err != nil {
333				builder.WriteString("\n  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()))
334			}
335			builder.WriteString("\n\n  " + styleHelp.Render("tab field · enter submit · esc cancel"))
336		}
337		return builder.String()
338	}
```

```text
23	// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
24	// much of it is currently in flight.
25	//
26	// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
27	// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
28	// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
29	// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
30	// RepoActions groups catalog metadata mutations for ordinary repositories.
31	type RepoActions struct {
32		Patch func(ctx context.Context, row RepoRow, tags []string, note string) (string, error)
33	}
34	
35	type RepoRow struct {
36		Repo        repo.Repo
37		Status      gitx.Status
38		Topology    gitx.RecoveryTopology
39		TopologyErr error
40		SizeTarget  diskusage.Target
41		Usage       *diskusage.Usage
42		SizeError   error
43		// Asset is catalog metadata joined without persisting an otherwise
44		// unobserved repository. A Try asset lets callers suppress or label it.
45		Asset *catalog.Entry
46		// Context is the canonical checkout plus every linked worktree, enriched
47		// with task and runtime state. It is shared by the tree, copy actions and
48		// `dev repo context`, so those surfaces cannot disagree.
49		Context inventory.RepoContext
50		// LastActivity is the newest commit time in this checkout. It is a durable,
51		// cheap approximation of "when was this repo last touched" and is sortable.
52		LastActivity time.Time
53		// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
54		Worktrees int
55		// Tasks are the recorded tasks belonging to this repository.
56		Tasks []*task.Task
57		// NoteCount/LatestNote are joined from the durable sidecar store when this
58		// repo already has a catalog identity.
59		NoteCount  int
60		LatestNote *note.Note
61		// Live reports a runtime session sitting in this repository.
62		Live          bool
63		Runtime       string
64		RuntimeHandle string
65		RuntimeStatus string
66		// RemoteForge / RemoteName identify origin for matching the REMOTE view to
67		// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.
68		RemoteForge forge.Kind
69		RemoteName  string
70	}

72	// Sessions returns every runtime session attached to any checkout in this
73	// repository.
74	func (r RepoRow) Sessions() []runtime.Session { return r.Context.Sessions() }

76	// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
77	// IsTry reports an ungraduated Try that should live in the dedicated TRY view,
78	// while remaining in the model's local snapshot for REMOTE matching.
79	func (r RepoRow) IsTry() bool {
80		return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Kind == catalog.KindTry && r.Asset.Experiment != nil &&
81			(r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated)
82	}

84	func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
85		n := 0
86		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
87			if t.State == task.Hot {
88				n++
89			}
90		}
91		return n
92	}

94	// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
95	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
96	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
97		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
98			return ""
99		}
100		counts := map[task.State]int{}
101		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
102			counts[t.State]++
103		}
104		var parts []string
105		for _, s := range task.States {
106			if counts[s] > 0 {
107				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
108			}
109		}
110		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
111	}

113	// searchText is what a filter query matches against.
114	func (r RepoRow) searchText() string {
115		var b strings.Builder
116		b.WriteString(r.Repo.Display())
117		b.WriteString(" ")
118		b.WriteString(r.Status.Branch)
119		b.WriteString(" ")
120		b.WriteString(r.Topology.Summary())
121		for _, branch := range r.Topology.Branches {
122			b.WriteString(" ")
123			b.WriteString(branch.Branch)
124			b.WriteString(" ")

127		if r.Asset != nil {

131			b.WriteString(r.Asset.Note)
132			b.WriteString(" ")
133			b.WriteString(strings.Join(r.Asset.Tags, " "))
134		}
135		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
136			b.WriteString(" ")
137			b.WriteString(t.Title())
138			b.WriteString(" ")
139			b.WriteString(t.Branch)
140		}
141		for _, checkout := range r.Context.Checkouts {
142			b.WriteString(" ")
143			b.WriteString(checkout.Worktree.Path)
144			b.WriteString(" ")
145			b.WriteString(checkout.Branch())
146			b.WriteString(" ")
147			b.WriteString(string(checkout.Ownership))
148		}
149		return strings.ToLower(b.String())

152	func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool {
153		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
154		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
155			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
156			if structured {
157				switch key {
158				case "tag":
159					if r.Asset == nil || !r.Asset.HasTag(value) {
160						return false
161					}
162					continue
163				case "remote":
164					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Topology.Summary()), value) {
165						return false
166					}
167					continue
168				case "size":
169					if !matchesSize(r.Usage, value) {
170						return false
171					}
172					continue
173				case "kind":
174					kind := catalog.KindRepository
175					if r.Asset != nil {
176						kind = r.Asset.Kind
177					}
178					if string(kind) != value {
179						return false
180					}
181					continue
182				}
183			}
184			if !strings.Contains(r.searchText(), term) {
185				return false
186			}
187		}
188		return true
189	}
```

```text
11	func (m Model) noteMode() bool {
12		return m.mode == modeNoteBrowse || m.mode == modeNoteAdd ||
13			m.mode == modeNoteSearch || m.mode == modeNoteConfirmDelete
14	}
15	
16	func (m Model) renderNotes() string {
17		var b strings.Builder
18		title := m.noteTarget.Name()
19		if title == "" {
20			title = "repository"
21		}
22		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s\n\n", styleTitle.Render(fmt.Sprintf("dev  NOTES  %s  ·  %d notes", title, len(m.notes))))
23	
24		switch m.mode {
25		case modeNoteAdd:
26			b.WriteString("  " + styleTitle.Render("quick thought") + "\n\n")
27			b.WriteString("  " + m.input.View() + "\n\n")
28			if m.err != nil {
29				b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n\n")
30			}
31			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render("enter save · esc cancel"))
32			return b.String()
33	
34		case modeNoteSearch:
35			b.WriteString("  " + styleTitle.Render("search") + "\n\n")
36			b.WriteString("  " + m.input.View() + "\n\n")
37			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render("enter search · esc clear and return"))
38			return b.String()
39	
40		case modeNoteConfirmDelete:
41			if n, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
42				b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("Delete note "+n.ID[:8]+"?") + "\n")
43				b.WriteString("  " + n.Preview(maxInt(20, m.width-6)) + "\n\n")
44			}
45			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render("y delete · n / esc cancel"))
46			return b.String()
47		}
48	
49		if m.noteQuery != "" {
50			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("search: "+m.noteQuery) + "\n\n")
51		}
52		if m.noteLoading {
53			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Loading notes…") + "\n")
54			return b.String()
55		}
56		if m.err != nil {
57			b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n")
58		}
59		if len(m.notes) == 0 {
60			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No notes. Press a or n to add one.") + "\n\n")
61			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render("a/n add · / search · N/esc back"))
62			return b.String()
63		}
64	
65		idW, whenW, tagsW := 8, 6, clamp(m.width/5, 10, 24)
66		thoughtW := m.width - idW - whenW - tagsW - 12
67		if thoughtW < 20 {
68			thoughtW = 20
69		}
70		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  %s  %s  %s  %s\n",
71			styleHeader.Render(fitCell("ID", idW)),
72			styleHeader.Render(fitCell("WHEN", whenW)),
73			styleHeader.Render(fitCell("TAGS", tagsW)),
74			styleHeader.Render(fitCell("THOUGHT", thoughtW)))
75	
76		maxRows := m.height - 11
77		if m.noteExpanded {
78			maxRows -= 6
79		}
80		if maxRows < 3 {
81			maxRows = 3
82		}
83		from, to := noteWindow(len(m.notes), m.noteCursor, maxRows)
84		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
85			n := m.notes[i]
86			tags := strings.Join(n.Tags, ",")
87			if tags == "" {
88				tags = "—"
89			}
90			line := strings.Join([]string{
91				fitCell(n.ID[:8], idW), fitCell(noteAge(n.Created), whenW),
92				fitCell(tags, tagsW), fitCell(n.Preview(thoughtW), thoughtW),
93			}, "  ")
94			if i == m.noteCursor {
95				b.WriteString(styleSelected.Render("▸ ") + styleSelected.Render(line) + "\n")
96			} else {
97				b.WriteString("  " + line + "\n")
98			}
99		}
100		if len(m.notes) > maxRows {
101			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  %s\n", styleDim.Render(fmt.Sprintf("… %d–%d of %d", from+1, to, len(m.notes))))
102		}
103		if m.noteExpanded {
104			if n, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
105				body := lipgloss.NewStyle().Width(maxInt(20, m.width-4)).Render(strings.TrimSpace(n.Body))
106				body = limitLines(body, maxInt(3, m.height/3))
107				b.WriteString("\n  " + styleDim.Render(n.ID+" · "+n.Updated.Format(time.RFC3339)) + "\n")
108				b.WriteString("  " + strings.ReplaceAll(body, "\n", "\n  ") + "\n")
109			}
110		}
111		b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("j/k move · / search · enter expand · a add · e edit · d delete · N/esc back"))
112		return b.String()
113	}
114	
115	func noteWindow(total, cursor, height int) (from, to int) {
116		if total <= height {
117			return 0, total
118		}
119		from = cursor - height/2
120		if from < 0 {
121			from = 0
122		}
123		if from+height > total {
124			from = total - height
125		}
126		return from, from + height
127	}
128	
129	func noteAge(created time.Time) string {
130		d := time.Since(created)
131		switch {
132		case d < time.Minute:
133			return "now"
134		case d < time.Hour:
135			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
136		case d < 24*time.Hour:
137			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
138		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
139			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
140		default:
141			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
142		}
143	}
144	
145	func limitLines(text string, limit int) string {
146		lines := strings.Split(text, "\n")
147		if len(lines) <= limit {
148			return text
149		}
150		return strings.Join(lines[:limit], "\n") + "\n…"
151	}
152	
153	func maxInt(a, b int) int {
154		if a > b {
155			return a
156		}
157		return b
158	}
```

```text
1	// Package tui is the interactive dashboard behind a bare `dev`.
2	//
3	// It renders the same inventory that `dev ls` prints, from the same
4	// inventory.Collect call, so the two can never disagree. Its job is the part a
5	// static listing cannot do: let you act on what you are looking at without
6	// retyping a task name.
7	package tui
8	
9	import (
10		"github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss"
11		"github.com/muesli/termenv"
12	)
13	
14	// Colours are chosen from the 256-colour cube rather than truecolour so the
15	// dashboard degrades sensibly in a basic terminal, and lipgloss adapts them to
16	// the background it detects.
17	var (
18		styleTitle = lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true)
19		styleDim   = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
20		styleHelp  = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
21		styleErr   = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("203"))
22		styleOK    = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("78"))
23	
24		styleSelected = lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true).Foreground(lipgloss.Color("81"))
25		styleHeader   = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true).Bold(true)
26	
27		styleHot  = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("209"))
28		styleWarm = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("179"))
29		styleCold = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("110"))
30		styleDone = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("78"))
31	
32		styleDirty = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("215"))
33		styleClean = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)
34		styleLive  = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("78"))
35		styleDrift = lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color("203"))
36	)
37	
38	// SetColorEnabled makes the dashboard honour dev's global --color flag, which
39	// previously stopped at the non-interactive commands: the styles below are
40	// package-level, but lipgloss resolves their colours through the default
41	// renderer at render time, so switching the profile before the program starts
42	// is enough to strip them.
43	func SetColorEnabled(enabled bool) {
44		if enabled {
45			lipgloss.SetColorProfile(termenv.ColorProfile())
46			return
47		}
48		lipgloss.SetColorProfile(termenv.Ascii)
49	}
50
```

1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
