5	`AGENTS.md` is the canonical repository guidance file. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to it; edit this file rather than replacing the symlink.
6	
7	## Toolchain and commands
8	
9	- Go 1.26.4 (from `go.mod`) builds the CLI. Python 3.11+ and `uv` are used only for the documentation site.
10	- `make` / `make all` runs `fmt -> vet -> test -> build`. `make fmt` runs `gofmt -w .` and therefore modifies files.
11	- There is no working `make lint` recipe even though `lint` appears in `.PHONY`. The repository's static gates are formatting and `go vet`.
12	
13	```bash
14	make build                         # build ./dev with git-derived version metadata
15	make test                          # go test ./...
16	go test -race ./...                # CI test command
17	go test ./internal/gitx -run '^TestAddWorktreeUsesExplicitBase$'  # one test
18	go test ./internal/cli -run '^TestName/Subtest$'                  # one subtest
19	make vet                           # go vet ./...
20	files="$(gofmt -l .)" && test -z "$files"  # format check that preserves gofmt failures
21	make e2e                           # real CLI lifecycle in an isolated temporary HOME
22	make skill-sync                    # regenerate command docs, then rebuild embedded skill
23	make skill-check                   # fail when command tree and generated skill reference drift
24	make install                       # binary under PREFIX; skill in user agent directories
25	```
26	
27	Documentation uses the same sequence as CI:
28	
29	```bash
30	uv sync --frozen --extra docs
31	uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --source
32	uv run mkdocs build --strict
33	uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --site site
34	```
35	
36	If generated `docs/llms*.txt` files drift, regenerate them with `uv run python scripts/check-docs.py --source --generate-llms` and then rerun the documentation checks.
37	
38	## Architecture
39	
40	The executable path is deliberately shallow:
41	
42	```text
43	cmd/dev/main.go
44	  -> cli.Execute()
45	  -> cli.NewRootCommandWithIO()
46	  -> App.Load()
47	  -> Cobra command handler
48	  -> domain package(s)
49	```
50	
51	`internal/cli` assembles commands, parses flags, invokes services, and renders output. Keep policy out of command handlers; it belongs in independently testable domain packages:
52	
53	- `config` owns defaults, TOML overlays, validation, and XDG paths.
54	- `gitx` is the Git porcelain boundary and canonicalizes repository identity through the shared Git common directory.
55	- `task` persists only human intent Git cannot derive: task mode/state, owner, next action, and runtime hints. Lifecycle callers use exact-record revisions and locked compare-and-update/delete transactions rather than treating a previously read task as current.
56	- `wt` owns managed linked-worktree creation, placement, provisioning plans, and safe removal. Runtimes never create or manage Git worktrees; they surface checkout or experiment paths selected and validated by the calling `dev` flow, including managed, external, or adopted worktrees and non-Git Try directories.
57	- `runtime` abstracts Herdr, tmux, Zellij, and the no-multiplexer backend. Handles are backend-qualified hints and must be checked against live checkout coverage before reuse.
58	- `taskflow` is the UI-agnostic lifecycle authority: it separates recorded intent, typed live observations, immutable guarded plans, approvals, and partial result ledgers. Apply locks and reloads task/Git/worktree/runtime/artifact/remote identity, then rejects stale authority before mutation.
59	- `repo` discovers and deduplicates repositories; `inventory` joins repositories, Git state, tasks, all registered worktrees, and live runtime data. CLI listings and UI projections consume this joined view.
60	- `flowtui` is an independent Bubble Tea model for the preview `dev flow` repository state-machine UI. It receives repository reads and taskflow Plan/Apply callbacks; do not embed it in or add a mode to the dashboard's `tui` model.
61	- `catalog` stores stable repository/Try identity and personal metadata. `experiment` owns Try creation, archive/restore, and graduation, including intent records and rollback/reconciliation around moves.
62	- `note` stores multiple repository thoughts as durable Markdown keyed by catalog ID and maintains a rebuildable SQLite FTS index. It is distinct from task context and the catalog's single metadata summary.
63	- `tui` owns Bubble Tea state/rendering only. `internal/cli/tui.go` injects callbacks to the same services used by non-interactive commands.
64	- `stats` is durable SQLite data; `diskusage`, note FTS, and forge/gitignore data are regenerable caches. Do not treat stats as cache.
65	- `forge` wraps optional `gh`, `glab`, and Azure CLI integrations and must degrade to local Git behavior when they are unavailable.
66	- `sshhost` owns bounded static discovery of the active user OpenSSH Include closure, canonical files under `~/.ssh/dev.d`, public-key selection/generation/bootstrap, fresh authentication proofs, and the explicit handoff into dev fleet. OpenSSH and plain `ssh -G` remain semantic authority; dev reads foreign host definitions but never rewrites them, copies private keys, weakens host-key policy, or treats every alias as a fleet member.
67	- `fleet` merges the user-authored primary `remotes.toml` with strict dev-owned `remotes.d/ssh-<alias>.toml` registrations. Remote `dev` state remains host-local. `remote_os` selects target semantics: POSIX uses the shell launcher, while Windows uses an encoded PowerShell launcher that accepts only hidden fleet helpers, preserves sync stdin, and never applies controller path rules to remote paths.
68	
69	The principal task start flow spans `internal/cli/start.go`, `start_flow.go`, `gitx`/`wt`, `runtime`, and `task`: resolve the canonical repository and explicit base, create or select the checkout, provision/open it, then persist and annotate the task. Task-backed park/resume/completion/retirement and exact unmanaged Adopt/Remove policy belong in `taskflow`; CLI commands, the dashboard, `sweep`, and `flowtui` are adapters. Preserve report-before-apply and no-data-loss ordering, including the isolated compatibility paths that have not migrated to taskflow.
70	
71	State is split intentionally:
72	
73	- Git remotes/branches are durable code truth.
74	- Worktrees are disposable local checkouts.
75	- Runtime sessions are per-host and re-derivable.
76	- Task TOML and catalog assets hold only intent/identity that Git cannot answer.
77	- Repository quick-note Markdown is durable sidecar data; `notes.db` is only its disposable search index.
78	- `stats.db` is durable observation data; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/*` is disposable.
79	- The user's OpenSSH configuration is durable connection truth. Dev owns only its exact top-level `Include ~/.ssh/dev.d/*.conf` and structurally valid fragments in `~/.ssh/dev.d`; key bootstrap sends public material only and has no private-key transfer or remote-key revocation lifecycle.
80	- Fleet intent is the merged primary `remotes.toml` plus generated sibling `remotes.d` fragments. A generated fragment exists only after explicit `dev ssh setup --fleet` and a fresh ordinary alias login; controller caches and each remote machine's paths/tasks/runtime remain re-derivable or host-local.
81	
82	## Behavioral contracts
83	
84	- Task modes are `worktree`, `branch`, and `direct`; lifecycle states are `hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done`. READY/REVIEW/MERGED/RETIRED are action readiness or result milestones, never extra persisted states.
85	- Persisted intent, observed facts, and guarded action plans are separate layers. Unknown, failed, skipped, loading, or stale observations never become a false clean/closed fact.
86	- Use an explicit base for branch/worktree creation. Do not infer a safe base from whichever branch happens to be checked out.
87	- Never nest a managed worktree inside a repository. Removing a worktree does not remove its branch, and dirty removal stays opt-in.
88	- Cold parking requires committed, pushed, reconstructible work before runtime/worktree cleanup.
89	- A taskflow Plan is bound to the exact task revision and repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact identities shown at Plan time. Apply must lock, reload, and revalidate those identities; a changed revision or authority produces a stale-plan result with no new effect.
90	- Managed rows receive only legal mode/state lifecycle actions. An unmanaged linked checkout may be adopted by metadata-only task creation or removed only when exact, clean, unclaimed, non-harness, and branch-preserving; canonical, harness-owned, ambiguous/conflicting, locked, prunable, or incompletely observed rows fail closed for destructive actions.
91	- Local repository refresh must not contact remotes. Fetching refs and querying a forge are explicit network actions, and review evidence is run-local manual evidence limited to portable existence/state/draft/URL/provider/time fields; never infer review decisions or checks.
92	- Reconciliation flows such as `sweep`, command-level `adopt`, and bootstrap organization plans report before applying changes. Direct actions such as `wt rm`, `tries archive`, and `cache clear` mutate immediately after their own safety checks; do not treat them as previews. `dev flow` is plan-first regardless of the adapted command's normal CLI interaction.
93	- Raw Git and configured external tools remain outside dev-mediated locks, revalidation, and safety guarantees. Existing expert CLI flags remain compatibility surface even when the preview flow deliberately omits them.
94	- A recognized agent in a canonical checkout occupies it regardless of whether its status is working, idle, done, or unknown. Shared-writer overrides require coordinated disjoint ownership.
95	- A parallel launch target is only the exact root pane returned for a newly created first-class Herdr worktree; reused/fallback/unverified surfaces fail closed.
96	- `dev ls --json` is an external automation contract. Add fields rather than renaming/removing existing fields; apply the same compatibility care to other documented structured output.
97	- Quick notes attach to the canonical repository through catalog identity. Markdown is durable, note deletion requires confirmation, and clearing/rebuilding note FTS must never delete source files.
98	- SSH initialization is report-before-apply; managed host changes are confined to canonical dev-owned fragments. Full bootstrap requires an explicit existing key or explicit generation, registers fleet only behind `--fleet`, and reports interrupted remote installation as unknown rather than pretending to roll it back.
99	- Filesystem transitions must retain path traversal/symlink, same-filesystem, source revalidation, and rollback/reconciliation checks.
100	
101	## Versioning and changelog
102	
103	The current published baseline is `v0.2.4` (2026-09-01). The CLI version authority is an immutable `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` Git tag:
104	
105	- `Makefile` derives development builds with `git describe --tags --match 'v[0-9]*' --always --dirty` and injects `internal/cli.Version` through `-ldflags`. The `--match` filter is load-bearing: any other tag in the repository (a `backup/` or `rescue/` marker, say) must never become `--version`.
106	- `go install ...@version` recovers the module version from Go build information.
107	- `pyproject.toml` version `0.0.0` belongs only to the MkDocs environment and is not the CLI version.
108	
109	Every user-visible feature must be added to `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` as part of the feature change. Do not publish or describe a feature build under an older release's version; a release containing new compatible behavior must receive a newer version. Decide from public compatibility impact rather than blindly from the commit type.
110	
111	**When to release.** A tag is not an occasional ceremony; it is how a downstream binary learns it is stale. `go install ...@latest` resolves to the newest tag, so anything merged but untagged is invisible outside this repository.
112	
113	- A landed branch that stands alone is released immediately: bump the patch during `0.x` (`v0.1.x`) and tag it as the last step of landing.
114	- A landed branch belonging to an announced milestone accumulates in `[Unreleased]`; the milestone closes with a minor bump (`v0.2.0`).
115	- Never let `[Unreleased]` grow past one milestone's worth of work. `v0.1.0` to `v0.1.11` were tagged retroactively on 2026-08-29 precisely because 38 commits accumulated with no release.
116	
117	**What downstream gets.** Every release from `v0.2.0` forward publishes platform binaries and `SHA256SUMS` alongside the GitHub release, and `dev doctor` reports the running version so a user can compare without leaving the terminal. A release that ships neither leaves `dev --version` as the only signal, which is what the freshness work exists to fix.
118	
119	For a release:
120	
121	1. Move the relevant `[Unreleased]` entries into `## [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD` and update comparison links.
122	2. Update version-pinned install examples when the documented recommended release changes.
123	3. Push `main` first. `release.yml` asserts the tagged commit is an ancestor of `origin/main`, so a tag pushed ahead of its branch fails validation.
124	4. Tag the exact commit on `main` as `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`; never move or reuse a published tag. Never push `backup/*` or `rescue/*` tags — a tag reachable from a commit that predates the `--match` filter breaks the workflow's `./dev --version` assertion.
125	5. Let `.github/workflows/release.yml` run CI, verify `./dev --version`, build the platform matrix, create the GitHub release, and publish the matching Homebrew formula. The repository secret `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` must be a fine-grained token with Contents write access to `daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap`; a tap publication failure fails the release job so it can be retried instead of leaving Homebrew users stale.
126	
127	If the Homebrew step needs a retry or an older stable release needs a one-time backfill, run `gh workflow run publish-homebrew.yml -f version=vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. The manual workflow verifies that the release exists and republishes only the formula; it does not create or move a tag or GitHub release.
128	
129	Stable release tags only are accepted by the current workflow; prerelease tags are not supported.
130	
131	## Keep implementation, skill, and docs aligned
132	
133	`internal/skill/dev-cli/` is shipped product surface, not incidental prose: `internal/skill/skill.go` embeds the entire tree in the binary. A code change is incomplete when the bundled skill or public documentation still describes old behavior.
134	
135	| Change | Required synchronization |
136	|---|---|
137	| Cobra command name, `Use`, `Short`, flag, or global option | Run `make skill-sync`, inspect `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/commands.md`, then run `make skill-check`. Never edit the generated block by hand. |
138	| Task modes/states/defaults or lifecycle preconditions | Update `SKILL.md`, `references/task-lifecycle.md`, README, embedded help, relevant English and zh-TW workflow/mental-model/compatibility pages, and transition tests. |
139	| Worktree placement, provisioning, include rules, strategies, or safety checks | Update `references/worktree-ownership.md`, README/public worktree docs, config examples, and focused `wt` tests. |
140	| Runtime protocol, fallback order, activation, agent collision, exact-pane launch, or cleanup behavior | Update `references/runtime-herdr.md`, `references/parallel-agents.md`, compatibility docs, and runtime/lifecycle tests. Keep the boundary clear: `dev start` prepares a checkout/runtime surface; it does not launch an agent. |
141	| Bootstrap scan/layout/index/move behavior | Update `references/bootstrap.md`, public bootstrap docs, and bootstrap tests. |
142	| Config fields/defaults or structured output | Update generated command help where applicable, authored reference pages and both locales, examples, and compatibility tests. |
143	| Quick-note storage, identity, search, structured output, or TUI behavior | Update README, embedded help, `SKILL.md`, `references/notes.md`, and paired English/zh-TW mental-model, workflow, TUI, commands/config, compatibility, and freshness pages. |
144	| Any user-visible feature or fix | Update `CHANGELOG.md`; update README/help/MkDocs/skill wherever they make the affected claim. |
145	
146	`make skill-check` proves only that generated command syntax matches the Cobra tree. It cannot detect drift in lifecycle semantics, JSON schemas, safety claims, examples, README, embedded help, or authored skill references; review those manually. Because the skill is compiled with `go:embed`, rebuild after any skill edit before testing the bundled output.
147	
148	English and zh-TW MkDocs pages are maintained as a pair. Run the strict documentation checks above after changing either locale, navigation, snippets, or freshness metadata.

401	// New builds the dashboard.
402	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
403		in := textinput.New()
404		in.CharLimit = 200
405		cloneSpinner := spinner.MiniDot
406		cloneSpinner.FPS = 200 * time.Millisecond
407	
408		m := Model{
409			actions:            actions,
410			rows:               rows,
411			repos:              repos,
412			input:              in,
413			remoteCloneSpinner: spinner.New(spinner.WithSpinner(cloneSpinner)),
414			width:              100,
415			height:             30,
416			firstViewReady:     make(chan struct{}),
417			firstViewOnce:      &sync.Once{},
418		}
419		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
420			m.toolGeneration = 1
421		}
422		if rows != nil {
423			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
424		}
425		if repos != nil {
426			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
427		}
428		return m
429	}

153	func (m Model) focusOverlayField(index int) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
154		if m.overlay.fieldCount == 0 {
155			return m, nil
156		}
157		if index < 0 {
158			index = m.overlay.fieldCount - 1
159		}
160		if index >= m.overlay.fieldCount {
161			index = 0
162		}
163		for fieldIndex := 0; fieldIndex < m.overlay.fieldCount; fieldIndex++ {
164			m.overlay.fields[fieldIndex].input.Blur()
165		}

170	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
171		switch m.overlay.kind {
172		case overlayHelp:
173			switch message.String() {
174			case "esc", "?", "q":
175				m.overlay = overlayState{}
176			}
177			return m, nil
178	
179		case overlayTryMenu:
180			switch message.String() {
181			case "esc", "q":
182				m.overlay = overlayState{}
183				return m, nil
184			case "j", "down":
185				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
186					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
187				}
188				return m, nil
189			case "k", "up":
190				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
191					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
192				}
193				return m, nil
194			case "enter":
195				if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
196					return m, nil
197				}
198				action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
199				row := m.overlay.target
200				switch action {
201				case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
202					return m.openTryForm(action, row)
203				case TryArchive:
204					return m.openTryConfirmation(action, row)
205				case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
206					m.overlay = overlayState{}
207					m.status = string(action) + " in progress…"
208					return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: action, ID: row.Item.ID})
209				}
210			}
211			return m, nil
212	
213		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
214			switch message.String() {
215			case "esc":
216				m.overlay = overlayState{}
217				m.err = nil
218				return m, nil
219			case "tab", "down":
220				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
221			case "shift+tab", "up":
222				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
223			case "enter":
224				return m.submitTryOverlay()
225			}
226			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
227			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
228			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
229			return m, command
230		}
231		return m, nil
232	}

234	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
235		value := func(key string) string {
236			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
237				if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
238					return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
239				}
240			}
241			return ""
242		}
243		if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
244			row := m.overlay.repoTarget
245			tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
246			note := value("note")
247			m.overlay = overlayState{}
248			m.err = nil
249			m.status = "updating repository metadata…"
250			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
251		}
252	
253		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
254		switch m.overlay.action {
255		case TryCreate:
256			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
257			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
258				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
259				return m, nil
260			}
261			gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
262			if !ok {
263				m.err = fmt.Errorf("git init must be yes or no")
264				return m, nil
265			}
266			request.NoGit = !gitInit
267		case TryMark:
268			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
269			request.Note = value("note")
270		case TryRestore:
271			request.To = value("to")
272		case TryGraduate:
273			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
274		case TryArchive:
275			if value("confirm") != "YES" {
276				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
277				return m, nil
278			}
279		default:
280			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
281			return m, nil
282		}
283		m.overlay = overlayState{}
284		m.err = nil
285		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
286		return m, m.applyTry(request)
287	}

Selection is index-based per tab, and visible-row derivation is the key abstraction that keeps filtering, sorting, cursor clamping, rendering, and actions aligned; I’m now tracing those helpers and every dispatch priority in `Update`.

2790	
2791	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2792		n := m.count()
2793		page := m.listHeight() / 2
2794		if page < 1 {
2795			page = 1
2796		}
2797	
2798		if m.remoteClone.active() {
2799			if msg.String() == "q" || msg.String() == "ctrl+c" {
2800				if !m.remoteClone.canceling {
2801					m.remoteClone.canceling = true
2802					if m.remoteClone.cancel != nil {
2803						m.remoteClone.cancel()
2804					}
2805				}
2806				return m, nil
2807			}
2808			switch msg.String() {
2809			case "j", "down", "ctrl+n", "k", "up", "ctrl+p",
2810				"ctrl+d", "pgdown", "ctrl+u", "pgup", "g", "home", "G", "end",
2811				"tab", "l", "right", "shift+tab", "h", "left", "/", "0":
2812				// Navigation and filtering remain available while the mutation runs.
2813			case "esc":
2814				if m.filter == "" && len(m.states) == 0 {
2815					return m, nil
2816				}
2817			default:
2818				return m, nil
2819			}
2820		}
2821	
2822		switch msg.String() {
2823		case "q", "ctrl+c":
2824			m.quitting = true
2825			return m, tea.Quit
2826		case "esc":
2827			// One escape clears whatever narrowing is in effect before quitting
2828			// becomes the meaning of the key.
2829			if m.filter != "" || len(m.states) > 0 {
2830				m.filter, m.states = "", nil
2831				m.setAt(0)
2832				return m, nil
2833			}
2834			m.quitting = true
2835			return m, tea.Quit
2836	
2837		// Vim-style movement, with the arrow equivalents alongside.
2838		case "j", "down", "ctrl+n":
2839			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
2840		case "k", "up", "ctrl+p":
2841			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
2842		case "ctrl+d", "pgdown":
2843			m.setAt(m.at() + page)
2844		case "ctrl+u", "pgup":
2845			m.setAt(m.at() - page)
2846		case "g", "home":
2847			m.setAt(0)
2848		case "G", "end":
2849			m.setAt(n - 1)
2850	
2851		// View switching. h/l double as left/right between views, since a list has
2852		// no horizontal axis of its own.
2853		case "tab", "l", "right":
2854			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+1)%len(Views)]
2855			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2856		case "shift+tab", "h", "left":
2857			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+len(Views)-1)%len(Views)]
2858			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2859	
2860		case "/":
2861			m.mode = modeFilter
2862			m.input.SetValue(m.filter)
2863			m.input.Placeholder = "filter"
2864			m.input.CursorEnd()
2865			m.input.Focus()
2866			return m, textinput.Blink
2867	
2868		case "?":
2869			return m.openHelpOverlay(), nil
2870	
2871		case "n":
2872			if m.view == ViewTries {
2873				return m.openTryForm(TryCreate, TryRow{})
2874			}
2875			if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
2876				return m.openNoteAdd(target, false)
2877			}
2878			return m, nil
2879	
2880		case "N":
2881			if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
2882				return m.openNotes(target)
2883			}
2884			return m, nil
2885	
2886		case "r":
2887			if m.view == ViewFleet {

3572	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
3573		fresh := valid && err == nil
3574		var commands []tea.Cmd
3575		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
3576			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
3577				continue
3578			}
3579			state := m.viewLoad(view)
3580			if state.loading || m.view == view {
3581				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
3582				if fresh {
3583					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
3584					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
3585					continue
3586				}
3587				dependencyErr := err
3588				if dependencyErr == nil {
3589					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
3590				}
3591				current := m.viewLoad(view)
3592				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
3593				continue
3594			}
3595			if state.hasSnapshot {
3596				m.invalidateView(view)
3597			}
3598		}
3599		return batchCommands(commands...)
3600	}

3821			}

3832				}

3834				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3835			}

3837		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {

3841				}

3844		}
3845		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
3846			if !r.Cloned() {

3848			}
3849			return func() tea.Msg {
3850				opened, err := m.actions.OpenRemote(context.Background(), r)
3851				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3852			}
3853		}
3854		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil && m.actions.OpenFleet != nil {

3856			if err != nil {

3862				}

3865		}
3866		return nil
3867	}

3869	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
3870	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
3871	// the dashboard is displaying.
3872	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
3873		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
3874			if t.Key != key {
3875				continue
3876			}
3877			if t.Probe != nil && t.Availability != ToolAvailable {
3878				detail := "availability is still being checked"
3879				if t.Availability == ToolUnavailable {
3880					detail = "is not installed"
3881				}
3882				return func() tea.Msg {
3883					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s %s", t.Command[0], detail)}
3884				}
3885			}
3886			dir := m.currentDir()
3887			if dir == "" {
3888				return func() tea.Msg {
3889					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
3890				}
3891			}
3892			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
3893			c.Dir = dir
3894			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
3895				if err != nil {
3896					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)}
3897				}
3898				return actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name, forceSizes: true}
3899			})
3900		}
3901		return nil
3902	}

3911			}
3912		}
3913		return out

431	// WithTrace observes performance boundaries without controlling model state.

443	// WithRemotes seeds the lazy forge view from a fresh on-disk cache. The first
444	// switch is then instant; r still refreshes explicitly.
445	func (m Model) WithRemotes(rows []RemoteRow) Model {
446		m.replaceRemotes(rows)
447		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRemote, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
448		return m

464	}

691	func batchCommands(commands ...tea.Cmd) tea.Cmd {
692		filtered := commands[:0]
693		for _, command := range commands {
694			if command != nil {
695				filtered = append(filtered, command)
696			}
697		}
698		switch len(filtered) {
699		case 0:
700			return nil
701		case 1:
702			return filtered[0]
703		default:
704			return tea.Batch(filtered...)
705		}
706	}

750	func (m Model) probeTools() tea.Cmd {
751		generation := m.toolGeneration
752		tools := append([]Tool(nil), m.actions.Tools...)
753		ctx := m.baseContext()
754		return func() tea.Msg {
755			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTools, perftrace.Fields{Generation: generation})
756			jobs := make(chan int, len(tools))
757			for index := range tools {
758				jobs <- index
759			}
760			close(jobs)
761			var workers sync.WaitGroup
762			for range min(2, len(tools)) {
763				workers.Go(func() {
764					for index := range jobs {
765						available := true
766						if tools[index].Probe != nil {
767							available = tools[index].Probe(ctx)
768						}
769						if ctx.Err() != nil {
770							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnknown
771						} else if available {
772							tools[index].Availability = ToolAvailable
773						} else {
774							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnavailable
775						}
776					}
777				})
778			}
779			workers.Wait()
780			finish(traceOutcome(ctx.Err()))
781			return toolsMsg{generation: generation, tools: tools}
782		}
783	}

799				out.rows, out.rowsErr = m.actions.Reload(ctx)
800				out.rowsSet, out.rowsValid = true, snapshotValid(out.rows, out.rowsErr)
801				finish(traceOutcome(out.rowsErr))

805				out.repos, out.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(ctx)

812				out.triesSet, out.triesValid = true, snapshotValid(out.tries, out.triesErr)

19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
20	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

136	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
137		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
138		if d < time.Hour {
139			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
140		}
141		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)

144	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
145	// is another one — is never in doubt.
146	func (m Model) renderHeader() string {
147		build := func(compact, summary bool) string {
148			short := map[View]string{
149				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
150				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
151			}
152			var tabs []string
153			for _, view := range Views {
154				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
155				if compact {
156					name = short[view]
157				}
158				label := name
159				if !compact {
160					label = " " + name + " "
161				}
162				if view == m.view {
163					tabs = append(tabs, styleSelected.Render(label))
164				} else {
165					tabs = append(tabs, styleDim.Render(label))
166				}
167			}
168			line := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + strings.Join(tabs, styleDim.Render("│"))
169			if summary {
170				line += "   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary())
171			}
172			if m.filter != "" {
173				line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter)
174			}
175			return line
176		}
177		line := build(false, true)
178		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
179			line = build(false, false)
180		}
181		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
182			line = build(true, false)
183		}
184		if lipgloss.Width(line) > m.width {
185			line = styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + styleSelected.Render(strings.ToUpper(m.view.String()))
186			if m.filter != "" {
187				available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(line) - 4
188				if available > 1 {
189					line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
190				}
191			}
192		}
193		return line + "\n"
194	}

196	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
197	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
198	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
199		h := m.listHeight()
200		if n <= h {
201			return 0, n
202		}
203		from = m.at() - h/2
204		if from < 0 {
205			from = 0
206		}
207		if from+h > n {
208			from = n - h
209		}
210		return from, from + h
211	}

312	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
313		r := item.Repo
314		checkout, child := item.checkout()
315		if !child {
316			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
317				marker := "▸ "
318				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
319					marker = "▾ "
320				}
321				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
322			}
323			if name == "live" {
324				return parentLiveColumn(r)
325			}
326			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
327		}
328	
329		switch name {
330		case "repo":
331			connector := "├─ "
332			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
333				connector = "└─ "
334			}
335			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
336			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
337				label = checkout.Branch()
338			}
339			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
340				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
341			}
342			return connector + label
343		case "branch":
344			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
345				return branch
346			}
347			return "(detached)"
348		case "git":
349			switch {
350			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
351				return "prunable"
352			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
353				return "locked"
354			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
355				return "?"
356			default:
357				return checkout.Status.Summary()
358			}
359		case "live":
360			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
361		case "latest":
362			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
363		case "worktrees":
364			return "—"
365		case "tasks":
366			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
367				return "?"
368			}
369			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
370		case "notes":
371			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
372				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
373			}
374			return "—"
375		case "category":
376			return "—"
377		case "path":
378			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
379		}
380		return ""
381	}
382	
383	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
384		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
385			return "?"
386		}
387		sessions := r.Sessions()
388		if len(sessions) == 0 {
389			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
390		}
391		if len(sessions) > 1 {
392			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
393		}
394		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
395		if status != "" {
396			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
397		}
398		return r.Runtime
399	}
400	
401	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
402		if runtimeErr != nil {
403			return "?"
404		}
405		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
406			return "closed"
407		}
408		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
409			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
410		}
411		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
412			return runtimeName + ":" + status
413		}
414		return runtimeName
415	}
416	
417	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
418		if len(tasks) == 0 {
419			return "—"
420		}
421		counts := map[task.State]int{}
422		for _, t := range tasks {
423			counts[t.State]++
424		}
425		var parts []string
426		for _, state := range task.States {
427			if counts[state] > 0 {
428				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
429			}
430		}
431		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
432	}
433	
434	type repoColumnSpec struct {
435		name, header string
436		width, min   int
437	}
438	
439	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
440		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
441		if len(names) == 0 {
442			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
443		}
444		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
445			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
446			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
447			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
448			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
449			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
450			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
451			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
452			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
453			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
454			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
455			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
456			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
457		}
458		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
459		for _, name := range names {
460			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
461				columns = append(columns, c)
462			}
463		}
464		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
465		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
466		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
467		for _, c := range columns {
468			total += c.width
469		}
470		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
471			for i := range columns {
472				if columns[i].name != preferred {
473					continue
474				}
475				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
476				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
477				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
478				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
479					columns[i].width--
480					total--
481				}
482			}
483			if total <= m.width {
484				break
485			}
486		}
487		return columns
488	}
489	
490	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
491		switch name {
492		case "repo":
493			return r.Repo.Display()
494		case "branch":
495			if r.Repo.Bare {
496				return "(bare)"
497			}
498			return r.Status.Branch
499		case "git":
500			if r.Repo.Bare {
501				return "—"
502			}
503			return r.Status.Summary()
504		case "remote":
505			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
506				return "?"
507			}
508			return r.Topology.Summary()
509		case "size":
510			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
511		case "live":
512			if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
513				return "?"
514			}
515			if !r.Live {
516				return "—"
517			}
518			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
519				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
520			}
521			return r.Runtime
522		case "latest":
523			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
524		case "worktrees":
525			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
526				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
527			}
528			return "—"
529		case "tasks":
530			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
531				return "?"
532			}
533			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
534				return tasks
535			}
536			return "—"
537		case "notes":
538			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
539				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
540			}
541			return "—"
542		case "category":
543			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
544				return r.Repo.Category
545			}
546			return "—"
547		case "path":
548			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
549		}
550		return ""

150	// send feeds a sequence of key presses through Update, running any command the
151	// model returns so the action callbacks actually fire — that is what makes
152	// these tests exercise the real key bindings rather than the model's fields.
153	func send(m tui.Model, msgs ...tea.Msg) tui.Model {
154		var cur tea.Model = m
155		for _, msg := range msgs {
156			var cmd tea.Cmd
157			cur, cmd = cur.Update(msg)
158			// Follow the command chain, so an action's resulting message (and the
159			// reload it triggers) is applied too. Commands that do not return
160			// promptly are the cursor's blink timers; running those would make the
161			// suite sleep for half a second per keystroke.
162			for i := 0; cmd != nil && i < 8; i++ {
163				out, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
164				if !ok || out == nil {
165					break
166				}
167				if _, isBatch := out.(tea.BatchMsg); isBatch {
168					break
169				}
170				cur, cmd = cur.Update(out)
171			}
172		}
173		return cur.(tui.Model)
174	}
175	
176	// runQuickly executes a command, giving up on anything that blocks — which in
177	// practice means the cursor blink timers.
178	func runQuickly(cmd tea.Cmd) (tea.Msg, bool) {
179		done := make(chan tea.Msg, 1)
180		go func() { done <- cmd() }()
181		select {
182		case msg := <-done:
183			return msg, true
184		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
185			return nil, false
186		}
187	}
188	
189	func updateOnce(m tui.Model, msg tea.Msg) (tui.Model, tea.Cmd) {
190		updated, cmd := m.Update(msg)
191		return updated.(tui.Model), cmd
192	}
193	
194	func applyQuickCommand(t *testing.T, m tui.Model, cmd tea.Cmd) (tui.Model, tea.Cmd) {
195		t.Helper()
196		if cmd == nil {
197			t.Fatal("expected command")
198		}
199		msg, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
200		if !ok {
201			t.Fatal("command did not return promptly")
202		}
203		return updateOnce(m, msg)
204	}
205	
206	func commandBatch(t *testing.T, cmd tea.Cmd) tea.BatchMsg {
207		t.Helper()
208		if cmd == nil {
209			t.Fatal("expected command batch")
210		}
211		msg, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
212		if !ok {
213			t.Fatal("command batch did not return promptly")
214		}
215		batch, ok := msg.(tea.BatchMsg)
216		if !ok {
217			t.Fatalf("command returned %T, want tea.BatchMsg", msg)
218		}
219		return batch
220	}

1328	func TestViewReadinessTransitionsAreTraced(t *testing.T) {
1329		trace := perftrace.New(32)
1330		actions := newActions(&recorder{}, nil)
1331		actions.ReloadFleet = func(context.Context) ([]tui.FleetRow, error) {
1332			return []tui.FleetRow{{Host: "lab", State: fleet.HostOK}}, nil
1333		}
1334		m := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(trace)
1335		m = send(m, key("tab"), key("tab"))
1336		events := trace.Freeze().Events
1337		var requested, accepted, finished bool
1338		for _, event := range events {
1339			if event.View != perftrace.ViewFleet || event.Generation != 1 {
1340				continue
1341			}
1342			switch event.Name {
1343			case perftrace.TUIViewLoadRequested:
1344				requested = true
1345			case perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted:
1346				accepted = event.Rows != nil && *event.Rows == 1
1347			case perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished:
1348				finished = event.Outcome == perftrace.OutcomeSuccess

1443	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1444	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1445		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1446		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1447			switch {
1448			case x > y:
1449				return -1
1450			case x < y:
1451				return 1
1452			default:
1453				return 0
1454			}
1455		}
1456		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1457			if x == y {
1458				return 0
1459			}
1460			if x {
1461				return -1
1462			}
1463			return 1
1464		}
1465		latest := func() int {
1466			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1467				return 0
1468			}
1469			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1470				return -1
1471			}
1472			return 1
1473		}
1474	
1475		switch sortBy {
1476		case "name":
1477			return nameCmp
1478		case "latest":
1479			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1480				return c
1481			}
1482		case "git":
1483			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1484				return c
1485			}
1486			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1487				return c
1488			}
1489		case "size":
1490			switch {
1491			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1492				return -1
1493			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1494				return 1
1495			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1496				return -1
1497			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1498				return 1
1499			}
1500		case "tasks":
1501			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1502				return c
1503			}
1504			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1505				return c
1506			}
1507		default: // activity
1508			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1509				return c
1510			}
1511			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1512				return c
1513			}
1514			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1515				return c
1516			}
1517			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1518				return c
1519			}
1520			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1521				return c
1522			}
1523		}
1524		return nameCmp
1525	}

42	func newTUICmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
43		cmd := &cobra.Command{
44			Use:   "tui",
45			Short: "Interactive dashboard over the inventory",
46			Long: `Browse and act on your work in progress.
47	
48	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability
49	to open, park and annotate a task without retyping its name.
50	
51	Seven lists, switched with tab:
52	
53	  TASKS   change streams dev is tracking — what am I working on
54	  REPOS   durable repositories under the scan roots — what do I have here
55	  FLEET   repositories and active work across configured SSH machines
56	  TRY     scratch experiments and retained lifecycle history
57	  REMOTE  repositories visible through configured forge CLIs — what can I clone/open
58	  SKILLS  startup-context/global agent skills; all repositories outside Git
59	  MCP     startup-context static declarations; all repositories outside Git
60	
61	Navigation is vim-style, with arrows alongside:
62	
63	  j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
64	  g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
65	  /          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
66	
67	Actions depend on the list:
68	
69	  TASKS   enter open · p park · c edit next
70		  REPOS   enter ad hoc · space worktrees · m metadata · s worktree task · d direct task
71		  FLEET   enter Herdr/SSH open · Git changes are read-only here
72		  TRY     enter open · n create · space lifecycle/metadata actions
73	  REMOTE  enter open local · c clone after confirmation
74	  SKILLS  a interactive add · c check updates · u update selected after confirmation
75	  MCP     r reload static declarations; no server is started or probed
76	
77	  y       copy menu: yy context · yp path · yb branch · ys sessions · yw WT paths
78	  H       selected repo heatmap; b backfills it when empty
79	  e       edit config; returning live-reloads data, columns, sort and tools
80	  O / R   cycle / reverse REPOS or TRY sort
81	  r       reload config + data     1 / 2 / 3  hot / warm / cold
82	  0       clear filters            a include history  ? help  q quit
83	
84	External tools are configured, not fixed — see [[tui.tools]] in the config,

86	the dashboard suspends while they do and redraws afterwards, and bindings for

97	func newTUIToolsCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

99			Use:   "tools",
100			Short: "List the external tool bindings and whether each one works here",
101			Long: `Show which programs the dashboard will hand the terminal to.
102	
103	Bindings come from [[tui.tools]] in the config; with none configured, the
104	built-in set applies. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely, so
105	what is bound is always exactly what is written down.
106	
107	Add your own — an editor, a script, anything you already reach for:
108	
109	    [[tui.tools]]
110	    key  = "V"
111	    name = "nvim"
112	    run  = "nvim ."
113	
114	    [[tui.tools]]
115	    key  = "B"
116	    name = "vibe"
117	    run  = "vibe"
118	
119	The command runs through your shell in the selected row's checkout, so
120	arguments, environment variables and your own scripts all behave as typed.
121	Set interactive = true only for aliases/functions from your shell rc; that

123			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
124			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
125				configured := len(app.Cfg.TUI.Tools) > 0
126				source := "built-in defaults"

128					source = config.Contract(app.Cfg.Source)
129				}

133				style := app.outStyle()
134				configuredTools := app.Cfg.EffectiveTools()
135				for i, tool := range externalTools(app) {
136					status := "yes"

138						status = style.warning("no — not on PATH")

140						status = style.success(status)

608				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
609				if err != nil {
610					return "", err
611				}
612				actionApp := *active
613				actionApp.runtimeInstance = rt
614				spec, err := buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, &actionApp, r.Repo, startRequest{
615					Name: name, Mode: task.ModeWorktree,
616				})
617				if err != nil {
618					return "", err
619				}
620				started, err := executeStartSpec(ctx, &actionApp, spec, nil)
621				if err != nil {
622					return "", err
623				}
624				return fmt.Sprintf("started %s on %s", name, started.Task.Branch), nil
625			},
626	
627			StartDirect: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
628				active := appState.Current()
629				rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
630				if err != nil {
631					return "", err
632				}
633				return startDirectFromTUI(ctx, active, rt, r, name)
634			},
635	
636			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
637				active := appState.Current()
638				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
639				if err != nil {
640					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
641				}
642				defer store.Close()
643				until := time.Now()
644				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
645				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
646					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
647				})
648				if err != nil {
649					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
650				}
651				seconds, days := 0, 0
652				for _, value := range totals {
653					seconds += value
654					if value > 0 {
655						days++
656					}
657				}
658				return tui.StatsPanel{
659					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
660					Since: since, Until: until,
661					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
662						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
663					}),
664				}, nil
665			},
666	
667			BackfillStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) error {
668				active := appState.Current()
669				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, active.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repoName)
670				if err != nil {
671					return err
672				}
673				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
674				if err != nil {
675					return err
676				}
677				defer store.Close()
678				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
679				return err
680			},
681	
682			EditConfig: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
683				proc, _, _, err := configEditorProcess(appState.Current(), "")
684				return proc, err
685			},
686	
687			EditFleetConfig: func() (*exec.Cmd, error) {
688				return fleetConfigEditorProcess(appState.Current(), "")
689			},
690	
691			// loadFleetConfig applies defaults and re-runs the private-mode check,
692			// so an edit that loosens remotes.toml's permissions while it holds a
693			// plaintext password is caught here rather than at the next fan-out.
694			ValidateFleetConfig: func() error {
695				_, err := loadFleetConfig(appState.Current())
696				return err
697			},
698	
699			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
700				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
701				if err != nil {
702					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
703				}
704				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
705				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
706				if err != nil {
707					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
708				}
709				status := "config + data reloaded"
710				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
711					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
712				}
713				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
714					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
715					Tools:       externalTools(next),
716					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
717					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
718					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
719				}, status, nil
720			},
721		}
722	
723		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
724		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
725		// while dozens of repos are probed.
726		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
727		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
728		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
729		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
730		cancelRun()
731		app.finishTrace()
732		if err != nil {
733			return err
734		}
735		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
736		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
737		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
738			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
739				return app.cdDirective(dir)
740			}
741			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
742				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
743				if resolveErr != nil {
744					return resolveErr
745				}
746				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
747			}
748		}
749		return nil
750	}
751	
752	// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe the configuration an
753	// agent launched from the startup context would see. Inside a Git checkout the
754	// exact current worktree is the only project target; global sources are still
```

226	// Filter selects declarations for CLI or TUI consumers. Empty fields are
227	// wildcards; Enabled and HasCredentials distinguish an omitted filter from false.
228	type Filter struct {
229		Agent          Agent
230		Scope          Scope
231		Source         DeclarationSource
232		Transport      Transport
233		Repository     string
234		NameContains   string
235		Enabled        *bool
236		HasCredentials *bool
237	}
238	
239	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
240	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
242			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
243			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
244			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
245			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
246			return false
247		}
248		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
249			return false
250		}
251		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
252			return false
253		}
254		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
255			return false
256		}
257		return true
258	}
259	
260	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
261	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
262		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
263		for _, row := range rows {
264			if f.Match(row) {
265				out = append(out, row)
266			}
267		}
268		return out
269	}
270	
271	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
272	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
273		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
274			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
275			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
276			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
277			for n := range ak {
278				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
279					return ak[n] < bk[n]
280				}
281			}
282			return false
283		})
284	}
285	
286	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {

290		case ScopeLocal:
291			return "1-local"
292		case ScopeUser:

195	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to
196	// cwd outside Git keeps project-scoped skills useful for ordinary folders too.
197	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {
198		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
199		if err == nil {
200			cwd = abs
201		}
202		if repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd); err == nil && repository.Root != "" {
203			return repository.Root
204		}
205		return filepath.Clean(cwd)
206	}
207	
208	// Inventory scans cwd's current target and the requested global scope.
209	func Inventory(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
210		target, err := agenttarget.Current(ctx, cwd)
211		if err != nil {
212			return Result{}, err
213		}
214		return Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, options)
215	}
216	
217	// Scan inventories the requested targets. Global paths are scanned only once,
218	// regardless of target count.
219	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
221			return Result{}, err
222		}
223		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
224		if !project && !global {
225			project, global = true, true
226		}
227	
228		result := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
229		definitions := Registry()
230		if project {
231			for _, target := range agenttarget.Dedupe(targets) {
232				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
233					return result, err
234				}
235				rows, diagnostics := scanProjectScope(ctx, target, definitions)
236				result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
237				result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
238				if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
239					return result, err
240				}
241			}
242		}
243		if global {
244			rows, diagnostics := scanGlobalScope(ctx, definitions)
245			result.Skills = append(result.Skills, rows...)
246			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
247			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
248				return result, err
249			}
250		}
251	
252		sortSkills(result.Skills)
253		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
254		if options.Check {
255			result.Skills = CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
256			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
257				return result, err
258			}
259		}
260		return result, nil
261	}
262	
263	// ScanTargets is an explicit compatibility name for Scan.
264	func ScanTargets(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options ListOptions) (Result, error) {
265		return Scan(ctx, targets, options)
266	}

268	// List preserves the original row-only API. Native diagnostics are available
269	// through Inventory or Scan and never turn a malformed neighboring scope into a
270	// fatal whole-scan error.
271	func List(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) ([]Skill, error) {
272		result, err := Inventory(ctx, cwd, options)
273		return result.Skills, err

276	// ManagedName returns the canonical lock key for one unambiguous provider-
277	// managed skill. Direct-managed dev-cli and option-like keys are never handed
278	// to the external update command.
279	func directManagedSkillName(name string) bool {
280		return reservedSkillNameKey(name) == reservedSkillNameKey(skill.Name)
281	}
282	
283	func reservedSkillNameKey(value string) string {
284		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
285		var builder strings.Builder
286		lastDash := false
287		for _, character := range value {
288			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' {
289				builder.WriteRune(character)
290				lastDash = false
291			} else if !lastDash {
292				builder.WriteByte('-')
293				lastDash = true
294			}
295		}
296		return strings.Trim(builder.String(), "-")
297	}

299	func lockUpdateable(entry LockMetadata) bool {
300		if _, ok := safeSkillFolder(entry.SkillPath); !ok || !safeProviderSkillName(entry.Name) {
301			return false
302		}
303		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(entry.SourceType)) {
304		case "github", "git", "gitlab":
305			_, ok := sourceURL(entry)
306			return ok
307		case "well-known":
308			return strings.TrimSpace(entry.Source) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(entry.SourceURL) != ""
309		default:
310			return false
311		}
312	}

318			!directManagedSkillName(row.Lock.Name)

321	func ManagedName(ctx context.Context, cwd, name string, scope Scope) (string, bool) {
322		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
323			return "", false
324		}
325		root := ProjectRoot(ctx, cwd)
326		var document lockDocument
327		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
328			document = readGlobalLock(globalLockPath())
329		} else {
330			document = readProjectLock(filepath.Join(root, "skills-lock.json"))
331		}
332		entry, ok := document.find(name)
333		if !ok || !lockUpdateable(entry) {
334			return "", false
335		}
336		return entry.Name, true
337	}

339	// Managed reports whether name has an update-safe upstream lock entry.

345	// FindProject returns one installed project-scoped skill by exact or normalized
346	// name. An exact name wins when normalized filesystem names collide.
347	func FindProject(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string) (Skill, error) {
348		rows, err := List(ctx, projectRoot, ListOptions{Project: true})
349		if err != nil {
350			return Skill{}, err
351		}
352		for _, row := range rows {
353			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && row.Name == name {
354				return row, nil
355			}
356		}
357		want := normalizedName(name)
358		var matches []Skill
359		for _, row := range rows {
360			if row.Scope == ScopeProject && row.Presence == PresencePresent && normalizedName(row.Name) == want {
361				matches = append(matches, row)
362			}
363		}
364		if len(matches) == 1 {
365			return matches[0], nil
366		}
367		return Skill{}, fmt.Errorf("project skill %q is not installed", name)
368	}

370	// MergeResults combines independently scanned targets while restoring the
371	// domain's deterministic ordering and registry metadata.
372	func MergeResults(results ...Result) Result {
373		merged := Result{RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion}
374		for _, result := range results {
375			merged.Skills = append(merged.Skills, result.Skills...)
376			merged.Diagnostics = append(merged.Diagnostics, result.Diagnostics...)
377			if result.RegistrySource != "" {
378				merged.RegistrySource = result.RegistrySource
379			}
380			if result.RegistryVersion != "" {
381				merged.RegistryVersion = result.RegistryVersion
382			}
383		}
384		sortSkills(merged.Skills)
385		sortDiagnostics(merged.Diagnostics)
386		return merged

389	func sortSkills(rows []Skill) {
390		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
391			left, right := rows[i], rows[j]
392			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
393				return left.Scope == ScopeProject
394			}
395			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
396				return left.Repository < right.Repository
397			}
398			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
399				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
400			}
401			leftName, rightName := strings.ToLower(left.Name), strings.ToLower(right.Name)
402			if leftName != rightName {
403				return leftName < rightName
404			}
405			if left.Name != right.Name {
406				return left.Name < right.Name
407			}
408			return left.Path < right.Path
409		})
410	}
411	
412	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
413		sort.SliceStable(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
414			left, right := diagnostics[i], diagnostics[j]
415			if left.Repository != right.Repository {
416				return left.Repository < right.Repository
417			}
418			if left.Checkout != right.Checkout {
419				return left.Checkout < right.Checkout
420			}
421			if left.Scope != right.Scope {
422				return left.Scope < right.Scope
423			}
424			if left.Path != right.Path {
425				return left.Path < right.Path
426			}
427			if left.Name != right.Name {
428				return left.Name < right.Name
429			}
430			if left.Kind != right.Kind {
431				return left.Kind < right.Kind
432			}
433			return left.Message < right.Message
434		})
435	}
436	
437	func safeDisplayValue(value string) bool {
438		if value == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
439			return false
440		}
441		return !strings.ContainsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
442			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.In(r, unicode.Cf)
443		})
444	}
445	
446	func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
447		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
448		out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
449		for _, value := range values {
450			if value == "" {
451				continue
452			}
453			if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
454				continue
455			}
456			seen[value] = struct{}{}
457			out = append(out, value)
458		}
459		sort.Strings(out)
460		return out
461	}

464		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
465		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
466			return ""
467		}
468		return home
469	}

42	func newTUICmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
43		cmd := &cobra.Command{
44			Use:   "tui",
45			Short: "Interactive dashboard over the inventory",
46			Long: `Browse and act on your work in progress.
47	
48	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability
49	to open, park and annotate a task without retyping its name.
50	
51	Seven lists, switched with tab:
52	
53	  TASKS   change streams dev is tracking — what am I working on
54	  REPOS   durable repositories under the scan roots — what do I have here
55	  FLEET   repositories and active work across configured SSH machines
56	  TRY     scratch experiments and retained lifecycle history
57	  REMOTE  repositories visible through configured forge CLIs — what can I clone/open
58	  SKILLS  startup-context/global agent skills; all repositories outside Git
59	  MCP     startup-context static declarations; all repositories outside Git
60	
61	Navigation is vim-style, with arrows alongside:
62	
63	  j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
64	  g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
65	  /          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
66	
67	Actions depend on the list:
68	
69	  TASKS   enter open · p park · c edit next
70		  REPOS   enter ad hoc · space worktrees · m metadata · s worktree task · d direct task
71		  FLEET   enter Herdr/SSH open · Git changes are read-only here
72		  TRY     enter open · n create · space lifecycle/metadata actions
73	  REMOTE  enter open local · c clone after confirmation
74	  SKILLS  a interactive add · c check updates · u update selected after confirmation
75	  MCP     r reload static declarations; no server is started or probed
76	
77	  y       copy menu: yy context · yp path · yb branch · ys sessions · yw WT paths
78	  H       selected repo heatmap; b backfills it when empty
79	  e       edit config; returning live-reloads data, columns, sort and tools
80	  O / R   cycle / reverse REPOS or TRY sort
81	  r       reload config + data     1 / 2 / 3  hot / warm / cold
82	  0       clear filters            a include history  ? help  q quit
83	
84	External tools are configured, not fixed — see [[tui.tools]] in the config,
85	and "dev tui tools" for what is bound here. They run in the selected row's checkout;
86	the dashboard suspends while they do and redraws afterwards, and bindings for
87	programs that are not installed are not offered.`,
88			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
89			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
90				return runTUI(app)
91			},
92		}
93		cmd.AddCommand(newTUIToolsCmd(app))
94		return cmd
95	}
96	
97	func newTUIToolsCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
98		return &cobra.Command{
99			Use:   "tools",
100			Short: "List the external tool bindings and whether each one works here",
101			Long: `Show which programs the dashboard will hand the terminal to.
102	
103	Bindings come from [[tui.tools]] in the config; with none configured, the
104	built-in set applies. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely, so
105	what is bound is always exactly what is written down.
106	
107	Add your own — an editor, a script, anything you already reach for:
108	
109	    [[tui.tools]]
110	    key  = "V"
111	    name = "nvim"
112	    run  = "nvim ."
113	
114	    [[tui.tools]]
115	    key  = "B"
116	    name = "vibe"
117	    run  = "vibe"
118	
119	The command runs through your shell in the selected row's checkout, so
120	arguments, environment variables and your own scripts all behave as typed.
121	Set interactive = true only for aliases/functions from your shell rc; that
122	binding runs through $SHELL -lic and the mode is shown in this listing.`,
123			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
124			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
125				configured := len(app.Cfg.TUI.Tools) > 0
126				source := "built-in defaults"
127				if configured {
128					source = config.Contract(app.Cfg.Source)
129				}
130				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "tool bindings from %s\n\n", source)
131	
132				t := app.newTable("KEY", "NAME", "MODE", "RUNS", "AVAILABLE")
133				style := app.outStyle()
134				configuredTools := app.Cfg.EffectiveTools()
135				for i, tool := range externalTools(app) {
136					status := "yes"
137					if tool.Probe != nil && !tool.Probe(ctxOf()) {
138						status = style.warning("no — not on PATH")
139					} else {
140						status = style.success(status)
141					}
142					// Command is [shell, -c/-lic, run]; show the run itself.
143					run := tool.Command[len(tool.Command)-1]
144					mode := "shell"
145					if i < len(configuredTools) && configuredTools[i].Interactive {
146						mode = "interactive"
147					}
148					t.Add(tool.Key, tool.Name, mode, run, status)
149				}
150				t.Render(app.Out)
151	
152				if !configured {
153					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nOverride them with [[tui.tools]] in your config; see \"dev tui tools --help\".")
154				}
155				fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nA tool cannot take a key the dashboard already uses; dev reports the clash on load.")
156				return nil
157			},
158		}
159	}

161	// interactive reports whether a real terminal is attached. Piping `dev` into
162	// anything must produce the plain listing, not terminal control sequences.
163	func interactive() bool {
164		for _, f := range []*os.File{os.Stdin, os.Stdout} {
165			info, err := f.Stat()
166			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeCharDevice == 0 {
167				return false
168			}
169		}
170		return true
171	}

191	func tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app *App, name string) (string, error) {
192		projectRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot)
193		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(projectRoot, name)
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
196		}
197		return destination, nil
198	}

200	func cloneRemoteFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, row tui.RemoteRow) (string, error) {
201		destination, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app, row.Repo.Name)
202		if err != nil {
203			return "", err
204		}
205		discoverable, err := repositoryPathDiscoverable(app.Cfg, destination)
206		if err != nil {
207			return "", fmt.Errorf("verify REMOTE clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
208		}
209		if !discoverable {
210			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is outside paths.scan_roots/repo_paths; add paths.project_root to scan_roots before cloning from REMOTE",
211				config.Contract(destination))
212		}
213		if _, err := os.Lstat(destination); err == nil {
214			return destination, fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots/repo_paths or move it before cloning", config.Contract(destination))
215		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
216			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
217		}
218		acquired, err := repo.Acquire(ctx, repo.AcquireRequest{
219			Kind: repo.AcquireClone, Name: row.Repo.Name,
220			CloneRef: row.Repo.CloneURL, Destination: destination,
221		})
222		if err != nil {
223			if _, statErr := os.Lstat(destination); statErr == nil {
224				return destination, fmt.Errorf("%w; inspect the destination now present at %s before retrying", err, config.Contract(destination))
225			}
226			return "", err
227		}
228		return acquired.Path, nil
229	}

231	func startDirectFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, row tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
232		if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, row.Repo.Path); err != nil {
233			return "", err
234		}
235		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, row.Repo.Path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return "", err
238		}
239		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
241		}
242		id := task.MakeID(row.Repo.Name, status.Branch)
243		replaceDoneRevision := ""
244		existing, err := existingTaskForStart(app.Tasks, id)
245		if err != nil {
246			return "", err
247		}
248		if existing != nil && existing.State != task.Done {
249			return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
250		}
251		if existing != nil {
252			replaceDoneRevision = existing.Revision()
253		}
254		handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, row.Repo.Path, row.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
255		if err != nil {
256			return "", err
257		}
258		tracked := &task.Task{
259			Name: name, Repo: row.Repo.Name, RepoPath: row.Repo.Path,
260			Branch: status.Branch, Base: status.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
261			State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
262		}
263		setTaskRuntime(tracked, rt, handle)
264		if replaceDoneRevision != "" {
265			err = app.Tasks.ReplaceDone(tracked, replaceDoneRevision)
266		} else {
267			err = app.Tasks.Save(tracked)
268		}
269		if err != nil {
270			if handle.Created && handle.Handle != "" {
271				_ = rt.Close(ctx, handle.Handle)
272			}
273			return "", err
274		}
275		annotate(app, rt, tracked)
276		return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, status.Branch), nil
277	}

636			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
637				active := appState.Current()
638				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
639				if err != nil {
640					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
641				}
642				defer store.Close()
643				until := time.Now()
644				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
645				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
646					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
647				})
648				if err != nil {
649					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
650				}
651				seconds, days := 0, 0
652				for _, value := range totals {
653					seconds += value
654					if value > 0 {
655						days++
656					}
657				}
658				return tui.StatsPanel{
659					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
660					Since: since, Until: until,
661					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
662						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
663					}),
664				}, nil
665			},

668				active := appState.Current()

670				if err != nil {
671					return err
672				}
673				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
674				if err != nil {
675					return err
676				}
677				defer store.Close()
678				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
679				return err
680			},

691			// loadFleetConfig applies defaults and re-runs the private-mode check,
692			// so an edit that loosens remotes.toml's permissions while it holds a
693			// plaintext password is caught here rather than at the next fan-out.
694			ValidateFleetConfig: func() error {

699			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
700				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
701				if err != nil {
702					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
703				}
704				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
705				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
706				if err != nil {
707					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
708				}
709				status := "config + data reloaded"
710				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
711					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
712				}
713				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
714					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
715					Tools:       externalTools(next),
716					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
717					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
718					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
719				}, status, nil
720			},
721		}
722	
723		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
724		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
725		// while dozens of repos are probed.
726		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
727		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
728		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
729		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
730		cancelRun()
731		app.finishTrace()
732		if err != nil {
733			return err
734		}
735		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
736		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
737		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
738			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
739				return app.cdDirective(dir)
740			}
741			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
742				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
743				if resolveErr != nil {
744					return resolveErr
745				}
746				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
747			}
748		}
749		return nil
750	}
751	
752	// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe the configuration an
753	// agent launched from the startup context would see. Inside a Git checkout the
754	// exact current worktree is the only project target; global sources are still
755	// scanned once by the domain scanners. Outside Git, the dashboard retains its
756	// cross-repository inventory role and includes every accepted REPOS target.
757	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target) []agenttarget.Target {
758		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
759		for _, row := range locals {
760			if !row.IsTry() {
761				repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
762			}
763		}
764		targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
765		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" && current.CommonDir != "" &&
766			!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
767			return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
768		}
769		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
770	}

772	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
773		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
774		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
775	}
