```text
777	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
778		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
779		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
780		if err != nil {
781			return nil, err
782		}
783		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
784		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
785		if !sessionsSet {
786			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
787		}
788		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
789		for _, item := range items {
790			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
791			if item.Entry != nil {
792				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
793					copy := location
794					row.Location = &copy
795				}
796			}
797			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
798			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
799				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
800					sizeRepo = &discovered
801				}
802			}
803			if sizeRepo != nil {
804				worktreeCount := 0
805				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
806					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
807				}
808				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
809			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
810				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
811			}
812			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
813				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
814			}
815			if item.Live.Present {
816				for _, session := range sessions {
817					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
818						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
819						row.Live = true
820						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
821						break
822					}
823				}
824			}
825			rows = append(rows, row)
826		}
827		return rows, listErr
828	}
829	
830	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
831		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
832		if err != nil {
833			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
834		}
835		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
836			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
837				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
838				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
839			})
840			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
841			return item, resolveErr
842		}
843		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
844			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
845				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
846			}
847			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
848			if openErr != nil {
849				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
850			}
851			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
852			if rt.Name() == "none" {
853				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
854			} else {
855				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
856				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
857			}
858			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
859				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
860			}
861			return result, nil
862		}
863	
864		switch request.Action {
865		case tui.TryOpen:
866			item, resolveErr := resolve()
867			if resolveErr != nil {
868				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
869			}
870			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
871	
872		case tui.TryCreate:
873			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
874				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
875			})
876			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
877			if created.InitWarning != nil {
878				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
879			}
880			if createErr != nil {
881				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
882			}
883			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
884			if created.Existing {
885				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
886			}
887			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
888			result.RefreshRepos = true
889			return result, openErr
890	
891		case tui.TryMark:
892			item, resolveErr := resolve()
893			if resolveErr != nil {
894				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
895			}
896			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
897			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
898			note := request.Note
899			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
900				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
901			})
902			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
903			return tui.TryActionResult{
904				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
905			}, patchErr
906	
907		case tui.TryDeprecate:
908			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
909			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
910			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
911	
912		case tui.TryReactivate:
913			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
914			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
915			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
916	
917		case tui.TryArchive:
918			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
919			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
920			return tui.TryActionResult{
921				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
922			}, transitionErr
923	
924		case tui.TryRestore:
925			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
926			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
927			return tui.TryActionResult{
928				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
929			}, transitionErr
930	
931		case tui.TryGraduate:
932			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
933				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
934			})
935			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
936			if graduateErr != nil {
937				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
938			}
939			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
940			result.RefreshRepos = true
941			return result, openErr
942		}
943		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
944	}
945	
946	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
947	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
948	type repoCollectOptions struct {
949		IncludeTries bool
950		Sessions     []runtime.Session
951		SessionsErr  error
952		SessionsSet  bool
953		Tasks        []*task.Task
954		TasksSet     bool
955		Repos        []repo.Repo
956		ReposSet     bool
957		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
958	}
959	
960	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
961	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
962	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
963		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
964	}
965	
966	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
967		repos := options.Repos
968		var err error
969		if !options.ReposSet {
970			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
971			if err != nil {
972				return nil, err
973			}
974		}
975		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
976		if err != nil {
977			return nil, err
978		}
979		if !options.IncludeTries {
980			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
981			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
982			for index, repository := range repos {
983				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
984					continue
985				}
986				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
987				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
988			}
989			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
990		}
991		tasks := options.Tasks
992		var taskDiagnostics []task.Diagnostic
993		if !options.TasksSet {
994			tasks, taskDiagnostics, err = app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
995			if err != nil {
996				return nil, err
997			}
998		}
999		var taskInventoryErr error
1000		for _, diagnostic := range taskDiagnostics {
1001			taskInventoryErr = errors.Join(taskInventoryErr, diagnostic)
1002		}
1003		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
1004		for _, tracked := range tasks {
1005			byRepo[tracked.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[tracked.RepoPath], tracked)
1006		}
1007		sessions := options.Sessions
1008		runtimeErr := options.SessionsErr
1009		if !options.SessionsSet {
1010			sessions, runtimeErr = rt.List(ctx)
1011		}
1012		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
1013		if app.Notes != nil {
1014			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
1015			if noteErr != nil {
1016				return nil, noteErr
1017			}
1018			for _, n := range allNotes {
1019				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
1020			}
1021		}
1022	
1023		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
1024		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
1025		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
1026		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
1027		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
1028		limiter := options.Limiter
1029		if limiter == nil {
1030			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
1031		}
1032		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1033		for i, r := range repos {
1034			wg.Add(1)
1035			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
1036				defer wg.Done()
1037				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
1038				if !ok {
1039					return
1040				}
1041				defer release()
1042	
1043				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1044				if row.Asset != nil {
1045					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1046					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1047					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1048						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1049					}
1050				}
1051				if r.HasGit {
1052					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1053				}
1054				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1055				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1056					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1057				}
1058				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1059				row.Context.TaskErr = taskInventoryErr
1060				row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
1061				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1062				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1063				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1064					row.Status = main.Status
1065				}
1066				if !r.Bare {
1067					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1068				}
1069				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1070					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1071					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1072				}
1073				if r.HasGit {
1074					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1075						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1076						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1077					}, row.Worktrees)
1078				} else {
1079					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1080				}
1081				out[i] = row
1082			}(i, r)
1083		}
1084		wg.Wait()
1085		return out, ctx.Err()
1086	}
1087	
1088	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1089	//
1090	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1091	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1092	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1093	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1094		var out []tui.Tool
1095		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1096			run := t.Run
1097			name := t.Name
1098			if name == "" {
1099				name = firstWord(run)
1100			}
1101			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1102			if t.Interactive {
1103				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1104				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1105				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1106				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1107				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1108			}
1109			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1110				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1111				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1112			})
1113		}
1114		return out
1115	}
1116	
1117	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1118	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1119	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1120	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1121		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1122	}
1123	
1124	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1125		if ctx == nil {
1126			ctx = context.Background()
1127		}
1128		word := firstWord(run)
1129		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1130			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1131			if word == "" {
1132				return false
1133			}
1134			word = firstWord(word)
1135		}
1136		if word == "" {
1137			return false
1138		}
1139		if interactive {
1140			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1141			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1142			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1143			defer cancel()
1144			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1145				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1146			return probe.Run() == nil
1147		}
1148		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1149			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1150			return err == nil
1151		}
1152		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1153		return err == nil
1154	}
1155	
1156	func firstWord(s string) string {
1157		f := strings.Fields(s)
1158		if len(f) == 0 {
1159			return ""
1160		}
1161		return f[0]
1162	}
1163	
1164	func shellPath() string {
1165		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1166			return s
1167		}
1168		return "/bin/sh"
1169	}
1170	
1171	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1172	// of private repositories.
1173	func remoteCachePath() string {
1174		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1175	}
1176	
1177	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1178		parts := []string{
1179			"forge-source-v1",
1180			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1181			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1182			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1183		}
1184		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1185			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1186		}
1187		sort.Strings(parts)
1188		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1189		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1190	}
1191	
1192	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1193	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1194	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1195	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1196		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1197		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1198		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1199			return nil, false, false
1200		}
1201		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1202		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1203			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1204		}
1205		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1206	}
1207	
1208	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1209	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1210	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1211		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1212		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1213			return nil, false
1214		}
1215		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1216	}
1217	
1218	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1219		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1220		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1221		for _, r := range locals {
1222			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1223				continue
1224			}
1225			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1226			if ambiguous[key] {
1227				continue
1228			}
1229			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1230				delete(byRemote, key)
1231				ambiguous[key] = true
1232				continue
1233			}
1234			byRemote[key] = r
1235		}
1236		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1237		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1238			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1239			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1240				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1241				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1242				if local.Asset != nil {
1243					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1244				}
1245			}
1246			out = append(out, row)
1247		}
1248		return out
1249	}
1250	
1251	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1252	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1253	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1254	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1255		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1256		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1257			return nil, false
1258		}
1259		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1260	}
1261	
1262	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1263		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1264		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1265			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1266		}
1267		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1268	}
1269	
1270	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1271	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1272	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1273	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1274		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1275		LocalsSet    bool
1276		Providers    []forge.Forge
1277		ProvidersSet bool
1278	}
1279	
1280	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1281		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1282	}
1283	
1284	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1285		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1286	}
1287	
1288	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1289		type result struct {
1290			kind  forge.Kind
1291			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1292			err   error
1293		}
1294		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1295		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1296			if options.LocalsSet {
1297				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1298			}
1299			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1300		}
1301		providers := options.Providers
1302		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1303			providers = configuredForges(app)
1304		}
1305		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1306		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1307		available := 0
1308		var unavailable []error
1309		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1310		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1311		for _, f := range providers {
1312			if !f.Available() {
1313				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1314				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1315				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1316					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1317					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1318					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1319				}
1320				continue
1321			}
1322			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1323			available++
1324			wg.Add(1)
1325			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1326				defer wg.Done()

1407	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1408		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1409			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1410				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1411			}
1412			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1413		})
1414	}

1416	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1417		providers := forge.All()
1418		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1419			return providers
1420		}
1421		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1422		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1423			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1424				Organization: target.Organization,
1425				Project:      target.Project,
1426			})
1427		}
1428		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1429	}

1431	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1432		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1433		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1434		if assetErr != nil {
1435			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1436			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1437		}
1438		type localMatch struct {
1439			repository repo.Repo
1440			asset      *catalog.Entry
1441		}
1442		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1443		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1444		for index, r := range locals {
1445			if r.Bare {
1446				continue
1447			}
1448			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1449			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1450				continue
1451			}
1452			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1453			if ambiguous[key] {
1454				continue
1455			}
1456			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1457				delete(localByRemote, key)
1458				ambiguous[key] = true
1459				continue
1460			}
1461			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1462		}
1463		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1464		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1465			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1466			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1467				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1468				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1469				if local.asset != nil {
1470					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1471				}
1472			}
1473			out = append(out, row)
1474		}
1475		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1476		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1477		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1478		return out
1479	}
1480	
1481	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1482		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1483			return
1484		}
1485		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1486		if err != nil {
1487			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1488			return
1489		}
1490		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1491			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1492		}
1493		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1494			return
1495		}
1496		host := config.Hostname()
1497		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1498		for _, entry := range entries {
1499			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1500			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1501				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1502				continue
1503			}
1504			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1505		}
1506		for index := range rows {
1507			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1508			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1509			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1510				continue
1511			}
1512			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1513			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1514			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1515			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1516		}
1517	}
1518	
1519	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1520		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1521			if candidate == "" {
1522				continue
1523			}
1524			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1525				return candidate
1526			}
1527		}
1528		return ""
1529	}

1531	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1532		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1533		if err != nil {
1534			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1535		}
1536		path := tmp.Name()
1537		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1538			_ = tmp.Close()
1539			_ = os.Remove(path)
1540			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1541		}
1542		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1543			_ = os.Remove(path)
1544			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1545		}
1546		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1547		if err != nil {
1548			_ = os.Remove(path)
1549			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1550		}
1551		return tui.NoteEdit{
1552			Command: proc,
1553			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1554				if runErr != nil {
1555					_ = os.Remove(path)
1556					return runErr
1557				}
1558				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1559				if err != nil {
1560					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1561				}
1562				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1563					_ = os.Remove(path)
1564					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1565				}
1566				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1567				if err != nil {
1568					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1569				}
1570				_ = os.Remove(path)
1571				return nil
1572			},
1573		}, nil
1574	}
```

```text
57	  REMOTE  repositories visible through configured forge CLIs — what can I clone/open
```

```text
754	// exact current worktree is the only project target; global sources are still
755	// scanned once by the domain scanners. Outside Git, the dashboard retains its
756	// cross-repository inventory role and includes every accepted REPOS target.
757	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target) []agenttarget.Target {
758		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
759		for _, row := range locals {
760			if !row.IsTry() {
761				repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)

766			!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
767			return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
768		}
769		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
770	}

821						break
```

```text
1330	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1331		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1332		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1333			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1334			if structured {
1335				switch key {
1336				case "scope":
1337					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1338						return false
1339					}
1340					continue
1341				case "agent":
1342					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1343					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1344						return false
1345					}
1346					continue
1347				case "update":
1348					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1349						return false
1350					}
1351					continue
1352				case "repo":
1353					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1354						return false
1355					}
1356					continue
1357				case "presence":
1358					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1359						return false
1360					}
1361					continue
1362				case "integrity":
1363					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1364						return false
1365					}
1366					continue
1367				}
1368			}
1369			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1370				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1371				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1372				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1373				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1374			}, " "))
1375			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1376				return false
1377			}
1378		}
1379		return true
1380	}

1392	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {

1407				case "managed":

1409				case "state":
1410					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1411				default:
1412					field = ""
1413				}
1414				if field != "" {
1415					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1416						return false
1417					}
1418					continue
1419				}
1420			}
1421			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1422				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1423				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1424				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1425			}, " "))
1426			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1427				return false
1428			}
1429		}
1430		return true
1431	}
```

The external-action boundary is clean and reusable: the model stores typed callbacks in `Actions`, launches ordinary async work as `tea.Cmd`, uses `tea.ExecProcess` only when a child must own the terminal, and converts open results into deferred `Chosen`/`Activation` handoffs after the alternate screen exits. Status precedence is also explicit—global error, clone progress, per-view error, global success, per-view status—before context-sensitive key hints are wrapped to terminal width.

```text
19	const tuiPTYHelperEnv = "DEV_TUI_PTY_HELPER"

21	func TestInitialFrameAndQuitWhileLocalLoadIsBlocked(t *testing.T) {
22		command := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestTUIBlockedLoadHelper$")
23		command.Env = append(os.Environ(), tuiPTYHelperEnv+"=1", "TERM=xterm-256color")
24		terminal, err := pty.StartWithSize(command, &pty.Winsize{Rows: 30, Cols: 120})
25		if err != nil {
26			t.Fatal(err)
27		}
28		defer terminal.Close()
29	
30		chunks := make(chan []byte, 16)
31		readErr := make(chan error, 1)
32		go func() {
33			buffer := make([]byte, 4096)
34			for {
35				n, err := terminal.Read(buffer)
36				if n > 0 {
37					chunks <- append([]byte(nil), buffer[:n]...)
38				}
39				if err != nil {
40					readErr <- err
41					return
42				}
43			}
44		}()
45	
46		var output bytes.Buffer
47		frameDeadline := time.NewTimer(15 * time.Second)
48		defer frameDeadline.Stop()
49		for !bytes.Contains(output.Bytes(), []byte("TASKS")) ||
50			!bytes.Contains(output.Bytes(), []byte("Loading tasks")) {
51			select {
52			case chunk := <-chunks:
53				output.Write(chunk)
54			case err := <-readErr:
55				if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) {
56					t.Fatalf("read PTY before initial frame: %v\n%s", err, output.Bytes())
57				}
58				t.Fatalf("PTY closed before initial frame:\n%s", output.Bytes())
59			case <-frameDeadline.C:
60				_ = command.Process.Kill()
61				_ = command.Wait()
62				t.Fatalf("initial frame did not appear while producer was blocked:\n%s", output.Bytes())
63			}
64		}
65		if _, err := terminal.Write([]byte("q")); err != nil {
66			t.Fatal(err)
67		}
68	
69		exited := make(chan error, 1)
70		go func() { exited <- command.Wait() }()
71		select {
72		case err := <-exited:
73			if err != nil {
74				t.Fatalf("TUI did not exit cleanly after q: %v\n%s", err, output.Bytes())
75			}
76		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
77			_ = command.Process.Kill()
78			<-exited
79			t.Fatalf("TUI did not process q while producer was blocked:\n%s", output.Bytes())
80		}
81	}
```

```text
857	func tryRow(id, name string, phase catalog.ExperimentPhase, state catalog.LocationState, tags ...string) tui.TryRow {
858		path := "/src/tries/" + name
859		location := catalog.Location{State: state, CurrentPath: path}
860		if state == catalog.LocationArchived {
861			location.RestorePath = path
862			location.CurrentPath = "/src/tries/.dev/archive/" + id + "/" + name
863		}
864		entry := &catalog.Entry{
865			ID: id, Kind: catalog.KindTry, Name: name, Tags: tags,
866			Experiment: &catalog.Experiment{Phase: phase, Slug: name, OriginalPath: path},
867			Locations:  map[string]catalog.Location{"test": location},
868		}
869		item := experiment.Item{
870			Entry: entry, ID: id, Kind: catalog.KindTry, Name: name, Basename: name,
871			Slug: name, Phase: phase, Tags: append([]string(nil), tags...),
872			Live: experiment.LiveFacts{
873				Present: state == catalog.LocationPresent, CurrentPath: location.CurrentPath,
874				RealPath: location.CurrentPath,
875			},
876		}
877		copy := location
878		return tui.TryRow{Item: item, Location: &copy}
879	}
```

```text
1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
18	)
19	
20	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
21	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
22	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
23	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
24	type Target struct {
25		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
26		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
27		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
28		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
29		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
30	}
31	
32	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
33	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
34	func (t Target) Key() string {
35		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
36	}
37	
38	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
39	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
40	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
41	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
42		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
43		if err == nil {
44			return target, nil
45		}
46		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
47			return Target{}, ctxErr
48		}
49		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
50			return Target{}, err
51		}
52		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
53		if pathErr != nil {
54			return Target{}, pathErr
55		}
56		name := filepath.Base(root)
57		return Target{
58			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
59			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
60		}, nil
61	}
62	
63	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
64	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
65		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
66		if err != nil {
67			return Target{}, err
68		}
69		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
70		if err != nil {
71			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
72		}
73		return fromGit(found)
74	}
75	
76	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
77	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
78	// worktree path is preserved.
79	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
80		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Target{}, err
83		}
84		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
85		if err != nil {
86			return Target{}, err
87		}
88		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
89		// An explicit linked-worktree path keeps the main repository identity from
90		// Git, but its checkout root remains the navigation path the caller selected.
91		switch {
92		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath):
93			if found.Name != "" {
94				target.RepoName = found.Name
95			}
96			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
97				target.RepoDisplay = display
98			}
99			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
100			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
101		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot):
102			target.CheckoutRoot = navigationPath(found.Path)
103		}
104		return target, nil
105	}
106	
107	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
108	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
109		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
110	}
111	
112	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
113	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
114	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
115	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
116		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
117			return Target{}, false
118		}
119		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
120		commonDir := found.CommonDir
121		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
122			return Target{}, false
123		}
124		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
125		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
126		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
127		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
128		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
129		name := found.Name
130		if name == "" {
131			name = filepath.Base(repository)
132		}
133		display := found.Display()
134		if display == "" {
135			display = name
136		}
137		return Target{
138			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
139			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
140		}, true
141	}
142	
143	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
144	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
145	
146	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
147	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
148	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
149	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
150		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
151		for _, found := range repositories {
152			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
153				targets = append(targets, target)
154			}
155		}
156		return Dedupe(targets)
157	}
158	
159	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
160	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
161	
162	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
163	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
164	// other target builders.
165	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
166		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
167		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
168			current = ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)
169			out = append(out, current)
170		}
171		return Dedupe(out)
172	}
173	
174	// ReconcileCurrent preserves the exact current checkout while applying the
175	// canonical repository's configured navigation identity when it is known.
176	func ReconcileCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) Target {
177		for _, target := range targets {
178			if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
179				current.RepoName = target.RepoName
180				current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
181				current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
182				if comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot) == comparablePath(current.CheckoutRoot) {
183					current.CheckoutRoot = target.CheckoutRoot
184				}
185				break
186			}
187		}
188		return current
189	}
190	
191	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
192	// concrete main-checkout targets.
193	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
194		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
199	}
200	
201	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
202	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
203	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
204		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
205		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
206		for _, target := range targets {
207			key := target.Key()
208			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
209				continue
210			}
211			seen[key] = struct{}{}
212			out = append(out, target)
213		}
214		Sort(out)
215		return out
216	}
217	
218	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
219	func Sort(targets []Target) {
220		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
221			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
222			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
223			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
224				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
225			}
226			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
227				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
228			}
229			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
230				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
231			}
232			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
233				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
234			}
235			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
236				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
237			}
238			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
239		})
240	}
241	
242	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
243		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
244			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
245		}
246		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
247		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
248		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
249		name := found.Name
250		if name == "" {
251			name = filepath.Base(repository)
252		}
253		return Target{
254			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
255			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
256		}, nil
257	}
258	
259	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
260		for _, value := range values {
261			if value != "" {
262				return value
263			}
264		}
265		return ""
266	}
267	
268	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err != nil {
271			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
272		}
273		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
274			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
275		}
276		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
277	}
278	
279	func navigationPath(value string) string {
280		if value == "" {
281			return ""
282		}
283		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
284		if err == nil {
285			value = absolute
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
291		if value == "" {
292			return ""
293		}
294		if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(value); err == nil {
295			return resolved
296		}
297		return navigationPath(value)
298	}
299	
300	func comparablePath(value string) string {
301		return canonicalPath(value)
302	}
303
```

```text
53	// DeriveWebURL returns a display-safe browser URL when the evidence can be
54	// mapped without guessing. Evidence order is exact RemoteRepo URL, strict Azure
55	// mapping, then literal/configured GitHub or GitLab endpoints. Unknown SSH
56	// aliases, local paths, file URLs, unsupported schemes/ports, controls, and
57	// ambiguous encoded separators return unavailable.
58	func DeriveWebURL(request WebURLRequest) (WebURL, bool) {
59		if request.Exact != nil {
60			if result, ok := webURLFromExact(*request.Exact); ok {
61				return result, true
62			}
63		}
64		if _, rawURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(request.Remote); ok {
65			if _, _, safeURL, ok := parseSafeHTTPS(rawURL); ok {
66				return WebURL{

68					Source: WebURLSourceAzureRemote, Confidence: WebURLConfidenceStrict,
69				}, true
70			}
71		}
72

74		if !ok {
75			return WebURL{}, false
76		}
77		hosts := webHostPolicy(request)
78		provider := hosts.provider(endpoint.host, endpoint.transport == "ssh")
79		if provider == Unknown || !validRepositorySegments(provider, endpoint.segments) {
80			return WebURL{}, false
81		}
82		segments := stripGitSuffix(endpoint.segments)
83		if segments == nil {
84			return WebURL{}, false
85		}
86		return WebURL{
87			URL: buildHTTPSURL(endpoint.host, segments), Provider: provider,
88			Source: WebURLSourceGitRemote, Confidence: WebURLConfidenceConservative,
89		}, true

130	func parseForgeEndpoint(raw string) (forgeEndpoint, bool) {
131		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
132			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
133		}
134		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
135		if raw == "" {
136			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
137		}
138		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
139			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
140			if err != nil || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
141				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
142			}
143			host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
144			segments, ok := decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
145			if !ok {
146				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
147			}
148			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
149			case "https":
150				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
152				}
153				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "https", host: host, segments: segments}, true
154			case "ssh":
155				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22" || u.User == nil || u.User.Username() != "git" {
156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
157				}
158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}
166	
167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
168		if at <= 0 || raw[:at] != "git" {
169			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
172		if colon < 0 {
173			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
174		}
175		colon += at + 1
176		host := raw[at+1 : colon]
177		if host == "" || strings.ContainsAny(host, `/\\[]:`) || !validWebHost(host) {
178			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
179		}
180		path := stripQueryFragment(raw[colon+1:])
181		segments, ok := decodeURLPath(path)
182		if !ok {
183			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
184		}
185		return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: strings.ToLower(host), segments: segments}, true
186	}

197			return "", nil, "", false
198		}
199		segments, ok = decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
200		if !ok {
201			return "", nil, "", false
202		}
203		host = strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
204		return host, segments, buildHTTPSURL(host, segments), true
205	}
206	
207	func decodeURLPath(path string) ([]string, bool) {
208		path = strings.Trim(path, "/")
209		if path == "" {
210			return nil, false
211		}
212		rawSegments := strings.Split(path, "/")
213		segments := make([]string, 0, len(rawSegments))
214		for _, raw := range rawSegments {
215			if raw == "" || hasEncodedSeparator(raw) {
216				return nil, false
217			}
218			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(raw)
219			if err != nil || decoded == "" || decoded == "." || decoded == ".." || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) ||
220				strings.ContainsAny(decoded, `/\\`) || hasEncodedSeparator(decoded) || containsControl(decoded) {
221				return nil, false
222			}
223			segments = append(segments, decoded)
224		}
225		return segments, true
226	}
227	
228	func stripGitSuffix(segments []string) []string {
229		if len(segments) == 0 {
230			return nil
231		}
232		result := append([]string(nil), segments...)
233		result[len(result)-1] = strings.TrimSuffix(result[len(result)-1], ".git")
234		if result[len(result)-1] == "" {
235			return nil
236		}
237		return result
238	}
239	
240	func validRepositorySegments(provider Kind, segments []string) bool {
241		segments = stripGitSuffix(segments)
242		switch provider {
243		case GitHub:
244			return len(segments) == 2
245		case GitLab:
246			return len(segments) >= 2
247		default:
248			return false
249		}
250	}
251	
252	func buildHTTPSURL(host string, segments []string) string {
253		return (&url.URL{Scheme: "https", Host: strings.ToLower(host), Path: "/" + strings.Join(segments, "/")}).String()
254	}
255	
256	func safeRawURLText(value string) bool {
257		return utf8.ValidString(value) && !containsControl(value)
258	}
259	
260	func containsControl(value string) bool {
261		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
262			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
263		}) >= 0
264	}
265	
266	func hasEncodedSeparator(value string) bool {
267		current := value
268		for depth := 0; depth < 8; depth++ {
269			lower := strings.ToLower(current)
270			if strings.Contains(lower, "%2f") || strings.Contains(lower, "%5c") {
271				return true
272			}
273			if !strings.ContainsRune(current, '%') {
274				return false
275			}
276			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(current)
277			if err != nil || decoded == current {
278				return false
279			}
280			current = decoded
281		}
282		// Deeply nested escaping is unnecessary for repository identities and is
283		// ambiguous across clients with different decode counts.
284		return true
285	}
286	
287	func stripQueryFragment(value string) string {
288		if index := strings.IndexAny(value, "?#"); index >= 0 {
289			return value[:index]
290		}
291		return value
292	}
293	
294	type hostPolicy struct {
295		github map[string]struct{}
296		gitlab map[string]struct{}
297	}
298	
299	func webHostPolicy(request WebURLRequest) hostPolicy {
300		policy := hostPolicy{github: map[string]struct{}{}, gitlab: map[string]struct{}{}}
301		for _, host := range append([]string{"github.com", os.Getenv("GH_HOST")}, request.GitHubHosts...) {
302			if normalized, ok := normalizeConfiguredHost(host); ok {
303				policy.github[normalized] = struct{}{}
304			}
305		}
306		for _, host := range append([]string{"gitlab.com", os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST")}, request.GitLabHosts...) {
307			if normalized, ok := normalizeConfiguredHost(host); ok {
308				policy.gitlab[normalized] = struct{}{}
309			}
310		}
311		return policy
312	}
313	
314	func (policy hostPolicy) provider(host string, ssh bool) Kind {
315		host = strings.ToLower(host)
316		if configured, decided := policy.configuredProvider(host); decided {
317			return configured
318		}
319		if ssh {
320			// An unconfigured SSH hostname may be an alias whose real web host is
321			// unrelated. Only explicit web-host configuration or public defaults can
322			// authorize an SSH transform.
323			return Unknown
324		}
325		return literalForgeHost(host)
326	}
327	
328	func (policy hostPolicy) identityProvider(host string) Kind {
329		host = strings.ToLower(host)
330		if configured, decided := policy.configuredProvider(host); decided {
331			return configured
332		}
333		// Legacy identity classification may recognize provider-named enterprise
334		// hosts. Unlike DeriveWebURL, this does not manufacture a browser hostname.
335		return literalForgeHost(host)
336	}
337	
338	func (policy hostPolicy) configuredProvider(host string) (Kind, bool) {
339		_, github := policy.github[host]
340		_, gitlab := policy.gitlab[host]
341		switch {
342		case github && gitlab:
343			return Unknown, true
344		case github:
345			return GitHub, true
346		case gitlab:
347			return GitLab, true
348		default:
349			return Unknown, false
350		}
351	}
352	
353	func literalForgeHost(host string) Kind {
354		switch {
355		case host == "github.com", strings.HasPrefix(host, "github."):
356			return GitHub
357		case host == "gitlab.com", strings.HasPrefix(host, "gitlab."):
358			return GitLab
359		default:
360			return Unknown
361		}
362	}
363	
364	func normalizeConfiguredHost(raw string) (string, bool) {
365		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
366			return "", false
367		}
368		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
369		if raw == "" {
370			return "", false
371		}
372		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
373			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
374			if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" ||
375				u.Path != "" && u.Path != "/" || u.Hostname() == "" || u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
376				return "", false
377			}
378			raw = u.Hostname()
379		} else if strings.ContainsAny(raw, `/\\@?#`) {
380			return "", false
381		} else {
382			u, err := url.Parse("//" + raw)
383			if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" || u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
384				return "", false
385			}
```

```text
13	func resolverOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
14		if err != nil {
15			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
16		}
17		return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
18	}
19	
20	// tuiRuntimeResolver moves runtime auto-detection off the first-view path while
21	// sharing exactly one result across inventory loads and actions.
22	type tuiRuntimeResolver struct {
23		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
24		resolve func() runtime.Runtime
25		once    sync.Once
26		ready   chan struct{}
27		rt      runtime.Runtime
28	}
29	
30	func newTUIRuntimeResolver(app *App) *tuiRuntimeResolver {
31		snapshot := *app
32		return &tuiRuntimeResolver{
33			trace: app.trace, resolve: snapshot.Runtime, ready: make(chan struct{}),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	func (r *tuiRuntimeResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
38		r.once.Do(func() {
39			go func() {
40				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIRuntimeResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
41				r.rt = r.resolve()
42				finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
43				close(r.ready)
44			}()
45		})
46		if ctx == nil {
47			ctx = context.Background()
48		}
49		select {
50		case <-ctx.Done():
51			return nil, ctx.Err()
52		case <-r.ready:
53			return r.rt, nil
54		}
55	}
56	
57	// tuiProjectRootResolver keeps startup-context discovery lazy and shared by
58	// SKILLS/MCP reads and skill actions.
59	type tuiProjectRootResolver struct {
60		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
61		ctx     context.Context
62		getwd   func() (string, error)
63		resolve func(context.Context, string) (agenttarget.Target, error)
64		once    sync.Once
65		ready   chan struct{}
66		target  agenttarget.Target
67		err     error
68	}
69	
70	func newTUIProjectRootResolver(trace *perftrace.Recorder, ctx context.Context) *tuiProjectRootResolver {
71		if ctx == nil {
72			ctx = context.Background()
73		}
74		return &tuiProjectRootResolver{
75			trace: trace, ctx: ctx, getwd: os.Getwd, resolve: agenttarget.Current,
76			ready: make(chan struct{}),
77		}
78	}
79	
80	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) ResolveTarget(ctx context.Context) (agenttarget.Target, error) {
81		r.once.Do(func() {
82			go func() {
83				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProjectRootResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
84				cwd, err := r.getwd()
85				if err == nil {
86					r.target, err = r.resolve(r.ctx, cwd)
87				}
88				r.err = err
89				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
90				close(r.ready)
91			}()
92		})
93		if ctx == nil {
94			ctx = context.Background()
95		}
96		select {
97		case <-ctx.Done():
98			return agenttarget.Target{}, ctx.Err()
99		case <-r.ready:
100			return r.target, r.err
101		}
102	}
103	
104	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
105		target, err := r.ResolveTarget(ctx)
106		return target.CheckoutRoot, err
107	}
108	
109	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) Current() (string, bool) {
110		select {
111		case <-r.ready:
112			return r.target.CheckoutRoot, r.err == nil
113		default:
114			return "", false
115		}
116	}
```

```text
1	package inventory
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"sync"
7	
8		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agenttarget"
10	)
11	
12	// AgentSkillOptions selects native scopes and the explicit remote freshness
13	// pass. With neither scope selected, project and global rows are both returned.
14	type AgentSkillOptions struct {
15		Project bool
16		Global  bool
17		Check   bool
18		Limiter *Limiter
19	}
20	
21	// CollectAgentSkills scans each repository target through the shared local
22	// process limiter, scans global paths once, and only then groups remote source
23	// checks across the complete result.
24	func CollectAgentSkills(ctx context.Context, targets []agenttarget.Target, options AgentSkillOptions) (agentskill.Result, error) {
25		if ctx == nil {
26			ctx = context.Background()
27		}
28		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
29		if !project && !global {
30			project, global = true, true
31		}
32		targets = agenttarget.Dedupe(targets)
33		partCount := 0
34		if project {
35			partCount += len(targets)
36		}
37		globalIndex := -1
38		if global {
39			globalIndex = partCount
40			partCount++
41		}
42		parts := make([]agentskill.Result, partCount)
43		errs := make([]error, partCount)
44		limiter := options.Limiter
45		if limiter == nil {
46			limiter = NewLimiter(8)
47		}
48	
49		var wait sync.WaitGroup
50		launch := func(index int, scan func() (agentskill.Result, error)) {
51			wait.Go(func() {
52				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
53				if !ok {
54					errs[index] = ctx.Err()
55					return
56				}
57				defer release()
58				parts[index], errs[index] = scan()
59			})
60		}
61		if project {
62			for index, target := range targets {
63				target := target
64				launch(index, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
65					return agentskill.Scan(ctx, []agenttarget.Target{target}, agentskill.ListOptions{Project: true})
66				})
67			}
68		}
69		if global {
70			launch(globalIndex, func() (agentskill.Result, error) {
71				return agentskill.Scan(ctx, nil, agentskill.ListOptions{Global: true})
72			})
73		}
74		wait.Wait()
75	
76		result := agentskill.MergeResults(parts...)
77		if options.Check && ctx.Err() == nil {
78			result.Skills = agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, result.Skills)
79		}
80		joined := errors.Join(errs...)
81		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
82			joined = errors.Join(joined, ctxErr)
83		}
84		return result, joined
85	}
86
```

```text
91	func parseMCPAgents(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, error) {
92		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Agent{
93			"claude-code": agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode,
94			"codex":       agentmcp.AgentCodex,
95			"cursor":      agentmcp.AgentCursor,
96			"gemini-cli":  agentmcp.AgentGeminiCLI,
97			"opencode":    agentmcp.AgentOpenCode,
98		}
99		result := map[agentmcp.Agent]bool{}
100		for _, value := range values {
101			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
102			agent, ok := allowed[value]
103			if !ok {
104				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP agent %q", value)
105			}
106			result[agent] = true
107		}
108		return result, nil
109	}
110	
111	func parseMCPScopes(values []string) (map[agentmcp.Scope]bool, error) {
112		allowed := map[string]agentmcp.Scope{
113			"project":         agentmcp.ScopeProject,
114			"local":           agentmcp.ScopeLocal,
115			"user":            agentmcp.ScopeUser,
116			"custom":          agentmcp.ScopeCustom,
117			"system-defaults": agentmcp.ScopeSystemDefaults,
118			"system-override": agentmcp.ScopeSystemOverride,
119			"managed":         agentmcp.ScopeManaged,
120		}
121		result := map[agentmcp.Scope]bool{}
122		for _, value := range values {
123			value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
124			scope, ok := allowed[value]
125			if !ok {
126				return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported MCP scope %q", value)
127			}
128			result[scope] = true
129		}
130		return result, nil
131	}

133	func filterMCPDeclarations(rows []agentmcp.Declaration, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Declaration {
134		filtered := make([]agentmcp.Declaration, 0, len(rows))
135		for _, row := range rows {
136			if len(agents) > 0 && !agents[row.Agent] || len(scopes) > 0 && !scopes[row.Scope] {
137				continue
138			}
139			filtered = append(filtered, row)
140		}
141		return filtered
142	}

144	func filterMCPDiagnostics(rows []agentmcp.Diagnostic, agents map[agentmcp.Agent]bool, scopes map[agentmcp.Scope]bool) []agentmcp.Diagnostic {

148				continue
149			}
150			filtered = append(filtered, row)
151		}
152		return filtered

155	func renderMCPTable(app *App, rows []agentmcp.Declaration) error {
156		if len(rows) == 0 {
157			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No MCP server declarations found.")
158			return nil
159		}
160		table := app.newTable("REPO", "SCOPE", "AGENT", "SERVER", "TRANSPORT", "STATE", "SOURCE", "TARGET", "CONFIG")
161		for _, row := range rows {
162			source := string(row.Source)
163			if row.Plugin != "" {
164				source += ":" + row.Plugin
165			}
166			target := row.Endpoint
167			if target == "" {
168				target = row.Command
169			}
170			table.Add(dash(row.Repository), string(row.Scope), string(row.Agent), row.Name,
171				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclaredState(row), source, dash(target), config.Contract(row.ConfigPath))
172		}
173		table.Render(app.Out)
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	func renderMCPDiagnostics(app *App, diagnostics []agentmcp.Diagnostic) {
178		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
179			owner := string(diagnostic.Agent) + "/" + string(diagnostic.Scope)
180			if diagnostic.Repository != "" {
181				owner = diagnostic.Repository + "/" + owner
182			}
183			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "warning: MCP inventory %s (%s): %s\n",
184				owner, config.Contract(diagnostic.ConfigPath), diagnostic.Message)
185		}
186	}
187	
188	func mcpDeclaredState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
189		if row.Enabled == nil {
190			return "configured"
191		}
192		if *row.Enabled {
193			return "enabled"
194		}
195		return "disabled"
196	}
```

```text
36	func TestProjectRootResolverIsNotPoisonedByCanceledWaiter(t *testing.T) {
37		resolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(nil, t.Context())
38		resolver.getwd = func() (string, error) { return "/repo/nested", nil }
39		started := make(chan struct{})
40		release := make(chan struct{})
41		resolver.resolve = func(ctx context.Context, _ string) (agenttarget.Target, error) {
42			close(started)
43			select {
44			case <-ctx.Done():
45				return agenttarget.Target{CheckoutRoot: "/repo/nested"}, nil
46			case <-release:
47				return agenttarget.Target{CheckoutRoot: "/repo"}, nil
48			}
49		}
50	
51		caller, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
52		first := make(chan error, 1)
53		go func() {
54			_, err := resolver.Resolve(caller)
55			first <- err
56		}()
57		<-started
58		cancel()
59		select {
60		case err := <-first:
61			if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
62				t.Fatalf("first waiter error = %v", err)
63			}
64		case <-time.After(time.Second):
65			t.Fatal("canceled waiter did not return")
66		}
67	
68		close(release)
69		root, err := resolver.Resolve(t.Context())
70		if err != nil || root != "/repo" {

72		}
73		if current, ok := resolver.Current(); !ok || current != "/repo" {
```

```text
1919	func remoteRow(provider forge.Kind, fullName, local string) tui.RemoteRow {
1920		name := fullName
1921		if i := strings.LastIndexByte(name, '/'); i >= 0 {
1922			name = name[i+1:]
1923		}
1924		return tui.RemoteRow{
```

```text
1088	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.

1090	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is

1093	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1094		var out []tui.Tool
1095		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1096			run := t.Run
1097			name := t.Name
1098			if name == "" {
1099				name = firstWord(run)
1100			}
1101			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1102			if t.Interactive {
1103				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1104				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1105				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1106				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1107				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1108			}
1109			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1110				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1111				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1112			})
1113		}
1114		return out
1115	}
```

```text
1525	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1526	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1527	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1528		if width < 20 {
1529			width = 20
1530		}
1531		var lines []string
1532		cur := ""
1533		for _, it := range items {
1534			candidate := it
1535			if cur != "" {
1536				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1537			}
1538			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1539				lines = append(lines, cur)
1540				cur = it
1541				continue
1542			}
1543			cur = candidate
1544		}
1545		if cur != "" {
1546			lines = append(lines, cur)
1547		}
1548		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1549	}

1574			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
1575		case d.Hours() < 24*14:
1576			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
1577		case d.Hours() < 24*60:

1579		default:

1581		}

1598	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1599	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1600	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1601		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1602			return s
1603		}
1604		var b strings.Builder
1605		used := 0
1606		for _, r := range s {
1607			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1608			if used+w > n-1 {
1609				break
1610			}
1611			b.WriteRune(r)
1612			used += w
1613		}
1614		return b.String() + "…"
1615	}

1618		if v < lo {
1619			return lo
1620		}
1621		if v > hi {
1622			return hi
1623		}
1624		return v
```

```text
25	func (m Model) beginSizeLoad(force bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
26		if m.actions.Sizes.Start == nil {
27			return m, nil
28		}
29		if m.sizeLoad.ID != 0 && m.actions.Sizes.Cancel != nil {
30			m.actions.Sizes.Cancel(m.sizeLoad.ID)
31		}
32		targets := make([]diskusage.Target, 0, len(m.repos)+len(m.tries))

35				targets = append(targets, row.SizeTarget)

37		}
38		for _, row := range m.tries {
39			if row.SizeTarget.Checkout != "" {
40				targets = append(targets, row.SizeTarget)
41			}
42		}
43		m.sizeLoad = m.actions.Sizes.Start(m.baseContext(), targets, force)
44		if m.sizeLoad.ID == 0 || m.sizeLoad.Results == nil {
45			return m, nil
46		}
47		return m, waitForSize(m.sizeLoad)

55			}
56			return sizeMsg{loadID: load.ID, result: result}
57		}
58	}

62		// two candidate models never share a mutated backing array.

74			}

89	func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool {
90		if usage == nil {
91			return false
92		}
93		expression = strings.TrimSpace(expression)
94		operator := "="
95		for _, candidate := range []string{">=", "<=", ">", "<", "="} {
96			if strings.HasPrefix(expression, candidate) {
97				operator = candidate
98				expression = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(expression, candidate))
99				break
100			}
101		}
102		bytes, err := humanize.ParseBytes(expression)
103		if err != nil {
104			return false
105		}
106		owned := uint64(max(usage.OwnedBytes, 0))
107		switch operator {
108		case ">=":
109			return owned >= bytes
110		case "<=":
111			return owned <= bytes
112		case ">":
113			return owned > bytes
114		case "<":
115			return owned < bytes
116		default:
117			return owned == bytes
118		}
119	}
120	
121	func sizeDetailLines(usage *diskusage.Usage, err error, target diskusage.Target) []string {
122		if target.Checkout == "" {
123			return nil
124		}
125		if err != nil {
126			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleErr.Render(err.Error()))}
127		}
128		if usage == nil {
129			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleDim.Render("measuring…"))}
130		}
131		lines := []string{
132			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s logical owned", styleDim.Render("size"), usage.HumanOwned()),
133			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("checkout"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(usage.CheckoutBytes, 0)))),
134		}
135		if usage.PrivateGitBytes != nil {
136			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("private .git"),
137				humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.PrivateGitBytes, 0)))))
138		}
139		if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
140			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s (not reclaimable with this checkout)",
141				styleDim.Render("shared .git"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.SharedGitBytes, 0)))))
142		}
143		if !usage.Complete {
144			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  partial; %d unreadable entries", styleDim.Render("measure"), usage.UnreadableEntries))
145		}
146		return lines
147	}
148	
149	func sizeCell(usage *diskusage.Usage, err error, target diskusage.Target) string {
150		switch {
151		case err != nil:
152			return "?"
153		case target.Checkout == "":
154			return "—"
155		case usage == nil:
156			return "…"
157		default:
158			value := usage.HumanOwned()
159			if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
160				value += "+S"
161			}
162			return value
163		}
164	}
```

```text
2	
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
6	
7	## [Unreleased]
8	
9	## [0.2.12] - 2026-09-04
10	
11	### Changed
12	
13	- The TUI SKILLS and MCP views are now startup-context-first. From a Git
14	  checkout they scan only the exact current worktree plus global/user sources,
15	  matching what an agent launched there can read instead of listing unrelated
16	  projects. Outside Git they retain the cross-repository inventory and include
17	  every accepted REPOS target.
18	
19	## [0.2.11] - 2026-09-04
20	
21	### Added
22	
23	- `dev pr list` shows the pull and merge requests you opened and the ones
24	  awaiting your review, and joins reported head branches to local task and
25	  checkout health. Account and per-repository surfaces remain explicit;
26	  personal per-repository queries may call once per requested role, engaged
27	  repositories bound the default local scope, and `--all-repos` widens it.
28	  `--actions` and schema-versioned `--json` emit reviewable `gh`/`glab` command
29	  strings; `dev` prints them and never runs them.
30	- `dev prompt list|render|run|open` provides a provider-neutral prompt handoff.
31	  Built-in `pr-triage`, `session-close`, and `workspace-closeout` recipes collect
32	  deterministic read-only context. `render` prints it, `run` launches a bounded
33	  batch command with no user stdin (10-minute default), and `open` launches a
34	  foreground conversation in the current terminal with no default timeout.
35	  There is no built-in vendor, agent, or launcher, and `dev` never parses the
36	  reply, loops, mutates lifecycle state, or changes permissions.
37	- Agent launchers use host-only nested configuration: `[[agent]]` selects a
38	  unique name/default, while `[agent.run]` and `[agent.open]` independently set
39	  direct `command` argv or static `shell`, `stdin|file|argv` input, plus optional
40	  batch timeout/shell-RC policy. `open` rejects stdin and timeout, prompts are never interpolated
41	  into shell text, and repository `.dev-cli/config.toml` cannot define agents.
42	- Agent profiles may include an optional description, and `dev prompt agents
43	  [--json]` exposes a sorted discovery inventory. The stable JSON objects contain
44	  name/description/default and redacted run/open capability metadata; neither
45	  output form reveals argv, shell source, executable directories, environment,
46	  prompt text, or config path.
47	- `dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees` adds a schema-version-1, report-before-apply
48	  cleanup path for Claude Workflow worktrees. A bounded private-metadata adapter
49	  verifies exact workflow/agent/path/journal linkage without decoding prompts,
50	  scripts, logs, result bodies, or transcripts; strict V1 liveness, Git/task/
51	  artifact/runtime/caller checks, ignored-file and recursive-submodule checks,
52	  and locked fingerprint revalidation all fail closed. Apply is TTY-only with
53	  per-item confirmation and plain non-force removal. Branches survive by default;
54	  separately requested deletion needs an explicit unchanged base and safe `-d`.
55	  Claude Code 2.1.259 does not expose branch/HEAD plus a non-replayable
56	  registration generation, so its current claims report `provider-git-identity`
57	  as unknown and remain report-only rather than authorizing path-reuse deletion.
58	
59	### Changed
60	
61	- `dev doctor` now reports whether `gh` and `glab` are signed in, not only
62	  whether they are installed, with the exact login command for each.
63	
64	### Fixed
65	
66	- Pull-request `--repo` selectors now constrain both account rows and local
67	  query targets, and JSON reports the effective scope after non-open account
68	  requests narrow to local collection. Schema version 1 local joins distinguish
69	  `expected_branch` from `live_branch`, report checkout existence, worktree
70	  registration and status availability/errors independently, and include Git
71	  status only when the expected branch is actually checked out. Fork pull
72	  requests join against their source repository (resolving GitLab source project
73	  IDs when needed), canonical/unmanaged/external worktrees join without a task,
74	  duplicate local clones no longer suppress the remote query, and ambiguous
75	  same-branch local evidence fails closed instead of choosing a clone. Provider
76	  host identity is preserved so an enterprise remote is never queried against
77	  the public forge, partial failures appear in JSON `warnings`, and stale GitHub
78	  checks are not reported as passing.
79	
80	## [0.2.10] - 2026-09-04
81	
82	### Fixed
83	
84	- REMOTE cloning now stays visibly pending with an animated status, lets `enter`
85	  clone and stay or `o` clone and open, and waits for a local-only repository
86	  refresh before marking the checkout as `repo` and making it searchable in
87	  REPOS. Clone, discovery, and runtime-open failures retain the last known true
88	  local state instead of reverting to a misleading `not cloned` row.
89	- The built-in `agent-ready` preset now generates one canonical, explicitly
90	  incomplete `AGENTS.md` starter with safe working rules, non-fabrication
91	  guidance, project TODOs, and concrete handoff requirements instead of pointing
92	  at undocumented checks. Its common ignore block now excludes only SpecStory's
93	  derived root `statistics.json` while leaving session histories and project
94	  config trackable; orphan salvage uses the same exact-path rule instead of
95	  discarding similarly named nested files.
96	
97	## [0.2.9] - 2026-09-03
98	
99	### Added
100	
101	- Bare `dev repo clone` and the interactive `dev start` repository step now
102	  offer a configurable line picker. Clone candidates come from the existing
103	  private forge cache without an implicit network refresh; outside a checkout,
104	  start candidates use fast live discovery and are fully resolved after selection,
105	  while the in-repository current default remains immediate. `fzf` is the
106	  default when installed, a built-in Bubble Tea selector is the automatic
107	  fallback, manual entry and non-TTY behavior remain available, and optional
108	  Television/fzf compositions over `dev repo remote --cached --json` ship under
109	  `contrib/`.
110	
111	## [0.2.8] - 2026-09-03
112	
113	### Added
114	
115	- Added the `dev ssh` command family for bounded static OpenSSH alias discovery,
116	  source-aware `list`/`show`, report-before-apply Include initialization,
117	  idempotent managed-host setup, fresh login probes, narrow removal, versioned
118	  JSON, and a six-column TSV selector contract. Setup supports explicit existing
119	  keys or Ed25519 generation, ProxyJump routes, POSIX and Windows OpenSSH targets,
120	  config-only/dry-run operation, and opt-in fleet registration after a fresh
121	  ordinary alias login succeeds.
122	- Added strict dev-owned fleet fragments beside the primary remote config
123	  (`remotes.d/ssh-<alias>.toml`, or the directory derived from `--remotes`) and
124	  `remote_os = "posix"|"windows"`. Windows fleet targets now run allowlisted
125	  hidden helpers through an encoded PowerShell launcher, with native Windows SSH,
126	  ACL, reparse-point, key-generation, cancellation, and fleet behavior enforced
127	  by a required CI gate plus Windows ARM64 compile coverage.
```

```text
19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually

21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}
```
