312	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
313		r := item.Repo
314		checkout, child := item.checkout()
315		if !child {
316			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
317				marker := "▸ "
318				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
319					marker = "▾ "
320				}
321				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
322			}
323			if name == "live" {
324				return parentLiveColumn(r)
325			}
326			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
327		}
328	
329		switch name {
330		case "repo":
331			connector := "├─ "
332			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
333				connector = "└─ "
334			}
335			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
336			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
337				label = checkout.Branch()
338			}
339			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
340				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
341			}
342			return connector + label
343		case "branch":
344			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
345				return branch
346			}
347			return "(detached)"
348		case "git":
349			switch {
350			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
351				return "prunable"
352			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
353				return "locked"
354			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
355				return "?"
356			default:
357				return checkout.Status.Summary()
358			}
359		case "live":
360			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
361		case "latest":
362			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
363		case "worktrees":
364			return "—"
365		case "tasks":
366			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
367				return "?"
368			}
369			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
370		case "notes":
371			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
372				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
373			}
374			return "—"
375		case "category":
376			return "—"
377		case "path":
378			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
379		}
380		return ""
381	}
382	
383	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
384		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
385			return "?"
386		}
387		sessions := r.Sessions()
388		if len(sessions) == 0 {
389			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
390		}
391		if len(sessions) > 1 {
392			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
393		}
394		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
395		if status != "" {
396			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
397		}
398		return r.Runtime
399	}
400	
401	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
402		if runtimeErr != nil {
403			return "?"
404		}
405		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
406			return "closed"
407		}
408		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
409			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
410		}
411		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
412			return runtimeName + ":" + status
413		}
414		return runtimeName
415	}
416	
417	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
418		if len(tasks) == 0 {
419			return "—"
420		}
421		counts := map[task.State]int{}
422		for _, t := range tasks {
423			counts[t.State]++
424		}
425		var parts []string
426		for _, state := range task.States {
427			if counts[state] > 0 {
428				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
429			}
430		}
431		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
432	}

484				break
485			}
486		}
487		return columns
488	}

248	c          confirm an absent repo; then enter stays or o opens after clone
249	q / ctrl-c request cancellation while clone/refresh/open is pending
250	r          refresh configured forge CLIs, replacing the cache
251	```
252	
253	SKILLS:
254	
255	```
256	a          open the interactive installer (default personal skill catalog)
257	c          check lock-managed Git sources without installing updates
258	u          confirm and update only the selected lock-managed skill
259	r          reload local project/global state without network access
260	```
261	
262	The detail pane separates repository/checkout, local presence/integrity, agent
263	compatibility, source, manager, and upstream freshness. Filters include
264	`repo:api`, `scope:global`, `agent:Codex`, `presence:missing`, and
265	`update:update_available`.
266	
267	MCP:
268	
269	```
270	r          reload static declarations; no server is started or probed
271	```
272	
273	The MCP detail pane contains sanitized config/source/transport/policy facts,
274	exact Claude local project identity, bounded credential-reference summaries, and
275	redaction markers—never raw args, environment/header/OAuth values, indirect file
276	content, or connection health.
277	
278	## Heatmap and live config
279	
280	```
281	H   open the selected repository's one-year activity heatmap
282	    b backfills only that repo; r rereads stats; H / esc returns
283	
284	e   edit the effective config in VISUAL/EDITOR
285	r   reparse config and reload local/remote data and tool bindings
286	```
287	
288	An empty heatmap is actionable: press `b` to derive only the selected repo's
289	history into stats.db and automatically redraw. `r` does not manufacture data;
290	it rereads what collectors/backfill have stored.
291	
292	Returning from `e` live-reloads the config. Changes to scan roots, worktree
293	policy, forge cache settings and `[[tui.tools]]` take effect immediately. A
294	runtime backend change needs a restart because existing callbacks and sessions
295	belong to the backend the TUI opened with; the status line says so rather than
296	pretending to switch underneath a live workspace.
297	
298	## External tools are explicit configuration
299	
300	```bash
301	dev tui tools
302	```
303	
304	shows every binding, the exact command, its source, and whether it can run on
305	this machine. `dev config init` writes the defaults out in full:
306	
307	```toml
308	[[tui.tools]]
309	key  = "L"
310	name = "lazygit"
311	run  = "lazygit"
312	
313	[[tui.tools]]
314	key  = "Y"
315	name = "yazi"
316	run  = "yazi"
317	
318	[[tui.tools]]
319	key  = "V"
320	name = "nvim"
321	run  = "nvim ."
322	
323	[[tui.tools]]
324	key  = "B"
325	name = "vibe"
326	run  = "vibe"
327	interactive = true
328	
329	[[tui.tools]]
330	key  = "P"
331	name = "plans here"
332	run  = "claude-plans-here"
333	interactive = true
334	```
335	
336	A configured list replaces the defaults entirely. Commands run through
337	`$SHELL` in the selected row's checkout, so arguments, environment variables
338	and executable scripts work. `interactive = true` runs through `$SHELL -lic`
339	and deliberately evaluates the command *after* rc loading, so this machine's
340	`vibe` alias and `claude-plans-here` function work. Prefer a real script on PATH
341	when the binding should be portable to machines with different shell configs.
342	The dashboard resolves availability in a bounded background load after the first
343	view; rendering itself never launches the shell. Unknown or missing bindings are
344	hidden and fail closed until the current config generation has been checked.
345	
346	Keys are case-sensitive. A tool cannot take one the dashboard owns; config
347	loading reports the collision instead of silently shadowing movement or quit.
348

8	
9	# TUI, repositories, quick notes, and bootstrap
10	
11	Bare `dev` opens an interactive dashboard when standard input/output are terminals. When piped, it prints the plain task listing so shell composition remains predictable.
12	
13	There are two independent full-screen models. Bare `dev` / `dev tui` is the
14	seven-view inventory dashboard below. Preview-labelled `dev flow [repo]` is a
15	TTY-only, plan-first lifecycle view for one canonical repository; it is not a
16	dashboard tab or mode.
17	
18	## Seven views
19	
20	| View | Question | Source |
21	|---|---|---|
22	| TASKS | What am I working on? | task registry plus live Git/runtime facts |
23	| REPOS | What durable repositories exist here? | configured scan roots and local catalog |
24	| FLEET | What exists and is active on configured machines? | accepted local REPOS snapshot plus remote `dev` snapshots over SSH |
25	| TRY | Which experiments can I resume, archive, or graduate? | experiment catalog plus live facts |
26	| REMOTE | What can I open or clone? | authenticated `gh`/`glab` inventories and cache |
27	| SKILLS | Which skills would an agent launched from this context read? | exact startup checkout plus global sources inside Git; all REPOS targets outside Git |
28	| MCP | Which MCP declarations would that context expose? | sanitized static configuration with the same context-first target scope |
29	
30	The initial TASKS frame is built before runtime auto-detection, project-root
31	lookup, cache decoding, shell tool probes, or the optional release refresh can
32	finish. TASKS, REPOS, and TRY then publish independently from one shared local
33	cycle. REMOTE, FLEET, SKILLS, and MCP stay lazy. Each requested view has a generation:
34	`r` supersedes the previous read, late results are ignored, failed refreshes keep
35	usable rows visible, and a successful empty result removes obsolete rows. Cache
36	acceptance and current live completion are distinct; there is no all-tabs-ready
37	state for optional views that may never be opened.
38	
39	Use an absolute path that does not exist for a one-run diagnostic trace:
40	
41	```bash
42	DEV_TUI_TRACE=/tmp/dev-tui-trace.json dev
43	```
44	
45	The private, bounded JSON is written after the alternate screen is restored. It
46	contains relative timings, aggregate row counts, and categorical
47	view/generation/outcome fields, never repository/task/host/tool names, paths,
48	commands, key values, URLs, handles, or
49	raw errors. It is not `stats.db` and is never sent anywhere.
50	`tui.initial_view_returned` means the Bubble Tea view string was built, not that
51	the terminal rasterized it.
52	
53	Switch with `tab`, `h`/`l`, or arrows. Use `j`/`k`, `g`/`G`, `ctrl+d`/`ctrl+u`, `/` to filter, `?` for help, and `esc`/`q` to leave the current mode.
54	
55	## Common actions
56	
57	### TASKS
58	
59	```text
60	enter/o   open the selected task
61	p         park warm and enter the next action
62	c         edit the next action
63	n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
64	1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
65	```
66	
67	A COLD worktree task must be rebuilt with `dev resume`; the dashboard does not silently recreate it through a generic open action. A missing or unregistered worktree points to `dev sweep` first, so unique agent artifacts are reported for salvage before the task is resumed or reaped. Enter never opens an abandoned artifact-only directory. At 97 or more terminal cells the TASKS table includes a display-width-aware `REPO` column; narrower layouts retain the previous columns and show repo/path in detail.
68	
69	### Repository flow
70	
71	```bash
72	dev flow              # exact current surface, or picker outside Git
73	dev flow api          # explicit repository
74	```
75	
76	Flow lists every registered worktree plus task-only COLD/DONE rows and labels
77	canonical/managed/unmanaged/harness/task-only/conflict topology. Use `j/k` for
78	rows, `h/l` for actions, Tab for panel focus, Enter to build a plan, then `y` or
79	the displayed typed token to approve only a READY plan. `r` reloads local facts;
80	`R` offers explicit fetch, review query, or both. Startup and `r` never use the
81	network.
82	
83	The plan separates persisted HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE intent from live evidence,
84	shows remediation/fallback for blocked actions, and is revalidated against the
85	exact task revision and Git/worktree/runtime/artifact identity before Apply.
86	Partial effects remain in a result ledger. Eligible unmanaged rows can be
87	metadata-only Adopted or cleanly Removed while preserving their branch;
88	canonical/harness/conflict destruction fails closed. See [Repository lifecycle
89	flow](repository-flow.md) for action and compatibility boundaries.
90	
91	### REPOS
92	
93	```text
94	enter/o   ad-hoc open without creating a task
95	space     expand linked worktrees
96	m         edit repository tags/summary
97	n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
98	d         track direct work on the current branch
99	s         start isolated work: branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
100	H         open the repository activity heatmap
101	y         open copy/context actions
102	```
103	
104	Expanded rows explain every linked worktree, including harness-owned `(ephemeral)` and otherwise unmanaged `(external)` checkouts. The LIVE column shows runtime activity separately from task state.
105	
106	`dev repo context [repo]` emits the same agent-ready Markdown context available from the TUI copy menu, including paths, Git/worktree/runtime facts, and tasks. `--json` adds the schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract; `--refresh` is the only form that live-probes optional forge and configured fleet sources.
107	
108	### TRY and REMOTE
109	
110	TRY handles low-cost experiments, reversible archive/restore, marking, and graduation. Archive is organization, not deletion or disk reclamation.
111	
112	REMOTE loads lazily so startup does not wait for the network. Its private XDG
113	cache is decoded after the first view and holds the complete paginated inventory.
114	Fresh rows require no network; stale rows stay searchable while background
115	refresh runs. Oversized/malformed payloads and caches fingerprinted for another
116	configured GH/GL host or Azure target are ignored. GitLab uses explicit
117	`GITLAB_HOST`/`GLAB_HOST` (default `gitlab.com`) instead of inferring a host from
118	cwd; successful empty inventories clear old rows. Enter opens an existing local
119	clone. For an absent repository, `c` confirms a path-confined `project_root`
120	destination; `enter` clones and stays in the dashboard, while `o` clones and
121	opens afterward. A `project_root` outside the configured REPOS discovery
122	roots/depth is rejected before mutation. An animated row/status marker remains
123	visible through Git clone and the local-only, generation-guarded REPOS refresh;
124	`q`/Ctrl-C requests cancellation without abandoning the in-flight result. Once
125	accepted, REMOTE marks the checkout as `repo` and REPOS can search it
126	immediately. If Git leaves a destination after failure, REMOTE marks its exact
127	path `inspect` instead of deleting it or offering a misleading retry. `r` forces a forge refresh.
128	Use `/vis:private` for an exact visibility filter. Notes are enabled only after
129	a REMOTE row resolves to a local clone. TRY keeps lowercase `n` for creating a
130	new Try rather than a repository note.
131	
132	### CLI repository pickers
133	
134	Bare `dev repo clone` opens a picker over the existing private forge cache. It
135	uses each provider's exact clone URL, never refreshes the network implicitly,
136	and keeps a manual URL/path/`owner/name` choice. A stale or incomplete cache is
137	still selectable with a warning; populate or replace it explicitly:
138	
139	```bash
140	dev repo remote --refresh
141	dev repo clone
142	```
143	
144	Outside a checkout, bare `dev start` uses the same picker UI over fast live
145	local discovery, then fully resolves the selected repository before planning a
146	task. Inside a repository it retains the immediate current-repository default
147	without scanning every configured root. The default
148	external selector is `fzf`; a missing executable falls back to the built-in
149	Bubble Tea list, and `[picker] command = []` forces that list. Compatible
150	external commands receive candidates on stdin and must return one unchanged
151	line on stdout. Non-TTY callers retain line prompts and never receive picker UI.
152	
153	The repository's `contrib/television/dev-remote-repos.toml` and
154	`contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash` compose over the same public source instead of
155	creating another inventory:
156	
157	```bash
158	dev repo remote --refresh                 # populate once or refresh deliberately
159	ref="$(tv dev-remote-repos)" && [ -n "$ref" ] && dev repo clone "$ref"
160	source contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash
161	dev-repo-clone-fzf
162	```
163	
164	Both external recipes require `jq`, read `dev repo remote --cached --json`, and
165	pass one quoted clone URL to `dev repo clone`. They are examples to copy or
166	symlink; dev does not modify Television, shell, or chezmoi configuration.
167	
168	### FLEET
169	
170	FLEET also loads lazily. It keeps valid cached rows usable while waiting for the
171	current REPOS generation to be accepted, reuses that snapshot for the local host
172	instead of scanning repositories again, and then fans out to configured SSH
173	hosts. This machine is hidden by default because REPOS already provides the
174	richer local inventory; press `a` to include/hide local rows. Press `r` to
175	supersede an older request and force a live reload. Changing any endpoint field,
176	including SSH port, invalidates that host's cache. None of this changes
177	`dev fleet list`, whose non-interactive output continues to include this machine.
178	
179	## Repository quick notes
180	
181	On TASKS and REPOS, lowercase `n` opens a one-line quick-add prompt and uppercase `N` opens the selected repository's notes overlay. A child worktree resolves to the same canonical repository through catalog identity.
182	
183	```text
184	j/k       move
185	/         search body, tags, and repository
186	Enter     expand or collapse the Markdown body
187	a or n    add another note
188	e         edit the body in VISUAL/EDITOR
189	d         enter confirmation; y deletes
190	Esc       return without changing data
191	```
192	
193	The optional REPOS column `notes` shows a count. It is off by default because the table is width-constrained. Repository detail shows the count and latest preview when notes exist; task detail does so when the task resolves to a loaded repository row.
194	
195	The same source-of-truth workflow is available without the TUI:
196	
197	```bash
198	dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
199	dev note list api
200	dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
201	dev note show <id-or-prefix>
202	dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
203	dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # confirms
204	dev note path api
205	dev note reindex
206	```
207	
208	A note ID prefix must be unique and at least eight characters.
209	
210	Markdown under configured `paths.state_dir/notes` is durable; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is only a rebuildable search index. See the [complete generated command reference](../reference/commands-config.md#complete-generated-command-reference) for exact flags.
211	
212	SKILLS and MCP both load lazily after the current REPOS generation is accepted.
213	Inside Git they scan only the exact startup checkout plus global/user sources,
214	matching what an agent launched there can read and excluding unrelated projects.
215	Outside Git they retain the cross-repository inventory, scanning every accepted
216	REPOS target plus the ordinary startup directory. Refreshes keep
217	usable rows visible, warning-only partial inventories stay fresh, and a visible
218	capability view resumes automatically after REPOS recovers.
219	
220	SKILLS reads the versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry and lock files
221	natively—no Node, `skills`, npm, `npx`, agent detector, or project code runs.
222	Same-named project/global/repository rows remain distinct. Presence and embedded
223	`dev-cli` integrity are local facts; update state is a separate lock-recorded
224	upstream comparison. `c` is the explicit grouped Git source check, `a` opens the
225	upstream interactive installer, and `u` confirms before updating only the
226	selected lock-managed skill in that row's checkout. The check hashes Git object
227	bytes without populating a checkout; locale-dependent non-ASCII folder hashes stay
228	unverifiable. Mutations require a directly installed `skills` executable, skip
229	repository-local npm shims, reject source-less locks, and serialize cooperating
230	`dev` processes. Filters include `repo:`, `scope:`, `agent:`, `update:`,
231	`presence:`, and `integrity:`.
232	
233	MCP reads static declarations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and
234	OpenCode. It preserves file/scope rows and exact Claude local project keys instead
235	of guessing a generally effective configuration; only Claude's documented
236	user/project/local/managed project approvals are resolved. An absolute
237	`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` relocates Claude user sources. Configured/enabled/disabled
238	never means connected or healthy. Provider-specific environment reference names
239	and finite OAuth facts remain, while values, raw arguments, URL
240	credentials/path/query/fragment, and indirect file content are discarded before
241	rows enter the model. The scanner never runs a server, helper, URL, or agent MCP
242	command. Filters include `repo:`,
243	`agent:`, `scope:`, `transport:`, `managed:`, and `state:`; `r` only rereads
244	static files.
245	
246	## External tools
247	
248	```bash
249	dev tui tools
250	```
251	
252	Configured tools run through `$SHELL` in the selected checkout while the alternate screen is suspended. `interactive = true` uses `$SHELL -lic` so local aliases/functions can resolve; use a real executable on `PATH` when the binding must be portable. Availability probes run in a bounded background load after the first view; rendering never starts a login shell, and unresolved bindings fail closed.
253	
254	```toml
255	[[tui.tools]]
256	key = "L"
257	name = "lazygit"
258	run = "lazygit"
259	```
260	
261	Keys are case-sensitive and cannot shadow dashboard-owned bindings. Returning from an editor can reload most config; switching runtime backend requires restarting the TUI.
262	
263	## Inventory an existing machine
264	
265	Start with a report:
266	
267	```bash
268	dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
269	dev bootstrap ~/code --json
270	```
271	
272	The scanner identifies canonical checkouts, linked worktrees, bare repositories, and symlink aliases, then deduplicates them by Git identity.
273	
274	The recommended organization layer is a non-destructive symlink index:
275	
276	```bash
277	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
278	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
279	```
280
```

10	# TUI、Repository、Quick Notes 與 Bootstrap

18	
19	## 七個 view
20	
21	| View | 回答問題 | 來源 |
22	|---|---|---|
23	| TASKS | 我正在處理什麼？ | task registry 加即時 Git/runtime facts |
24	| REPOS | 本機有哪些持久 repositories？ | 設定的 scan roots 與 local catalog |
25	| FLEET | 設定的機器上有哪些 repository 與 active work？ | 已接受的 local REPOS snapshot 加上透過 SSH 取得的 remote `dev` snapshots |

30	
31	初始 TASKS frame 會先建立，不等待 runtime auto-detection、project-root lookup、
32	cache decode、shell tool probe 或 optional release refresh 完成。TASKS、REPOS 與
33	TRY 接著由同一個 shared local cycle 獨立發布；REMOTE、FLEET、SKILLS 與 MCP 維持
34	lazy。每個被請求的 view 都有自己的 generation：`r` 會 supersede 舊讀取，晚到

45	Private、bounded JSON 會在 alternate screen 還原後才寫入。內容只有 relative timing、
46	aggregate row counts 與 categorical view/generation/outcome fields，不包含 repository/task/host/tool
47	名稱、paths、commands、key values、URLs、handles 或 raw errors。它不是

53	## 常用 actions
54	
55	### TASKS
56	
57	```text
58	enter/o   開啟選取的 task
59	p         park warm 並輸入 next action
60	c         編輯 next action
61	n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
62	1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
63	```
64	
65	COLD worktree task 必須透過 `dev resume` 重建；TUI 不會用 generic open action 靜默重建。若 worktree 已遺失或不再由 Git 註冊，必須先執行 `dev sweep`，讓它在 resume 或 reap 前回報需要 salvage 的 agent artifacts。Enter 不會開啟只剩 artifacts 的 abandoned directory。Terminal 寬度至少 97 cells 時，TASKS table 會顯示 display-width-aware `REPO` column；更窄時保留原 columns，並在 detail 顯示 repo/path。
66	
67	### REPOS
68	
69	```text
70	enter/o   ad-hoc open，不建立 task
71	space     展開 linked worktrees
72	m         編輯 repository tags/summary
73	n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
74	d         追蹤目前 branch 的 direct work
75	s         啟動 isolated work：branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
76	H         開啟 repository activity heatmap
77	y         開啟 copy/context actions
78	```
79	
80	展開後會顯示每個 linked worktree，包括 harness-owned `(ephemeral)` 與未受管理的 `(external)` checkout。LIVE column 將 runtime activity 與 task state 分開。
81	
82	`dev repo context [repo]` 會輸出 TUI copy menu 相同的 agent-ready Markdown context，包含 paths、Git/worktree/runtime facts 與 tasks。`--json` 加入 schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract；只有 `--refresh` 會 live-probe optional forge 與 configured fleet sources。
83	
84	### 獨立 Repository Flow
85	
86	```text
87	dev flow [repo]         依 cwd 或明確 repo 開啟 canonical repository
88	j/k 或 Up/Down          選 surface row
89	h/l 或 Left/Right       選 action
90	Enter                   只建立 plan
91	r                       只更新 local facts
92	R                       明確選 fetch refs、query review 或 both
93	```
94

113	exact path 標成 `inspect`，不會自動刪除或提供誤導性的 retry。`r` 才會
114	強制更新 forge inventories。使用 `/vis:private` 可精確過濾 visibility。只有 REMOTE row
115	能解析到 local clone 時才能使用 notes。TRY 保留 lowercase `n` 建立新 Try，不會改成
116	repository note。
117	
118	### CLI repository pickers
119	
120	Bare `dev repo clone` 會對既有 private forge cache 開啟 picker。它使用各 provider
121	的 exact clone URL，絕不 implicit refresh network，並保留 manual URL/path/`owner/name`
122	選項。Stale 或 incomplete cache 仍可選，但會顯示 warning；cache 必須明確 populate
123	或 replace：
124	
125	```bash
126	dev repo remote --refresh
127	dev repo clone
128	```
129	
130	在 checkout 外，bare `dev start` 使用相同 picker UI 選 fast live local discovery
131	的結果，之後才 full resolve 選定 repository 並規劃 task。在 repository 內則保留
132	immediate current-repository default，不掃描所有 configured roots。Default external selector 是 `fzf`；
133	executable 缺少時 fallback 到 built-in Bubble Tea list，`[picker] command = []` 會
134	強制使用 built-in。相容 external command 從 stdin 讀 candidates，並須在 stdout
135	原樣回傳一行。Non-TTY caller 保留 line prompt，絕不收到 picker UI。
136	
137	Repository 的 `contrib/television/dev-remote-repos.toml` 與
138	`contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash` 會組合相同 public source，不建立另一份 inventory：
139	
140	```bash
141	dev repo remote --refresh                 # 只在明確要求時 populate／refresh
142	ref="$(tv dev-remote-repos)" && [ -n "$ref" ] && dev repo clone "$ref"
143	source contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash
144	dev-repo-clone-fzf
145	```
146	
147	兩個 external recipe 都需要 `jq`、只讀 `dev repo remote --cached --json`，並將
148	一個 quoted clone URL 傳給 `dev repo clone`。它們是供 copy 或 symlink 的範例；
149	dev 不會修改 Television、shell 或 chezmoi config。

151	### FLEET
152	
153	FLEET 同樣延遲載入。等待目前的 REPOS generation 被接受時，仍可使用 valid
154	cached rows；接受後會重用該 snapshot 作為 local host 資料，不再重掃
155	repositories，接著才 fan out 到設定的 SSH hosts。它預設隱藏本機，因為 REPOS
156	已提供較完整的 local inventory；按 `a` 可顯示或隱藏 local rows。按 `r` 會
157	supersede 舊 request 並強制執行 live reload。任何 endpoint field（包含 SSH
158	port）改變都會讓該 host cache 失效。這不會改變 `dev fleet list`：其
159	non-interactive output 仍包含本機與所有已設定的 remote hosts。
160	
161	## Repository quick notes
162	
163	在 TASKS 與 REPOS，lowercase `n` 開啟單行 quick-add prompt，uppercase `N` 開啟選取 repository 的 notes overlay。Child worktree 會透過 catalog identity 解析到同一個 canonical repository。
164	
165	```text
166	j/k       移動
167	/         搜尋 body、tags 與 repository
168	Enter     展開或收合 Markdown body
169	a or n    新增另一則 note
170	e         用 VISUAL/EDITOR 編輯 body
171	d         進入確認；y 才刪除
172	Esc       不改資料並返回
173	```
174	
175	可選的 REPOS column `notes` 顯示數量。Table 寬度有限，因此預設不啟用。Notes 存在時，repository detail 顯示數量與最新 preview；task 能解析到已載入 repository row 時，task detail 才會顯示。
176

180	dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
181	dev note list api
182	dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
183	dev note show <id-or-prefix>
184	dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
185	dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # 會確認
186	dev note path api
187	dev note reindex
188	```
189	
190	Note ID prefix 必須唯一，且至少八個字元。

193	
194	SKILLS 與 MCP 都會等目前 REPOS generation 被接受後才延遲載入。在 Git 內，兩者只掃描

196	不再混入無關 projects。在 Git 外則保留 cross-repository inventory，掃描所有 accepted
197	REPOS targets 加 ordinary startup directory。Refresh 時會保留可用 rows；warning-only partial inventory

200	SKILLS 直接讀取 versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry 與 lock files；

202	project/global/repository rows 保持分開。Presence 與 embedded `dev-cli` integrity
203	是 local facts；update state 則是獨立的 lock-recorded upstream comparison。`c`
204	是明確且 grouped 的 Git source check；`a` 開啟 upstream interactive installer；
205	`u` 先確認，再於該 row 的 checkout 更新選取且受 lock 管理的 skill。Check 直接
206	hash Git object bytes，不建立 checkout；依 locale 排序的 non-ASCII folder hash
207	維持 unverifiable。Mutation 需要直接安裝的 `skills` executable，會跳過
208	repository-local npm shim、拒絕 source-less lock，並在 cooperating `dev` processes
209	之間 serialized。Filters 包含 `repo:`、`scope:`、`agent:`、`update:`、
210	`presence:` 與 `integrity:`。
211	
212	MCP 會讀取 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 與 OpenCode 的 static
213	declarations。它保留 file/scope rows 與 exact Claude local project key，不猜測
214	一般化的 effective config；只有 Claude documented user/project/local/managed
215	project approvals 會被解析。Absolute `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 會搬移 Claude user
216	sources。Configured/enabled/disabled 不代表 connected 或 healthy。Provider-specific
217	environment reference names 與有限 OAuth facts 會保留；其 values、raw arguments、
218	URL credentials/path/query/fragment 與 indirect file content 都會在 row 進入 model
219	前被丟棄。Scanner 不會執行 server、helper、URL 或 agent MCP command。Filters 包含 `repo:`、`agent:`、`scope:`、`transport:`、
220	`managed:` 與 `state:`；`r` 只重讀 static files。

222	## External tools
223	
224	```bash
225	dev tui tools
226	```
227	
228	設定的 tool 會在暫停 alternate screen 後，透過 `$SHELL` 於選取 checkout 執行。`interactive = true` 使用 `$SHELL -lic`，讓 local aliases/functions 能解析；跨機器需要 portability 時應使用 `PATH` 中的真實 executable。Availability probe 會在 first view 後以 bounded background load 執行；rendering 不會啟動 login shell，尚未解析的 binding 會 fail closed。
229	
230	```toml

232	key = "L"
233	name = "lazygit"
234	run = "lazygit"
235	```
236	
237	Key 區分大小寫，且不能覆蓋 dashboard-owned binding。離開 editor 後可 reload 多數 config；更換 runtime backend 需要重啟 TUI。

239	Configured tool 是刻意保留的 escape hatch：它在選取 checkout 執行任意 configured command，不會自動繼承 `dev flow` 的 PlanID、conditions、agent occupancy 或 revalidation guards。Raw Git／forge command 也是同樣邊界；operator 必須自行確認其 safety。

1	# Agent skill and MCP inventory
2	
3	Use these inventories to answer two different questions:
4	
5	- `dev skill list`: which reusable instruction packages are present, and whether
6	  an explicit upstream source check reports newer lock-recorded content.
7	- `dev mcp list`: which external MCP capabilities are declared in supported
8	  static agent configuration files.
9	
10	Do not treat an MCP declaration as a skill, a live connection, or permission to
11	invoke tools.
12	
13	## Skill inventory
14	
15	```bash
16	dev skill list
17	dev skill list --repo <repo-or-checkout> --project
18	dev skill list --all
19	dev skill list --all --check --json
20	```
21	
22	Reads use a versioned snapshot of all 77 agent paths from `skills@1.5.23` plus
23	project/global locks. They never execute `skills`, Node, npm, `npx`, agent
24	detectors, or project code. `--all` scans canonical repositories. The TUI is
25	context-first: inside Git it scans only the exact startup checkout plus global
26	paths; outside Git it scans all accepted REPOS targets plus the ordinary startup
27	directory.
28	
29	Keep status dimensions separate:
30	
31	- presence: local directory present or lock-only/missing;
32	- integrity: only embedded `dev-cli` files can be verified against the binary; additional user files are ignored;
33	- update: lock-recorded upstream content is unchecked/current/changed/missing or
34	  unverifiable.
35	
36	`--check` is the explicit network action. It groups equal Git source/ref pairs
37	and hashes Git object bytes without populating a checkout, so filters/autocrlf do
38	not run or alter results. Non-ASCII provider folder hashes remain unverifiable
39	when locale ordering cannot be reproduced. `skill add` and `skill update` are
40	explicit, serialized mutations and require a directly installed `skills`
41	executable; `dev` skips repository-local npm bins and rejects source-less locks.
42	
43	## MCP inventory

45	```bash
46	dev mcp list
47	dev mcp list --repo <repo-or-checkout>
48	dev mcp list --all --json
49	dev mcp list --agent claude-code,codex --scope project
50	```
51	
52	Adapters cover Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. Rows remain
53	scope-qualified declarations; local Claude rows retain the exact project key and
54	an absolute `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` relocates user sources. `dev` resolves only
55	Claude's documented user/project/local/managed project approvals; it does not
56	guess a generally effective configuration. `configured`, `enabled`, and
57	`disabled` are declaration/approval facts, not health.
58	
59	The TUI applies the same context-first target policy as SKILLS: the exact startup
60	checkout inside Git, or the cross-repository REPOS inventory outside Git.

67

70	Treat the coverage metadata as part of the result.

553	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
554		if at.IsZero() {
555			return "—"
556		}
557		d := time.Since(at)
558		switch {
559		case d < time.Hour:
560			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
561		case d < 24*time.Hour:
562			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
563		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
564			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
565		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
566			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
567		default:
568			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
569		}
570	}

576		}

12	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {

14			return m.runContext
15		}
16		return context.Background()

27		if m.configCancel != nil {
28			m.configCancel()
29		}
30		m.configGeneration++
31		m.configContext, m.configCancel = context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())

42	type loadCause string

47		loadRefresh loadCause = "refresh"
48		loadConfig  loadCause = "config"

52	// viewLoadState is deliberately plain value state. Model is copied by Bubble
53	// Tea, so request state must not hide a mutable map or shared slice.
54	type viewLoadState struct {
55		generation  uint64
56		cause       loadCause
57		requested   bool
58		loading     bool
59		hasSnapshot bool
60		source      perftrace.Source

67		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewFleet, m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil)
68		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewSkills, m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil)
69		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewMCP, m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil)
70	}

72	func (m *Model) prepareRepoDependentForReload(view View, enabled bool) {
73		if !enabled {
74			return
75		}
76		state := m.viewLoad(view)
77		switch {
78		case state.loading || m.view == view:
79			m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
80			m.setViewStatus(view, "waiting for local repositories…")
81		case state.hasSnapshot:
82			m.invalidateView(view)
83		}
84	}

86	func (m *Model) beginViewLoad(view View, cause loadCause) uint64 {
87		if view == ViewRepos {
88			m.prepareRepoDependentsForReload()
89		}
90		index := int(view)
91		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
92			cancel()
93		}
94		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
95		m.loadContexts[index] = ctx
96		m.loadCancels[index] = cancel
97		if view == ViewRepos && m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
98			// A newer REPOS generation may supersede the clone-triggered refresh.
99			// Cancellation must always follow the generation that can complete it.
100			m.remoteClone.cancel = cancel
101		}
102		state := &m.loads[index]
103		state.generation++
104		state.cause = cause
105		state.requested = true
106		state.loading = true
107		state.outcome = ""
108		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = nil
109		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = ""
110		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadRequested, perftrace.Fields{
111			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageRequested, Generation: state.generation,
112		})
113		return state.generation
114	}

116	func (m *Model) beginLocalLoads(cause loadCause) (tasks, repos, tries uint64) {
117		if m.localCancel != nil {
118			m.localCancel()
119		}
120		m.localContext, m.localCancel = context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
121		m.localGeneration++
122		tasks = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTasks, cause)
123		repos = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, cause)
124		tries = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTries, cause)
125		if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
126			// Production's shared loader reads localContext rather than the per-view
127			// context created above, so cancellation follows the actual producer.
128			m.remoteClone.cancel = m.localCancel
129		}
130		return tasks, repos, tries
131	}

203	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
204		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {

216		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
217		state.outcome = outcome

220			state.source = source
221			state.freshness = freshness

226				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,

228			})
229		} else if state.hasSnapshot {

235			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,

259		case err != nil || !valid:

35				n, err := terminal.Read(buffer)
36				if n > 0 {
37					chunks <- append([]byte(nil), buffer[:n]...)
38				}
39				if err != nil {
40					readErr <- err
41					return
42				}
43			}
44		}()
45	
46		var output bytes.Buffer
47		frameDeadline := time.NewTimer(15 * time.Second)
48		defer frameDeadline.Stop()
49		for !bytes.Contains(output.Bytes(), []byte("TASKS")) ||
50			!bytes.Contains(output.Bytes(), []byte("Loading tasks")) {
51			select {
52			case chunk := <-chunks:
53				output.Write(chunk)
54			case err := <-readErr:
55				if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) {
56					t.Fatalf("read PTY before initial frame: %v\n%s", err, output.Bytes())
57				}
58				t.Fatalf("PTY closed before initial frame:\n%s", output.Bytes())
59			case <-frameDeadline.C:
60				_ = command.Process.Kill()
61				_ = command.Wait()
62				t.Fatalf("initial frame did not appear while producer was blocked:\n%s", output.Bytes())
63			}
64		}
65		if _, err := terminal.Write([]byte("q")); err != nil {
66			t.Fatal(err)
67		}
68	
69		exited := make(chan error, 1)
70		go func() { exited <- command.Wait() }()
71		select {
72		case err := <-exited:
73			if err != nil {
74				t.Fatalf("TUI did not exit cleanly after q: %v\n%s", err, output.Bytes())
75			}
76		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
77			_ = command.Process.Kill()
78			<-exited
79			t.Fatalf("TUI did not process q while producer was blocked:\n%s", output.Bytes())
80		}
81	}

333	func normalizeOptions(options Options) Options {

335			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
336		}
337		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
338			options.XDGConfigHome = ""
339		}
340		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
341			options.CodexHome = ""
342		}
343		if options.GeminiCLIHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.GeminiCLIHome) {
344			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
345		}
346		for _, path := range []*string{&options.ClaudeUserConfigPath, &options.ClaudeUserSettingsPath, &options.ClaudeManagedConfigPath} {
347			if *path != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(*path) {
348				*path = ""
349			}
350		}
351		managedSettings := make([]string, 0, len(options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths))
352		for _, path := range options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths {
353			if filepath.IsAbs(path) {
354				managedSettings = append(managedSettings, filepath.Clean(path))
355			}
356		}
357		options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths = managedSettings
358		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {
359			options.Concurrency = defaultConcurrency
360		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
361			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
362		}
363		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {
364			options.MaxFileBytes = DefaultMaxFileBytes
365		} else if options.MaxFileBytes > maximumMaxFileBytes {
366			options.MaxFileBytes = maximumMaxFileBytes
367		}
368		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {
369			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = defaultSymlinkDepth
370		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
371			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
372		}
373		return options
374	}

376	func normalizeTargets(targets []Target, cwd string) []Target {
377		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
378		for _, target := range targets {
379			if strings.TrimSpace(target.CheckoutRoot) == "" {
380				continue
381			}
382			checkout := target.CheckoutRoot
383			if !filepath.IsAbs(checkout) {
384				checkout = filepath.Join(cwd, checkout)
385			}
386			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(checkout)
387			if err != nil {
388				continue
389			}
390			target.CheckoutRoot = filepath.Clean(absolute)
391			if target.RepoPath == "" {
392				target.RepoPath = target.CheckoutRoot
393			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(target.RepoPath) {
394				target.RepoPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, target.RepoPath))
395			}
396			target.RepoDisplay = strings.TrimSpace(target.RepoDisplay)
397			if target.RepoDisplay == "" {
398				target.RepoDisplay = target.RepoName
399			}
400			if target.CommonDir == "" {
401				target.CommonDir = target.RepoPath
402			}
403			out = append(out, target)
404		}
405		return agenttarget.Dedupe(out)
406	}

510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)
512		if !read.present {
513			if read.code == "" {
514				return nil, nil
515			}
516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {
518				localSpec := spec
519				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
520				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, read.code))
521			}
522			return nil, diagnostics
523		}
524		var rows []Declaration
525		var codes []DiagnosticCode
526		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
527		switch spec.adapter {
528		case adapterClaudeProject:
529			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {
532				approval := readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
533				switch {
534				case approval.code != "":
535					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
536				case approval.present:
537					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
538					if code != "" {
539						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
540					} else {
541						approvalState.merge(enabled, disabled, enableAll)
542					}
543				}
544			}
545			applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, approvalState.enabled, approvalState.disabled, approvalState.enableAll)
546		case adapterClaudeUser:
547			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:
557			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
559			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
560		default:
561			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics
570	}
571	
572	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
573		return Diagnostic{
574			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
575			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout,
576			LocalProjectPath: spec.localProjectPath, ConfigPath: spec.path,
577			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
578		}
579	}
580	
581	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
582		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
583		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
584			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
585			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
586			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
587			for n := range ak {
588				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
589					return ak[n] < bk[n]
590				}
591			}
592			return false
593		})
594	}

116	// dedupeScanLocations first coalesces identical registry paths, then aliases to
117	// the same physical directory. The latter retains every logical path and agent
118	// attribution while ensuring the directory is read only once.
119	func dedupeScanLocations(input []logicalScanLocation) []physicalScanLocation {
120		byLogical := map[string]*logicalScanLocation{}
121		for _, location := range input {
122			path := filepath.Clean(location.Path)
123			current := byLogical[path]
124			if current == nil {
125				copy := logicalScanLocation{Path: path}
126				byLogical[path] = &copy
127				current = &copy
128			}
129			current.AgentIDs = append(current.AgentIDs, location.AgentIDs...)
130		}
131		logicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byLogical))
132		for path := range byLogical {
133			logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, path)
134		}
135		sort.Strings(logicalPaths)
136	
137		byPhysical := map[string]*physicalScanLocation{}
138		for _, path := range logicalPaths {
139			logical := *byLogical[path]
140			logical.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(logical.AgentIDs)

329	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
330		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(filename)
331		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
332			return "", false, nil
333		}
334		if errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular) {
335			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
336		}
337		if err != nil {
338			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
339		}
340		defer file.Close()
341	
342		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
343		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
344		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
345		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
346		consumed := int64(len(first))
347		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
348			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
349		}
350		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
351		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
352			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
353		}
354		var frontmatter strings.Builder
355		closed := false
356		for {
357			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
358			consumed += int64(len(line))
359			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
360				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
361			}
362			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
363				closed = true
364				break
365			}
366			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
367			if lineErr != nil {
368				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
369					break
370				}
371				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
372			}
373		}
374		if !closed {
375			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376		}
377		var metadata struct {
378			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
379			Description string `yaml:"description"`
380		}
381		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
382			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
383		}
384		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
385		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
386		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
387			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
388		}
389		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
390			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
391		}
392		return metadata.Name, true, nil
393	}

482	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {
483		files, err := skill.Files()
484		if err != nil {
485			row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
486			row.IntegrityDetail = err.Error()
487			return
488		}
489		row.Integrity = IntegrityVerified
490		row.IntegrityDetail = "all embedded files match this dev binary"
491		for index := range row.Installations {
492			status, detail := bundledIntegrity(row.Installations[index].RealPath, files)
493			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status
494			row.Installations[index].IntegrityDetail = detail
495			if status == IntegrityDrifted {
496				row.Integrity = IntegrityDrifted
497				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
498			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {
499				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown
500				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
501			}
502		}
503	}
504	
505	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
506		for relative, want := range files {
507			got, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), filepath.Join(directory, relative), int64(len(want))+1)
508			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
509				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
510			}
511		}
512		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
513	}
514	
515	// bundledStatus preserves the legacy update-status contract while deriving it
516	// from the already-computed aggregate integrity across every installation.
517	func bundledStatus(integrity Integrity, detail string) (UpdateStatus, string) {
518		if integrity == IntegrityVerified {
519			return UpdateCurrent, detail
520		}
521		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
522			return UpdateAvailable, detail
523		}
524		return UpdateFailed, detail
525	}

541			return parsed.String()

140	// Registry returns the complete path snapshot with environment overrides
141	// resolved for this process. Results are sorted by stable agent ID.
142	func Registry() []AgentDefinition {
143		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
144		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
145			home = ""
146		}
147		definitions := make([]AgentDefinition, 0, len(registrySnapshot))
148		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
149			base, environment := resolveGlobalBase(entry.base, home)
150			global := ""
151			if entry.base != baseNone && base != "" {
152				global = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(entry.global))
153			}
154			definitions = append(definitions, AgentDefinition{
155				ID: entry.id, DisplayName: entry.display,
156				ProjectSkillsDir: filepath.FromSlash(entry.project),
157				GlobalSkillsDir:  global, GlobalEnvironment: environment,
158				RegistrySource: RegistrySource, RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
159			})
160		}
161		sort.Slice(definitions, func(i, j int) bool { return definitions[i].ID < definitions[j].ID })
162		return definitions
163	}
164	
165	func agentDisplayNames(ids []string) []string {
166		byID := make(map[string]string, len(registrySnapshot))
167		for _, entry := range registrySnapshot {
168			byID[entry.id] = entry.display
169		}
170		names := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			if name := byID[id]; name != "" {
173				names = append(names, name)
174			} else {
175				names = append(names, id)
176			}
177		}
178		return uniqueSorted(names)
179	}
180	
181	func resolveGlobalBase(base globalBase, home string) (string, string) {
182		switch base {
183		case baseNone:
184			return "", ""
185		case baseHome:

22	
23	// MutationProvider describes the explicit installer boundary without running
24	// it. Repository-scoped mutations require a direct executable: invoking npx in
25	// an untrusted checkout could substitute a repository-local binary.
26	type MutationProvider struct {
27		Available bool
28		Command   string
29		Path      string
30		Detail    string
31	}
32	
33	// MutationCommand keeps provider execution behind one host-wide lock. Callers
34	// may either Run directly or Prepare the underlying process for Bubble Tea.
35	type MutationCommand struct {
36		Command *exec.Cmd
37		ctx     context.Context
38	}
39	
40	// Prepare acquires the provider mutation lock and returns an idempotent
41	// completion callback that joins process and release errors.
42	func (m *MutationCommand) Prepare() (*exec.Cmd, func(error) error, error) {
43		if m == nil || m.Command == nil {
44			return nil, nil, errors.New("skill mutation command is empty")
45		}
46		ctx := m.ctx
47		if ctx == nil {
48			ctx = context.Background()
49		}
50		cache, err := os.UserCacheDir()
51		if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(cache) {
52			return nil, nil, errors.New("could not resolve the user cache for skill mutation locking")
53		}
54		lease, err := lockx.AcquireDir(ctx, filepath.Join(cache, "dev-cli", "skill-mutation"), "agent skill mutation")
55		if err != nil {
56			return nil, nil, err
57		}
58		var once sync.Once
59		var result error
60		finish := func(processErr error) error {
61			once.Do(func() { result = errors.Join(processErr, lease.Close()) })
62			return result
63		}
64		return m.Command, finish, nil
65	}
66	
67	// Run executes the provider while holding the host-wide mutation lock.
68	func (m *MutationCommand) Run() error {
69		command, finish, err := m.Prepare()
70		if err != nil {
71			return err
72		}
73		return finish(command.Run())
74	}
75	
76	// MutationProviderStatus performs path lookup only. It is suitable for doctor
77	// and other read-only status surfaces because it never starts skills, npx, npm,
78	// or project code.
79	func MutationProviderStatus() MutationProvider {
80		return MutationProviderStatusFor("")
81	}
82	
83	// MutationProviderStatusFor rejects a provider inside projectRoot in addition
84	// to npm-local shims. The selected repository never supplies the program that
85	// mutates it.
86	func MutationProviderStatusFor(projectRoot string) MutationProvider {
87		var rejected string
88		for _, path := range skillsExecutableCandidates() {
89			if resolved, trusted := trustedSkillsExecutable(path, projectRoot); trusted {
90				return MutationProvider{Available: true, Command: "skills", Path: resolved, Detail: "skills executable available"}
91			}
92			if rejected == "" {
93				rejected = path
94			}
95		}
96		if rejected != "" {
97			return MutationProvider{Path: rejected, Detail: "skills executable resolves inside the selected repository or node_modules; install a trusted global executable"}
98		}
99		if path, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
100			return MutationProvider{
101				Path:   path,
102				Detail: "npx found but not invoked from repository checkouts; install the `skills` executable for add/update",
103			}
104		}
105		return MutationProvider{Detail: "skills executable is not installed"}
106	}
107	
108	func skillsExecutableCandidates() []string {
109		seen := map[string]bool{}
110		var candidates []string
111		for _, directory := range filepath.SplitList(os.Getenv("PATH")) {
112			if directory == "" {

114			}
115			candidate, err := filepath.Abs(filepath.Join(directory, "skills"))

72	func (m *Model) prepareRepoDependentForReload(view View, enabled bool) {
73		if !enabled {
74			return
75		}
76		state := m.viewLoad(view)
77		switch {
78		case state.loading || m.view == view:
79			m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
80			m.setViewStatus(view, "waiting for local repositories…")
81		case state.hasSnapshot:
82			m.invalidateView(view)
83		}
84	}
85	
86	func (m *Model) beginViewLoad(view View, cause loadCause) uint64 {
87		if view == ViewRepos {
88			m.prepareRepoDependentsForReload()
89		}
90		index := int(view)
91		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
92			cancel()
93		}
94		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
95		m.loadContexts[index] = ctx
96		m.loadCancels[index] = cancel
97		if view == ViewRepos && m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
98			// A newer REPOS generation may supersede the clone-triggered refresh.
99			// Cancellation must always follow the generation that can complete it.
100			m.remoteClone.cancel = cancel
101		}
102		state := &m.loads[index]
103		state.generation++
104		state.cause = cause
105		state.requested = true
106		state.loading = true
107		state.outcome = ""
108		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = nil
109		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = ""
110		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadRequested, perftrace.Fields{
111			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageRequested, Generation: state.generation,
112		})
113		return state.generation
114	}
115	
116	func (m *Model) beginLocalLoads(cause loadCause) (tasks, repos, tries uint64) {
117		if m.localCancel != nil {
118			m.localCancel()
119		}
120		m.localContext, m.localCancel = context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
121		m.localGeneration++
122		tasks = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTasks, cause)
123		repos = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, cause)
124		tries = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTries, cause)
125		if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
126			// Production's shared loader reads localContext rather than the per-view
127			// context created above, so cancellation follows the actual producer.
128			m.remoteClone.cancel = m.localCancel
129		}
130		return tasks, repos, tries
131	}
132	
133	func (m Model) localReadContext() context.Context {
134		if m.localContext != nil {
135			return m.localContext
136		}
137		return m.baseContext()
138	}
139	
140	func (m *Model) finishLocalLoad() {
141		if m.localCancel != nil {
142			m.localCancel()
143			m.localCancel, m.localContext = nil, nil
144		}
145	}
146	
147	func (m *Model) invalidateView(view View) {
148		index := int(view)
149		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
150			cancel()
151		}
152		m.loadCancels[index], m.loadContexts[index] = nil, nil
153		state := &m.loads[index]
154		state.generation++
155		state.requested = false
156		state.loading = false
157		state.outcome = ""
158		if state.hasSnapshot {
159			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
160		}
161		m.viewErrors[index] = nil
162		m.viewStatuses[index] = ""
163	}
164	
165	func (m *Model) beginTryLoads(includeRepos bool, cause loadCause) {
166		m.beginViewLoad(ViewTries, cause)
167		if includeRepos {
168			m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, cause)
169		}
170	}

172	func (m *Model) seedViewSnapshot(view View, source perftrace.Source, freshness perftrace.Freshness, actionable bool) {
173		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
174		state.hasSnapshot = true
175		state.source = source
176		state.freshness = freshness
177		state.outcome = perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
178		state.actionable = actionable
179	}
180	
181	func (m *Model) applyCacheSeed(view View, generation uint64, rows int, freshness perftrace.Freshness) bool {
182		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
183		if generation != state.generation {
184			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
185				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
186				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
187			})
188			return false
189		}
190		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
191		count := rows
192		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
193			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
194			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,
195			Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuccess, Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
196		})
197		return true
198	}
199	
200	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
201	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
202	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
203	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
204		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
205	
206		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
207		if generation != state.generation {
208			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
209				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
210				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
211			})
212			return false
213		}
214	
215		state.loading = false
216		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
217		state.outcome = outcome
218		if valid {
219			state.hasSnapshot = true
220			state.source = source
221			state.freshness = freshness
222			state.actionable = actionable
223			count := rows
224			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
225				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
226				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
227				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
228			})
229		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
230			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
231		}
232		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
233		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
234			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
235			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
236			Generation: generation,
237		})
238		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
239			cancel()
240			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
241			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
242		}
243		return true
244	}

247		if err != nil {
248			return perftrace.FreshnessStale
249		}

50	func (m Model) startLocalLoad() tea.Cmd {
51		if m.actions.Local.Start == nil {
52			return nil
53		}
54		request := LocalLoadRequest{
55			CycleGeneration: m.localGeneration,
56			TasksGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
57			ReposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
58			TriesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
59			ShowAllTries:    m.showAllTries,
60			ForceSizes:      m.forceSizeReload,
61		}
62		load := m.actions.Local.Start(m.localReadContext(), request)
63		load.Request = request
64		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
65			return nil
66		}
67		return waitForLocal(load)
68	}
69	
70	func waitForLocal(load LocalLoad) tea.Cmd {
71		return func() tea.Msg {
72			result, ok := <-load.Results
73			if !ok {
74				return localMsg{load: load, done: true}
75			}
76			return localMsg{load: load, result: result}
77		}
78	}
79	
80	func (m Model) applyLocalResult(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
81		accepted := false
82		switch result.View {
83		case ViewTasks:

85				ViewTasks, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
86				len(result.Tasks), result.Err, result.Valid,
87			)
88			if accepted && result.Valid {
89				m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), result.Tasks...)
90			}
91		case ViewRepos:
92			accepted = m.applyViewResult(
93				ViewRepos, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
94				len(result.Repos), result.Err, result.Valid,
95			)
96			if accepted && result.Valid {
97				m.acceptCompleteRepoSnapshot(result.Err)
98				m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), result.Repos...)
99				m.matchRemoteLocals()
100			}
101		case ViewTries:

103				ViewTries, result.Generation, result.Valid, "live", resultFreshness(result.Err),
104				len(result.Tries), result.Err, result.Valid,
105			)
106			if accepted && result.Valid {

108				m.matchRemoteLocals()
109			}
110		}
111		m.setAt(m.at())
112		return m, accepted

27			return m, nil
28		}

30			m.actions.Sizes.Cancel(m.sizeLoad.ID)
31		}

55			}

60	func (m *Model) applySizeResult(result diskusage.Result) {
61		// Bubble Tea copies Model by value; clone slice headers before patching rows so
62		// two candidate models never share a mutated backing array.
63		m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), m.repos...)
64		m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), m.tries...)
65		for index := range m.repos {
66			if m.repos[index].SizeTarget.Key != result.Key {
67				continue
68			}
69			if result.Err != nil {
70				m.repos[index].Usage, m.repos[index].SizeError = nil, result.Err
71			} else {
72				usage := result.Usage
73				m.repos[index].Usage, m.repos[index].SizeError = &usage, nil
74			}
75		}
76		for index := range m.tries {
77			if m.tries[index].SizeTarget.Key != result.Key {
78				continue
79			}
80			if result.Err != nil {
81				m.tries[index].Usage, m.tries[index].SizeError = nil, result.Err

89	func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool {
90		if usage == nil {
91			return false
92		}
93		expression = strings.TrimSpace(expression)
94		operator := "="
95		for _, candidate := range []string{">=", "<=", ">", "<", "="} {
96			if strings.HasPrefix(expression, candidate) {
97				operator = candidate
98				expression = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(expression, candidate))
99				break
100			}
101		}
102		bytes, err := humanize.ParseBytes(expression)
103		if err != nil {
104			return false
105		}
106		owned := uint64(max(usage.OwnedBytes, 0))
107		switch operator {
108		case ">=":
109			return owned >= bytes
110		case "<=":
111			return owned <= bytes
112		case ">":
113			return owned > bytes
114		case "<":
115			return owned < bytes
116		default:
117			return owned == bytes
118		}
119	}

121	func sizeDetailLines(usage *diskusage.Usage, err error, target diskusage.Target) []string {
122		if target.Checkout == "" {
123			return nil
124		}
125		if err != nil {
126			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleErr.Render(err.Error()))}
127		}
128		if usage == nil {
129			return []string{fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("size"), styleDim.Render("measuring…"))}
130		}
131		lines := []string{
132			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s logical owned", styleDim.Render("size"), usage.HumanOwned()),
133			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("checkout"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(usage.CheckoutBytes, 0)))),
134		}
135		if usage.PrivateGitBytes != nil {
136			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("private .git"),
137				humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.PrivateGitBytes, 0)))))
138		}
139		if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
140			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s (not reclaimable with this checkout)",
141				styleDim.Render("shared .git"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.SharedGitBytes, 0)))))
142		}
143		if !usage.Complete {
144			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  partial; %d unreadable entries", styleDim.Render("measure"), usage.UnreadableEntries))
145		}
146		return lines
147	}

159			if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {

161			}

139			p.startupOptions |= withMouseCellMotion // set
140			p.startupOptions &^= withMouseAllMotion // clear
141		}
142	}
143	
144	// WithMouseAllMotion starts the program with the mouse enabled in "all motion"
145	// mode.
146	//
147	// EnableMouseAllMotion is a special command that enables mouse click, release,
148	// wheel, and motion events, which are delivered regardless of whether a mouse
149	// button is pressed, effectively enabling support for hover interactions.
150	//
151	// This will try to enable the mouse in extended mode (SGR), if that is not
152	// supported by the terminal it will fall back to normal mode (X10).
153	//
154	// Many modern terminals support this, but not all. If in doubt, use
155	// EnableMouseCellMotion instead.
156	//
157	// To enable the mouse once the program has already started running use the
158	// EnableMouseAllMotion command. To disable the mouse when the program is
159	// running use the DisableMouse command.
160	//
161	// The mouse will be automatically disabled when the program exits.
162	func WithMouseAllMotion() ProgramOption {
163		return func(p *Program) {
164			p.startupOptions |= withMouseAllMotion   // set
165			p.startupOptions &^= withMouseCellMotion // clear
166		}
167	}
168

```
