261	func scanLocation(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, target agenttarget.Target, location physicalScanLocation) ([]scannedSkill, []Diagnostic) {
262		entries, err := os.ReadDir(location.Path)
263		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
264			return nil, nil
265		}
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, []Diagnostic{decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
268				Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: location.Path,
269				Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not read skills directory: %v", err),
270			}, target)}
271		}
272		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
273	
274		var skills []scannedSkill
275		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
276		for _, entry := range entries {
277			if ctx.Err() != nil {
278				break
279			}
280			child := filepath.Join(location.Path, entry.Name())
281			info, err := os.Stat(child)
282			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
283				continue
284			}
285			if err != nil {
286				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
287					Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: child,
288					Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect skill directory: %v", err),
289				}, target))
290				continue
291			}
292			if !info.IsDir() {
293				continue
294			}
295			name, present, err := readSkillName(filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"))
296			if !present {
297				continue
298			}
299			if err != nil {
300				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
301					Kind: DiagnosticSkillFrontmatter, Scope: scope,
302					Path: filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"), Message: err.Error(),
303				}, target))
304				continue
305			}
306			physical := child
307			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child); err == nil {
308				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
309			}
310			var logicalPaths, agentIDs []string
311			for _, logical := range location.Logical {
312				logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, filepath.Join(logical.Path, entry.Name()))
313				agentIDs = append(agentIDs, logical.AgentIDs...)
314			}
315			logicalPaths = uniqueSorted(logicalPaths)
316			agentIDs = uniqueSorted(agentIDs)
317			installation := Installation{
318				RealPath: physical, LogicalPaths: logicalPaths, AgentIDs: agentIDs,
319				Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs), Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
320			}
321			if len(logicalPaths) > 0 {
322				installation.Path = logicalPaths[0]
323			}
324			skills = append(skills, scannedSkill{Name: name, Installation: installation})
325		}
326		return skills, diagnostics
327	}
328	
329	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
330		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(filename)
331		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
332			return "", false, nil
333		}
334		if errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular) {
335			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
336		}
337		if err != nil {
338			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
339		}
340		defer file.Close()
341	
342		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
343		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
344		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
345		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
346		consumed := int64(len(first))
347		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
348			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
349		}
350		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
351		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
352			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
353		}
354		var frontmatter strings.Builder
355		closed := false
356		for {
357			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
358			consumed += int64(len(line))
359			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
360				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
361			}
362			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
363				closed = true
364				break
365			}
366			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
367			if lineErr != nil {
368				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
369					break
370				}
371				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
372			}
373		}
374		if !closed {
375			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376		}
377		var metadata struct {
378			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
379			Description string `yaml:"description"`
380		}
381		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
382			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
383		}
384		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
385		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
386		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
387			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
388		}
389		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
390			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
391		}
392		return metadata.Name, true, nil
393	}

499				row.Integrity = IntegrityUnknown

501			}
502		}

package tui

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentmcp"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
)

func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {
	if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
		return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
	}
	if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
		return row.Lock.File, nil
	}
	return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
}

func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
	if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
		return skillFilePath(row)
	}
	if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
		if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
		}
		return row.ConfigPath, nil
	}
	return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
}

func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
	lines := []string{
		"name: " + row.Name,
		"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
	}
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
	lines := []string{
		"server: " + row.Name,
		"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
		"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
	}
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
	if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
		lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
	}
	lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
	if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
		credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
		for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
			value := string(credential.Kind)
			if credential.Name != "" {
				value += ":" + credential.Name
			}
			credentials = append(credentials, value)
		}
		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
	}
	if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
		redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
		for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
			redactions[i] = string(redaction)
		}
		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
	}
	if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
		coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
		for i, item := range row.Coverage {
			coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
		}
		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
	}
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return lines
	}
	return append(lines, label+": "+value)
}

package tui

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentmcp"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
)

func TestCapabilityFileEditReloadsOnlyOriginatingView(t *testing.T) {
	skillLoads, mcpLoads := 0, 0
	model := New(Actions{
		ReloadSkills: func(_ context.Context, scope CapabilityScope) ([]agentskill.Skill, error) {
			skillLoads++
			if scope != CapabilityAllRepositories {
				t.Fatalf("skill reload scope = %s", scope)
			}
			return []agentskill.Skill{{Name: "edited"}}, nil
		},
		ReloadMCP: func(context.Context, CapabilityScope) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
			mcpLoads++
			return nil, nil
		},
	}, nil, nil)
	model.view = ViewSkills
	model.capabilityScope = CapabilityAllRepositories
	model.seedViewSnapshot(ViewSkills, "live", "fresh", true)
	model.seedViewSnapshot(ViewMCP, "live", "fresh", true)

	next, command := model.Update(capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: ViewSkills})
	model = next.(Model)
	if command == nil {
		t.Fatal("successful editor return did not start a capability reload")
	}
	next, _ = model.Update(command())
	model = next.(Model)
	if skillLoads != 1 || mcpLoads != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("capability reloads skills=%d MCP=%d", skillLoads, mcpLoads)
	}
	if len(model.skills) != 1 || model.skills[0].Name != "edited" {
		t.Fatalf("edited skill snapshot = %+v", model.skills)
	}
}

func TestCapabilityFileEditorProcessRequiresExistingRegularFile(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(root, "config.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("{}\n"), 0o600); err != nil {

		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := process.Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("editor process: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := capabilityFileEditorProcess(root); !errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular) {
		t.Fatalf("directory editor error = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := capabilityFileEditorProcess(filepath.Join(root, "missing")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		t.Fatalf("missing editor error = %v", err)
	}
}

func TestReadTUICapabilityFileIsBoundedAndRegular(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(root, "config.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("raw-local-secret\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := readTUICapabilityFile(context.Background(), path)
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(got) != "raw-local-secret" {
		t.Fatalf("read capability file = %q, %v", got, err)
	}

	tooLarge := filepath.Join(root, "large.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(tooLarge, make([]byte, tuiCapabilityFileMaxBytes+1), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := readTUICapabilityFile(context.Background(), tooLarge); !errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrTooLarge) {
		t.Fatalf("large capability file error = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := readTUICapabilityFile(context.Background(), root); !errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular) {
		t.Fatalf("directory capability file error = %v", err)
	}
}

1322	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1323	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1324	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1325	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1326	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1327		if row.Task == nil {
1328			return ""
1329		}
1330		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1331			return "dev sweep"
1332		}
1333		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1334			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1335		}
1336		return ""
1337	}
1338	
1339	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1340		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1341		if command == "" {
1342			return nil
1343		}
1344		switch {
1345		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1346			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1347		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1348			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1349		default:
1350			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1351		}
1352	}

1372						return false

1377					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {

1384					}
1385					continue
1386				case "repo":

1390					continue
1391				case "presence":
1392					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1393						return false
1394					}
1395					continue
1396				case "integrity":
1397					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1398						return false
1399					}
1400					continue
1401				}
1402			}
1403			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1404				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,

1408			}, " "))
1409			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1410				return false
1411			}
1412		}
1413		return true
1414	}

1477	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1478	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1479		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1480		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1481			switch {
1482			case x > y:
1483				return -1
1484			case x < y:
1485				return 1
1486			default:
1487				return 0
1488			}
1489		}
1490		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1491			if x == y {
1492				return 0
1493			}
1494			if x {
1495				return -1
1496			}
1497			return 1
1498		}
1499		latest := func() int {
1500			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1501				return 0
1502			}
1503			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1504				return -1
1505			}
1506			return 1
1507		}
1508	
1509		switch sortBy {
1510		case "name":
1511			return nameCmp
1512		case "latest":
1513			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1514				return c
1515			}
1516		case "git":
1517			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1518				return c
1519			}
1520			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1521				return c
1522			}
1523		case "size":
1524			switch {
1525			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1526				return -1
1527			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1528				return 1
1529			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1530				return -1
1531			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1532				return 1
1533			}
1534		case "tasks":
1535			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1536				return c
1537			}
1538			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1539				return c
1540			}
1541		default: // activity
1542			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1543				return c
1544			}
1545			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1546				return c
1547			}
1548			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1549				return c
1550			}
1551			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1552				return c
1553			}
1554			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1555				return c
1556			}
1557		}
1558		return nameCmp
1559	}

234	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
235		value := func(key string) string {

250			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
251		}
252	
253		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
254		switch m.overlay.action {
255		case TryCreate:
256			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
257			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
258				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
259				return m, nil
260			}
261			gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
262			if !ok {

264				return m, nil
265			}
266			request.NoGit = !gitInit
267		case TryMark:
268			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
269			request.Note = value("note")
270		case TryRestore:
271			request.To = value("to")
272		case TryGraduate:
273			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
274		case TryArchive:
275			if value("confirm") != "YES" {
276				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
277				return m, nil
278			}
279		default:
280			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
281			return m, nil
282		}
283		m.overlay = overlayState{}
284		m.err = nil
285		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
286		return m, m.applyTry(request)

256	func (r RemoteRow) matches(query string) bool {
257		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
258		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
259			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
260			if structured && (key == "vis" || key == "visibility") {
261				if strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility) != value {
262					return false
263				}
264				continue
265			}
266			if !strings.Contains(r.searchText(), term) {
267				return false
268			}
269		}
270		return true
271	}

package tui

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
)

type listAction uint8

const (
	listActionOpen listAction = iota
	listActionAddNote
	listActionBrowseNotes
	listActionPark
	listActionEditNext
	listActionToggleWorktrees
	listActionRepoMetadata
	listActionStartWorktree
	listActionStartDirect
	listActionCopy
	listActionStats
	listActionRemoteClone
	listActionSkillUpdate
	listActionOpenCapabilityFile
	listActionCopyCapabilityPath
	listActionCopyCapabilitySummary
	listActionCopySkillSourceURL
	listActionCopyCapabilityRaw
	listActionTryMark
	listActionTryDeprecate
	listActionTryReactivate
	listActionTryArchive
	listActionTryRestore
	listActionTryGraduate
)

type selectionToken struct {
	view View
	key  string
}

func repoItemKey(item repoItem) string {
	key := repoKey(item.Repo) + "\x00"
	if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
		return key + checkout.Worktree.Path
	}
	return key
}

func fleetRowKey(row FleetRow) string {
	path := ""
	if row.Repository != nil {
		path = row.Repository.Path
	}
	return row.Host + "\x00" + path
}

func skillRowKey(row agentskill.Skill) string {
	lockFile := ""
	if row.Lock != nil {
		lockFile = row.Lock.File
	}
	return strings.Join([]string{string(row.Scope), row.Checkout, row.Path, lockFile, row.Name}, "\x00")
}

func mcpRowKey(row interface {
	GetMCPKey() string
}) string {
	return row.GetMCPKey()
}

func declarationRowKey(row struct {
	Name             string
	Agent            string
	Scope            string
	ConfigPath       string
	LocalProjectPath string
	Plugin           string
}) string {
	return strings.Join([]string{row.Agent, row.Scope, row.ConfigPath, row.LocalProjectPath, row.Plugin, row.Name}, "\x00")
}

func (m Model) currentSelectionToken() (selectionToken, bool) {
	switch m.view {
	case ViewTasks:
		row, ok := m.currentTask()
		if !ok || row.Task == nil {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: row.Task.ID}, true
	case ViewRepos:
		row, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: repoItemKey(row)}, true
	case ViewFleet:
		row, ok := m.currentFleet()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: fleetRowKey(row)}, true
	case ViewTries:
		row, ok := m.currentTry()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: row.Item.ID}, true
	case ViewRemote:
		row, ok := m.currentRemote()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: remoteRowKey(row)}, true
	case ViewSkills:
		row, ok := m.currentSkill()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: skillRowKey(row)}, true
	case ViewMCP:
		row, ok := m.currentMCP()
		if !ok {
			return selectionToken{}, false
		}
		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: mcpDeclarationKey(row)}, true
	default:
		return selectionToken{}, false
	}
}

func mcpDeclarationKey(row interface {
	MCPDeclarationKey() string
}) string {
	return row.MCPDeclarationKey()
}

func (m *Model) selectToken(token selectionToken) bool {
	if m.view != token.view {
		return false
	}
	switch token.view {
	case ViewTasks:
		for i, row := range m.visibleTasks() {
			if row.Task != nil && row.Task.ID == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	case ViewRepos:
		for i, row := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
			if repoItemKey(row) == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	case ViewFleet:
		for i, row := range m.visibleFleet() {
			if fleetRowKey(row) == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	case ViewTries:
		for i, row := range m.visibleTries() {
			if row.Item.ID == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	case ViewRemote:
		for i, row := range m.visibleRemotes() {
			if remoteRowKey(row) == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	case ViewSkills:
		for i, row := range m.visibleSkills() {
			if skillRowKey(row) == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	case ViewMCP:
		for i, row := range m.visibleMCP() {
			if mcpDeclarationKey(row) == token.key {
				m.setAt(i)
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (m Model) selectionHeading() (string, string) {
	if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
		return row.Task.Title(), contract(row.Checkout)
	}
	if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
		if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
			return item.Repo.Repo.Display() + "/" + filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path), contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
		}
		return item.Repo.Repo.Display(), contract(item.Repo.Repo.Path)
	}
	if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
		if row.Repository != nil {
			return row.Host + "/" + row.Repository.Display, contract(row.Repository.Path)
		}
		return row.Host, string(row.State)
	}
	if row, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
		return row.Item.DisplayName(), contract(row.Item.Live.CurrentPath)
	}
	if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
		detail := row.Repo.URL
		if row.LocalPath != "" {
			detail = contract(row.LocalPath)
		}
		return row.Repo.FullName, detail
	}
	if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
		path, _ := skillFilePath(row)
		return row.Name, contract(path)
	}
	if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
		return row.Name, contract(row.ConfigPath)
	}
	return "", ""
}

func (m Model) openActionMenu() Model {
	token, ok := m.currentSelectionToken()
	if !ok {
		return m
	}
	subject, detail := m.selectionHeading()
	overlay := overlayState{
		kind: overlayActionMenu, title: strings.ToUpper(m.view.String()) + " actions",
		subject: subject, detail: detail, selection: token,
	}

	switch m.view {
	case ViewTasks:
		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok && m.actions.Open != nil && taskOpenBlocker(row) == nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionOpen, "open task")
		}
		m.addNoteOptions(&overlay)
		if m.actions.SetNext != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionEditNext, "edit next action")
		}
		if m.actions.Park != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionPark, "park warm")
		}
		m.addStatsOption(&overlay)

	case ViewRepos:
		item, _ := m.currentRepoItem()
		if item.child() {
			if checkout, ok := item.checkout(); ok && checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable && m.actions.OpenCheckout != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionOpen, "open worktree")
			}
			overlay.addOption(listActionToggleWorktrees, "collapse worktrees")
		} else {
			if m.actions.OpenRepo != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionOpen, "open repository")
			}
			if item.Repo.Worktrees > 0 && item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr == nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionToggleWorktrees, "expand or collapse worktrees")
			}
			if m.actions.Repos.Patch != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionRepoMetadata, "edit repository metadata")
			}
			if m.actions.Start != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionStartWorktree, "start worktree task")
			}
			if m.actions.StartDirect != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionStartDirect, "start direct task")
			}
		}
		m.addNoteOptions(&overlay)
		if m.actions.Copy != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionCopy, "copy repository data…")
		}
		m.addStatsOption(&overlay)

	case ViewFleet:
		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil && m.actions.OpenFleet != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionOpen, "open repository on host")
		}

	case ViewTries:
		row, _ := m.currentTry()
		if m.actions.Tries.Apply != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionTryMark, "edit tags and note")
			switch row.Item.Phase {
			case catalog.PhaseActive:
				overlay.addOption(listActionTryDeprecate, "deprecate (metadata only)")
			case catalog.PhaseDeprecated:
				overlay.addOption(listActionTryReactivate, "reactivate")
			}
			if row.Item.Phase != catalog.PhaseGraduated {
				switch row.LocationState() {
				case catalog.LocationPresent:
					overlay.addOption(listActionTryArchive, "archive locally (reversible move)")
					overlay.addOption(listActionTryGraduate, "graduate into a project")
				case catalog.LocationArchived:
					overlay.addOption(listActionTryRestore, "restore from local archive")
					overlay.addOption(listActionTryGraduate, "graduate archived Try")
				}
			}
			if row.Present() {
				overlay.addOption(listActionOpen, "open Try")
			}
		}

	case ViewRemote:
		row, _ := m.currentRemote()
		if row.Cloned() && m.actions.OpenRemote != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionOpen, "open local checkout")
			m.addNoteOptions(&overlay)
		} else if !row.Cloned() && m.actions.CloneRemote != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionRemoteClone, "clone repository…")
		}

	case ViewSkills:
		row, _ := m.currentSkill()
		if _, err := skillFilePath(row); err == nil && m.actions.OpenFile != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionOpenCapabilityFile, "open skill file")
		}
		if m.actions.Copy != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionCopyCapabilityPath, "copy skill file path")
			overlay.addOption(listActionCopyCapabilitySummary, "copy safe skill summary")
			if row.SourceURL != "" {
				overlay.addOption(listActionCopySkillSourceURL, "copy skill source URL")
			}
			if m.actions.ReadFile != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionCopyCapabilityRaw, "copy raw skill file")
			}
		}
		if m.actions.UpdateSkill != nil && agentskill.CanUpdate(row) {
			overlay.addOption(listActionSkillUpdate, "update selected skill…")
		}

	case ViewMCP:
		row, _ := m.currentMCP()
		if row.ConfigPath != "" && m.actions.OpenFile != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionOpenCapabilityFile, "open MCP config")
		}
		if m.actions.Copy != nil {
			overlay.addOption(listActionCopyCapabilityPath, "copy MCP config path")
			overlay.addOption(listActionCopyCapabilitySummary, "copy safe declaration summary")
			if m.actions.ReadFile != nil {
				overlay.addOption(listActionCopyCapabilityRaw, "copy raw MCP config file")
			}
		}
	}

	if overlay.optionCount == 0 {
		return m
	}
	m.overlay = overlay
	m.err = nil
	return m
}

func (m Model) addNoteOptions(overlay *overlayState) {
	if _, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); !ok {
		return
	}
	if m.actions.Notes.Add != nil {
		overlay.addOption(listActionAddNote, "add note")
	}
	if m.actions.Notes.List != nil {
		overlay.addOption(listActionBrowseNotes, "browse notes")
	}
}

func (m Model) addStatsOption(overlay *overlayState) {
	if m.selectedRepoName() != "" && m.actions.LoadStats != nil {
		overlay.addOption(listActionStats, "open activity heatmap")
	}
}

func (m Model) runOverlayAction() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 || m.overlay.optionIndex >= m.overlay.optionCount {
		return m, nil
	}
	action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
	token := m.overlay.selection
	if !m.selectToken(token) {
		m.overlay = overlayState{}
		m.err = fmt.Errorf("selected row changed while its action menu was open")
		return m, nil
	}
	m.overlay = overlayState{}
	return m.runListAction(action)
}

func (m Model) runListAction(action listAction) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	switch action {
	case listActionOpen:
		return m, m.openSelected()
	case listActionAddNote:
		if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
			return m.openNoteAdd(target, false)
		}
	case listActionBrowseNotes:
		if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
			return m.openNotes(target)
		}
	case listActionPark:
		if _, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
			return m.prompt(modeConfirmPark, "", "what to do when you come back")
		}
	case listActionEditNext:
		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
			return m.prompt(modeEditNext, row.Task.Next, "next action")
		}
	case listActionToggleWorktrees:
		return m.toggleSelectedRepo()
	case listActionRepoMetadata:
		if row, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
			return m.openRepoForm(row)
		}
	case listActionStartWorktree:
		if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
			return m.prompt(modeStartTask, "", "name for the new worktree task")
		}
	case listActionStartDirect:
		if _, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
			return m.prompt(modeStartDirect, "", "name for direct work on current branch")
		}
	case listActionCopy:
		m.mode, m.err, m.status = modeCopy, nil, ""
		return m, nil
	case listActionStats:
		repo := m.selectedRepoName()
		if repo != "" && m.actions.LoadStats != nil {
			m.mode, m.stats, m.status = modeStats, nil, "loading activity…"
			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
		}
	case listActionRemoteClone:
		return m.promptSelectedRemoteClone()
	case listActionSkillUpdate:
		return m.promptSelectedSkillUpdate()
	case listActionOpenCapabilityFile:
		return m.openSelectedCapabilityFile()
	case listActionCopyCapabilityPath:
		return m.copyCapabilityValue("p")
	case listActionCopyCapabilitySummary:
		return m.copyCapabilityValue("s")
	case listActionCopySkillSourceURL:
		return m.copyCapabilityValue("u")
	case listActionCopyCapabilityRaw:
		return m.copyCapabilityValue("f")
	case listActionTryMark, listActionTryDeprecate, listActionTryReactivate,
		listActionTryArchive, listActionTryRestore, listActionTryGraduate:
		return m.runTryListAction(action)
	}
	return m, nil
}

func (m Model) toggleSelectedRepo() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
	if !ok || item.Repo.Worktrees == 0 {
		return m, nil
	}
	if item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
		m.err = item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr
		return m, nil
	}
	if item.child() {
		for i := m.repoCursor - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			if !m.visibleRepoItems()[i].child() {
				m.repoCursor = i
				break
			}
		}
	}
	m.toggleRepo(item.Repo)
	return m, nil
}

func (m Model) promptSelectedRemoteClone() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	row, ok := m.currentRemote()
	if !ok || row.Cloned() {
		return m, nil
	}
	if row.CloneProblemPath != "" {
		if _, err := os.Lstat(row.CloneProblemPath); err == nil {
			m.err = fmt.Errorf("inspect or move the existing clone destination at %s before retrying", config.Contract(row.CloneProblemPath))
			return m, nil
		}
		m.setRemoteCloneProblem(row, "")
	}
	if !m.reposReadyForClone() {
		m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "wait for local repositories to finish loading")
		return m, nil
	}
	m.remoteClonePrompt = row
	return m.prompt(modeConfirmClone, row.Repo.FullName, "enter clone; o clone and open; esc cancel")
}

func (m Model) promptSelectedSkillUpdate() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading {
		m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "wait for the current skill reload/check to finish")
		return m, nil
	}
	row, ok := m.currentSkill()
	if !ok {
		return m, nil
	}
	if !agentskill.CanUpdate(row) {
		m.err = fmt.Errorf("%s has no update-safe provider lock", row.Name)
		return m, nil
	}
	m.skillUpdateTarget = row
	m.mode = modeConfirmSkillUpdate
	return m, nil
}

func (m Model) openSelectedCapabilityFile() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	path, err := m.capabilityFilePath()
	if err != nil {
		m.err = err
		return m, nil
	}
	if m.actions.OpenFile == nil {
		m.err = fmt.Errorf("opening capability files is unavailable")
		return m, nil
	}
	proc, err := m.actions.OpenFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		m.err = err
		return m, nil
	}
	view := m.view
	m.status = "editing " + config.Contract(path) + "…"
	return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
		return capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: view, err: err}
	})
}

func (m Model) runTryListAction(action listAction) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	row, ok := m.currentTry()
	if !ok {
		return m, nil
	}
	var tryAction TryAction
	switch action {
	case listActionTryMark:
		tryAction = TryMark
	case listActionTryDeprecate:
		tryAction = TryDeprecate
	case listActionTryReactivate:
		tryAction = TryReactivate
	case listActionTryArchive:
		tryAction = TryArchive
	case listActionTryRestore:
		tryAction = TryRestore
	case listActionTryGraduate:
		tryAction = TryGraduate
	}
	switch tryAction {
	case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
		return m.openTryForm(tryAction, row)
	case TryArchive:
		return m.openTryConfirmation(tryAction, row)
	case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
		m.status = string(tryAction) + " in progress…"
		return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: tryAction, ID: row.Item.ID})
	default:
		return m, nil
	}
}

func TestEveryDashboardViewBuildsRowActionMenu(t *testing.T) {
	actions := Actions{
		Open: func(context.Context, *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) { return OpenResult{}, nil },
		OpenRepo: func(context.Context, RepoRow) (OpenResult, error) { return OpenResult{}, nil },
		OpenFleet: func(context.Context, FleetRow) (*exec.Cmd, error) { return exec.Command("true"), nil },

		OpenFile:   func(string) (*exec.Cmd, error) { return exec.Command("true"), nil },
		Copy:       func(string) error { return nil },
		ReadFile:   func(context.Context, string) (string, error) { return "", nil },
		Tries: TryActions{
			Apply: func(context.Context, TryRequest) (TryActionResult, error) { return TryActionResult{}, nil },
		},

func TestActionMenuRevalidatesStableSelectionBeforeRunning(t *testing.T) {
	opened := 0
	actions := Actions{Open: func(context.Context, *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) {
		opened++
		return OpenResult{}, nil
	}}
	first := inventory.Row{Task: &task.Task{ID: "first", Name: "first"}, CheckoutExists: true}
	second := inventory.Row{Task: &task.Task{ID: "second", Name: "second"}, CheckoutExists: true}
	model := New(actions, []inventory.Row{first, second}, nil)
	model = model.openActionMenu()
	model.rows = []inventory.Row{second}

	next, command := model.runOverlayAction()
	model = next.(Model)
	if command != nil || opened != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stale menu ran action: command=%v opened=%d", command, opened)
	}
	if model.overlay.kind != overlayNone || model.err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("stale menu did not close with an error: overlay=%v err=%v", model.overlay.kind, model.err)
	}
}

func TestActionMenuAndKeyboardShareOpenDispatcher(t *testing.T) {
	var opened []string
	actions := Actions{Open: func(_ context.Context, selected *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) {
		opened = append(opened, selected.ID)
		return OpenResult{}, nil
	}}
	row := inventory.Row{Task: &task.Task{ID: "same", Name: "same"}, CheckoutExists: true}
	model := New(actions, []inventory.Row{row}, nil)

	_, command := model.runListAction(listActionOpen)
	if command == nil {
		t.Fatal("keyboard dispatcher returned no command")
	}
	_ = command()
	model = model.openActionMenu()
	_, command = model.runOverlayAction()
	if command == nil {
		t.Fatal("action menu returned no command")
	}
	_ = command()
	if len(opened) != 2 || opened[0] != "same" || opened[1] != "same" {
		t.Fatalf("open dispatches = %v", opened)
	}
}

package tui

import tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"

const mouseWheelRows = 3

func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
	if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
		return m, nil
	}
	if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
		return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
	}
	if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
		return m, nil
	}

	if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
		if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
			return m, nil
		}
		delta := mouseWheelRows
		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
			delta = -delta
		}
		m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
		return m, nil
	}
	if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
		return m, nil
	}

	if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
		for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
			if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
				continue
			}
			if m.view == hit.view {
				return m, nil
			}
			m.view = hit.view
			return m.afterViewSwitch()
		}
		return m, nil
	}

	row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
	if !ok {
		return m, nil
	}
	switch event.Button {
	case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
		m.setAt(row)
	case tea.MouseButtonRight:
		m.setAt(row)
		if !m.remoteClone.active() {
			m = m.openActionMenu()
		}
	}
	return m, nil
}

func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
	if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
		return 0, false
	}
	count := m.count()
	from, to := m.window(count)
	first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
	if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
		return 0, false
	}
	return from + y - first, true
}

func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
	if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
		return false
	}
	from, to := m.window(m.count())
	first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
	return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
}

func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
		if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
			return m, nil
		}
		delta := 1
		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
			delta = -1
		}
		m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
		return m, nil
	}
	if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
		return m, nil
	}
	first := 4
	if m.overlay.detail != "" {
		first++
	}
	if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
		m.overlay = overlayState{}
		return m, nil
	}
	m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
	return m.runOverlayAction()
}

func mouseMessage(x, y int, button tea.MouseButton, action tea.MouseAction) tea.MouseMsg {

}

func applyMouse(model Model, message tea.MouseMsg) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
	updated, command := model.Update(message)
	return updated.(Model), command
}

func mouseTaskRows(count int) []inventory.Row {
	rows := make([]inventory.Row, count)
	for i := range rows {
		rows[i] = inventory.Row{
			Task: &task.Task{ID: fmt.Sprintf("task-%02d", i), Name: fmt.Sprintf("task-%02d", i), State: task.Hot},
			Checkout: fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/task-%02d", i), CheckoutExists: true,
		}
	}
	return rows
}

func TestMouseClicksResponsiveTabSpans(t *testing.T) {
	for _, width := range []int{100, 42} {
		model := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
		model.width = width
		layout := model.buildHeaderLayout()
		if len(layout.tabs) != len(Views) {
			t.Fatalf("width %d rendered %d tabs, want %d", width, len(layout.tabs), len(Views))
		}
		for _, hit := range layout.tabs {
			candidate := model
			candidate, _ = applyMouse(candidate, mouseMessage((hit.from+hit.to)/2, 0, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
			if candidate.view != hit.view {
				t.Errorf("width %d click [%d,%d) selected %s, want %s", width, hit.from, hit.to, candidate.view, hit.view)
			}
		}
	}

	model := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
	model.width = 9
	layout := model.buildHeaderLayout()
	if len(layout.tabs) != 1 || layout.tabs[0].view != ViewTasks {
		t.Fatalf("current-only layout tabs = %+v", layout.tabs)
	}
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(model.width-1, 0, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.view != ViewTasks {
		t.Fatalf("click outside current-only tab changed view to %s", model.view)
	}
}

func TestMouseSelectsOnlyVisibleDataRows(t *testing.T) {
	rows := mouseTaskRows(20)
	opened := 0
	model := New(Actions{Open: func(context.Context, *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) {
		opened++
		return OpenResult{}, nil
	}}, rows, nil)
	model.height = 12
	model.setAt(10)
	from, _ := model.window(len(rows))
	firstY := 2 + model.listPreambleLines()

	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(4, firstY+1, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != from+1 || opened != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("row click selected=%d want=%d opened=%d", model.at(), from+1, opened)
	}
	selected := model.at()
	for _, message := range []tea.MouseMsg{
		mouseMessage(4, firstY, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionRelease),
		mouseMessage(4, firstY, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionMotion),
		mouseMessage(4, 2, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress),
		mouseMessage(4, firstY+model.listHeight()+2, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress),
	} {
		model, _ = applyMouse(model, message)
	}
	if model.at() != selected || opened != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("non-row mouse input changed selection=%d opened=%d", model.at(), opened)
	}
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(4, firstY+1, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if opened != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("repeated clicks inferred double-click open: %d", opened)
	}
}

func TestMouseAccountsForCapabilityLoadingPreamble(t *testing.T) {
	model := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
	model.view = ViewSkills
	model.skills = []agentskill.Skill{{Name: "first"}, {Name: "second"}}
	model.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadRefresh)
	if got := model.listPreambleLines(); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("loading preamble lines = %d", got)
	}

	model.setAt(1)
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 3, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("table header click changed capability selection to %d", model.at())
	}
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 4, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("first capability data row selected %d", model.at())
	}
}

func TestMouseWheelMovesThreeRowsOnlyOverList(t *testing.T) {
	model := New(Actions{}, mouseTaskRows(10), nil)
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 2, tea.MouseButtonWheelDown, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("wheel down selected %d, want 3", model.at())
	}
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 2, tea.MouseButtonWheelUp, tea.MouseActionPress))
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 2, tea.MouseButtonWheelUp, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("wheel up did not clamp: %d", model.at())
	}
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 2, tea.MouseButtonWheelRight, tea.MouseActionPress))
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, 20, tea.MouseButtonWheelDown, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("horizontal/outside wheel changed selection: %d", model.at())
	}
}

func TestMouseRightClickSelectsThenRunsActionMenu(t *testing.T) {
	rows := mouseTaskRows(2)
	var opened []string
	model := New(Actions{Open: func(_ context.Context, selected *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) {
		opened = append(opened, selected.ID)
		return OpenResult{}, nil
	}}, rows, nil)
	firstY := 2 + model.listPreambleLines()
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, firstY+1, tea.MouseButtonRight, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 1 || model.overlay.kind != overlayActionMenu {
		t.Fatalf("right click selected=%d overlay=%v", model.at(), model.overlay.kind)
	}

	firstOptionY := 4
	if model.overlay.detail != "" {
		firstOptionY++
	}
	var command tea.Cmd
	model, command = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(3, firstOptionY, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if command == nil {
		t.Fatal("clicking open menu option returned no command")
	}
	_ = command()
	if len(opened) != 1 || opened[0] != "task-01" {
		t.Fatalf("opened tasks = %v", opened)
	}
	if model.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
		t.Fatalf("action menu remained open: %v", model.overlay.kind)
	}
}

func TestMouseActionMenuWheelOutsideClickAndModalIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	rows := mouseTaskRows(1)
	model := New(Actions{
		Open:    func(context.Context, *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) { return OpenResult{}, nil },
		SetNext: func(context.Context, *task.Task, string) error { return nil },
		Park:    func(context.Context, *task.Task, string) (string, error) { return "", nil },
	}, rows, nil).openActionMenu()
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(2, 2, tea.MouseButtonWheelDown, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.overlay.optionIndex != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("menu wheel selected option %d", model.overlay.optionIndex)
	}
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(2, 0, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
		t.Fatalf("outside click did not close menu: %v", model.overlay.kind)
	}

	model = New(Actions{}, rows, nil).openHelpOverlay()
	model.setAt(0)
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(2, 3, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.overlay.kind != overlayHelp || model.at() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("help overlay passed click through: overlay=%v selected=%d", model.overlay.kind, model.at())
	}
}

func TestMouseIgnoresModifiedClicksAndCloneContextActions(t *testing.T) {
	rows := mouseTaskRows(2)
	model := New(Actions{Open: func(context.Context, *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) {
		return OpenResult{}, nil
	}}, rows, nil)
	firstY := 2 + model.listPreambleLines()
	modified := tea.MouseMsg(tea.MouseEvent{
		X: 2, Y: firstY + 1, Button: tea.MouseButtonLeft, Action: tea.MouseActionPress, Shift: true,
	})
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, modified)
	if model.at() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("modified click selected row %d", model.at())
	}

	model.remoteClone.phase = remoteCloneRunning
	model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(2, firstY+1, tea.MouseButtonRight, tea.MouseActionPress))
	if model.at() != 1 || model.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
		t.Fatalf("clone-time right click selected=%d overlay=%v", model.at(), model.overlay.kind)
	}
}

99	destination is labelled `inspect` with its exact path; dev does not delete it
100	automatically. Filters include visibility, for example

103	SKILLS and MCP also load lazily after the accepted REPOS snapshot. Inside Git,
104	both scan only the exact startup checkout and read user/global sources once, so
105	unrelated projects do not add noise. Outside Git, both retain the dashboard's

108	press `c` for the explicit read-only upstream source check. Refresh/check keeps

112	A wide TASKS table includes `REPO`; compact layouts keep repository/path in the

114	`update:`, `presence:`, and `integrity:`. MCP filters include `repo:`, `agent:`,
115	`scope:`, `transport:`, `managed:`, and `state:`.

127	Repeat the table for additional projects. Azure CLI and its `azure-devops`

```text
1	# Agent skills
2	
3	A provider-independent inventory of agent skills in the current checkout, any
4	selected repository, every configured repository, and global agent paths.
5	
6	## Reading the inventory
7	
8	```bash
9	dev skill list                         # current checkout + global
10	dev skill list --repo api --project    # one repository/checkout
11	dev skill list --all                   # canonical repositories + global once
12	dev skill list --all --check --json    # explicit upstream freshness check
13	```
14	
15	Project/global copies of one skill remain separate rows. Repository identity,
16	logical installations, compatible agent paths, local presence/integrity, source,
17	and update freshness are reported independently.
18	
19	## Where the data comes from
20	
21	Reads are native. `dev` scans a versioned snapshot of all 77 paths in the
22	`skills@1.5.23` registry plus project/global lock files. It never runs `skills`,
23	Node, npm, `npx`, agent detectors, or project code to list inventory. Shared
24	paths such as `.agents/skills` report registry compatibility; they do not claim
25	the corresponding agent executables are installed.
26	
27	Project scope defaults to the exact current checkout, including a linked
28	worktree. `--all` scans canonical configured repositories. The TUI reuses its
29	accepted REPOS snapshot and additionally includes the startup checkout when it
30	is a distinct linked worktree. Global paths are scanned once.
31	
32	A missing lock is normal. Malformed, unreadable, oversized, unsupported, or
33	ambiguous lock data is diagnosed without hiding valid neighboring rows. Absolute
34	`$XDG_STATE_HOME/skills/.skill-lock.json` is the global lock when configured;
35	otherwise `~/.agents/.skill-lock.json` is used.
36	
37	## Freshness and integrity
38	
39	Listing is local-only. `--check` (or TUI `c`) is the explicit network operation:
40	it groups equal Git source/ref pairs and compares Git tree/blob object bytes with
41	the lock-recorded hash without checking out remote content or modifying installed
42	files/locks. Checkout filters and `core.autocrlf` therefore cannot execute or alter
43	the comparison. Provider folder hashes containing non-ASCII paths are reported
44	unverifiable because upstream `localeCompare` ordering is locale-dependent.
45	
46	`current` therefore means upstream still matches the lock record. It does not
47	prove installed bytes are intact. Presence is tracked separately, and only the
48	embedded `dev-cli` skill can verify that every bundled file matches; additional user files are not treated as drift.
49	
50	## Updating
51	
52	```bash
53	dev skill add
54	dev skill update <name> --project [--repo api]
55	dev skill update <name> --global
56	```
57	
58	Only explicit add/install/update operations invoke the provider to change
59	skills. They require a directly installed `skills` executable and may access the
60	network; `dev doctor` may separately run that trusted executable's `--version`
61	probe. `dev` never invokes `npx` from a repository checkout, so a local
62	`node_modules/.bin/skills` cannot substitute for the provider; an ineligible PATH
63	shim is skipped when a later trusted executable exists. Unknown/source-less lock
64	entries are not mutation-eligible, and cooperating `dev` processes serialize the
65	entire provider run. Updates require one explicit scope and confirmation (or
66	`--yes`); no bulk update is implied by inventory.
67	
68	`dev doctor` reports native inventory separately from the optional mutation
69	provider.
70	
71	## dev's own skill is different
72	
73	The `dev-cli` skill is compiled into the binary. It updates when `dev` updates,
74	not through the upstream provider, and `make install` links it into agent
75	directories. The inventory marks it as directly managed and can verify its local
76	content against the embedded files.
77
```
</details></tool-use>

3	Inspect static MCP server declarations across repositories and supported agent

6	```bash
7	dev mcp list
8	dev mcp list --repo api
9	dev mcp list --all
10	dev mcp list --agent claude-code,codex --scope project --json
11	```
12	
13	The initial adapters cover Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode.
14	Project, local, user, custom, system, and managed declarations remain separate
15	rows. Claude user configuration honors an absolute `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; local
16	rows retain their exact project key. `configured`, `enabled`, and `disabled`
17	describe declarations plus Claude's documented user/project/local/managed project
18	approval settings; they are not connectivity or authentication health, and no
19	other agent's layers are merged into a guessed effective configuration.
20	
21	The scanner never executes agent MCP list/debug commands, configured commands,
22	header helpers, servers, or URLs. It does not expand environment placeholders,
23	read OAuth/token stores, or dereference OpenCode `{file:…}` values. Normalized
24	output retains only safe facts such as the command basename, provider-specific
25	environment reference names, argument count, OAuth presence/count facts, and a
26	URL scheme/host with userinfo, path, query, and fragment redacted. Explicit
27	Gemini SSE/streamable HTTP and Claude HTTP/streamable HTTP declarations stay
28	distinct; null server members are diagnostics rather than phantom rows.
29	
30	Static inventory cannot reproduce every runtime layer. Plugin caches, hosted
31	connectors, remote organization configuration, inline
32	`OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`, and command-line-only inputs are omitted and reported
33	as coverage limits. Duplicate names in different files/scopes are not merged
34	into a guessed effective configuration.
35	
36	The MCP TUI view reuses the accepted REPOS snapshot, includes the exact startup
37	linked worktree when distinct, and offers navigation, filtering, and reload only.

8	
9	# TUI, repositories, quick notes, and bootstrap
10	
11	Bare `dev` opens an interactive dashboard when standard input/output are terminals. When piped, it prints the plain task listing so shell composition remains predictable.
12	
13	There are two independent full-screen models. Bare `dev` / `dev tui` is the
14	seven-view inventory dashboard below. Preview-labelled `dev flow [repo]` is a
15	TTY-only, plan-first lifecycle view for one canonical repository; it is not a
16	dashboard tab or mode.
17	
18	## Seven views
19	
20	| View | Question | Source |
21	|---|---|---|
22	| TASKS | What am I working on? | task registry plus live Git/runtime facts |
23	| REPOS | What durable repositories exist here? | configured scan roots and local catalog |
24	| FLEET | What exists and is active on configured machines? | accepted local REPOS snapshot plus remote `dev` snapshots over SSH |
25	| TRY | Which experiments can I resume, archive, or graduate? | experiment catalog plus live facts |
26	| REMOTE | What can I open or clone? | authenticated `gh`/`glab` inventories and cache |
27	| SKILLS | Which skills would an agent launched from this context read? | exact startup checkout plus global sources inside Git; all REPOS targets outside Git |
28	| MCP | Which MCP declarations would that context expose? | sanitized static configuration with the same context-first target scope |
29	
30	The initial TASKS frame is built before runtime auto-detection, project-root
31	lookup, cache decoding, shell tool probes, or the optional release refresh can
32	finish. TASKS, REPOS, and TRY then publish independently from one shared local
33	cycle. REMOTE, FLEET, SKILLS, and MCP stay lazy. Each requested view has a generation:
34	`r` supersedes the previous read, late results are ignored, failed refreshes keep
35	usable rows visible, and a successful empty result removes obsolete rows. Cache
36	acceptance and current live completion are distinct; there is no all-tabs-ready
37	state for optional views that may never be opened.
38	
39	Use an absolute path that does not exist for a one-run diagnostic trace:
40	
41	```bash
42	DEV_TUI_TRACE=/tmp/dev-tui-trace.json dev
43	```
44	
45	The private, bounded JSON is written after the alternate screen is restored. It
46	contains relative timings, aggregate row counts, and categorical
47	view/generation/outcome fields, never repository/task/host/tool names, paths,
48	commands, key values, URLs, handles, or
49	raw errors. It is not `stats.db` and is never sent anywhere.
50	`tui.initial_view_returned` means the Bubble Tea view string was built, not that
51	the terminal rasterized it.
52	
53	Switch with `tab`, `h`/`l`, or arrows. Use `j`/`k`, `g`/`G`, `ctrl+d`/`ctrl+u`, `/` to filter, `?` for help, and `esc`/`q` to leave the current mode.
54	
55	## Common actions
56	
57	### TASKS
58	
59	```text
60	enter/o   open the selected task
61	p         park warm and enter the next action
62	c         edit the next action
63	n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
64	1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
65	```
66	
67	A COLD worktree task must be rebuilt with `dev resume`; the dashboard does not silently recreate it through a generic open action. A missing or unregistered worktree points to `dev sweep` first, so unique agent artifacts are reported for salvage before the task is resumed or reaped. Enter never opens an abandoned artifact-only directory. At 97 or more terminal cells the TASKS table includes a display-width-aware `REPO` column; narrower layouts retain the previous columns and show repo/path in detail.
68	
69	### Repository flow
70	
71	```bash
72	dev flow              # exact current surface, or picker outside Git
73	dev flow api          # explicit repository
74	```
75	
76	Flow lists every registered worktree plus task-only COLD/DONE rows and labels
77	canonical/managed/unmanaged/harness/task-only/conflict topology. Use `j/k` for
78	rows, `h/l` for actions, Tab for panel focus, Enter to build a plan, then `y` or
79	the displayed typed token to approve only a READY plan. `r` reloads local facts;
80	`R` offers explicit fetch, review query, or both. Startup and `r` never use the
81	network.
82	
83	The plan separates persisted HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE intent from live evidence,
84	shows remediation/fallback for blocked actions, and is revalidated against the
85	exact task revision and Git/worktree/runtime/artifact identity before Apply.
86	Partial effects remain in a result ledger. Eligible unmanaged rows can be
87	metadata-only Adopted or cleanly Removed while preserving their branch;
88	canonical/harness/conflict destruction fails closed. See [Repository lifecycle
89	flow](repository-flow.md) for action and compatibility boundaries.
90	
91	### REPOS
92	
93	```text
94	enter/o   ad-hoc open without creating a task
95	space     expand linked worktrees
96	m         edit repository tags/summary
97	n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
98	d         track direct work on the current branch
99	s         start isolated work: branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
100	H         open the repository activity heatmap
101	y         open copy/context actions
102	```
103	
104	Expanded rows explain every linked worktree, including harness-owned `(ephemeral)` and otherwise unmanaged `(external)` checkouts. The LIVE column shows runtime activity separately from task state.
105	
106	`dev repo context [repo]` emits the same agent-ready Markdown context available from the TUI copy menu, including paths, Git/worktree/runtime facts, and tasks. `--json` adds the schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract; `--refresh` is the only form that live-probes optional forge and configured fleet sources.
107	
108	### TRY and REMOTE
109	
110	TRY handles low-cost experiments, reversible archive/restore, marking, and graduation. Archive is organization, not deletion or disk reclamation.
111	
112	REMOTE loads lazily so startup does not wait for the network. Its private XDG
113	cache is decoded after the first view and holds the complete paginated inventory.
114	Fresh rows require no network; stale rows stay searchable while background
115	refresh runs. Oversized/malformed payloads and caches fingerprinted for another
116	configured GH/GL host or Azure target are ignored. GitLab uses explicit
117	`GITLAB_HOST`/`GLAB_HOST` (default `gitlab.com`) instead of inferring a host from
118	cwd; successful empty inventories clear old rows. Enter opens an existing local
119	clone. For an absent repository, `c` confirms a path-confined `project_root`
120	destination; `enter` clones and stays in the dashboard, while `o` clones and
121	opens afterward. A `project_root` outside the configured REPOS discovery
122	roots/depth is rejected before mutation. An animated row/status marker remains
123	visible through Git clone and the local-only, generation-guarded REPOS refresh;
124	`q`/Ctrl-C requests cancellation without abandoning the in-flight result. Once
125	accepted, REMOTE marks the checkout as `repo` and REPOS can search it
126	immediately. If Git leaves a destination after failure, REMOTE marks its exact
127	path `inspect` instead of deleting it or offering a misleading retry. `r` forces a forge refresh.
128	Use `/vis:private` for an exact visibility filter. Notes are enabled only after
129	a REMOTE row resolves to a local clone. TRY keeps lowercase `n` for creating a
130	new Try rather than a repository note.
131	
132	### CLI repository pickers
133	
134	Bare `dev repo clone` opens a picker over the existing private forge cache. It
135	uses each provider's exact clone URL, never refreshes the network implicitly,
136	and keeps a manual URL/path/`owner/name` choice. A stale or incomplete cache is
137	still selectable with a warning; populate or replace it explicitly:
138	
139	```bash
140	dev repo remote --refresh
141	dev repo clone
142	```
143	
144	Outside a checkout, bare `dev start` uses the same picker UI over fast live
145	local discovery, then fully resolves the selected repository before planning a
146	task. Inside a repository it retains the immediate current-repository default
147	without scanning every configured root. The default
148	external selector is `fzf`; a missing executable falls back to the built-in
149	Bubble Tea list, and `[picker] command = []` forces that list. Compatible
150	external commands receive candidates on stdin and must return one unchanged
151	line on stdout. Non-TTY callers retain line prompts and never receive picker UI.
152	
153	The repository's `contrib/television/dev-remote-repos.toml` and
154	`contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash` compose over the same public source instead of
155	creating another inventory:
156	
157	```bash
158	dev repo remote --refresh                 # populate once or refresh deliberately
159	ref="$(tv dev-remote-repos)" && [ -n "$ref" ] && dev repo clone "$ref"
160	source contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash
161	dev-repo-clone-fzf
162	```
163	
164	Both external recipes require `jq`, read `dev repo remote --cached --json`, and
165	pass one quoted clone URL to `dev repo clone`. They are examples to copy or
166	symlink; dev does not modify Television, shell, or chezmoi configuration.
167	
168	### FLEET
169	
170	FLEET also loads lazily. It keeps valid cached rows usable while waiting for the
171	current REPOS generation to be accepted, reuses that snapshot for the local host
172	instead of scanning repositories again, and then fans out to configured SSH
173	hosts. This machine is hidden by default because REPOS already provides the
174	richer local inventory; press `a` to include/hide local rows. Press `r` to
175	supersede an older request and force a live reload. Changing any endpoint field,
176	including SSH port, invalidates that host's cache. None of this changes
177	`dev fleet list`, whose non-interactive output continues to include this machine.
178	
179	## Repository quick notes
180	
181	On TASKS and REPOS, lowercase `n` opens a one-line quick-add prompt and uppercase `N` opens the selected repository's notes overlay. A child worktree resolves to the same canonical repository through catalog identity.
182	
183	```text
184	j/k       move
185	/         search body, tags, and repository
186	Enter     expand or collapse the Markdown body
187	a or n    add another note
188	e         edit the body in VISUAL/EDITOR
189	d         enter confirmation; y deletes
190	Esc       return without changing data
191	```
192	
193	The optional REPOS column `notes` shows a count. It is off by default because the table is width-constrained. Repository detail shows the count and latest preview when notes exist; task detail does so when the task resolves to a loaded repository row.
194	
195	The same source-of-truth workflow is available without the TUI:
196	
197	```bash
198	dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
199	dev note list api
200	dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
201	dev note show <id-or-prefix>
202	dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
203	dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # confirms
204	dev note path api
205	dev note reindex
206	```
207	
208	A note ID prefix must be unique and at least eight characters.
209	
210	Markdown under configured `paths.state_dir/notes` is durable; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is only a rebuildable search index. See the [complete generated command reference](../reference/commands-config.md#complete-generated-command-reference) for exact flags.
211	
212	SKILLS and MCP both load lazily after the current REPOS generation is accepted.
213	Inside Git they scan only the exact startup checkout plus global/user sources,
214	matching what an agent launched there can read and excluding unrelated projects.
215	Outside Git they retain the cross-repository inventory, scanning every accepted
216	REPOS target plus the ordinary startup directory. Refreshes keep
217	usable rows visible, warning-only partial inventories stay fresh, and a visible
218	capability view resumes automatically after REPOS recovers.
219	
220	SKILLS reads the versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry and lock files
221	natively—no Node, `skills`, npm, `npx`, agent detector, or project code runs.
222	Same-named project/global/repository rows remain distinct. Presence and embedded
223	`dev-cli` integrity are local facts; update state is a separate lock-recorded
224	upstream comparison. `c` is the explicit grouped Git source check, `a` opens the
225	upstream interactive installer, and `u` confirms before updating only the
226	selected lock-managed skill in that row's checkout. The check hashes Git object
227	bytes without populating a checkout; locale-dependent non-ASCII folder hashes stay
228	unverifiable. Mutations require a directly installed `skills` executable, skip
229	repository-local npm shims, reject source-less locks, and serialize cooperating
230	`dev` processes. Filters include `repo:`, `scope:`, `agent:`, `update:`,
231	`presence:`, and `integrity:`.
232	
233	MCP reads static declarations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and
234	OpenCode. It preserves file/scope rows and exact Claude local project keys instead
235	of guessing a generally effective configuration; only Claude's documented
236	user/project/local/managed project approvals are resolved. An absolute
237	`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` relocates Claude user sources. Configured/enabled/disabled
238	never means connected or healthy. Provider-specific environment reference names
239	and finite OAuth facts remain, while values, raw arguments, URL
240	credentials/path/query/fragment, and indirect file content are discarded before
241	rows enter the model. The scanner never runs a server, helper, URL, or agent MCP
242	command. Filters include `repo:`,
243	`agent:`, `scope:`, `transport:`, `managed:`, and `state:`; `r` only rereads
244	static files.
245	
246	## External tools
247	
248	```bash
249	dev tui tools
250	```
251	
252	Configured tools run through `$SHELL` in the selected checkout while the alternate screen is suspended. `interactive = true` uses `$SHELL -lic` so local aliases/functions can resolve; use a real executable on `PATH` when the binding must be portable. Availability probes run in a bounded background load after the first view; rendering never starts a login shell, and unresolved bindings fail closed.
253	
254	```toml
255	[[tui.tools]]
256	key = "L"
257	name = "lazygit"
258	run = "lazygit"
259	```
260	
261	Keys are case-sensitive and cannot shadow dashboard-owned bindings. Returning from an editor can reload most config; switching runtime backend requires restarting the TUI.
262	
263	## Inventory an existing machine
264	
265	Start with a report:
266	
267	```bash
268	dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
269	dev bootstrap ~/code --json
270	```
271	
272	The scanner identifies canonical checkouts, linked worktrees, bare repositories, and symlink aliases, then deduplicates them by Git identity.
273	
274	The recommended organization layer is a non-destructive symlink index:
275	
276	```bash
277	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
278	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
279	```
280	
281	Physical moves are a separate, stricter mode. A move plan blocks dirty repositories, linked worktrees, live sessions/current working directories, aliases that would break, occupied destinations, and cross-filesystem renames. If any row is blocked, apply moves none.
282	
283	## Adopt work already in flight
284	
285	Bootstrap answers **where repositories are**. Adoption answers **which existing branches, worktrees, and sessions are active work**:
286	
287	```bash
288	dev adopt
289	dev adopt --apply
290	```
```

19	## 七個 view
20	
21	| View | 回答問題 | 來源 |
22	|---|---|---|
23	| TASKS | 我正在處理什麼？ | task registry 加即時 Git/runtime facts |
24	| REPOS | 本機有哪些持久 repositories？ | 設定的 scan roots 與 local catalog |
25	| FLEET | 設定的機器上有哪些 repository 與 active work？ | 已接受的 local REPOS snapshot 加上透過 SSH 取得的 remote `dev` snapshots |
26	| TRY | 哪些 experiments 能 resume、archive 或 graduate？ | experiment catalog 加 live facts |
27	| REMOTE | 有哪些 repository 能 open 或 clone？ | authenticated `gh`/`glab` inventories 與 cache |
28	| SKILLS | 從目前 context 啟動 agent 時會讀到哪些 skills？ | Git 內使用 exact startup checkout 加 global sources；Git 外使用所有 REPOS targets |
29	| MCP | 該 context 會暴露哪些 MCP declarations？ | 採相同 context-first target scope 的 sanitized static config |
30	
31	初始 TASKS frame 會先建立，不等待 runtime auto-detection、project-root lookup、
32	cache decode、shell tool probe 或 optional release refresh 完成。TASKS、REPOS 與
33	TRY 接著由同一個 shared local cycle 獨立發布；REMOTE、FLEET、SKILLS 與 MCP 維持
34	lazy。每個被請求的 view 都有自己的 generation：`r` 會 supersede 舊讀取，晚到
35	結果會被忽略，refresh 失敗時保留可用 rows，而成功的空結果會移除過時 rows。

53	## 常用 actions
54	
55	### TASKS
56	
57	```text
58	enter/o   開啟選取的 task
59	p         park warm 並輸入 next action
60	c         編輯 next action
61	n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
62	1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
63	```
64	
65	COLD worktree task 必須透過 `dev resume` 重建；TUI 不會用 generic open action 靜默重建。若 worktree 已遺失或不再由 Git 註冊，必須先執行 `dev sweep`，讓它在 resume 或 reap 前回報需要 salvage 的 agent artifacts。Enter 不會開啟只剩 artifacts 的 abandoned directory。Terminal 寬度至少 97 cells 時，TASKS table 會顯示 display-width-aware `REPO` column；更窄時保留原 columns，並在 detail 顯示 repo/path。
66	
67	### REPOS
68	
69	```text
70	enter/o   ad-hoc open，不建立 task
71	space     展開 linked worktrees
72	m         編輯 repository tags/summary
73	n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
74	d         追蹤目前 branch 的 direct work
75	s         啟動 isolated work：branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
76	H         開啟 repository activity heatmap
77	y         開啟 copy/context actions
78	```
79	
80	展開後會顯示每個 linked worktree，包括 harness-owned `(ephemeral)` 與未受管理的 `(external)` checkout。LIVE column 將 runtime activity 與 task state 分開。
81	
82	`dev repo context [repo]` 會輸出 TUI copy menu 相同的 agent-ready Markdown context，包含 paths、Git/worktree/runtime facts 與 tasks。`--json` 加入 schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract；只有 `--refresh` 會 live-probe optional forge 與 configured fleet sources。
83	
84	### 獨立 Repository Flow
85	
86	```text
87	dev flow [repo]         依 cwd 或明確 repo 開啟 canonical repository
88	j/k 或 Up/Down          選 surface row
89	h/l 或 Left/Right       選 action
90	Enter                   只建立 plan
91	r                       只更新 local facts
92	R                       明確選 fetch refs、query review 或 both
93	```
94	
95	Flow 的 `CANONICAL`、`MANAGED`、`UNMANAGED`、`HARNESS`、`TASK-ONLY` 與 `CONFLICT` rows 各有不同 action set。只有 READY plan 經 `y` 或 exact typed token 的第二次 confirmation 後才 Apply；沒有 generic force、dirty discard、`--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime` 或 shared-writer override。Runtime `none` 顯示為 unobserved，不會被解讀成已證明沒有 session。Result 會保留 partial step ledger，Apply 後再 fresh local reload。

98	
99	TRY 管理低成本 experiment、可逆 archive/restore、mark 與 graduation。Archive 是整理，不是 deletion 或 disk reclamation。

102	view 後 decode，並保存完整 paginated inventory；fresh rows 不需要 network，

104	fingerprint 屬於其他 configured GH/GL host 或 Azure target 的 cache 都會被忽略。

106	推測 host；成功但為空的 inventory 會清除舊 rows。Enter 開啟既有 local clone。

262

350	`repo new --template` snapshots a local directory or Git tree into a fresh
351	history; it is not a clone. `--template-ref` and `--template-subdir` select the
352	exact source tree.
353	
354	Use `--check-in=commit|stage|none` to choose whether generated changes are
355	committed, staged for human review, or left unstaged (`auto` follows a new
356	repository's preset and otherwise defaults to none). `repo setup --commit`
357	remains the compatibility spelling for commit.
358	Stage mode cannot create an upstream and cannot hand dirty setup directly to
359	`start`.
