1322	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1323	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1324	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1325	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1326	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1327		if row.Task == nil {
1328			return ""
1329		}
1330		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1331			return "dev sweep"
1332		}
1333		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1334			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1335		}
1336		return ""
1337	}
1338	
1339	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1340		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1341		if command == "" {
1342			return nil
1343		}
1344		switch {
1345		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1346			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1347		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1348			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1349		default:
1350			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1351		}
1352	}

1364	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1365		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1366		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1367			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1368			if structured {
1369				switch key {
1370				case "scope":
1371					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1372						return false
1373					}
1374					continue
1375				case "agent":
1376					agents := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " ")
1377					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(agents), value) {
1378						return false
1379					}
1380					continue
1381				case "update":
1382					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.UpdateStatus)), value) {
1383						return false
1384					}
1385					continue
1386				case "repo":
1387					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(row.Repository), value) {
1388						return false
1389					}
1390					continue
1391				case "presence":
1392					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Presence)), value) {
1393						return false
1394					}
1395					continue
1396				case "integrity":
1397					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Integrity)), value) {
1398						return false
1399					}
1400					continue
1401				}
1402			}
1403			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1404				row.Name, row.Repository, row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout,
1405				string(row.Scope), row.Source, row.SourceURL, string(row.Presence), string(row.Integrity),
1406				string(row.ManagedBy), string(row.UpdateStatus),
1407				strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), row.Agents...), row.Attribution.AgentIDs...), " "),
1408			}, " "))
1409			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1410				return false
1411			}
1412		}
1413		return true
1414	}
1415

1418		for _, row := range m.mcp {

1426	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
1427		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1428		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1429			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1430			if structured {
1431				var field string
1432				switch key {
1433				case "repo":
1434					field = row.Repository
1435				case "agent":
1436					field = string(row.Agent)
1437				case "scope":
1438					field = string(row.Scope)
1439				case "transport":
1440					field = string(row.Transport)
1441				case "managed":
1442					field = string(row.Source)
1443				case "state":
1444					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1445				default:
1446					field = ""
1447				}
1448				if field != "" {
1449					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1450						return false
1451					}
1452					continue
1453				}
1454			}
1455			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1456				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1457				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1458				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1459			}, " "))
1460			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1461				return false
1462			}
1463		}
1464		return true
1465	}

1467	func mcpDeclarationState(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
1468		if row.Enabled == nil {
1469			return "configured"
1470		}
1471		if *row.Enabled {
1472			return "enabled"
1473		}
1474		return "disabled"
1475	}

1477	// compareRepos returns negative when a belongs before b.
1478	func compareRepos(a, b RepoRow, sortBy string) int {
1479		nameCmp := strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a.Repo.Display()), strings.ToLower(b.Repo.Display()))
1480		descInt := func(x, y int) int {
1481			switch {
1482			case x > y:
1483				return -1
1484			case x < y:
1485				return 1
1486			default:
1487				return 0
1488			}
1489		}
1490		descBool := func(x, y bool) int {
1491			if x == y {
1492				return 0
1493			}
1494			if x {
1495				return -1
1496			}
1497			return 1
1498		}
1499		latest := func() int {
1500			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1501				return 0
1502			}
1503			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1504				return -1
1505			}
1506			return 1
1507		}
1508	
1509		switch sortBy {
1510		case "name":
1511			return nameCmp
1512		case "latest":
1513			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1514				return c
1515			}
1516		case "git":
1517			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1518				return c
1519			}
1520			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1521				return c
1522			}
1523		case "size":
1524			switch {
1525			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1526				return -1
1527			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1528				return 1
1529			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1530				return -1
1531			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1532				return 1
1533			}
1534		case "tasks":
1535			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1536				return c
1537			}
1538			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1539				return c
1540			}
1541		default: // activity
1542			if c := descInt(a.HotTasks(), b.HotTasks()); c != 0 {
1543				return c
1544			}
1545			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1546				return c
1547			}
1548			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1549				return c
1550			}
1551			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1552				return c
1553			}
1554			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1555				return c
1556			}
1557		}
1558		return nameCmp
1559	}

1610	// setAt moves the cursor, clamped to the current view's length.
1611	func (m *Model) setAt(i int) {
1612		n := m.count()
1613		switch {
1614		case n == 0:
1615			i = 0
1616		case i >= n:
1617			i = n - 1
1618		case i < 0:
1619			i = 0
1620		}
1621		switch m.view {
1622		case ViewRepos:
1623			m.repoCursor = i
1624		case ViewFleet:
1625			m.fleetCursor = i
1626		case ViewTries:
1627			m.tryCursor = i
1628		case ViewRemote:
1629			m.remoteCursor = i
1630		case ViewSkills:
1631			m.skillCursor = i
1632		case ViewMCP:
1633			m.mcpCursor = i
1634		default:
1635			m.taskCursor = i
1636		}
1637	}

1730	func remoteIdentityKey(kind forge.Kind, fullName string) string {

1732	}

1734	func remoteRowKey(row RemoteRow) string {

1738	func (m *Model) replaceRemotes(rows []RemoteRow) {
1739		problems := map[string]string{}
1740		for _, row := range m.remotes {
1741			if row.CloneProblemPath == "" {
1742				continue
1743			}
1744			if _, err := os.Lstat(row.CloneProblemPath); err == nil {
1745				problems[remoteRowKey(row)] = row.CloneProblemPath
1746			}
1747		}
1748		m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), rows...)
1749		for i := range m.remotes {
1750			if path := problems[remoteRowKey(m.remotes[i])]; path != "" {
1751				m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath = path
1752			}
1753		}
1754	}

1756	func (m *Model) setRemoteLocal(row RemoteRow, path, name string, kind catalog.Kind) {
1757		m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), m.remotes...)
1758		key := remoteRowKey(row)
1759		for i := range m.remotes {
1760			if remoteRowKey(m.remotes[i]) == key {
1761				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = path
1762				m.remotes[i].LocalName = name
1763				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = kind
1764				if path != "" {
1765					m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath = ""
1766				}
1767				return
1768			}
1769		}
1770	}

1779			}

1783	func (m *Model) rememberUnconfirmedRemote(row RemoteRow, path, name string, kind catalog.Kind) {
1784		marker := remoteLocalMarker{
1785			key: remoteRowKey(row), matchKey: remoteIdentityKey(row.Repo.Forge, row.Repo.FullName),
1786			path: path, name: name, kind: kind,
1787		}
1788		markers := append([]remoteLocalMarker(nil), m.unconfirmedRemotes...)
1789		for i := range markers {
1790			if markers[i].key == marker.key {
1791				markers[i] = marker
1792				m.unconfirmedRemotes = markers
1793				return
1794			}
1795		}
1796		m.unconfirmedRemotes = append(markers, marker)
1797	}

1799	func (m *Model) forgetUnconfirmedRemote(row RemoteRow) {
1800		key := remoteRowKey(row)
1801		markers := make([]remoteLocalMarker, 0, len(m.unconfirmedRemotes))
1802		for _, marker := range m.unconfirmedRemotes {
1803			if marker.key != key {
1804				markers = append(markers, marker)
1805			}
1806		}
1807		m.unconfirmedRemotes = markers
1808	}

1816	func localCloneStillExists(path string) bool {
1817		info, err := os.Stat(path)
1818		if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
1819			return false
1820		}
1821		_, err = os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git"))
1822		return err == nil
1823	}
1824	
1825	func remoteMarkerConflictsWithRepos(marker remoteLocalMarker, rows []RepoRow) bool {
1826		for _, row := range rows {
1827			matchesPath := sameCheckoutPath(marker.path, row.Repo.Path) ||
1828				row.Repo.RealPath != "" && sameCheckoutPath(marker.path, row.Repo.RealPath)
1829			if matchesPath && (row.RemoteName == "" ||
1830				remoteIdentityKey(row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName) != marker.matchKey) {
1831				return true
1832			}
1833		}
1834		return false
1835	}
1836	
1837	func (m *Model) applyUnconfirmedRemoteLocals(blocked map[string]bool) {
1838		byKey := make(map[string]remoteLocalMarker, len(m.unconfirmedRemotes))
1839		kept := make([]remoteLocalMarker, 0, len(m.unconfirmedRemotes))
1840		for _, marker := range m.unconfirmedRemotes {
1841			if !localCloneStillExists(marker.path) || remoteMarkerConflictsWithRepos(marker, m.repos) {
1842				continue
1843			}
1844			kept = append(kept, marker)
1845			byKey[marker.key] = marker
1846		}
1847		m.unconfirmedRemotes = kept
1848		for i := range m.remotes {
1849			key := remoteRowKey(m.remotes[i])
1850			if m.remotes[i].Cloned() || blocked[key] {
1851				continue
1852			}
1853			if marker, ok := byKey[key]; ok {
1854				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = marker.path
1855				m.remotes[i].LocalName = marker.name
1856				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = marker.kind
1857			}
1858		}
1859	}
1860	
1861	// matchRemoteLocals fills cached remote rows from the freshly loaded local
1862	// inventory without another scan. A just-cloned path survives an unrelated
1863	// partial local result only while its Git checkout still exists.
1864	func (m *Model) matchRemoteLocals() {
1865		m.remotes = append([]RemoteRow(nil), m.remotes...)
1866		byRemote := map[string]RepoRow{}
1867		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1868		for _, r := range m.repos {
1869			if r.RemoteName == "" {
1870				continue
1871			}
1872			key := remoteIdentityKey(r.RemoteForge, r.RemoteName)
1873			if ambiguous[key] {
1874				continue
1875			}
1876			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1877				delete(byRemote, key)
1878				ambiguous[key] = true
1879				continue
1880			}
1881			byRemote[key] = r
1882		}
1883		triesByIdentity := map[string]TryRow{}
1884		ambiguousTry := map[string]bool{}
1885		for _, row := range m.tries {
1886			identity := row.Item.RemoteIdentity
1887			if !row.Present() || identity == "" || ambiguousTry[identity] {
1888				continue
1889			}
1890			if _, exists := triesByIdentity[identity]; exists {
1891				delete(triesByIdentity, identity)
1892				ambiguousTry[identity] = true
1893				continue
1894			}
1895			triesByIdentity[identity] = row
1896		}
1897		blockedUnconfirmed := map[string]bool{}
1898		for i := range m.remotes {
1899			key := remoteIdentityKey(m.remotes[i].Repo.Forge, m.remotes[i].Repo.FullName)
1900			identity := ""
1901			for _, raw := range []string{m.remotes[i].Repo.CloneURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.SSHURL, m.remotes[i].Repo.URL} {
1902				if identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
1903					break
1904				}
1905			}
1906			repository, repoOK := byRemote[key]
1907			try, tryOK := triesByIdentity[identity]
1908			sameCheckout := repoOK && tryOK && remotePathsOverlap(repository, try)
1909			if ambiguous[key] || ambiguousTry[identity] || (repoOK && tryOK && !sameCheckout) {
1910				blockedUnconfirmed[remoteRowKey(m.remotes[i])] = true
1911				m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1912				continue
1913			}
1914			if repoOK {
1915				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = repository.Repo.Path
1916				m.remotes[i].LocalName = repository.Repo.Display()
1917				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1918				m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath = ""
1919				if repository.Asset != nil {
1920					m.remotes[i].LocalKind = repository.Asset.Kind
1921				}
1922				continue
1923			}
1924			if tryOK {
1925				m.remotes[i].LocalPath = try.Item.Live.CurrentPath
1926				m.remotes[i].LocalName = try.Item.DisplayName()
1927				m.remotes[i].LocalKind = catalog.KindTry
1928				m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath = ""
1929				continue
1930			}
1931			m.remotes[i].LocalPath, m.remotes[i].LocalName, m.remotes[i].LocalKind = "", "", ""
1932			if m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath != "" {
1933				if _, err := os.Lstat(m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
1934					m.remotes[i].CloneProblemPath = ""
1935				}
1936			}
1937		}
1938		m.applyUnconfirmedRemoteLocals(blockedUnconfirmed)
1939	}
1940	
1941	func remotePathsOverlap(repository RepoRow, try TryRow) bool {
1942		for _, left := range []string{repository.Repo.Path, repository.Repo.RealPath} {
1943			for _, right := range []string{try.Item.Live.CurrentPath, try.Item.Live.RealPath} {
1944				if left != "" && right != "" && filepath.Clean(left) == filepath.Clean(right) {
1945					return true
1946				}
1947			}
1948		}
1949		return false
1950	}
1951	
1952	func (m Model) remoteCloneStatus() string {
1953		if m.remoteClone.canceling {
1954			return "canceling " + m.remoteClone.target.Repo.FullName + "…"
1955		}
1956		switch m.remoteClone.phase {
1957		case remoteCloneRunning:
1958			return "cloning " + m.remoteClone.target.Repo.FullName + "…"
1959		case remoteCloneRefreshing:
1960			return "cloned " + m.remoteClone.target.Repo.FullName + "; refreshing local repositories…"
1961		case remoteCloneOpening:
1962			return "opening " + m.remoteClone.target.Repo.FullName + "…"
1963		default:
1964			return ""
1965		}
1966	}
1967	
1968	func (m *Model) finishRemoteCloneState() tea.Cmd {
1969		deferred := m.remoteClone.deferredOpen
1970		m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
1971		if deferred.Directory != "" {
1972			m.chosen, m.quitting = deferred.Directory, true
1973			return tea.Quit
1974		}
1975		if deferred.RuntimeHandle != "" {
1976			m.activate, m.quitting = deferred.RuntimeHandle, true
1977			return tea.Quit
1978		}
1979		return nil
1980	}

1982	func (m Model) remoteCloneTargets(row RemoteRow) bool {
1983		return m.remoteClone.active() && remoteRowKey(m.remoteClone.target) == remoteRowKey(row)
1984	}

1986	func (m Model) selectedRemoteKey() string {
1987		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
1988		if m.remoteCursor < 0 || m.remoteCursor >= len(rows) {
1989			return ""
1990		}
1991		return remoteRowKey(rows[m.remoteCursor])

1994	func (m *Model) selectRemoteKey(key string) {
1995		for i, row := range m.visibleRemotes() {
1996			if remoteRowKey(row) == key {
1997				m.remoteCursor = i
1998				return
1999			}
2000		}
2001	}
2002	
2003	func (m Model) reposReadyForClone() bool {
2004		repos := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
2005		tries := m.viewLoad(ViewTries)
2006		reposReady := !repos.loading && repos.hasSnapshot && repos.actionable &&
2007			repos.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh && repos.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
2008		triesReady := !tries.requested || !tries.loading && tries.hasSnapshot && tries.actionable &&
2009			tries.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh && tries.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
2010		return m.configContext == nil && reposReady && triesReady
2011	}
2012	
2013	func (m Model) beginRemoteClone(openAfter bool) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2014		if m.remoteClone.active() || !m.reposReadyForClone() {
2015			return m, nil
2016		}
2017		row, ok := RemoteRow{}, false
2018		promptKey := remoteRowKey(m.remoteClonePrompt)
2019		for _, candidate := range m.remotes {
2020			if m.remoteClonePrompt.Repo.FullName != "" && remoteRowKey(candidate) == promptKey {
2021				row, ok = candidate, true
2022				break
2023			}
2024		}
2025		if !ok || row.Cloned() {
2026			m.remoteClonePrompt = RemoteRow{}
2027			m.mode = modeList
2028			m.input.Blur()
2029			if !ok {
2030				m.err = errors.New("the selected remote changed; choose it again")
2031			} else {
2032				m.status = row.Repo.FullName + " is already available locally"
2033			}
2034			return m, nil
2035		}
2036		m.remoteClonePrompt = RemoteRow{}
2037		m.mode = modeList
2038		m.input.Blur()
2039		m.err, m.status = nil, ""
2040		m.remoteCloneSequence++
2041		cloneContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
2042		m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{
2043			requestID: m.remoteCloneSequence,
2044			phase:     remoteCloneRunning,
2045			target:    row,
2046			openAfter: openAfter,
2047			cancel:    cancel,
2048		}
2049		requestID := m.remoteClone.requestID
2050		cloneRemote := m.actions.CloneRemote
2051		clone := func() tea.Msg {
2052			if cloneRemote == nil {
2053				return remoteCloneMsg{requestID: requestID, err: errors.New("cloning remote repositories is unavailable")}
2054			}
2055			path, err := cloneRemote(cloneContext, row)
2056			return remoteCloneMsg{requestID: requestID, path: path, err: err}
2057		}
2058		return m, tea.Batch(clone, m.remoteCloneSpinner.Tick)
2059	}
2060	
2061	func sameCheckoutPath(left, right string) bool {
2062		left, right = filepath.Clean(left), filepath.Clean(right)
2063		return left == right || runtime.GOOS == "windows" && strings.EqualFold(left, right)
2064	}
2065	
2066	func repoRowAtPath(rows []RepoRow, path string) (RepoRow, bool) {
2067		for _, row := range rows {
2068			for _, candidate := range []string{row.Repo.Path, row.Repo.RealPath} {
2069				if candidate != "" && sameCheckoutPath(candidate, path) {
2070					return row, true
2071				}
2072			}
2073		}
2074		return RepoRow{}, false
2075	}

2077	func (m *Model) openRemoteAfterClone(clone remoteCloneState, warning error) tea.Cmd {
2078		m.remoteClone.phase = remoteCloneOpening
2079		m.remoteClone.canceling = false
2080		m.remoteClone.refreshErr = warning
2081		target := clone.target
2082		target.LocalPath = clone.path
2083		if target.LocalName == "" {
2084			target.LocalName = clone.target.Repo.Name
2085		}
2086		if target.LocalKind == "" {
2087			target.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
2088		}
2089		requestID := clone.requestID
2090		openContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
2091		m.remoteClone.cancel = cancel
2092		openRemote := m.actions.OpenRemote
2093		return func() tea.Msg {
2094			if openRemote == nil {
2095				return remoteCloneOpenMsg{requestID: requestID, err: errors.New("opening remote repositories is unavailable")}
2096			}
2097			result, err := openRemote(openContext, target)
2098			return remoteCloneOpenMsg{requestID: requestID, result: result, err: err}
2099		}
2100	}

2102	func (m *Model) finishRemoteCloneStream(request LocalLoadRequest) {
2103		if m.remoteClone.phase != remoteCloneRefreshing || request.ReposGeneration < m.remoteClone.minReposGeneration {
2104			return
2105		}
2106		clone := m.remoteClone
2107		if clone.canceling {
2108			m.err = fmt.Errorf("cancel post-clone repository refresh for %s: result stream closed", clone.target.Repo.FullName)
2109		} else {
2110			m.err = fmt.Errorf("cloned %s to %s, but local repository refresh completed without a REPOS result",
2111				clone.target.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(clone.path))
2112		}
2113		m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2114	}
2115	
2116	func (m *Model) finishRemoteCloneRefresh(generation uint64, valid bool, refreshErr error) tea.Cmd {
2117		clone := m.remoteClone
2118		if clone.phase != remoteCloneRefreshing || generation < clone.minReposGeneration {
2119			return nil
2120		}
2121		if clone.canceling {
2122			if refreshErr == nil {
2123				refreshErr = errors.New("canceled")
2124			}
2125			m.err = fmt.Errorf("cancel post-clone repository refresh for %s: %w",
2126				clone.target.Repo.FullName, refreshErr)
2127			m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2128			return nil
2129		}
2130		if !valid {
2131			if refreshErr == nil {
2132				refreshErr = errors.New("local repository refresh returned no usable snapshot")
2133			}
2134			warning := fmt.Errorf("cloned %s to %s, but could not refresh local repositories: %w",
2135				clone.target.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(clone.path), refreshErr)
2136			m.setRemoteLocal(clone.target, clone.path, clone.target.Repo.Name, catalog.KindRepository)
2137			if clone.openAfter {
2138				return m.openRemoteAfterClone(clone, warning)
2139			}
2140			m.err = warning
2141			m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2142			return nil
2143		}
2144	
2145		discovered, ok := repoRowAtPath(m.repos, clone.path)
2146		if !ok {
2147			if !localCloneStillExists(clone.path) {
2148				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2149				m.setRemoteLocal(clone.target, "", "", "")
2150				m.err = fmt.Errorf("cloned checkout disappeared before local discovery completed: %s", config.Contract(clone.path))
2151				return nil
2152			}
2153			m.rememberUnconfirmedRemote(clone.target, clone.path, clone.target.Repo.Name, catalog.KindRepository)
2154			m.setRemoteLocal(clone.target, clone.path, clone.target.Repo.Name, catalog.KindRepository)
2155			var warning error
2156			if refreshErr != nil {
2157				warning = fmt.Errorf("cloned %s to %s, but local discovery did not find it after a partial refresh: %w",
2158					clone.target.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(clone.path), refreshErr)
2159			} else {
2160				warning = fmt.Errorf("cloned %s to %s, but local discovery did not find it; add paths.project_root to paths.scan_roots or add the clone to paths.repo_paths",
2161					clone.target.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(clone.path))
2162			}
2163			if clone.openAfter {
2164				return m.openRemoteAfterClone(clone, warning)
2165			}
2166			m.err = warning
2167			m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2168			return nil
2169		}
2170		matchedRemote := false
2171		for _, row := range m.remotes {
2172			if remoteRowKey(row) == remoteRowKey(clone.target) && row.LocalPath != "" &&
2173				sameCheckoutPath(row.LocalPath, discovered.Repo.Path) {
2174				matchedRemote = true
2175				break
2176			}
2177		}
2178		if !matchedRemote {
2179			m.setRemoteCloneProblem(clone.target, clone.path)
2180			warning := fmt.Errorf("cloned %s to %s, but local discovery could not match that checkout uniquely to the remote",
2181				clone.target.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(clone.path))
2182			if clone.openAfter {
2183				return m.openRemoteAfterClone(clone, warning)
2184			}
2185			m.err = warning
2186			m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2187			return nil
2188		}
2189	
2190		kind := catalog.KindRepository
2191		if discovered.Asset != nil && discovered.Asset.Kind != "" {
2192			kind = discovered.Asset.Kind
2193		}
2194		m.forgetUnconfirmedRemote(clone.target)
2195		if !clone.openAfter {
2196			m.err = nil
2197			m.status = "cloned " + clone.target.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(discovered.Repo.Path)
2198			return m.finishRemoteCloneState()
2199		}
2200	
2201		clone.path = discovered.Repo.Path
2202		clone.target.LocalName = discovered.Repo.Display()
2203		clone.target.LocalKind = kind
2204		return m.openRemoteAfterClone(clone, nil)
2205	}

2207	// currentDir is the checkout the selected row points at, for the external
2208	// tools and for the cd directive.
2209	func (m Model) currentDir() string {
2210		if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
2211			if r.CheckoutExists {
2212				return r.Checkout
2213			}
2214			return ""
2215		}
2216		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
2217			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
2218				if checkout.Exists && !checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
2219					return checkout.Worktree.Path
2220				}
2221				return ""
2222			}
2223			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
2224		}
2225		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok && r.Present() {
2226			return r.Item.Live.CurrentPath
2227		}
2228		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
2229			return r.LocalPath
2230		}
2231		return ""
2232	}

2234	// Update implements tea.Model.
2235	func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2236		switch msg := msg.(type) {
2237		case spinner.TickMsg:
2238			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
2239				return m, nil
2240			}
2241			var cmd tea.Cmd
2242			m.remoteCloneSpinner, cmd = m.remoteCloneSpinner.Update(msg)
2243			return m, cmd
2244	
2245		case remoteCloneMsg:
2246			if m.remoteClone.phase != remoteCloneRunning || msg.requestID != m.remoteClone.requestID {
2247				return m, nil
2248			}
2249			clone := m.remoteClone
2250			if clone.cancel != nil {
2251				clone.cancel()
2252			}
2253			if msg.err != nil {
2254				if strings.TrimSpace(msg.path) != "" {
2255					m.setRemoteCloneProblem(clone.target, filepath.Clean(msg.path))
2256				}
2257				if clone.canceling {
2258					m.err = fmt.Errorf("cancel clone %s: %w", clone.target.Repo.FullName, msg.err)
2259				} else {
2260					m.err = fmt.Errorf("clone %s: %w", clone.target.Repo.FullName, msg.err)
2261				}
2262				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2263				return m, nil
2264			}
2265			if strings.TrimSpace(msg.path) == "" {
2266				m.err = fmt.Errorf("clone %s returned no local path", clone.target.Repo.FullName)
2267				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2268				return m, nil
2269			}
2270			m.remoteClone.path = filepath.Clean(msg.path)
2271			m.remoteClone.phase = remoteCloneRefreshing
2272			m.remoteClone.openAfter = m.remoteClone.openAfter && !clone.canceling
2273			selectedRemote := m.selectedRemoteKey()
2274			m.rememberUnconfirmedRemote(clone.target, m.remoteClone.path, clone.target.Repo.Name, catalog.KindRepository)
2275			m.setRemoteLocal(clone.target, m.remoteClone.path, clone.target.Repo.Name, catalog.KindRepository)
2276			m.selectRemoteKey(selectedRemote)
2277			reposGeneration := m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadAction)
2278			m.remoteClone.canceling = false
2279			m.remoteClone.minReposGeneration = reposGeneration
2280			return m, m.reloadReposOnly()
2281	
2282		case remoteCloneOpenMsg:
2283			if m.remoteClone.phase != remoteCloneOpening || msg.requestID != m.remoteClone.requestID {
2284				return m, nil
2285			}
2286			clone := m.remoteClone
2287			if clone.cancel != nil {
2288				clone.cancel()
2289			}
2290			if clone.canceling {
2291				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2292				if msg.err != nil {
2293					m.err = errors.Join(clone.refreshErr,
2294						fmt.Errorf("cancel opening %s: %w", clone.target.Repo.FullName, msg.err))
2295				} else {
2296					m.err = clone.refreshErr
2297					m.status = "open completed before cancellation; stayed in the dashboard"
2298					if msg.result.Status != "" {
2299						m.status += " — " + msg.result.Status
2300					}
2301				}
2302				return m, nil
2303			}
2304			if msg.err != nil {
2305				openErr := fmt.Errorf("cloned %s to %s, but could not open it: %w",
2306					clone.target.Repo.FullName, config.Contract(clone.path), msg.err)
2307				m.err = errors.Join(clone.refreshErr, openErr)
2308				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2309				return m, nil
2310			}
2311			m.err = clone.refreshErr
2312			m.status = msg.result.Status
2313			if m.status == "" {
2314				m.status = "cloned " + clone.target.Repo.FullName + " to " + config.Contract(clone.path)
2315			}
2316			if msg.result.Directory != "" {
2317				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2318				m.chosen, m.quitting = msg.result.Directory, true
2319				return m, tea.Quit
2320			}
2321			if msg.result.RuntimeHandle != "" {
2322				m.remoteClone = remoteCloneState{}
2323				m.activate, m.quitting = msg.result.RuntimeHandle, true
2324				return m, tea.Quit
2325			}
2326			return m, m.finishRemoteCloneState()
2327	
2328		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
2329			m.width, m.height = msg.Width, msg.Height
2330			return m, nil
2331	
2332		case tea.MouseMsg:
2333			return m.updateMouse(msg)
2334	
2335		case localMsg:
2336			if msg.done {
2337				request := msg.load.Request
2338				current := m.localGeneration == request.CycleGeneration
2339				if !current {
2340					return m, nil
2341				}
2342				m.finishLocalLoad()
2343				m.finishRemoteCloneStream(request)
2344				m.forceSizeReload = false
2345				return m.beginSizeLoad(request.ForceSizes)
2346			}
2347			var accepted bool
2348			m, accepted = m.applyLocalResult(msg.result)
2349			next := waitForLocal(msg.load)
2350			if accepted && msg.result.View == ViewRepos {
2351				clone := m.finishRemoteCloneRefresh(msg.result.Generation, msg.result.Valid, msg.result.Err)
2352				fleet := m.afterReposResult(msg.result.Valid, msg.result.Err)
2353				return m, batchCommands(next, clone, fleet)
2354			}
2355			return m, next
2356	
2357		case reposMsg:
2358			accepted := m.applyViewResult(
2359				ViewRepos, msg.generation, msg.valid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2360				resultFreshness(msg.err), len(msg.rows), msg.err, msg.valid,
2361			)
2362			if !accepted {
2363				return m, nil
2364			}
2365			if msg.valid {
2366				m.acceptCompleteRepoSnapshot(msg.err)
2367				m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.rows...)
2368				m.matchRemoteLocals()
2369			}
2370			m.setAt(m.at())
2371			var sizeCmd tea.Cmd
2372			if msg.valid {
2373				m, sizeCmd = m.beginSizeLoad(false)
2374			}
2375			cloneCmd := m.finishRemoteCloneRefresh(msg.generation, msg.valid, msg.err)
2376			fleetCmd := m.afterReposResult(msg.valid, msg.err)
2377			return m, batchCommands(sizeCmd, cloneCmd, fleetCmd)
2378	
2379		case reloadMsg:
2380			acceptedLocal := false
2381			reposAccepted := false
2382			if msg.rowsSet && m.applyViewResult(
2383				ViewTasks, msg.rowsGeneration, msg.rowsValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2384				resultFreshness(msg.rowsErr), len(msg.rows), msg.rowsErr, msg.rowsValid,
2385			) {
2386				if msg.rowsValid {
2387					m.rows = append([]inventory.Row(nil), msg.rows...)
2388				}
2389				acceptedLocal = true
2390			}
2391			if msg.reposSet && m.applyViewResult(
2392				ViewRepos, msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2393				resultFreshness(msg.reposErr), len(msg.repos), msg.reposErr, msg.reposValid,
2394			) {
2395				if msg.reposValid {
2396					m.acceptCompleteRepoSnapshot(msg.reposErr)
2397					m.repos = append([]RepoRow(nil), msg.repos...)
2398					m.matchRemoteLocals()
2399				}
2400				acceptedLocal = true
2401				reposAccepted = true
2402			}
2403			if msg.triesSet && m.applyViewResult(
2404				ViewTries, msg.triesGeneration, msg.triesValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2405				resultFreshness(msg.triesErr), len(msg.tries), msg.triesErr, msg.triesValid,
2406			) {
2407				if msg.triesValid {
2408					m.tries = append([]TryRow(nil), msg.tries...)
2409					m.matchRemoteLocals()
2410				}
2411				acceptedLocal = true
2412			}
2413			if msg.remoteSet && m.applyViewResult(
2414				ViewRemote, msg.remoteGeneration, msg.remoteValid, perftrace.SourceLive,
2415				resultFreshness(msg.remoteErr), len(msg.remotes), msg.remoteErr, msg.remoteValid,
2416			) && msg.remoteValid {
2417				m.replaceRemotes(msg.remotes)
2418				m.matchRemoteLocals()
2419			}
2420			if acceptedLocal {
2421				m.forceSizeReload = false
2422			}
2423			m.setAt(m.at())
2424			m, sizeCmd := m.beginSizeLoad(msg.forceSizes)
2425			var cloneCmd, fleetCmd tea.Cmd
2426			if reposAccepted {
2427				cloneCmd = m.finishRemoteCloneRefresh(msg.reposGeneration, msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr)
2428				fleetCmd = m.afterReposResult(msg.reposValid, msg.reposErr)
2429			}
2430			return m, batchCommands(sizeCmd, cloneCmd, fleetCmd)
2431	
2432		case sizeMsg:
2433			if msg.loadID == 0 || msg.loadID != m.sizeLoad.ID {
2434				return m, nil
2435			}
2436			if msg.done {
2437				m.sizeLoad = diskusage.Load{}
2438				return m, nil
2439			}
2440			m.applySizeResult(msg.result)
2441			return m, waitForSize(m.sizeLoad)
2442

2446			}
2447			freshness := perftrace.FreshnessFresh

19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
20	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

39	func (m Model) listPreambleLines() int {
40		lines := 1 // the table header, or the one-line empty/loading state
41		switch m.view {
42		case ViewRemote:
43			if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.visibleRemotes()) > 0 {
44				lines++
45			}
46		case ViewSkills:
47			if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading && len(m.visibleSkills()) > 0 {
48				lines++
49			}
50		case ViewMCP:
51			if m.viewLoad(ViewMCP).loading && len(m.visibleMCP()) > 0 {
52				lines++
53			}
54		}
55		return lines
56	}

58	func lineCount(s string) int {
59		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
60		if s == "" {
61			return 0
62		}
63		return strings.Count(s, "\n") + 1
64	}

67	func (m Model) View() (output string) {
68		defer func() {
69			m.trace.MarkOnce(perftrace.TUIInitialViewReturned, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.View(m.view.String())})
70			m.signalFirstView()
71		}()
72		if m.quitting {
73			return ""
74		}
75		if m.noteMode() {
76			return m.renderNotes()
77		}
78		if m.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
79			return m.renderOverlay()
80		}
81		if m.mode == modeStats {
82			return m.renderStats()
83		}
84		var b strings.Builder
85		b.WriteString(m.renderHeader())
86		b.WriteString("\n")
87	
88		switch m.view {
89		case ViewRepos:
90			b.WriteString(m.renderRepos())
91		case ViewFleet:
92			b.WriteString(m.renderFleet())
93		case ViewTries:
94			b.WriteString(m.renderTries())
95		case ViewRemote:
96			b.WriteString(m.renderRemotes())
97		case ViewSkills:
98			b.WriteString(m.renderSkills())
99		case ViewMCP:
100			b.WriteString(m.renderMCP())
101		default:
102			b.WriteString(m.renderTasks())
103		}
104	
105		b.WriteString("\n")
106		b.WriteString(m.renderDetail())
107		b.WriteString("\n")
108		b.WriteString(m.renderFooter())
109		return b.String()
110	}

112	func (m Model) renderStats() string {
113		var b strings.Builder
114		title := "repo activity"
115		if m.stats != nil && m.stats.Repo != "" {
116			title = m.stats.Repo + " activity"
117		}
118		b.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  HEATMAP  "+title) + "\n\n")
119		if m.err != nil {
120			b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n")
121		} else if m.stats == nil {
122			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Loading activity…") + "\n")
123		} else if m.stats.Seconds == 0 {
124			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No activity recorded for this repository.\n"))
125			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Press b to backfill only this repo from Git history.\n"))
126		} else {
127			b.WriteString(m.stats.Heatmap)
128			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n  %s   %d active days   %s → %s\n",
129				styleOK.Render(humanSeconds(m.stats.Seconds)), m.stats.ActiveDays,
130				m.stats.Since.Format("2006-01-02"), m.stats.Until.Format("2006-01-02"))
131		}
132		b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("b backfill this repo · r reread stats · H / esc back · q quit"))
133		return b.String()

136	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
137		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
138		if d < time.Hour {
139			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
140		}
141		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
142	}

147	}

149	type headerLayout struct {
150		line string
151		tabs []tabHit
152	}
153	
154	// buildHeaderLayout renders the tab strip and records the exact cell spans it
155	// used, so mouse hit testing cannot drift from responsive labels or styles.
156	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
157		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
158			short := map[View]string{
159				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
160				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
161			}
162			var builder strings.Builder
163			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
164			builder.WriteString(prefix)
165			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
166			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
167			for index, view := range Views {
168				if index > 0 {
169					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
170					builder.WriteString(separator)
171					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
172				}
173				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
174				if compact {
175					name = short[view]
176				}
177				label := name
178				if !compact {
179					label = " " + name + " "
180				}
181				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
182				if view == m.view {
183					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
184				}
185				from := x
186				builder.WriteString(rendered)
187				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
188				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
189			}
190			if summary {
191				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
192			}
193			if m.filter != "" {
194				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
195			}
196			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
197		}
198	
199		layout := build(false, true)
200		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
201			layout = build(false, false)
202		}
203		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
204			layout = build(true, false)
205		}
206		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
207			return layout
208		}
209	
210		prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
211		name := strings.ToUpper(m.view.String())
212		line := prefix + styleSelected.Render(name)
213		layout = headerLayout{
214			line: line,
215			tabs: []tabHit{{view: m.view, from: lipgloss.Width(prefix), to: lipgloss.Width(line)}},
216		}
217		if m.filter != "" {
218			available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(layout.line) - 4
219			if available > 1 {
220				layout.line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
221			}
222		}
223		return layout
224	}

226	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
227	// is another one — is never in doubt.
228	func (m Model) renderHeader() string { return m.buildHeaderLayout().line + "\n" }

230	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
231	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
232	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
233		h := m.listHeight()
234		if n <= h {
235			return 0, n
236		}
237		from = m.at() - h/2
238		if from < 0 {
239			from = 0
240		}
241		if from+h > n {
242			from = n - h
243		}
244		return from, from + h
245	}

253		rows := m.visibleTasks()
254		if len(rows) == 0 {
255			return m.emptyTasks()
256		}
257		nameW, branchW, nextW := m.columnWidths()
258		showRepo := m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint
259	
260		headers := []string{
261			fitCell("TASK", nameW),
262			fitCell("STATE", 6),
263		}
264		if showRepo {
265			headers = append(headers, fitCell("REPO", taskRepoWidth))
266		}
267		headers = append(headers,
268			fitCell("BRANCH", branchW),
269			fitCell("GIT", 16),
270			fitCell("AGE", 5),
271			fitCell("NEXT", nextW),
272		)
273	
274		var b strings.Builder
275		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
276	
277		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
278		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
279			r := rows[i]
280			cells := []string{
281				fitCell(r.Task.Title(), nameW),
282				fitCell(r.Task.State.Label(), 6),
283			}
284			if showRepo {
285				cells = append(cells, fitCell(r.Task.Repo, taskRepoWidth))

287			cells = append(cells,
288				fitCell(r.Task.Branch, branchW),
289				fitCell(gitColumn(r), 16),
290				fitCell(shortAge(r), 5),
291				fitCell(nextColumn(r), nextW),
292			)
293			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
294			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, colourState(r.Task.State, line)))

297		return b.String()

301		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
302		if len(items) == 0 {
303			if m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading {
304				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
305			}
306			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
307				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
308		}
309		columns := m.repoColumns()
310	
311		var b strings.Builder
312		var headers []string
313		for _, c := range columns {
314			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
315		}
316		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
317	
318		from, to := m.window(len(items))
319		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
320			item := items[i]
321			r := item.Repo
322			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
323			for _, c := range columns {
324				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
325			}
326			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
327			styled := line
328			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
329				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
330					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
331				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
332					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
333					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
334				}
335			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
336				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
337			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
338				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
339			}
340			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
341		}
342		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
343		return b.String()
344	}

346	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
347		r := item.Repo
348		checkout, child := item.checkout()
349		if !child {
350			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
351				marker := "▸ "
352				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
353					marker = "▾ "
354				}
355				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
356			}
357			if name == "live" {
358				return parentLiveColumn(r)
359			}
360			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
361		}
362	
363		switch name {
364		case "repo":
365			connector := "├─ "
366			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
367				connector = "└─ "
368			}
369			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
370			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
371				label = checkout.Branch()
372			}
373			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
374				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
375			}
376			return connector + label
377		case "branch":
378			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
379				return branch
380			}
381			return "(detached)"
382		case "git":
383			switch {
384			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
385				return "prunable"
386			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
387				return "locked"
388			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
389				return "?"
390			default:
391				return checkout.Status.Summary()
392			}
393		case "live":
394			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
395		case "latest":
396			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
397		case "worktrees":
398			return "—"
399		case "tasks":
400			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
401				return "?"
402			}
403			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
404		case "notes":
405			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
406				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
407			}
408			return "—"
409		case "category":
410			return "—"
411		case "path":
412			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413		}
414		return ""
415	}

417	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
418		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
419			return "?"
420		}
421		sessions := r.Sessions()
422		if len(sessions) == 0 {
423			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
424		}
425		if len(sessions) > 1 {
426			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
427		}
428		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
429		if status != "" {
430			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
431		}
432		return r.Runtime
433	}
434	
435	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
436		if runtimeErr != nil {
437			return "?"
438		}
439		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
440			return "closed"
441		}
442		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
443			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
444		}
445		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
446			return runtimeName + ":" + status
447		}
448		return runtimeName
449	}

451	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
452		if len(tasks) == 0 {
453			return "—"
454		}
455		counts := map[task.State]int{}
456		for _, t := range tasks {
457			counts[t.State]++
458		}
459		var parts []string
460		for _, state := range task.States {
461			if counts[state] > 0 {
462				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
463			}
464		}
465		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
466	}

468	type repoColumnSpec struct {
469		name, header string
470		width, min   int
471	}
472	
473	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
474		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
475		if len(names) == 0 {
476			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
477		}
478		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
479			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
480			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
481			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
482			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
483			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
484			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
485			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
486			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
487			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
488			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
489			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
490			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
491		}
492		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
493		for _, name := range names {
494			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
495				columns = append(columns, c)
496			}
497		}
498		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
499		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
500		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
501		for _, c := range columns {
502			total += c.width
503		}
504		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
505			for i := range columns {
506				if columns[i].name != preferred {
507					continue
508				}
509				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
510				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
511				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
512				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
513					columns[i].width--
514					total--
515				}
516			}
517			if total <= m.width {
518				break
519			}
520		}
521		return columns
522	}
523	
524	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
525		switch name {
526		case "repo":
527			return r.Repo.Display()
528		case "branch":
529			if r.Repo.Bare {
530				return "(bare)"
531			}
532			return r.Status.Branch
533		case "git":
534			if r.Repo.Bare {
535				return "—"
536			}
537			return r.Status.Summary()
538		case "remote":
539			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
540				return "?"
541			}
542			return r.Topology.Summary()
543		case "size":
544			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
545		case "live":
546			if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
547				return "?"
548			}
549			if !r.Live {
550				return "—"
551			}
552			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
553				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
554			}
555			return r.Runtime
556		case "latest":
557			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
558		case "worktrees":
559			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
560				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
561			}
562			return "—"
563		case "tasks":
564			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
565				return "?"
566			}
567			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
568				return tasks
569			}
570			return "—"
571		case "notes":
572			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
573				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
574			}
575			return "—"
576		case "category":
577			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
578				return r.Repo.Category
579			}
580			return "—"
581		case "path":
582			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
583		}
584		return ""
585	}

587	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
588		if at.IsZero() {
589			return "—"
590		}
591		d := time.Since(at)
592		switch {
593		case d < time.Hour:
594			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
595		case d < 24*time.Hour:
596			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
597		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
598			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
599		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
600			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
601		default:
602			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
603		}
604	}

606	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
607		s = pad(s, width)
608		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
609			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
610		}
611		return s
612	}

614	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
615		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
616			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
617		}
618		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
619		if len(rows) == 0 {
620			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
621				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
622			}
623			if m.filter != "" {
624				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
625			}
626			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
627		}
628		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
629		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
630		if descW < 12 {
631			descW = 12
632		}
633	
634		var b strings.Builder
635		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
636			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
637		}
638		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
639			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
640		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
641		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
642			r := rows[i]
643			pending := m.remoteCloneTargets(r)
644			local := "—"
645			if pending {
646				local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " repo"
647				if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRunning {
648					local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " clone"
649				}
650			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
651				local = "inspect"
652			} else if r.Cloned() {
653				local = "yes"
654				if r.LocalKind != "" {
655					local = string(r.LocalKind)
656					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
657						local = "repo"
658					}
659				}
660			}
661			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
662			if vis == "" {
663				vis = "—"
664			}
665			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
666				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
667				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
668			styled := line
669			if r.Cloned() || pending {
670				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
671			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
672				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
673			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
674				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
675			}
676			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
677		}
678		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
679		return b.String()
680	}

682	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
683		rows := m.visibleFleet()
684		if len(rows) == 0 {
685			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
686				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
687			}
688			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
689				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
690			}
691			if !m.showLocalFleet {
692				for _, row := range m.fleet {
693					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
694						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
695					}
696				}
697			}
698			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
699		}
700		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
701		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
702		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
703		if pathW < 12 {
704			pathW = 12
705		}
706		var b strings.Builder
707		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
708			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
709		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
710		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
711			row := rows[i]
712			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
713			if row.Repository != nil {
714				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
715				if row.Repository.Live {
716					live = row.Repository.Runtime
717					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
718						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
719					}
720				}
721				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
722			}
723			state := string(row.State)
724			if row.FromCache {
725				state = "stale"
726			}
727			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
728				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
729				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
730			styled := line
731			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
732				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
733			} else if row.State != "ok" {
734				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
735			}
736			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
737		}
738		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
739		return b.String()
740	}

770			skillW, agentW := flex/2, flex-flex/2
771			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW)}
772			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {

784		var b strings.Builder

793		from, to := m.window(len(rows))

795			row := rows[i]

913	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
914		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
915		for _, policy := range row.Policies {
916			part := string(policy.Kind)
917			if policy.Value != "" {
918				part += ":" + policy.Value
919			}
920			if policy.Count > 0 {
921				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
922			}
923			parts = append(parts, part)
924		}
925		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
926	}
927	
928	func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration, maxWidth int) string {
929		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
930		for index, credential := range row.Credentials {
931			part := string(credential.Kind)
932			if credential.Name != "" {
933				part += ":" + credential.Name
934			}
935			candidate := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), parts...), part), ", ")
936			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > maxWidth {
937				remaining := len(row.Credentials) - index
938				if len(parts) == 0 {
939					if remaining == 1 {
940						return pad(part, maxWidth)
941					}
942					return pad(fmt.Sprintf("%s, +%d", part, remaining-1), maxWidth)
943				}
944				return pad(strings.Join(parts, ", ")+fmt.Sprintf(", +%d", remaining), maxWidth)
945			}
946			parts = append(parts, part)
947		}
948		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
949	}

951	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
952		var parts []string
953		for _, item := range []struct {
954			label string
955			n     int
956		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
957			if item.n > 0 {
958				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
959			}
960		}
961		if len(parts) == 0 {
962			return "—"
963		}
964		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
965	}

999	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
1000		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
1001			return "—"
1002		}
1003		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
1004		switch {
1005		case d < 24*time.Hour:
1006			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
1007		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
1008			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
1009		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
1010			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1011		default:
1012			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1013		}
1014	}

1043	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
1044		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
1045		if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
1046			fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
1047		}
1048		avail := m.width - fixed
1049		if avail < 40 {
1050			avail = 40
1051		}
1052		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1053		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1054		next = avail - name - branch
1055		if next < 10 {
1056			next = 10
1057		}
1058		return name, branch, next
1059	}

1061	// renderDetail shows what does not fit in the table — the reason to have a
1062	// dashboard rather than a listing.
1063	func (m Model) renderDetail() string {
1064		switch m.mode {
1065		case modeFilter:
1066			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("filter ") + m.input.View() +
1067				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to keep it · esc to clear")
1068		case modeEditNext:
1069			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("next action ") + m.input.View() +
1070				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to save · esc to cancel")
1071		case modeConfirmPark:
1072			row, _ := m.currentTask()
1073			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("park "+row.Task.Title()) +
1074				"\n  next: " + m.input.View() +
1075				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to park (session closes, worktree stays) · esc to cancel")
1076		case modeStartTask:
1077			r, _ := m.currentRepo()
1078			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("start work in "+r.Repo.Name) +
1079				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
1080				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to create the branch, worktree and session · esc to cancel")
1081		case modeStartDirect:
1082			r, _ := m.currentRepo()
1083			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("track direct work in "+r.Repo.Name) +
1084				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
1085				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to track the current branch; no branch/worktree is created · esc to cancel")
1086		case modeConfirmClone:
1087			r := m.remoteClonePrompt
1088			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("clone "+r.Repo.FullName) +
1089				"\n  to: " + contract(filepath.Join("<project_root>", r.Repo.Name)) +
1090				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter clone and stay · o clone and open · esc cancel")
1091		case modeConfirmSkillUpdate:
1092			row := m.skillUpdateTarget
1093			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("update "+string(row.Scope)+" skill "+row.Name) +
1094				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to update this skill · esc to cancel")
1095		case modeCopy:
1096			options := "y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths"
1097			if m.view == ViewSkills {
1098				options = "p skill file path · s safe summary · u source URL · f raw file"
1099			} else if m.view == ViewMCP {
1100				options = "p config path · s safe summary · f raw file"
1101			}
1102			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("copy ") + options +
1103				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("press a second key · esc to cancel")
1104		}
1105	
1106		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
1107			lines := []string{
1108				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("host"), row.Host),
1109				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("state"), row.State),
1110			}
1111			if row.Repository != nil {
1112				lines = append(lines,
1113					fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("path"), contract(row.Repository.Path)),
1114					fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("branch"), row.Repository.Branch),
1115					fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("git  "), row.Repository.Status.Breakdown()),
1116				)
1117				if len(row.Repository.RemoteIdentities) > 0 {
1118					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("remote"), strings.Join(row.Repository.RemoteIdentities, ", ")))
1119				}
1120				if row.Repository.Live {
1121					live := strings.TrimSpace(row.Repository.Runtime + " " + row.Repository.RuntimeHandle)
1122					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
1123						live += " · " + row.Repository.AgentStatus
1124					}
1125					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("live"), styleLive.Render(live)))
1126				}
1127			}
1128			if row.Error != "" {
1129				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("note "), styleDrift.Render(row.Error)))
1130			}
1131			return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
1132		}
1133		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
1134			lines := []string{
1135				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("repo"), dashCell(row.Repository)),
1136				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("scope "), row.Scope),
1137				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("agent "), row.Agent),
1138				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("config"), contract(row.ConfigPath)),

1471	func (m Model) renderFooter() string {
1472		viewErr, viewStatus := m.viewError(m.view), m.viewStatus(m.view)
1473		var status string
1474		switch {
1475		case m.err != nil:
1476			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + m.err.Error())
1477		case m.remoteClone.active():
1478			status = styleLive.Render(m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " " + m.remoteCloneStatus())
1479		case viewErr != nil:
1480			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + viewErr.Error())
1481		case m.status != "":
1482			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + m.status)
1483		case viewStatus != "":
1484			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + viewStatus)
1485		}
1486	
1487		var bindings []string
1488		if m.remoteClone.active() {
1489			bindings = []string{"q cancel clone", "tab view", "/ filter", "j/k move"}
1490			var b strings.Builder
1491			if status != "" {
1492				b.WriteString("  " + status + "\n")
1493			}
1494			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render(wrapBindings(bindings, m.width-4)))
1495			return b.String()
1496		}
1497		switch m.view {
1498		case ViewRepos:
1499			sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1500			if sortBy == "" {
1501				sortBy = "activity"
1502			}
1503			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1504				sortBy += "↑"
1505			}
1506			if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
1507				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open worktree", "space collapse")
1508			} else {
1509				bindings = append(bindings, "enter ad hoc", "space worktrees", "m metadata", "n add note", "N notes", "s worktree task", "d direct task")
1510			}
1511			bindings = append(bindings, "O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1512		case ViewFleet:
1513			if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil {
1514				bindings = append(bindings, "enter remote open")
1515			}
1516			local := "hidden"
1517			if m.showLocalFleet {
1518				local = "shown"
1519			}
1520			bindings = append(bindings, "a local:"+local, "r refresh")
1521		case ViewTries:
1522			sortBy := m.trySort
1523			if sortBy == "" {
1524				sortBy = "activity"
1525			}
1526			if m.tryReverse {
1527				sortBy += "↑"
1528			}
1529			bindings = append(bindings, "enter open", "n new", "space actions", "a history",
1530				"O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1531		case ViewRemote:
1532			if m.remoteClone.active() {
1533				bindings = append(bindings, "q cancel clone")
1534			} else if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
1535				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open local", "n add note", "N notes")
1536			} else if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
1537				bindings = append(bindings, "inspect local destination")
1538			} else {
1539				bindings = append(bindings, "c clone")
1540			}
1541		case ViewSkills:
1542			bindings = append(bindings, "a add", "c check", "u update selected", "A scope:"+m.capabilityScope.String())
1543		case ViewMCP:
1544			bindings = append(bindings, "A scope:"+m.capabilityScope.String(), "r reload declarations")
1545		default:
1546			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1547				if command := taskRecoveryCommand(row); command != "" {
1548					bindings = append(bindings, "recovery "+command)
1549				} else {
1550					bindings = append(bindings, "enter open")
1551				}
1552			}
1553			bindings = append(bindings, "n add note", "N notes", "p park", "c next")
1554		}
1555		if m.view == ViewRepos || m.view == ViewSkills || m.view == ViewMCP {
1556			bindings = append(bindings, "y copy")
1557		}
1558		bindings = append(bindings, "tab view", "/ filter", "? help")
1559		if m.view != ViewSkills && m.view != ViewMCP {
1560			bindings = append(bindings, "H stats")
1561		}
1562		// `e` edits whichever configuration the current view is about.
1563		switch m.view {
1564		case ViewFleet:
1565			bindings = append(bindings, "e hosts")
1566		case ViewSkills, ViewMCP:
1567			bindings = append(bindings, "e file")
1568		default:
1569			bindings = append(bindings, "e config")
1570		}
1571		if m.view != ViewSkills && m.view != ViewMCP {
1572			for _, t := range m.Tools() {
1573				bindings = append(bindings, t.Key+" "+t.Name)
1574			}
1575		}

1577			bindings = append(bindings, "1/2/3 state")

1579		bindings = append(bindings, "0 clear", "r reload", "q quit")

1582		if status != "" {

1589	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1590	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1591	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1592		if width < 20 {
1593			width = 20
1594		}
1595		var lines []string
1596		cur := ""
1597		for _, it := range items {
1598			candidate := it
1599			if cur != "" {
1600				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1601			}
1602			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1603				lines = append(lines, cur)
1604				cur = it
1605				continue
1606			}
1607			cur = candidate
1608		}
1609		if cur != "" {
1610			lines = append(lines, cur)
1611		}
1612		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1613	}

1662	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1663	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1664	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1665		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1666			return s
1667		}
1668		var b strings.Builder
1669		used := 0
1670		for _, r := range s {
1671			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1672			if used+w > n-1 {
1673				break
1674			}
1675			b.WriteRune(r)
1676			used += w
1677		}
1678		return b.String() + "…"
1679	}

1681	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
1682		if v < lo {
1683			return lo
1684		}
1685		if v > hi {
1686			return hi
1687		}
1688		return v
1689	}

205	func cloneRemoteFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, row tui.RemoteRow) (string, error) {
206		destination, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app, row.Repo.Name)
207		if err != nil {
208			return "", err
209		}
210		discoverable, err := repositoryPathDiscoverable(app.Cfg, destination)
211		if err != nil {
212			return "", fmt.Errorf("verify REMOTE clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
213		}
214		if !discoverable {
215			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is outside paths.scan_roots/repo_paths; add paths.project_root to scan_roots before cloning from REMOTE",
216				config.Contract(destination))
217		}
218		if _, err := os.Lstat(destination); err == nil {
219			return destination, fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots/repo_paths or move it before cloning", config.Contract(destination))
220		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
221			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
222		}
223		acquired, err := repo.Acquire(ctx, repo.AcquireRequest{
224			Kind: repo.AcquireClone, Name: row.Repo.Name,
225			CloneRef: row.Repo.CloneURL, Destination: destination,
226		})
227		if err != nil {
228			if _, statErr := os.Lstat(destination); statErr == nil {
229				return destination, fmt.Errorf("%w; inspect the destination now present at %s before retrying", err, config.Contract(destination))
230			}
231			return "", err
232		}
233		return acquired.Path, nil
234	}

643			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
644				active := appState.Current()
645				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
646				if err != nil {
647					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
648				}
649				defer store.Close()
650				until := time.Now()
651				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
652				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
653					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
654				})
655				if err != nil {
656					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
657				}
658				seconds, days := 0, 0
659				for _, value := range totals {
660					seconds += value
661					if value > 0 {
662						days++
663					}
664				}
665				return tui.StatsPanel{
666					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
667					Since: since, Until: until,
668					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
669						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
670					}),
671				}, nil
672			},

675				active := appState.Current()

678					return err
679				}
680				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
681				if err != nil {
682					return err
683				}
684				defer store.Close()
685				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
686				return err
687			},

706			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
707				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
708				if err != nil {
709					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
710				}
711				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
712				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
713				if err != nil {
714					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
715				}
716				status := "config + data reloaded"
717				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
718					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
719				}
720				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
721					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
722					Tools:       externalTools(next),
723					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
724					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
725					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
726				}, status, nil
727			},
728		}
729	
730		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
731		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
732		// while dozens of repos are probed.
733		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
734		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
735		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
736		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen(), tea.WithMouseCellMotion()).Run()
737		cancelRun()
738		app.finishTrace()
739		if err != nil {
740			return err
741		}
742		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
743		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
744		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
745			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
746				return app.cdDirective(dir)
747			}
748			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
749				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
750				if resolveErr != nil {
751					return resolveErr
752				}
753				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
754			}
755		}
756		return nil
757	}

767	// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe either what an agent
768	// launched from the startup context would see or every accepted repository.
769	// Global sources are still scanned once by the domain collectors.
770	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {
771		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
772		for _, row := range locals {
773			if !row.IsTry() {
774				repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
775			}
776		}
777		targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
778		if scope == tui.CapabilityAllRepositories {
779			return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
780		}
781		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" && current.CommonDir != "" &&
782			!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
783			return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
784		}
785		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
786	}

790		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
