759	func readTUICapabilityFile(ctx context.Context, path string) (string, error) {
760		body, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, config.Expand(path), tuiCapabilityFileMaxBytes)
761		if err != nil {
762			return "", err
763		}
764		return string(body), nil
765	}
766	
767	// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe either what an agent
768	// launched from the startup context would see or every accepted repository.
769	// Global sources are still scanned once by the domain collectors.
770	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {
771		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
772		for _, row := range locals {
773			if !row.IsTry() {
774				repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
775			}
776		}
777		targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
778		if scope == tui.CapabilityAllRepositories {
779			return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
780		}
781		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" && current.CommonDir != "" &&
782			!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
783			return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
784		}
785		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
786	}
787	
788	func collectTries(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
789		options := experiment.ListOptions{All: includeAll}
790		return collectTriesWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, options, nil, false)
791	}
792	
793	func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
794		sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
795		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
796		if err != nil {
797			return nil, err
798		}
799		items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
800		warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
801		if !sessionsSet {
802			sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
803		}
804		rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
805		for _, item := range items {
806			row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
807			if item.Entry != nil {
808				if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
809					copy := location
810					row.Location = &copy
811				}
812			}
813			sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
814			if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
815				if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
816					sizeRepo = &discovered
817				}
818			}
819			if sizeRepo != nil {
820				worktreeCount := 0
821				if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
822					worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
823				}
824				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
825			} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
826				row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
827			}
828			if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
829				row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
830			}
831			if item.Live.Present {
832				for _, session := range sessions {
833					if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
834						(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
835						row.Live = true
836						row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
837						break
838					}
839				}
840			}
841			rows = append(rows, row)
842		}
843		return rows, listErr
844	}
845	
846	func applyTryAction(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
847		service, err := newExperimentService(app)
848		if err != nil {
849			return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
850		}
851		resolve := func() (experiment.Item, error) {
852			item, diagnostics, resolveErr := service.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.ID, experiment.ResolveOptions{
853				IncludeDeprecated: true, IncludeArchived: true,
854				IncludeEvicted: true, IncludeGraduated: true,
855			})
856			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
857			return item, resolveErr
858		}
859		open := func(item experiment.Item, status string) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
860			if !item.Live.Present || item.Live.CurrentPath == "" {
861				return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("Try %s is not present on this host", item.DisplayName())
862			}
863			handle, openErr := openCheckout(ctx, rt, item.Live.CurrentPath, item.DisplayName())
864			if openErr != nil {
865				return tui.TryActionResult{}, openErr
866			}
867			result := tui.TryActionResult{Status: status, RefreshRepos: true}
868			if rt.Name() == "none" {
869				result.CD = item.Live.CurrentPath
870			} else {
871				result.Status += fmt.Sprintf(" in %s (%s)", rt.Name(), handle.Handle)
872				result.RuntimeHandle = handle.Handle
873			}
874			if _, touchErr := service.Touch(ctx, item.ID); touchErr != nil {
875				return result, fmt.Errorf("%s, but could not record activity: %w", status, touchErr)
876			}
877			return result, nil
878		}
879	
880		switch request.Action {
881		case tui.TryOpen:
882			item, resolveErr := resolve()
883			if resolveErr != nil {
884				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
885			}
886			return open(item, "opened "+item.DisplayName())
887	
888		case tui.TryCreate:
889			created, createErr := service.ResolveOrCreate(ctx, experiment.CreateRequest{
890				Name: request.Name, Clone: request.Clone, NoGit: request.NoGit,
891			})
892			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, created.Diagnostics)
893			if created.InitWarning != nil {
894				app.warnf("could not git init: %v", created.InitWarning)
895			}
896			if createErr != nil {
897				return tui.TryActionResult{}, createErr
898			}
899			status := "created " + created.Item.DisplayName()
900			if created.Existing {
901				status = "opened existing " + created.Item.DisplayName()
902			}
903			result, openErr := open(created.Item, status)
904			result.RefreshRepos = true
905			return result, openErr
906	
907		case tui.TryMark:
908			item, resolveErr := resolve()
909			if resolveErr != nil {
910				return tui.TryActionResult{}, resolveErr
911			}
912			desired := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.Tags)
913			remove := append([]string(nil), item.Tags...)
914			note := request.Note
915			updated, diagnostics, patchErr := service.Patch(ctx, experiment.PatchRequest{
916				Ref: item.ID, AddTags: desired, RemoveTags: remove, Note: &note,
917			})
918			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
919			return tui.TryActionResult{
920				Status: "updated metadata for " + updated.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
921			}, patchErr
922	
923		case tui.TryDeprecate:
924			transition, transitionErr := service.Deprecate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
925			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
926			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "deprecated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
927	
928		case tui.TryReactivate:
929			transition, transitionErr := service.Reactivate(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
930			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
931			return tui.TryActionResult{Status: "reactivated " + transition.Item.DisplayName()}, transitionErr
932	
933		case tui.TryArchive:
934			transition, transitionErr := service.Archive(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID})
935			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
936			return tui.TryActionResult{
937				Status: "archived " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
938			}, transitionErr
939	
940		case tui.TryRestore:
941			transition, transitionErr := service.Restore(ctx, experiment.TransitionRequest{Ref: request.ID, To: request.To})
942			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, transition.Diagnostics)
943			return tui.TryActionResult{
944				Status: "restored " + transition.Item.DisplayName(), RefreshRepos: true,
945			}, transitionErr
946	
947		case tui.TryGraduate:
948			graduated, graduateErr := service.Graduate(ctx, experiment.GraduateRequest{
949				Ref: request.ID, Category: request.Category, Name: request.Name,
950			})
951			warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, graduated.Diagnostics)
952			if graduateErr != nil {
953				return tui.TryActionResult{}, graduateErr
954			}
955			result, openErr := open(graduated.Item, "graduated "+graduated.Plan.Name)
956			result.RefreshRepos = true
957			return result, openErr
958		}
959		return tui.TryActionResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown Try action %q", request.Action)
960	}
961	
962	// repoCollectOptions leaves an opt-in path for the future TRY view while the
963	// ordinary repository inventory suppresses active and deprecated Tries.
964	type repoCollectOptions struct {
965		IncludeTries bool
966		Sessions     []runtime.Session
967		SessionsErr  error
968		SessionsSet  bool
969		Tasks        []*task.Task
970		TasksSet     bool
971		Repos        []repo.Repo
972		ReposSet     bool
973		Limiter      *inventory.Limiter
974	}
975	
976	// collectRepos builds the default repository view: what exists, plus how much
977	// of it is in flight, excluding cataloged active/deprecated Tries.
978	func collectRepos(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
979		return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
980	}
981	
982	func collectReposWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options repoCollectOptions) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
983		repos := options.Repos
984		var err error
985		if !options.ReposSet {
986			repos, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
987			if err != nil {
988				return nil, err
989			}
990		}
991		assets, catalogComplete, err := joinRepoAssets(app, repos)
992		if err != nil {
993			return nil, err
994		}
995		if !options.IncludeTries {
996			visibleRepos := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(repos))
997			visibleAssets := make([]*catalog.Entry, 0, len(repos))
998			for index, repository := range repos {
999				if suppressTryRepo(assets[index], catalogComplete) {
1000					continue
1001				}
1002				visibleRepos = append(visibleRepos, repository)
1003				visibleAssets = append(visibleAssets, assets[index])
1004			}
1005			repos, assets = visibleRepos, visibleAssets
1006		}
1007		tasks := options.Tasks
1008		var taskDiagnostics []task.Diagnostic
1009		if !options.TasksSet {
1010			tasks, taskDiagnostics, err = app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
1011			if err != nil {
1012				return nil, err
1013			}
1014		}
1015		var taskInventoryErr error
1016		for _, diagnostic := range taskDiagnostics {
1017			taskInventoryErr = errors.Join(taskInventoryErr, diagnostic)
1018		}
1019		byRepo := map[string][]*task.Task{}
1020		for _, tracked := range tasks {
1021			byRepo[tracked.RepoPath] = append(byRepo[tracked.RepoPath], tracked)
1022		}
1023		sessions := options.Sessions
1024		runtimeErr := options.SessionsErr
1025		if !options.SessionsSet {
1026			sessions, runtimeErr = rt.List(ctx)
1027		}
1028		notesByRepo := map[string][]*note.Note{}
1029		if app.Notes != nil {
1030			allNotes, noteErr := app.Notes.List("")
1031			if noteErr != nil {
1032				return nil, noteErr
1033			}
1034			for _, n := range allNotes {
1035				notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID] = append(notesByRepo[n.RepositoryID], n)
1036			}
1037		}
1038	
1039		out := make([]tui.RepoRow, len(repos))
1040		// Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising
1041		// ~3*56 git processes was the measured 4.2s startup bottleneck; eight
1042		// workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once. TUI callers
1043		// share the limiter with task enrichment.
1044		limiter := options.Limiter
1045		if limiter == nil {
1046			limiter = inventory.NewLimiter(8)
1047		}
1048		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1049		for i, r := range repos {
1050			wg.Add(1)
1051			go func(i int, r repo.Repo) {
1052				defer wg.Done()
1053				release, ok := limiter.Acquire(ctx)
1054				if !ok {
1055					return
1056				}
1057				defer release()
1058	
1059				row := tui.RepoRow{Repo: r, Asset: assets[i]}
1060				if row.Asset != nil {
1061					repoNotes := notesByRepo[row.Asset.ID]
1062					row.NoteCount = len(repoNotes)
1063					if len(repoNotes) > 0 {
1064						row.LatestNote = repoNotes[0]
1065					}
1066				}
1067				if r.HasGit {
1068					row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, r.Path)
1069				}
1070				row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.Path]...)
1071				if r.RealPath != "" && r.RealPath != r.Path {
1072					row.Tasks = append(row.Tasks, byRepo[r.RealPath]...)
1073				}
1074				row.Context = inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, r, row.Tasks, sessions, rt.Name())
1075				row.Context.TaskErr = taskInventoryErr
1076				row.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
1077				row.LastActivity = row.Context.LastActivity
1078				row.Worktrees = row.Context.WorktreeCount
1079				if main, ok := row.Context.Main(); ok {
1080					row.Status = main.Status
1081				}
1082				if !r.Bare {
1083					row.RemoteForge, row.RemoteName = forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1084				}
1085				if live := row.Context.Sessions(); len(live) > 0 {
1086					row.Live, row.Runtime = true, rt.Name()
1087					row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = live[0].Handle, live[0].AgentStatus
1088				}
1089				if r.HasGit {
1090					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(gitx.Repo{
1091						Root: r.Path, GitDir: r.GitDir, GitCommonDir: r.CommonDir,
1092						MainRoot: r.MainRoot, Name: r.Name, Bare: r.Bare,
1093					}, row.Worktrees)
1094				} else {
1095					row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(r.Path)
1096				}
1097				out[i] = row
1098			}(i, r)
1099		}
1100		wg.Wait()
1101		return out, ctx.Err()
1102	}
1103	
1104	// externalTools resolves the configured tool bindings.
1105	//
1106	// Configurable rather than fixed because which program you reach for is
1107	// personal, and because the useful ones are often your own scripts and
1108	// aliases, not just the well-known tools.
1109	func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool {
1110		var out []tui.Tool
1111		for _, t := range app.Cfg.EffectiveTools() {
1112			run := t.Run
1113			name := t.Name
1114			if name == "" {
1115				name = firstWord(run)
1116			}
1117			command := []string{shellPath(), "-c", run}
1118			if t.Interactive {
1119				// The command string passed to shell -lic is parsed before some
1120				// shells finish loading aliases. Parse only eval "$1" up front,
1121				// then evaluate the configured command after rc loading, so both
1122				// aliases (vibe) and functions (claude-plans-here) work.
1123				command = []string{shellPath(), "-lic", `eval "$1"`, "dev-tui-tool", run}
1124			}
1125			out = append(out, tui.Tool{
1126				Key: t.Key, Name: name, Command: command,
1127				Probe: commandRunnable(run, t.Interactive),
1128			})
1129		}
1130		return out
1131	}
1132	
1133	// commandRunnable resolves the command's first word on PATH, expanding a
1134	// leading environment variable so "$EDITOR ." checks the editor itself. The
1135	// returned probe is run by a bounded Bubble Tea command, never by View.
1136	func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool {
1137		return func(ctx context.Context) bool { return checkCommandRunnable(ctx, run, interactive) }
1138	}
1139	
1140	func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool {
1141		if ctx == nil {
1142			ctx = context.Background()
1143		}
1144		word := firstWord(run)
1145		if strings.HasPrefix(word, "$") {
1146			word = os.Getenv(strings.TrimPrefix(word, "$"))
1147			if word == "" {
1148				return false
1149			}
1150			word = firstWord(word)
1151		}
1152		if word == "" {
1153			return false
1154		}
1155		if interactive {
1156			// Ask the configured shell after it loads its rc files; LookPath
1157			// cannot see aliases or functions.
1158			probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
1159			defer cancel()
1160			probe := exec.CommandContext(probeCtx, shellPath(), "-lic",
1161				`command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1`, "dev-tool-probe", word)
1162			return probe.Run() == nil
1163		}
1164		if filepath.IsAbs(word) {
1165			_, err := os.Stat(word)
1166			return err == nil
1167		}
1168		_, err := exec.LookPath(word)
1169		return err == nil
1170	}
1171	
1172	func firstWord(s string) string {
1173		f := strings.Fields(s)
1174		if len(f) == 0 {
1175			return ""
1176		}
1177		return f[0]
1178	}
1179	
1180	func shellPath() string {
1181		if s := os.Getenv("SHELL"); s != "" {
1182			return s
1183		}
1184		return "/bin/sh"
1185	}
1186	
1187	// remoteCachePath is private because the inventory can contain names and URLs
1188	// of private repositories.
1189	func remoteCachePath() string {
1190		return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "remotes.json")
1191	}
1192	
1193	func remoteCacheSourceID(app *App) string {
1194		parts := []string{
1195			"forge-source-v1",
1196			"GH_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GH_HOST"),
1197			"GITLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST"),
1198			"GLAB_HOST=" + os.Getenv("GLAB_HOST"),
1199		}
1200		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1201			parts = append(parts, "azure="+target.Organization+"\x00"+target.Project)
1202		}
1203		sort.Strings(parts)
1204		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
1205		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:])
1206	}
1207	
1208	// cachedRemoteRows reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or
1209	// subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path. Local clone markers are
1210	// filled when the background local inventory arrives.
1211	func cachedRemoteRows(app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool, bool) {
1212		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1213		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1214		if !ok || cache.SourceID != sourceID {
1215			return nil, false, false
1216		}
1217		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(cache.Repos))
1218		for _, rr := range cache.Repos {
1219			out = append(out, tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr})
1220		}
1221		return out, true, !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID)
1222	}
1223	
1224	// cachedRemotesForRepoRows uses the local repo data the dashboard already
1225	// collected, avoiding another process-spawning scan on startup.
1226	func cachedRemotesForRepoRows(app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1227		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1228		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1229			return nil, false
1230		}
1231		return matchRemoteRepoRows(cache.Repos, locals), true
1232	}
1233	
1234	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1235		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1236		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1237		for _, r := range locals {
1238			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1239				continue
1240			}
1241			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1242			if ambiguous[key] {
1243				continue
1244			}
1245			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1246				delete(byRemote, key)
1247				ambiguous[key] = true
1248				continue
1249			}
1250			byRemote[key] = r
1251		}
1252		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1253		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1254			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1255			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1256				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1257				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1258				if local.Asset != nil {
1259					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1260				}
1261			}
1262			out = append(out, row)
1263		}
1264		return out
1265	}
1266	
1267	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1268	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1269	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1270	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1271		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1272		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1273			return nil, false
1274		}
1275		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1276	}
1277	
1278	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1279		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1280		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1281			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1282		}
1283		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1284	}
1285	
1286	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1287	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1288	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1289	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1290		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1291		LocalsSet    bool
1292		Providers    []forge.Forge
1293		ProvidersSet bool
1294	}
1295	
1296	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1297		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1298	}
1299	
1300	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1301		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1302	}
1303	
1304	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1305		type result struct {
1306			kind  forge.Kind
1307			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1308			err   error
1309		}
1310		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1311		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1312			if options.LocalsSet {
1313				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1314			}
1315			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1316		}
1317		providers := options.Providers
1318		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1319			providers = configuredForges(app)
1320		}
1321		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1322		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1323		available := 0
1324		var unavailable []error
1325		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1326		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1327		for _, f := range providers {
1328			if !f.Available() {
1329				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1330				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1331				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1332					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1333					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1334					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())

1337			}

1347		wg.Wait()
1348		close(ch)

1351				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)

1353					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1354				}
1355				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1356			}
1357			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1358				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1359			}
1360			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1361		}
1362	
1363		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1364		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1365			old = forge.Cache{}
1366		}
1367		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1368		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1369		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1370			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1371		}
1372		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1373			statuses[kind] = status
1374		}
1375		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1376		successful := 0
1377		now := time.Now().UTC()
1378		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1379			status := statuses[kind]
1380			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1381			statuses[kind] = status
1382		}
1383		for res := range ch {
1384			if res.err != nil {
1385				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1386				status := statuses[res.kind]
1387				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1388				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1389					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1390					status.FetchedAt = now
1391					status.Complete = false
1392				}
1393				statuses[res.kind] = status
1394				continue
1395			}
1396			successful++
1397			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1398			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1399		}
1400		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1401		complete := true
1402		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1403		for kind := range expected {
1404			status, ok := statuses[kind]

1406				complete = false
1407			}
1408			if ok {
1409				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1410			}
1411			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1412		}
1413		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1414		if successful > 0 {
1415			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1416				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1417				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1418			})
1419		}
1420		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1421	}

1423	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1424		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {
1425			if !repos[i].UpdatedAt.Equal(repos[j].UpdatedAt) {
1426				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1427			}
1428			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1429		})
1430	}
1431	
1432	func configuredForges(app *App) []forge.Forge {
1433		providers := forge.All()
1434		if app == nil || len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps) == 0 {
1435			return providers
1436		}
1437		targets := make([]forge.AzureDevOpsTarget, 0, len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps))
1438		for _, target := range app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps {
1439			targets = append(targets, forge.AzureDevOpsTarget{
1440				Organization: target.Organization,
1441				Project:      target.Project,
1442			})
1443		}
1444		return forge.All(forge.NewAzureDevOps(targets))
1445	}
1446	
1447	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1448		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1449		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1450		if assetErr != nil {
1451			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1452			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1453		}
1454		type localMatch struct {
1455			repository repo.Repo
1456			asset      *catalog.Entry
1457		}
1458		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1459		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1460		for index, r := range locals {
1461			if r.Bare {
1462				continue
1463			}
1464			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1465			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1466				continue
1467			}
1468			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1469			if ambiguous[key] {
1470				continue
1471			}
1472			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1473				delete(localByRemote, key)
1474				ambiguous[key] = true
1475				continue
1476			}
1477			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1478		}
1479		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1480		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1481			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1482			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1483				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1484				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1485				if local.asset != nil {
1486					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1487				}
1488			}
1489			out = append(out, row)
1490		}
1491		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1492		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1493		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)
1494		return out
1495	}
1496	
1497	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1498		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1499			return
1500		}
1501		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1502		if err != nil {
1503			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1504			return
1505		}
1506		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1507			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1508		}
1509		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1510			return
1511		}
1512		host := config.Hostname()
1513		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1514		for _, entry := range entries {
1515			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1516			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1517				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1518				continue
1519			}
1520			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1521		}
1522		for index := range rows {
1523			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1524			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1525			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1526				continue
1527			}
1528			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1529			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1530			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1531			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1532		}
1533	}
1534	
1535	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1536		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1537			if candidate == "" {
1538				continue
1539			}
1540			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1541				return candidate
1542			}
1543		}
1544		return ""
1545	}
1546	
1547	func prepareTUINoteEdit(app *App, n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
1548		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
1549		if err != nil {
1550			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1551		}
1552		path := tmp.Name()
1553		if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, n.Body); err != nil {
1554			_ = tmp.Close()
1555			_ = os.Remove(path)
1556			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1557		}
1558		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
1559			_ = os.Remove(path)
1560			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1561		}
1562		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
1563		if err != nil {
1564			_ = os.Remove(path)
1565			return tui.NoteEdit{}, err
1566		}
1567		return tui.NoteEdit{
1568			Command: proc,
1569			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
1570				if runErr != nil {
1571					_ = os.Remove(path)
1572					return runErr
1573				}
1574				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
1575				if err != nil {
1576					return fmt.Errorf("read edited body (preserved at %s): %w", path, err)
1577				}
1578				if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
1579					_ = os.Remove(path)
1580					return fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
1581				}
1582				_, err = app.Notes.Update(context.Background(), n.ID, n.Revision(), string(body), n.Tags)
1583				if err != nil {
1584					return fmt.Errorf("save edited note: %w; edited body preserved at %s", err, path)
1585				}
1586				_ = os.Remove(path)
1587				return nil
1588			},
1589		}, nil
1590	}

26	func newConfigEditorCommand(app *App, use, short string) *cobra.Command {
27		var editor string

29		cmd := &cobra.Command{
30			Use:   use,
31			Short: short,
32			Long: `Open the config file used by this invocation.
33	
34	If it does not exist, first generate the same machine-detected, fully commented
35	template as "dev config init". Editor resolution is explicit:
36	
37	    --editor → $VISUAL → $EDITOR → nvim → vim → vi
38	
39	An editor value may contain arguments (for example "code --wait"); it is
40	executed through the user's shell with the config path safely quoted.`,
41			Args: cobra.NoArgs,

54							return err
55						}
56						body := "# Project-owned dev overrides. Host paths/runtime/state are not allowed here.\nversion = 1\n\n[worktree]\n"
57						if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
58							return err
59						}

95	// configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
96	// it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
97	// which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
98	func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
99		path := app.configPath
100		if path == "" {
101			path = config.ConfigFile()
102		}
103		path = config.Expand(path)
104		created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, "", false, err
107		}
108		proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editor)
109		return proc, chosen, created, err
110	}
111	
112	func capabilityFileEditorProcess(path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
113		path = config.Expand(path)
114		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(path)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
117		}
118		if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
120		}
121		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
122		return proc, err
123	}
124	
125	// ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
126	// Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
127	func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
128		info, err := os.Stat(path)
129		switch {
130		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
131			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
132		case err == nil:
133			return false, nil
134		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
135			return false, err
136		}
137		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
138			return false, err
139		}
140		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
141		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
142			return false, err
143		}
144		return true, nil
145	}
146	
147	func editorProcess(path, override string) (*exec.Cmd, string, error) {
148		chosen, err := resolveEditor(override)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, "", err
151		}
152		command := chosen + " " + shellQuote(path)
153		return exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", command), chosen, nil
154	}
155	
156	func resolveEditor(override string) (string, error) {
157		for _, candidate := range []string{override, os.Getenv("VISUAL"), os.Getenv("EDITOR")} {
158			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
159				return candidate, nil
160			}
161		}
162		for _, candidate := range []string{"nvim", "vim", "vi"} {
163			if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
164				return candidate, nil
165			}
166		}
167		return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
168	}

284	// Agent is one provider-neutral local program dev can hand a rendered prompt
285	// to. Run and Open are separate because a batch command and an interactive TTY
286	// command usually have different argv and input requirements.
287	type Agent struct {
288		Name        string        `toml:"name"`
289		Description string        `toml:"description"`
290		Default     bool          `toml:"default"`
291		Run         AgentLauncher `toml:"run"`

295	// AgentLauncher is one batch or foreground command definition. Exactly one of
296	// Command and Shell is configured; prompt contents are never interpolated into
297	// Shell.
298	type AgentLauncher struct {
299		Command     []string `toml:"command"`
300		Shell       string   `toml:"shell"`
301		Input       string   `toml:"input"`
302		LoadShellRC bool     `toml:"load_shell_rc"`

305	
306	func (l AgentLauncher) Configured() bool {
307		return len(l.Command) > 0 || strings.TrimSpace(l.Shell) != "" || l.Input != "" ||
308			l.LoadShellRC || l.Timeout.Duration != 0
309	}
310	
311	// Handoff converts configuration to the neutral process contract. Run gets a
312	// ten-minute default; Open deliberately has no default deadline.
313	func (l AgentLauncher) Handoff(mode handoff.Mode) handoff.Launcher {
314		timeout := l.Timeout.Duration
315		if mode == handoff.ModeRun && timeout == 0 {
316			timeout = 10 * time.Minute
317		}
318		return handoff.Launcher{
319			Command: append([]string(nil), l.Command...), Shell: l.Shell,
320			Input: handoff.Transport(l.Input), LoadShellRC: l.LoadShellRC,
321			Timeout: timeout,
322		}
323	}

325	// AgentByName finds a configured agent. An empty name selects the one marked
326	// default, or the only configured agent when there is exactly one.
327	func (c Config) AgentByName(name string) (Agent, bool) {
328		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
329		if name != "" {
330			for _, agent := range c.Agents {
331				if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(agent.Name), name) {
332					return agent, true
333				}
334			}
335			return Agent{}, false
336		}
337		for _, agent := range c.Agents {
338			if agent.Default {
339				return agent, true
340			}
341		}
342		if len(c.Agents) == 1 {
343			return c.Agents[0], true
344		}
345		return Agent{}, false
346	}

399	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
400	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
401	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
402	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
403		cfg := Default()
404		if path == "" {
405			path = ConfigFile()
406		}
407		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
408		switch {
409		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
410			return cfg, nil
411		case err != nil:
412			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
413		}
414		if undecoded := md.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
415			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
416			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
417			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)
418		}
419		cfg.Source = path
420		return cfg, cfg.Validate()
421	}
422	
423	// Validate catches the settings that would otherwise fail deep inside a
424	// worktree create, when a directory has already been made.
425	func (c Config) Validate() error {
426		switch c.Runtime.Backend {
427		case "", "auto", "herdr", "tmux", "zellij", "none":
428		default:
429			return fmt.Errorf("runtime.backend %q: want auto, herdr, tmux, zellij or none", c.Runtime.Backend)
430		}
431		if c.Paths.WorktreePath == "" {
432			return errors.New("paths.worktree_path must not be empty")
433		}
434		if _, err := Render(c.Paths.WorktreePath, c.probeVars()); err != nil {
435			return fmt.Errorf("paths.worktree_path: %w", err)
436		}
437		if err := c.LocalFiles.Limits().Validate(); err != nil {
438			return fmt.Errorf("local_files: %w", err)
439		}
440		switch c.Bootstrap.Layout {
441		case "", "flat", "preserve":
442		default:
443			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.layout %q: want flat or preserve", c.Bootstrap.Layout)
444		}
445		if c.Bootstrap.MaxDepth < 0 {
446			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.max_depth must be zero (unlimited) or positive")
447		}
448		if c.Forge.RemoteLimit < 0 {
449			return fmt.Errorf("deprecated forge.remote_limit must be zero or positive")
450		}
451		for index, arg := range c.Picker.Command {
452			if strings.ContainsAny(arg, "\x00\r\n") {
453				return fmt.Errorf("picker.command[%d] must not contain NUL or a newline", index)
454			}
455			if index == 0 && strings.TrimSpace(arg) == "" {
456				return errors.New("picker.command[0] must name an executable; use an empty command array for the built-in picker")
457			}
458		}
459		if err := c.validateAgents(); err != nil {
460			return err
461		}
462		seenAzureTargets := map[string]bool{}
463		for i, target := range c.Forge.AzureDevOps {
464			organization := strings.TrimSpace(target.Organization)
465			project := strings.TrimSpace(target.Project)
466			if !validAzureDevOpsOrganization(organization) {
467				return fmt.Errorf("forge.azure_devops[%d].organization %q: want an Azure DevOps Services URL like https://dev.azure.com/acme", i, target.Organization)
468			}
469			if project == "" {
470				return fmt.Errorf("forge.azure_devops[%d].project must not be empty", i)
471			}
472			key := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimRight(organization, "/") + "/" + project)
473			if seenAzureTargets[key] {
474				return fmt.Errorf("forge.azure_devops[%d] duplicates organization/project %s / %s", i, organization, project)
475			}
476			seenAzureTargets[key] = true
477		}
478		validStrategy := func(v string) bool {
479			switch v {
480			case "", "reinstall", "copy", "link", "skip":
481				return true
482			}
483			return false
484		}
485		if !validStrategy(c.Worktree.Strategy) {
486			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategy %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", c.Worktree.Strategy)
487		}
488		for ecosystem, strategy := range c.Worktree.Strategies {
489			if !validStrategy(strategy) {
490				return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies.%s %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip",
491					ecosystem, strategy)
492			}
493		}
494		validColumns := map[string]bool{
495			"repo": true, "branch": true, "git": true, "remote": true, "size": true, "live": true,
496			"latest": true, "worktrees": true, "tasks": true, "notes": true,
497			"category": true, "path": true,
498		}
499		for i, column := range c.TUI.Repos.Columns {
500			if !validColumns[column] {
501				return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.columns[%d] %q: unknown column", i, column)
502			}
503		}
504		switch c.EffectiveRepoSort() {
505		case "activity", "latest", "name", "git", "size", "tasks":
506		default:
507			return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.sort %q: want activity, latest, name, git, size or tasks", c.TUI.Repos.Sort)
508		}
509		seen := map[string]string{}
510		for i, t := range c.TUI.Tools {
511			switch {
512			case t.Key == "":
513				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key is required", i)
514			case t.Run == "":
515				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d] (%s): run is required", i, t.Key)
516			}
517			if binding, ok := ReservedKey(t.Key); ok {
518				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key %q is the dashboard's %q binding; pick another",
519					i, t.Key, binding)
520			}
521			if prev, ok := seen[t.Key]; ok {
522				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key %q is already bound to %q", i, t.Key, prev)
523			}
524			seen[t.Key] = t.Name
525		}
526		return nil
527	}
528	
529	func validAzureDevOpsOrganization(raw string) bool {
530		u, err := url.Parse(raw)
531		if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.User != nil ||
532			u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" || u.Port() != "" {
533			return false
534		}
535		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
536		segments := strings.FieldsFunc(u.Path, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' })
537		switch {
538		case host == "dev.azure.com":
539			return len(segments) == 1
540		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com"):
541			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
542			return organization != "" && organization != "vs-ssh" && len(segments) == 0
543		default:
544			return false
545		}
546	}

564

566	func (c Config) TasksDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "tasks") }
567	
568	// AssetsDir holds one TOML file per catalog asset.
569	func (c Config) AssetsDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "assets") }
570

572	func (c Config) NotesDir() string { return filepath.Join(c.StateDir(), "notes") }

577	// ScanRoots returns the expanded repo discovery roots.
578	func (c Config) ScanRoots() []string {
579		out := make([]string, 0, len(c.Paths.ScanRoots))
580		for _, r := range c.Paths.ScanRoots {
581			if e := Expand(r); e != "" {
582				out = append(out, e)
583			}
584		}
585		return out
586	}
587	
588	// RepoPaths returns expanded exact repository paths.
589	func (c Config) RepoPaths() []string {
590		out := make([]string, 0, len(c.Paths.RepoPaths))
591		for _, path := range c.Paths.RepoPaths {
592			if expanded := Expand(path); expanded != "" {
593				out = append(out, expanded)
594			}
595		}
596		return out
597	}
598	
599	// DiscoveryRoots returns exact repositories first, followed by recursive scan
600	// roots. repo.Discover recognises when a supplied root is itself a repository.
601	func (c Config) DiscoveryRoots() []string {
602		seen := map[string]bool{}
603		out := make([]string, 0, len(c.Paths.RepoPaths)+len(c.Paths.ScanRoots))
604		for _, roots := range [][]string{c.RepoPaths(), c.ScanRoots()} {
605			for _, root := range roots {
606				clean := filepath.Clean(root)
607				if clean == "" || seen[clean] {
608					continue
609				}
610				seen[clean] = true
611				out = append(out, clean)
612			}
613		}
614		return out
615	}

617	// WorktreePathFor renders the configured template for one repo+branch pair.
618	func (c Config) WorktreePathFor(repoName, repoPath, branch, category string) (string, error) {
619		v := Vars{
620			"worktree_root": Expand(c.Paths.WorktreeRoot),
621			"repo":          repoName,
622			"repo_path":     repoPath,
623			"branch":        branch,
624			"category":      category,
625			"host":          Hostname(),
626			"date":          time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"),
627		}
628		rendered, err := Render(c.Paths.WorktreePath, v)
629		if err != nil {
630			return "", err
631		}
632		return Expand(rendered), nil
633	}

635	// Hostname is the machine identity recorded as a task's owner.
636	func Hostname() string {
637		if h, err := os.Hostname(); err == nil && h != "" {
638			return h
639		}
640		return "unknown"
641	}
642	
643	// validateAgents rejects an agent definition that could not run, or that could
644	// run in a way the user did not mean.
645	func (c Config) validateAgents() error {
646		seen := map[string]int{}
647		defaultAt := -1
648		for i, agent := range c.Agents {
649			name := strings.TrimSpace(agent.Name)
650			if name == "" {
651				return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d].name must not be empty", i)
652			}
653			if name != agent.Name {
654				return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d].name %q must not have surrounding whitespace", i, agent.Name)
655			}
656			if previous, exists := seen[strings.ToLower(name)]; exists {
657				return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d].name %q duplicates agent[%d]", i, name, previous)
658			}
659			seen[strings.ToLower(name)] = i
660	
661			if !agent.Run.Configured() && !agent.Open.Configured() {
662				return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d] %q: configure run or open", i, name)
663			}
664			for mode, launcher := range map[handoff.Mode]AgentLauncher{
665				handoff.ModeRun: agent.Run, handoff.ModeOpen: agent.Open,
666			} {
667				if !launcher.Configured() {
668					continue
669				}
670				if launcher.Timeout.Duration < 0 {
671					return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d].%s.timeout must not be negative", i, mode)
672				}
673				if err := handoff.Validate(mode, launcher.Handoff(mode)); err != nil {
674					return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d].%s: %w", i, mode, err)
675				}
676			}
677	
678			if agent.Default {
679				if defaultAt >= 0 {
680					return fmt.Errorf("agent[%d] %q: agent[%d] is already the default", i, name, defaultAt)
681				}
682				defaultAt = i
683			}
684		}
685		return nil
686	}

13		if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
14			return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
17			return row.Lock.File, nil
18		}
19		return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}
34	
35	func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
36		lines := []string{
37			"name: " + row.Name,
38			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
39		}
40		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
51	}
52	
53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
54		lines := []string{
55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}
59		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
60		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
61		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
62		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
63		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
64		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
65		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
66		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
67		if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
69		}
70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
73			for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
74				value := string(credential.Kind)
75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
84			for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
85				redactions[i] = string(redaction)
86			}
87			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
88		}
89		if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
90			coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
91			for i, item := range row.Coverage {
92				coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
93			}
94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}
98	
99	func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {
100		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
101			return lines
102		}
103		return append(lines, label+": "+value)
104	}

528		proc, err := m.actions.OpenFile(path)
529		if err != nil {

532		}
533		view := m.view
534		m.status = "editing " + config.Contract(path) + "…"
535		return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
536			return capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: view, err: err}
537		})

540	func (m Model) runTryListAction(action listAction) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
541		row, ok := m.currentTry()
542		if !ok {
543			return m, nil
544		}
545		var tryAction TryAction
546		switch action {
547		case listActionTryMark:
548			tryAction = TryMark
549		case listActionTryDeprecate:
550			tryAction = TryDeprecate
551		case listActionTryReactivate:
552			tryAction = TryReactivate
553		case listActionTryArchive:
554			tryAction = TryArchive
555		case listActionTryRestore:
556			tryAction = TryRestore
557		case listActionTryGraduate:
558			tryAction = TryGraduate
559		}
560		switch tryAction {
561		case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
562			return m.openTryForm(tryAction, row)
563		case TryArchive:
564			return m.openTryConfirmation(tryAction, row)
565		case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
566			m.status = string(tryAction) + " in progress…"
567			return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: tryAction, ID: row.Item.ID})
568		default:
569			return m, nil
570		}
571	}

1	package tui

5	const mouseWheelRows = 3
6	
7	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
8		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
9		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
10			return m, nil
11		}
12		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
13			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
14		}
15		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
16			return m, nil
17		}
18	
19		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
20			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
21				return m, nil
22			}
23			delta := mouseWheelRows
24			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
25				delta = -delta
26			}
27			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
28			return m, nil
29		}
30		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
31			return m, nil
32		}
33	
34		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
35			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
36				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
37					continue
38				}
39				if m.view == hit.view {
40					return m, nil
41				}
42				m.view = hit.view
43				return m.afterViewSwitch()
44			}
45			return m, nil
46		}
47	
48		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
49		if !ok {
50			return m, nil
51		}
52		switch event.Button {
53		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
54			m.setAt(row)
55		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
56			m.setAt(row)
57			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
58				m = m.openActionMenu()
59			}
60		}
61		return m, nil
62	}
63	
64	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
65		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
66			return 0, false
67		}
68		count := m.count()
69		from, to := m.window(count)
70		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
71		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
72			return 0, false
73		}
74		return from + y - first, true
75	}
76	
77	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
78		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
79			return false
80		}
81		from, to := m.window(m.count())
82		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
83		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
84	}
85	
86	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
87		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
88			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
89				return m, nil
90			}
91			delta := 1
92			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
93				delta = -1
94			}
95			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
96			return m, nil
97		}
98		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
99			return m, nil
100		}
101		first := 4
102		if m.overlay.detail != "" {
103			first++
104		}
105		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
106			m.overlay = overlayState{}
107			return m, nil
108		}
109		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
110		return m.runOverlayAction()
111	}

12	func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {

22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {

28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}

43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))

53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {

56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),

71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {

75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))

101			return lines
102		}

104	}

377	func (m Model) runOverlayAction() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
378		if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 || m.overlay.optionIndex >= m.overlay.optionCount {
379			return m, nil
380		}
381		action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
382		token := m.overlay.selection
383		if !m.selectToken(token) {
384			m.overlay = overlayState{}
385			m.err = fmt.Errorf("selected row changed while its action menu was open")
386			return m, nil
387		}
388		m.overlay = overlayState{}
389		return m.runListAction(action)

459	func (m Model) toggleSelectedRepo() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
460		item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()

462			return m, nil
463		}

7	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
8		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
9		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
10			return m, nil
11		}
12		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
13			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
14		}

16			return m, nil
17		}
18	
19		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
20			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
21				return m, nil
22			}
23			delta := mouseWheelRows
24			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
25				delta = -delta
26			}
27			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
28			return m, nil
29		}
30		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
31			return m, nil
32		}
33

35			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
36				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
37					continue
38				}
39				if m.view == hit.view {
40					return m, nil
41				}
42				m.view = hit.view
43				return m.afterViewSwitch()

45			return m, nil
46		}
47	
48		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)

54			m.setAt(row)
55		case tea.MouseButtonRight:

64	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
65		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
66			return 0, false
67		}
68		count := m.count()
69		from, to := m.window(count)
70		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
71		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
72			return 0, false
73		}
74		return from + y - first, true
75	}
76	
77	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
78		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
79			return false
80		}
81		from, to := m.window(m.count())
82		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
83		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
84	}

86	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
87		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
88			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
89				return m, nil
90			}
91			delta := 1
92			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
93				delta = -1
94			}
95			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
96			return m, nil
97		}
98		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
99			return m, nil
100		}
101		first := 4
102		if m.overlay.detail != "" {
103			first++
104		}
105		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
106			m.overlay = overlayState{}
107			return m, nil
108		}
109		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
110		return m.runOverlayAction()
111	}

 # Changelog
 
 All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
 
 The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
 
 ## [Unreleased]
 
+### Added
+
+- The dashboard now supports cell-motion mouse input: left-click selects rows or
+  switches visible tabs, the wheel moves three rows, and right-click opens the
+  selected row's existing actions without making a click implicitly open it.
+- SKILLS and MCP share a session-only `A` context/all scope toggle and can open
+  the selected local configuration in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` or copy its path,
+  sanitized summary, and explicitly requested raw file. Raw file copy is bounded
+  to 1 MiB but may put credentials and other declarations into the system
+  clipboard. `A` is now a reserved TUI tool key.
+
+### Changed
+
+- MCP caps its content-responsive `SERVER` column at 32 cells, keeping transport,
+  state, and source columns together instead of pushing them to the far edge of a
+  wide terminal.
+
 ## [0.2.12] - 2026-09-04
 
 ### Changed
 
 - The TUI SKILLS and MCP views are now startup-context-first. From a Git
   checkout they scan only the exact current worktree plus global/user sources,
   matching what an agent launched there can read instead of listing unrelated
   projects. Outside Git they retain the cross-repository inventory and include
   every accepted REPOS target.
 
 ## [0.2.11] - 2026-09-04
 
 ### Added
 
 - `dev pr list` shows the pull and merge requests you opened and the ones
   awaiting your review, and joins reported head branches to local task and
   checkout health. Account and per-repository surfaces remain explicit;
   personal per-repository queries may call once per requested role, engaged

 // configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
 // it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
 // which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
 func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
 	path := app.configPath
 	if path == "" {
 		path = config.ConfigFile()
 	}
 	path = config.Expand(path)
 	created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
 	if err != nil {
 		return nil, "", false, err
 	}
 	proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editor)
 	return proc, chosen, created, err
 }
 
+func capabilityFileEditorProcess(path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {

+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)

+	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
+	}

 // ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
 // Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
 func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
 	info, err := os.Stat(path)
 	switch {
 	case err == nil && info.IsDir():
 		return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
 	case err == nil:
 		return false, nil
 	case !os.IsNotExist(err):
 		return false, err
 	}
 	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
 		return false, err
 	}
 	body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
 	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
 		return false, err
 	}
 	return true, nil

+// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe either what an agent
+// launched from the startup context would see or every accepted repository.
+// Global sources are still scanned once by the domain collectors.
+func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {
 	repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
 	for _, row := range locals {
 		if !row.IsTry() {
 			repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
 		}
 	}
 	targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
+	if scope == tui.CapabilityAllRepositories {
+		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
+	}
 	if current.CheckoutRoot != "" && current.CommonDir != "" &&
 		!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
 		return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
 	}
 	return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
 }

 func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,

 	if err != nil {
 		return nil, err
 	}
 	items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
 	warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)

 // reservedKeys are the dashboard's own bindings. A tool cannot take one,
 // because losing the ability to quit or move is not a trade anyone wants.
 var reservedKeys = map[string]string{
 	"q": "quit", "j": "down", "k": "up", "g": "top", "G": "bottom",
 	"h": "previous view", "l": "next view", "tab": "next view",
 	"/": "filter", "r": "refresh", "o": "open", "p": "park",
 	"c": "edit next action", "s": "start a worktree task", "d": "start a direct task",
-	"a": "include hidden history", "n": "new Try / add repo note", "N": "browse repo notes", " ": "context actions",
+	"a": "include hidden history", "A": "capability scope", "n": "new Try / add repo note", "N": "browse repo notes", " ": "context actions",
 	"0": "clear filters", "1": "hot", "2": "warm", "3": "cold",
 	"?": "help", "H": "repo activity heatmap", "e": "edit config",
 	"O": "cycle repo sort", "R": "reverse repo sort",
 	"m": "edit repo metadata", "y": "copy repo metadata",
 }
 
 // ReservedKey reports the dashboard binding a key would collide with.
 func ReservedKey(key string) (string, bool) {
 	name, ok := reservedKeys[key]
 	return name, ok
 }
 
 // DefaultTools are the programs bound when nothing is configured. They are
 // written out in full by `dev config init` rather than left implicit, so what
 // is bound is visible rather than something to discover by pressing keys.
 func DefaultTools() []Tool {
 	return []Tool{
 		{Key: "L", Name: "lazygit", Run: "lazygit"},
 		{Key: "Y", Name: "yazi", Run: "yazi"},
 		{Key: "E", Name: "editor", Run: "$EDITOR ."},

118	func (o *overlayState) addField(key, label, placeholder, value string) {
119		if o.fieldCount >= len(o.fields) {
120			return
121		}
122		input := textinput.New()
123		input.CharLimit = 300
124		input.Placeholder = placeholder
125		input.SetValue(value)
126		input.CursorEnd()
127		o.fields[o.fieldCount] = formField{key: key, label: label, input: input}

131	func (m Model) focusOverlayField(index int) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
132		if m.overlay.fieldCount == 0 {
133			return m, nil
134		}
135		if index < 0 {
136			index = m.overlay.fieldCount - 1
137		}
138		if index >= m.overlay.fieldCount {
139			index = 0
140		}
141		for fieldIndex := 0; fieldIndex < m.overlay.fieldCount; fieldIndex++ {
142			m.overlay.fields[fieldIndex].input.Blur()
143		}
144		m.overlay.fieldIndex = index
145		return m, m.overlay.fields[index].input.Focus()

148	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
149		switch m.overlay.kind {
150		case overlayHelp:
151			switch message.String() {
152			case "esc", "?", "q":
153				m.overlay = overlayState{}
154			}
155			return m, nil
156	
157		case overlayActionMenu:
158			switch message.String() {
159			case "esc", "q":
160				m.overlay = overlayState{}
161				return m, nil
162			case "j", "down":
163				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
164					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
165				}
166				return m, nil
167			case "k", "up":
168				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
169					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
170				}
171				return m, nil
172			case "enter":
173				return m.runOverlayAction()
174			}
175			return m, nil
176	
177		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
178			switch message.String() {
179			case "esc":
180				m.overlay = overlayState{}
181				m.err = nil
182				return m, nil
183			case "tab", "down":
184				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
185			case "shift+tab", "up":
186				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
187			case "enter":
188				return m.submitTryOverlay()
189			}
190			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
191			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
192			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
193			return m, command
194		}
195		return m, nil
196	}

198	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
199		value := func(key string) string {
200			for index := 0; index < m.overlay.fieldCount; index++ {
201				if m.overlay.fields[index].key == key {
202					return strings.TrimSpace(m.overlay.fields[index].input.Value())
203				}
204			}
205			return ""
206		}
207		if m.overlay.kind == overlayRepoForm {
208			row := m.overlay.repoTarget
209			tags := splitTagInput(value("tags"))
210			note := value("note")
211			m.overlay = overlayState{}
212			m.err = nil
213			m.status = "updating repository metadata…"
214			return m, m.applyRepoPatch(row, tags, note)
215		}
216	
217		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
218		switch m.overlay.action {
219		case TryCreate:
220			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
221			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
222				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")
223				return m, nil
224			}
225			gitInit, ok := parseBoolInput(value("git"), true)
226			if !ok {
227				m.err = fmt.Errorf("git init must be yes or no")
228				return m, nil
229			}
230			request.NoGit = !gitInit
231		case TryMark:
232			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
233			request.Note = value("note")
234		case TryRestore:
235			request.To = value("to")
236		case TryGraduate:
237			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
238		case TryArchive:
239			if value("confirm") != "YES" {
240				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
241				return m, nil
242			}
243		default:
244			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
245			return m, nil
246		}
247		m.overlay = overlayState{}
248		m.err = nil
249		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
250		return m, m.applyTry(request)
251	}

19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
20	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

154	// buildHeaderLayout renders the tab strip and records the exact cell spans it
155	// used, so mouse hit testing cannot drift from responsive labels or styles.
156	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
157		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
158			short := map[View]string{
159				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
160				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
161			}
162			var builder strings.Builder
163			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
164			builder.WriteString(prefix)
165			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
166			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
167			for index, view := range Views {
168				if index > 0 {
169					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
170					builder.WriteString(separator)
171					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
172				}
173				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
174				if compact {
175					name = short[view]
176				}
177				label := name
178				if !compact {
179					label = " " + name + " "
180				}
181				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
182				if view == m.view {
183					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
184				}
185				from := x
186				builder.WriteString(rendered)
187				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
188				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
189			}
190			if summary {
191				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
192			}
193			if m.filter != "" {
194				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
195			}
196			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
197		}
198	
199		layout := build(false, true)
200		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
201			layout = build(false, false)
202		}
203		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
204			layout = build(true, false)
205		}
206		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
207			return layout
208		}
209	
210		prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
211		name := strings.ToUpper(m.view.String())
212		line := prefix + styleSelected.Render(name)
213		layout = headerLayout{
214			line: line,
215			tabs: []tabHit{{view: m.view, from: lipgloss.Width(prefix), to: lipgloss.Width(line)}},
216		}
217		if m.filter != "" {
218			available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(layout.line) - 4
219			if available > 1 {
220				layout.line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
221			}
222		}
223		return layout
224	}

230	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
231	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
232	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
233		h := m.listHeight()
234		if n <= h {
235			return 0, n
236		}
237		from = m.at() - h/2
238		if from < 0 {
239			from = 0
240		}
241		if from+h > n {
242			from = n - h
243		}
244		return from, from + h
245	}

364		case "repo":
365			connector := "├─ "
366			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
367				connector = "└─ "
368			}
369			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
370			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
371				label = checkout.Branch()
372			}
373			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
374				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
375			}
376			return connector + label
377		case "branch":
378			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
379				return branch
380			}
381			return "(detached)"
382		case "git":
383			switch {
384			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
385				return "prunable"
386			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
387				return "locked"
388			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
389				return "?"
390			default:
391				return checkout.Status.Summary()
392			}
393		case "live":
394			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
395		case "latest":
396			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
397		case "worktrees":
398			return "—"
399		case "tasks":
400			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
401				return "?"
402			}
403			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
404		case "notes":
405			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
406				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
407			}
408			return "—"
409		case "category":
410			return "—"
411		case "path":
412			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413		}
414		return ""
415	}

417	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
418		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
419			return "?"
420		}
421		sessions := r.Sessions()
422		if len(sessions) == 0 {
423			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
424		}
425		if len(sessions) > 1 {
426			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
427		}
428		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
429		if status != "" {
430			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
431		}
432		return r.Runtime
433	}

435	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
436		if runtimeErr != nil {
437			return "?"
438		}
439		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
440			return "closed"
441		}
442		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
443			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
444		}
445		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
446			return runtimeName + ":" + status
447		}
448		return runtimeName
449	}

451	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
452		if len(tasks) == 0 {
453			return "—"
454		}
455		counts := map[task.State]int{}
456		for _, t := range tasks {
457			counts[t.State]++
458		}
459		var parts []string
460		for _, state := range task.States {
461			if counts[state] > 0 {
462				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
463			}
464		}
465		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
466	}
467	
468	type repoColumnSpec struct {
469		name, header string
470		width, min   int
471	}
472	
473	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
474		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
475		if len(names) == 0 {
476			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
477		}
478		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
479			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
480			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
481			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
482			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
483			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
484			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
485			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
486			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
487			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
488			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
489			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
490			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
491		}
492		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
493		for _, name := range names {
494			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
495				columns = append(columns, c)
496			}
497		}
498		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
499		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
500		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
501		for _, c := range columns {
502			total += c.width
503		}
504		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
505			for i := range columns {
506				if columns[i].name != preferred {
507					continue
508				}
509				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
510				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
511				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
512				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
513					columns[i].width--
514					total--
515				}
516			}
517			if total <= m.width {
518				break
519			}
520		}
521		return columns
522	}
523	
524	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
525		switch name {
526		case "repo":
527			return r.Repo.Display()
528		case "branch":
529			if r.Repo.Bare {
530				return "(bare)"
531			}
532			return r.Status.Branch
533		case "git":
534			if r.Repo.Bare {
535				return "—"
536			}
537			return r.Status.Summary()
538		case "remote":
539			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
540				return "?"
541			}
542			return r.Topology.Summary()
543		case "size":
544			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
545		case "live":
546			if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
547				return "?"
548			}
549			if !r.Live {
550				return "—"
551			}
552			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
553				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
554			}
555			return r.Runtime
556		case "latest":
557			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
558		case "worktrees":
559			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
560				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
561			}
562			return "—"
563		case "tasks":
564			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
565				return "?"
566			}
567			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
568				return tasks
569			}
570			return "—"
571		case "notes":
572			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
573				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
574			}
575			return "—"
576		case "category":
577			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
578				return r.Repo.Category
579			}
580			return "—"
581		case "path":
582			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
583		}
584		return ""
585	}
586	
587	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
588		if at.IsZero() {
589			return "—"
590		}
591		d := time.Since(at)
592		switch {
593		case d < time.Hour:
594			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
595		case d < 24*time.Hour:
596			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
597		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
598			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
599		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
600			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
601		default:
602			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
603		}
604	}

606	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
607		s = pad(s, width)
608		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
609			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
610		}
611		return s
612	}
