614	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
615		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
616			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
617		}
618		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
619		if len(rows) == 0 {
620			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
621				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
622			}
623			if m.filter != "" {
624				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
625			}
626			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
627		}
628		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
629		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
630		if descW < 12 {
631			descW = 12
632		}
633	
634		var b strings.Builder
635		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
636			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
637		}
638		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
639			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
640		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
641		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
642			r := rows[i]
643			pending := m.remoteCloneTargets(r)
644			local := "—"
645			if pending {
646				local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " repo"
647				if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRunning {
648					local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " clone"
649				}
650			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
651				local = "inspect"
652			} else if r.Cloned() {
653				local = "yes"
654				if r.LocalKind != "" {
655					local = string(r.LocalKind)
656					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
657						local = "repo"
658					}
659				}
660			}
661			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
662			if vis == "" {
663				vis = "—"
664			}
665			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
666				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
667				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
668			styled := line
669			if r.Cloned() || pending {
670				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
671			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
672				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
673			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
674				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
675			}
676			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
677		}
678		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
679		return b.String()
680	}

682	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
683		rows := m.visibleFleet()
684		if len(rows) == 0 {
685			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
686				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
687			}
688			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
689				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
690			}
691			if !m.showLocalFleet {
692				for _, row := range m.fleet {
693					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
694						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
695					}
696				}
697			}
698			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
699		}
700		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
701		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
702		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
703		if pathW < 12 {
704			pathW = 12
705		}
706		var b strings.Builder
707		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
708			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
709		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
710		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
711			row := rows[i]
712			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
713			if row.Repository != nil {
714				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
715				if row.Repository.Live {
716					live = row.Repository.Runtime
717					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
718						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
719					}
720				}
721				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
722			}
723			state := string(row.State)
724			if row.FromCache {
725				state = "stale"
726			}
727			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
728				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
729				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
730			styled := line
731			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
732				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
733			} else if row.State != "ok" {
734				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
735			}
736			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
737		}
738		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
739		return b.String()
740	}
741	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {
742		state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
743		rows := m.visibleSkills()
744		if state.loading && len(m.skills) == 0 {
745			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading agent skills…") + "\n"
746		}
747		if len(rows) == 0 {
748			if !state.hasSnapshot {
749				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Agent skills load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
750			}
751			if m.filter != "" {
752				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
753			}
754			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skills found. Press a to open the installer.") + "\n"
755		}
756	
757		var headers []string
758		var values func(agentskill.Skill) []string
759		switch {
760		case m.width >= 110:
761			repoW, scopeW, skillW, installW, updateW, agentW := 16, 7, 20, 9, 10, 20
762			sourceW := max(12, m.width-96)
763			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW), fitCell("SOURCE", sourceW)}
764			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
765				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW), fitCell(skillSource(row), sourceW)}
766			}
767		case m.width >= 82:
768			repoW, scopeW, installW, updateW := 16, 7, 9, 10
769			flex := max(28, m.width-54)
770			skillW, agentW := flex/2, flex-flex/2
771			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW)}
772			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
773				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW)}
774			}
775		default:
776			repoW, updateW := 14, 10
777			skillW := max(12, m.width-30)
778			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW)}
779			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
780				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW)}
781			}
782		}
783	
784		var b strings.Builder
785		if state.loading {
786			message := "Showing installed skills while refreshing…"
787			if m.skillsChecking {
788				message = "Showing installed skills while checking sources…"
789			}
790			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render(message) + "\n")
791		}
792		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
793		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
794		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
795			row := rows[i]
796			line := strings.Join(values(row), "  ")
797			styled := line
798			switch row.UpdateStatus {
799			case agentskill.UpdateAvailable, agentskill.UpdateMissing, agentskill.UpdateFailed:
800				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
801			case agentskill.UpdateCurrent:
802				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
803			case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
804				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
805			}
806			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
807		}
808		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
809		return b.String()
810	}

913	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
914		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
915		for _, policy := range row.Policies {
916			part := string(policy.Kind)
917			if policy.Value != "" {
918				part += ":" + policy.Value
919			}
920			if policy.Count > 0 {
921				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
922			}
923			parts = append(parts, part)
924		}
925		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
926	}

928	func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration, maxWidth int) string {
929		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
930		for index, credential := range row.Credentials {
931			part := string(credential.Kind)
932			if credential.Name != "" {
933				part += ":" + credential.Name
934			}
935			candidate := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), parts...), part), ", ")
936			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > maxWidth {
937				remaining := len(row.Credentials) - index
938				if len(parts) == 0 {
939					if remaining == 1 {
940						return pad(part, maxWidth)
941					}
942					return pad(fmt.Sprintf("%s, +%d", part, remaining-1), maxWidth)
943				}
944				return pad(strings.Join(parts, ", ")+fmt.Sprintf(", +%d", remaining), maxWidth)
945			}
946			parts = append(parts, part)
947		}
948		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
949	}
950	
951	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
952		var parts []string
953		for _, item := range []struct {
954			label string
955			n     int
956		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
957			if item.n > 0 {
958				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
959			}
960		}
961		if len(parts) == 0 {
962			return "—"
963		}
964		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
965	}

967	func skillUpdateLabel(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
968		switch status {
969		case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
970			return "update"
971		case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
972			return "missing"
973		case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
974			return "unknown"
975		case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
976			return "failed"
977		default:
978			return string(status)
979		}
980	}
981	
982	func skillAgentSummary(agents []string) string {
983		if len(agents) == 0 {
984			return "—"
985		}
986		if len(agents) <= 3 {
987			return strings.Join(agents, ", ")
988		}
989		return strings.Join(agents[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(agents)-3)
990	}

992	func skillSource(row agentskill.Skill) string {
993		if row.Source != "" {
994			return row.Source
995		}
996		return string(row.ManagedBy)
997	}
998	
999	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
1000		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
1001			return "—"
1002		}
1003		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
1004		switch {
1005		case d < 24*time.Hour:
1006			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
1007		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
1008			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
1009		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
1010			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1011		default:
1012			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1013		}
1014	}

1043	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
1044		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
1045		if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
1046			fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
1047		}
1048		avail := m.width - fixed
1049		if avail < 40 {
1050			avail = 40
1051		}
1052		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1053		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1054		next = avail - name - branch
1055		if next < 10 {
1056			next = 10
1057		}
1058		return name, branch, next
1059	}

1589	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1590	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1591	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1592		if width < 20 {
1593			width = 20
1594		}
1595		var lines []string
1596		cur := ""
1597		for _, it := range items {
1598			candidate := it
1599			if cur != "" {
1600				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1601			}
1602			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1603				lines = append(lines, cur)
1604				cur = it
1605				continue
1606			}
1607			cur = candidate
1608		}
1609		if cur != "" {
1610			lines = append(lines, cur)
1611		}
1612		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1613	}

1632	func shortAge(r inventory.Row) string {
1633		d := r.Age()
1634		switch {
1635		case d <= 0:
1636			return "—"
1637		case d.Hours() < 24:
1638			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
1639		case d.Hours() < 24*14:
1640			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
1641		case d.Hours() < 24*60:
1642			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1643		default:
1644			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1645		}
1646	}

1649		switch s {

1651			return styleHot.Render(line)
1652		case task.Warm:
1653			return styleWarm.Render(line)
1654		case task.Cold:
1655			return styleCold.Render(line)
1656		case task.Done:

1662	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1663	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1664	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1665		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1666			return s
1667		}
1668		var b strings.Builder
1669		used := 0
1670		for _, r := range s {
1671			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1672			if used+w > n-1 {
1673				break
1674			}
1675			b.WriteRune(r)
1676			used += w
1677		}
1678		return b.String() + "…"
1679	}
1680	
1681	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
1682		if v < lo {
1683			return lo
1684		}
1685		if v > hi {
1686			return hi
1687		}
1688		return v
1689	}

 // configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
 // it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
 // which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
 func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
 	path := app.configPath
 	if path == "" {
 		path = config.ConfigFile()
 	}
 	path = config.Expand(path)
 	created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
 	if err != nil {
 		return nil, "", false, err
 	}

 	return proc, chosen, created, err

+func capabilityFileEditorProcess(path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {

 // ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
 // Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
 func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
 	info, err := os.Stat(path)
 	switch {
 	case err == nil && info.IsDir():
 		return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
 	case err == nil:
 		return false, nil
 	case !os.IsNotExist(err):
 		return false, err
 	}
 	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
 		return false, err
 	}
 	body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
 	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
 		return false, err
 	}
 	return true, nil

558	 	generation := m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).generation
559	 	locals := append([]RepoRow(nil), m.repos...)

563	 		}
564	 		finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerRemote, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRemote, Generation: generation})
565	 		var rows []RemoteRow
566	 		var err error
567	 		matchLocals := m.actions.ReloadRemoteWithRepos != nil
568	 		if matchLocals {
569	 			rows, err = m.actions.ReloadRemoteWithRepos(m.viewContext(ViewRemote), locals)
570	 		} else {
571	 			rows, err = m.actions.ReloadRemote(m.viewContext(ViewRemote))
572	 		}
573	 		finish(traceOutcome(err))
574	 		return remoteMsg{
575	 			generation: generation, rows: rows, valid: snapshotValid(rows, err),
576	 			matchLocals: matchLocals, err: err,
577	 		}
578	 	}

130	 // ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
131	 // Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
132	 func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
133	 	info, err := os.Stat(path)

135	 	case err == nil && info.IsDir():

147	 		return false, err

155	 		return nil, "", err
156	 	}
157	 	command := chosen + " " + shellQuote(path)
158	 	return exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", command), chosen, nil
159	 }
160	 
161	 func resolveEditor(override string) (string, error) {
162	 	for _, candidate := range []string{override, os.Getenv("VISUAL"), os.Getenv("EDITOR")} {
163	 		if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
164	 			return candidate, nil
165	 		}
166	 	}
167	 	for _, candidate := range []string{"nvim", "vim", "vi"} {
168	 		if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
169	 			return candidate, nil
170	 		}
171	 	}
172	 	return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
173	 }

290	 func newTUIToolsCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
291	 	return &cobra.Command{
292	 		Use:   "tools",
293	 		Short: "List the external tool bindings and whether each one works here",
294	 		Long: `Show which programs the dashboard will hand the terminal to.
295	 
296	 Bindings come from [[tui.tools]] in the config; with none configured, the
297	 built-in set applies. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely, so
298	 what is bound is always exactly what is written down.
299	 
300	 Add your own — an editor, a script, anything you already reach for:
301	 
302	     [[tui.tools]]
303	     key  = "V"
304	     name = "nvim"
305	     run  = "nvim ."
306	 
307	     [[tui.tools]]
308	     key  = "B"
309	     name = "vibe"
310	     run  = "vibe"
311	 
312	 The command runs through your shell in the selected row's checkout, so
313	 arguments, environment variables and your own scripts all behave as typed.
314	 Set interactive = true only for aliases/functions from your shell rc; that
315	 binding runs through $SHELL -lic and the mode is shown in this listing.`,
316	 		Args: cobra.NoArgs,
317	 		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
318	 			configured := len(app.Cfg.TUI.Tools) > 0
319	 			source := "built-in defaults"
320	 			if configured {
321	 				source = config.Contract(app.Cfg.Source)
322	 			}
323	 			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "tool bindings from %s\n\n", source)
324	 
325	 			t := app.newTable("KEY", "NAME", "MODE", "RUNS", "AVAILABLE")
326	 			style := app.outStyle()
327	 			configuredTools := app.Cfg.EffectiveTools()
328	 			for i, tool := range externalTools(app) {
329	 				status := "yes"
330	 				if tool.Probe != nil && !tool.Probe(ctxOf()) {
331	 					status = style.warning("no — not on PATH")
332	 				} else {
333	 					status = style.success(status)
334	 				}
335	 				// Command is [shell, -c/-lic, run]; show the run itself.
336	 				run := tool.Command[len(tool.Command)-1]
337	 				mode := "shell"
338	 				if i < len(configuredTools) && configuredTools[i].Interactive {
339	 					mode = "interactive"
340	 				}
341	 				t.Add(tool.Key, tool.Name, mode, run, status)
342	 			}
343	 			t.Render(app.Out)
344	 
345	 			if !configured {
346	 				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nOverride them with [[tui.tools]] in your config; see \"dev tui tools --help\".")
347	 			}
348	 			fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nA tool cannot take a key the dashboard already uses; dev reports the clash on load.")
349	 			return nil
350	 		},
351	 	}
352	 }

850	 func collectTriesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, options experiment.ListOptions,
851	 	sessions []runtime.Session, sessionsSet bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
852	 	service, err := newExperimentService(app)
853	 	if err != nil {
854	 		return nil, err
855	 	}
856	 	items, diagnostics, listErr := service.List(ctx, options)
857	 	warnExperimentDiagnostics(app, diagnostics)
858	 	if !sessionsSet {
859	 		sessions, _ = rt.List(ctx)
860	 	}
861	 	rows := make([]tui.TryRow, 0, len(items))
862	 	for _, item := range items {
863	 		row := tui.TryRow{Item: item}
864	 		if item.Entry != nil {
865	 			if location, ok := item.Entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname()); ok {
866	 				copy := location
867	 				row.Location = &copy
868	 			}
869	 		}
870	 		sizeRepo := item.Live.Repo
871	 		if sizeRepo == nil && item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
872	 			if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); discoverErr == nil {
873	 				sizeRepo = &discovered
874	 			}
875	 		}
876	 		if sizeRepo != nil {
877	 			worktreeCount := 0
878	 			if worktrees, worktreeErr := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath); worktreeErr == nil && len(worktrees) > 1 {
879	 				worktreeCount = len(worktrees) - 1
880	 			}
881	 			row.SizeTarget = diskusage.FromGit(*sizeRepo, worktreeCount)
882	 		} else if item.Live.CurrentPath != "" {
883	 			row.SizeTarget = diskusage.Plain(item.Live.CurrentPath)
884	 		}
885	 		if item.Live.Present && item.Live.Repo != nil {
886	 			row.Topology, row.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, item.Live.CurrentPath)
887	 		}
888	 		if item.Live.Present {
889	 			for _, session := range sessions {
890	 				if session.Covers(item.Live.CurrentPath) ||
891	 					(item.Live.RealPath != "" && session.Covers(item.Live.RealPath)) {
892	 					row.Live = true
893	 					row.Runtime, row.RuntimeHandle, row.RuntimeStatus = rt.Name(), session.Handle, session.AgentStatus
894	 					break
895	 				}
896	 			}
897	 		}
898	 		rows = append(rows, row)
899	 	}
900	 	return rows, listErr

285	 	case TryRestore:

288	 		request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
289	 	case TryArchive:
290	 		if value("confirm") != "YES" {

292	 			return m, nil
293	 		}
294	 	default:

397	 func (m Model) renderStats() string {
398	 	var b strings.Builder
399	 	title := "repo activity"
400	 	if m.stats != nil && m.stats.Repo != "" {
401	 		title = m.stats.Repo + " activity"
402	 	}
403	 	b.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  HEATMAP  "+title) + "\n\n")
404	 	if m.err != nil {

406	 	} else if m.stats == nil {

408	 	} else if m.stats.Seconds == 0 {
409	 		b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No activity recorded for this repository.\n"))
410	 		b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Press b to backfill only this repo from Git history.\n"))
411	 	} else {

413	 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n  %s   %d active days   %s → %s\n",
414	 			styleOK.Render(humanSeconds(m.stats.Seconds)), m.stats.ActiveDays,
415	 			m.stats.Since.Format("2006-01-02"), m.stats.Until.Format("2006-01-02"))
416	 	}
417	 	b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("b backfill this repo · r reread stats · H / esc back · q quit"))
418	 	return b.String()
419	 }

421	 func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
422	 	d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
423	 	if d < time.Hour {
424	 		return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
425	 	}
426	 	return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
427	 }

541	 // window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
542	 // it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
543	 func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
544	 	h := m.listHeight()
545	 	if n <= h {
546	 		return 0, n
547	 	}
548	 	from = m.at() - h/2
549	 	if from < 0 {
550	 		from = 0
551	 	}
552	 	if from+h > n {
553	 		from = n - h
554	 	}
555	 	return from, from + h
556	 }

778	 func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
779	 	fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
780	 	if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
781	 		fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
782	 	}
783	 	avail := m.width - fixed
784	 	if avail < 40 {
785	 		avail = 40
786	 	}
787	 	name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
788	 	branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
789	 	next = avail - name - branch
790	 	if next < 10 {
791	 		next = 10
792	 	}
793	 	return name, branch, next
794	 }

3083			return m.runListAction(listActionSkillUpdate)
3084	
3085		case "e":
3086			if m.view == ViewSkills || m.view == ViewMCP {
3087				return m.runListAction(listActionOpenCapabilityFile)
3088			}
3089			if m.view == ViewFleet {
3090				if m.actions.EditFleetConfig == nil {
3091					return m, nil
3092				}
3093				proc, err := m.actions.EditFleetConfig()
3094				if err != nil {
3095					m.err = err
3096					return m, nil
3097				}
3098				m.status = "editing remotes.toml…"
3099				return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
3100					return fleetConfigEditedMsg{err: err}
3101				})
3102			}
3103			if m.actions.EditConfig == nil {
3104				return m, nil
3105			}
3106			proc, err := m.actions.EditConfig()
3107			if err != nil {
3108				m.err = err
3109				return m, nil
3110			}
3111			m.status = "editing config…"
3112			return m, tea.ExecProcess(proc, func(err error) tea.Msg {
3113				return configEditedMsg{err: err}
3114			})
3115	
3116		case "O":
3117			switch m.view {
3118			case ViewRepos:
3119				orders := []string{"activity", "latest", "name", "git", "size", "tasks"}
3120				m.actions.RepoSort = nextSort(m.actions.RepoSort, orders)
3121				m.status = "repo sort: " + m.actions.RepoSort
3122			case ViewTries:
3123				m.trySort = nextSort(m.trySort, []string{"activity", "name", "phase", "size"})
3124				m.status = "Try sort: " + m.trySort
3125			default:
3126				return m, nil
3127			}
3128			m.setAt(0)
3129			return m, nil
3130	
3131		case "R":
3132			switch m.view {
3133			case ViewRepos:
3134				m.actions.RepoReverse = !m.actions.RepoReverse
3135				m.status = fmt.Sprintf("repo sort reversed: %v", m.actions.RepoReverse)
3136			case ViewTries:
3137				m.tryReverse = !m.tryReverse
3138				m.status = fmt.Sprintf("Try sort reversed: %v", m.tryReverse)
3139			default:
3140				return m, nil
3141			}
3142			m.setAt(0)
3143			return m, nil
3144	
3145		case "H":
3146			return m.runListAction(listActionStats)
3147	
3148		default:
3149			if cmd := m.launchTool(msg.String()); cmd != nil {
3150				return m, cmd
3151			}
3152		}
3153		m.setAt(m.at())
3154		return m, nil
3155	}

3196	func (m Model) beginNoteLoad(refreshRepos bool) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
3197		m.noteRequest++
3198		request, targetKey, target := m.noteRequest, m.noteTarget.Key(), m.noteTarget
3199		reposGeneration := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation
3200		if refreshRepos {
3201			reposGeneration = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, loadAction)
3202		}
3203		query := m.noteQuery
3204		m.noteLoading = true
3205		return m, func() tea.Msg {
3206			if m.actions.Notes.List == nil {
3207				return noteListMsg{request: request, targetKey: targetKey, reposGeneration: reposGeneration}
3208			}
3209			var (
3210				notes []*note.Note
3211				err   error
3212			)
3213			if query != "" && m.actions.Notes.Search != nil {
3214				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.Search(m.baseContext(), target, query)
3215			} else {
3216				notes, err = m.actions.Notes.List(m.baseContext(), target)
3217			}
3218			msg := noteListMsg{
3219				notes: notes, request: request, targetKey: targetKey, err: err,
3220				reposGeneration: reposGeneration,
3221			}
3222			if refreshRepos && m.actions.ReloadRepos != nil {
3223				msg.repos, msg.reposErr = m.actions.ReloadRepos(m.viewContext(ViewRepos))
3224				msg.reposSet, msg.reposValid = true, snapshotValid(msg.repos, msg.reposErr)
3225			}
3226			return msg
3227		}
3228	}

3237	func (m *Model) clampNoteCursor() {

3242			m.noteCursor = len(m.notes) - 1
3243		case m.noteCursor < 0:

3248	func (m Model) updateNotes(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3249		switch m.mode {
3250		case modeNoteBrowse:
3251			switch msg.String() {
3252			case "esc", "N", "q":
3253				m.mode, m.notes, m.noteQuery, m.err = modeList, nil, "", nil
3254				m.noteRequest++
3255				return m, nil
3256			case "j", "down":
3257				m.noteCursor++
3258				m.noteExpanded = false
3259				m.clampNoteCursor()
3260			case "k", "up":
3261				m.noteCursor--
3262				m.noteExpanded = false
3263				m.clampNoteCursor()
3264			case "g", "home":
3265				m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = 0, false
3266			case "G", "end":
3267				m.noteCursor, m.noteExpanded = len(m.notes)-1, false
3268				m.clampNoteCursor()
3269			case "enter":
3270				if _, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
3271					m.noteExpanded = !m.noteExpanded
3272				}
3273			case "a", "n":
3274				return m.openNoteAdd(m.noteTarget, true)
3275			case "/":
3276				m.mode = modeNoteSearch
3277				m.input.SetValue(m.noteQuery)
3278				m.input.Placeholder = "search body, tags, repo"
3279				m.input.CursorEnd()
3280				return m, m.input.Focus()
3281			case "d":
3282				if _, ok := m.currentNote(); ok {
3283					m.mode = modeNoteConfirmDelete
3284				}
3285			case "e":
3286				n, ok := m.currentNote()
3287				if !ok || m.actions.Notes.Edit == nil {
3288					return m, nil
3289				}
3290				edit, err := m.actions.Notes.Edit(n)
3291				if err != nil {
3292					m.err = err
3293					return m, nil
3294				}
3295				return m, tea.ExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
3296					if edit.Complete != nil {
3297						runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
3298					}
3299					return noteActionMsg{status: "updated note " + n.ID[:8], returnBrowse: true, err: runErr}
3300				})
3301			}
3302			return m, nil
3303	
3304		case modeNoteAdd:
3305			switch msg.String() {
3306			case "esc":
3307				m.input.Blur()
3308				if m.noteReturnToBrowse {
3309					m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
3310				} else {
3311					m.mode = modeList
3312				}
3313				return m, nil
3314			case "enter":
3315				body := strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
3316				if body == "" {
3317					m.err = fmt.Errorf("note body is empty")
3318					return m, nil
3319				}
3320				m.input.Blur()
3321				returnBrowse := m.noteReturnToBrowse
3322				return m, func() tea.Msg {
3323					status, err := m.actions.Notes.Add(context.Background(), m.noteTarget, body)
3324					return noteActionMsg{status: status, returnBrowse: returnBrowse, err: err}
3325				}
3326			}
3327			input, cmd := m.input.Update(msg)
3328			m.input = input
3329			return m, cmd
3330	
3331		case modeNoteSearch:
3332			switch msg.String() {
3333			case "esc":
3334				m.input.Blur()
3335				m.noteQuery, m.mode, m.noteLoading = "", modeNoteBrowse, true
3336				return m.beginNoteLoad(false)
3337			case "enter":
3338				m.noteQuery = strings.TrimSpace(m.input.Value())
3339				m.input.Blur()
3340				m.mode, m.noteLoading, m.noteCursor = modeNoteBrowse, true, 0
3341				return m.beginNoteLoad(false)
3342			}
3343			input, cmd := m.input.Update(msg)
3344			m.input = input
3345			return m, cmd
3346	
3347		case modeNoteConfirmDelete:
3348			switch msg.String() {
3349			case "esc", "n":
3350				m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
3351			case "y", "Y":
3352				n, ok := m.currentNote()
3353				if !ok || m.actions.Notes.Delete == nil {
3354					m.mode = modeNoteBrowse
3355					return m, nil
3356				}
3357				return m, func() tea.Msg {
3358					status, err := m.actions.Notes.Delete(context.Background(), n)
3359					return noteActionMsg{status: status, returnBrowse: true, err: err}
3360				}
3361			}
3362			return m, nil
3363		}
3364		return m, nil
3365	}

3384	func (m Model) copyRepoValue(key string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3385		item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
3386		if !ok {
3387			m.mode = modeList
3388			return m, nil
3389		}
3390		checkoutIndex := -1
3391		if item.child() {
3392			checkoutIndex = item.CheckoutIndex
3393		}
3394	
3395		var payload, label string
3396		switch key {
3397		case "y":
3398			payload = inventory.FormatRepoContext(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
3399			if item.child() {
3400				label = "worktree context"
3401			} else {
3402				label = "repo context"
3403			}
3404		case "p":
3405			label = "checkout path"
3406			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
3407				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Worktree.Path
3408			} else {
3409				payload = item.Repo.Repo.Path
3410			}
3411		case "b":
3412			label = "branch"
3413			if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
3414				payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Branch()
3415			} else if main, found := item.Repo.Context.Main(); found {
3416				payload = main.Branch()
3417			} else {
3418				payload = item.Repo.Status.Branch
3419			}
3420			if payload == "" {
3421				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("selected checkout has detached HEAD")
3422				return m, nil
3423			}
3424		case "s":
3425			label = "runtime sessions"
3426			payload = inventory.FormatSessions(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
3427			if payload == "" {
3428				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no live runtime sessions to copy")
3429				return m, nil
3430			}
3431		case "w":
3432			label = "worktree paths"
3433			payload = inventory.LinkedWorktreePaths(item.Repo.Context)
3434			if payload == "" {
3435				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no linked worktrees to copy")
3436				return m, nil
3437			}
3438		default:
3439			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown copy key %q", key)
3440			return m, nil
3441		}
3442		return m.copyText(payload, label, true)
3443	}

3445	func (m Model) copyCapabilityValue(key string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3446		var payload, label string
3447		path, pathErr := m.capabilityFilePath()
3448		switch m.view {
3449		case ViewSkills:
3450			row, ok := m.currentSkill()
3451			if !ok {
3452				m.mode = modeList
3453				return m, nil
3454			}
3455			switch key {
3456			case "p":
3457				payload, label = path, "skill file path"
3458			case "s":
3459				payload, label = formatSkillSummary(row), "skill summary"
3460			case "u":
3461				if row.SourceURL == "" {
3462					m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no source URL", row.Name)
3463					return m, nil
3464				}
3465				payload, label = row.SourceURL, "skill source URL"
3466			case "f":
3467				return m.copyRawFile(path, pathErr, "raw skill file")
3468			default:
3469				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown skill copy key %q", key)
3470				return m, nil
3471			}
3472		case ViewMCP:
3473			row, ok := m.currentMCP()
3474			if !ok {
3475				m.mode = modeList
3476				return m, nil
3477			}
3478			switch key {
3479			case "p":
3480				payload, label = path, "MCP config path"
3481			case "s":
3482				payload, label = formatMCPSummary(row), "MCP declaration summary"
3483			case "f":
3484				return m.copyRawFile(path, pathErr, "raw MCP config file")
3485			default:
3486				m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown MCP copy key %q", key)
3487				return m, nil
3488			}
3489		}
3490		if pathErr != nil && key == "p" {
3491			m.mode, m.err = modeList, pathErr
3492			return m, nil
3493		}
3494		return m.copyText(payload, label, false)
3495	}

3497	func (m Model) copyRawFile(path string, pathErr error, label string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3498		m.mode = modeList
3499		if pathErr != nil {
3500			m.err = pathErr
3501			return m, nil
3502		}
3503		if m.actions.ReadFile == nil {
3504			m.err = fmt.Errorf("reading capability files is unavailable")
3505			return m, nil
3506		}
3507		if m.actions.Copy == nil {
3508			m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable")
3509			return m, nil
3510		}
3511		ctx := m.baseContext()
3512		return m, func() tea.Msg {
3513			payload, err := m.actions.ReadFile(ctx, path)
3514			if err != nil {
3515				return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", label, err)}
3516			}
3517			if err := m.actions.Copy(payload); err != nil {
3518				return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", label, err)}
3519			}
3520			return copyMsg{status: "copied " + label}
3521		}
3522	}
3523	
3524	func (m Model) copyText(payload, label string, repoFallback bool) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3525		m.mode = modeList
3526		if m.actions.Copy == nil {
3527			m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable")
3528			if repoFallback {
3529				m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable; use `dev repo context`")
3530			}
3531			return m, nil
3532		}
3533		return m, func() tea.Msg {
3534			if err := m.actions.Copy(payload); err != nil {
3535				if repoFallback {
3536					return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w; use `dev repo context` as a fallback", label, err)}
3537				}
3538				return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", label, err)}
3539			}
3540			return copyMsg{status: "copied " + label}
3541		}
3542	}

3570	func (m Model) updateStats(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3571		switch msg.String() {
3572		case "q", "ctrl+c":
3573			m.quitting = true
3574			return m, tea.Quit
3575		case "esc", "H":
3576			m.mode, m.stats, m.err, m.status = modeList, nil, nil, ""
3577			return m, nil
3578		case "r":
3579			repo := ""
3580			if m.stats != nil {
3581				repo = m.stats.Repo
3582			}
3583			if repo == "" {
3584				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
3585			}
3586			m.stats, m.status = nil, "loading activity…"
3587			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
3588		case "b":
3589			repo := ""
3590			if m.stats != nil {
3591				repo = m.stats.Repo
3592			}
3593			if repo == "" {
3594				repo = m.selectedRepoName()
3595			}
3596			if repo == "" || m.actions.BackfillStats == nil {
3597				return m, nil
3598			}
3599			m.status = "backfilling this repository from Git history…"
3600			return m, func() tea.Msg {
3601				err := m.actions.BackfillStats(context.Background(), repo)
3602				return statsBackfilledMsg{repo: repo, err: err}
3603			}
3604		}
3605		return m, nil
3606	}

3610		generation := m.loads[int(view)].generation
3611		m.loads[int(view)] = viewLoadState{generation: generation}
3612		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = nil
3613		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = ""
3614		switch view {
3615		case ViewSkills:

3617			m.skillCursor = 0
3618			m.skillsChecking = false
3619			m.skillsInventoryErr = nil

3627	func (m Model) toggleCapabilityScope() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3628		if m.capabilityScope == CapabilityAllRepositories {
3629			m.capabilityScope = CapabilityStartupContext
3630		} else {
3631			m.capabilityScope = CapabilityAllRepositories
3632		}
3633		m.resetCapabilityView(ViewSkills)
3634		m.resetCapabilityView(ViewMCP)
3635		m.err, m.status = nil, ""
3636	
3637		view := m.view
3638		m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
3639		if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(view); err != nil {
3640			state := m.viewLoad(view)
3641			m.applyViewResult(view, state.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
3642			return m, nil
3643		}
3644		if m.viewWaitsForRepos(view) {
3645			m.setViewStatus(view, "waiting for local repositories…")
3646			return m, nil
3647		}
3648		m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
3649		return m, m.reloadDependentView(view)
3650	}

3652	func (m Model) viewUsesRepos(view View) bool {
3653		switch view {
3654		case ViewFleet:
3655			return m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil
3656		case ViewSkills:
3657			return m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil
3658		case ViewMCP:
3659			return m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil
3660		default:
3661			return false
3662		}
3663	}
3664	
3665	func (m Model) viewWaitsForRepos(view View) bool {
3666		return m.viewUsesRepos(view) && m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading
3667	}
3668	
3669	func (m Model) dependentReposUnavailable(view View) error {
3670		if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
3671			return nil
3672		}
3673		repos := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
3674		if repos.loading || (repos.hasSnapshot && repos.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh) {
3675			return nil
3676		}

3709	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
3710		fresh := valid && err == nil
3711		var commands []tea.Cmd
3712		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
3713			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
3714				continue
3715			}
3716			state := m.viewLoad(view)
3717			if state.loading || m.view == view {
3718				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
3719				if fresh {
3720					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
3721					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
3722					continue
3723				}
3724				dependencyErr := err
3725				if dependencyErr == nil {
3726					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
3727				}
3728				current := m.viewLoad(view)
3729				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
3730				continue
3731			}
3732			if state.hasSnapshot {
3733				m.invalidateView(view)
3734			}
3735		}
3736		return batchCommands(commands...)
3737	}

3740	// first opened, so starting the dashboard never waits on the network, a forge
3741	// CLI, or Node tooling.

3809	func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3810		switch msg.String() {
3811		case "esc":
3812			m.mode = modeList
3813			m.input.Blur()
3814			m.filter = ""
3815			m.setAt(0)
3816			return m, nil
3817		case "enter":
3818			m.mode = modeList
3819			m.input.Blur()
3820			return m, nil
3821		}
3822		var cmd tea.Cmd
3823		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
3824		// Filtering live is the point: seeing the list narrow as you type is what
3825		// makes it faster than remembering an exact name.
3826		m.filter = m.input.Value()
3827		m.setAt(0)
3828		return m, cmd

3943	func (m Model) openSelected() tea.Cmd {
3944		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
3945			if err := taskOpenBlocker(row); err != nil {
3946				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: err} }
3947			}
3948			t := row.Task
3949			return func() tea.Msg {
3950				opened, err := m.actions.Open(context.Background(), t)
3951				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3952			}
3953		}
3954		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
3955			return func() tea.Msg {
3956				opened, err := m.actions.OpenRepo(context.Background(), r)
3957				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3958			}
3959		}
3960		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
3961			checkout, _ := item.checkout()
3962			dir := checkout.Worktree.Path
3963			return func() tea.Msg {
3964				if !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
3965					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("worktree checkout is missing or prunable: %s", dir)}
3966				}
3967				if m.actions.OpenCheckout == nil {
3968					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("opening linked worktrees is unavailable")}
3969				}
3970				opened, err := m.actions.OpenCheckout(context.Background(), item.Repo, checkout)
3971				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3972			}
3973		}
3974		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
3975			if !r.Present() {
3976				return func() tea.Msg {
3977					return tryActionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("Try %s is %s on this host", r.Item.DisplayName(), r.Where())}
3978				}
3979			}
3980			return m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: TryOpen, ID: r.Item.ID})
3981		}
3982		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
3983			if !r.Cloned() {
3984				return nil // c is the explicit clone action
3985			}
3986			return func() tea.Msg {
3987				opened, err := m.actions.OpenRemote(context.Background(), r)
3988				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3989			}
3990		}
3991		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil && m.actions.OpenFleet != nil {
3992			process, err := m.actions.OpenFleet(context.Background(), row)
3993			if err != nil {
3994				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: err} }
3995			}
3996			return tea.ExecProcess(process, func(err error) tea.Msg {
3997				if err != nil {
3998					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("fleet open: %w", err)}
3999				}
4000				return actionMsg{status: "returned from " + row.Host}
4001			})
4002		}
4003		return nil
4004	}

4006	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
4007	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
4008	// the dashboard is displaying.
4009	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
4010		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
4011			if t.Key != key {
4012				continue
4013			}
4014			if t.Probe != nil && t.Availability != ToolAvailable {
4015				detail := "availability is still being checked"
4016				if t.Availability == ToolUnavailable {
4017					detail = "is not installed"
4018				}
4019				return func() tea.Msg {
4020					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s %s", t.Command[0], detail)}
4021				}
4022			}
4023			dir := m.currentDir()
4024			if dir == "" {
4025				return func() tea.Msg {
4026					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
4027				}
4028			}
4029			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
4030			c.Dir = dir
4031			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
4032				if err != nil {
4033					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)}
4034				}
4035				return actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name, forceSizes: true}
4036			})
4037		}
4038		return nil
4039	}

4053	// Summary counts the task states, for the header line.
4054	func (m Model) Summary() string {
4055		counts := map[task.State]int{}
4056		for _, r := range m.rows {
4057			counts[r.Task.State]++
4058		}
4059		var parts []string
4060		for _, s := range task.States {
4061			if counts[s] > 0 {
4062				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s %d %s", s.Icon(), counts[s], s))
4063			}
4064		}
4065		repoCount := 0
4066		for _, row := range m.repos {
4067			if !row.IsTry() {
4068				repoCount++
4069			}
4070		}
4071		if repoCount > 0 {
4072			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d repos", repoCount))
4073		}
4074		if len(m.tries) > 0 {
4075			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d tries", len(m.tries)))
4076		}
4077		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
4078			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d remote", len(m.remotes)))
4079		}
4080		if count := m.fleetCount(); count > 0 {
4081			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d fleet", count))
4082		}
4083		if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).hasSnapshot {
4084			project, global := 0, 0
4085			for _, row := range m.skills {
4086				if row.Scope == agentskill.ScopeProject {
4087					project++
4088				} else if row.Scope == agentskill.ScopeGlobal {
4089					global++
4090				}
4091			}
4092			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%dP/%dG skills", project, global))
4093		}
4094		if m.viewLoad(ViewMCP).hasSnapshot {
4095			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d mcp", len(m.mcp)))
4096		}
4097		if len(parts) == 0 {
4098			return "no tasks"
4099		}
4100		return strings.Join(parts, "   ")
4101	}

 	}
+
+	drain := time.NewTimer(time.Second)
+	defer drain.Stop()
+drainOutput:
+	for {
+		select {
+		case chunk := <-chunks:
+			output.Write(chunk)
+		case <-readErr:
+			break drainOutput
+		case <-drain.C:
+			break drainOutput
+		}
+	}
+drainBuffered:
+	for {
+		select {
+		case chunk := <-chunks:
+			output.Write(chunk)
+		default:
+			break drainBuffered
+		}
+	}
+	for _, sequence := range [][]byte{[]byte("\x1b[?1002l"), []byte("\x1b[?1006l")} {
+		if !bytes.Contains(output.Bytes(), sequence) {
+			t.Fatalf("TUI exit did not disable mouse tracking %q:\n%s", sequence, output.Bytes())
+		}
+	}
 }

+func TestMCPWideLayoutCapsServerColumn(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []agentmcp.Declaration{
+		{Name: strings.Repeat("server", 10), Agent: agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode, Scope: agentmcp.ScopeProject, Transport: agentmcp.TransportStdio},
+	}
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, nil)
+	actions.ReloadMCP = func(context.Context, tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
+		return rows, nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, nil, nil)
+	m = send(m, tea.WindowSizeMsg{Width: 200, Height: 30})
+	m = send(m, key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"))
+
+	var header string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			header = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if header == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP header missing:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if got := lipgloss.Width(header); got != 126 {
+		t.Fatalf("wide MCP header width = %d, want 126 with a 32-cell SERVER cap:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+	if got := strings.Index(header, "TRANSPORT"); got > 82 {
+		t.Fatalf("TRANSPORT starts at cell %d; SERVER still absorbed wide-screen padding:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+
+	m = send(m, key("/"))
+	for _, msg := range typeText("server") {
+		m = send(m, msg)
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("enter"))
+	var filteredHeader string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			filteredHeader = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if lipgloss.Width(filteredHeader) != lipgloss.Width(header) {
+		t.Fatalf("filter shifted MCP columns:\nbefore: %s\nafter:  %s", header, filteredHeader)
+	}
+}

95	// configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
96	// it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
97	// which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
98	func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
99		path := app.configPath
100		if path == "" {
101			path = config.ConfigFile()
102		}
103		path = config.Expand(path)
104		created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, "", false, err
107		}
108		proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editor)
109		return proc, chosen, created, err
110	}
111	
112	func capabilityFileEditorProcess(path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
113		path = config.Expand(path)
114		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(path)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
117		}
118		if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
120		}
121		proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
122		return proc, err
123	}
124	
125	// ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
126	// Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
127	func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
128		info, err := os.Stat(path)
129		switch {
130		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
131			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
132		case err == nil:
133			return false, nil
134		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
135			return false, err
136		}
137		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
138			return false, err
139		}
140		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
141		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
142			return false, err
143		}
144		return true, nil
145	}
146	
147	func editorProcess(path, override string) (*exec.Cmd, string, error) {
148		chosen, err := resolveEditor(override)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, "", err
151		}
152		command := chosen + " " + shellQuote(path)
153		return exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", command), chosen, nil
154	}
155	
156	func resolveEditor(override string) (string, error) {
157		for _, candidate := range []string{override, os.Getenv("VISUAL"), os.Getenv("EDITOR")} {
158			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
159				return candidate, nil
160			}
161		}
162		for _, candidate := range []string{"nvim", "vim", "vi"} {
163			if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
164				return candidate, nil
165			}
166		}
167		return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
168	}

226	// Tool is one external program bound to a key in the dashboard.
227	type Tool struct {
228		// Key launches it. A single character, and not one of the dashboard's own
229		// bindings — dev reports a clash rather than silently shadowing.
230		Key string `toml:"key"`
231		// Name is shown in the footer.
232		Name string `toml:"name"`
233		// Run is a shell command, executed in the selected row's checkout.
234		Run string `toml:"run"`
235		// Interactive runs through $SHELL -lic, loading the user's rc file so a
236		// shell alias or function can be used. Off by default: startup files can
237		// print output and alter environment in ways an ordinary command should
238		// not inherit accidentally.
239		Interactive bool `toml:"interactive"`
240	}
241	
242	// reservedKeys are the dashboard's own bindings. A tool cannot take one,
243	// because losing the ability to quit or move is not a trade anyone wants.
244	var reservedKeys = map[string]string{
245		"q": "quit", "j": "down", "k": "up", "g": "top", "G": "bottom",
246		"h": "previous view", "l": "next view", "tab": "next view",
247		"/": "filter", "r": "refresh", "o": "open", "p": "park",
248		"c": "edit next action", "s": "start a worktree task", "d": "start a direct task",
249		"a": "include hidden history", "A": "capability scope", "n": "new Try / add repo note", "N": "browse repo notes", " ": "context actions",
250		"0": "clear filters", "1": "hot", "2": "warm", "3": "cold",
251		"?": "help", "H": "repo activity heatmap", "e": "edit config",
252		"O": "cycle repo sort", "R": "reverse repo sort",
253		"m": "edit repo metadata", "y": "copy repo metadata",
254	}
255	
256	// ReservedKey reports the dashboard binding a key would collide with.
257	func ReservedKey(key string) (string, bool) {
258		name, ok := reservedKeys[key]
259		return name, ok
260	}
261	
262	// DefaultTools are the programs bound when nothing is configured. They are
263	// written out in full by `dev config init` rather than left implicit, so what
264	// is bound is visible rather than something to discover by pressing keys.
265	func DefaultTools() []Tool {
266		return []Tool{
267			{Key: "L", Name: "lazygit", Run: "lazygit"},
268			{Key: "Y", Name: "yazi", Run: "yazi"},
269			{Key: "E", Name: "editor", Run: "$EDITOR ."},
270			{Key: "S", Name: "shell", Run: "$SHELL"},
271		}
272	}
273	
274	// EffectiveTools returns the configured tools, or the defaults when none are
275	// configured. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely — a partial
276	// merge would make it unclear which bindings are in effect.
277	func (c Config) EffectiveTools() []Tool {
278		if len(c.TUI.Tools) == 0 {
279			return DefaultTools()
280		}
281		return c.TUI.Tools
282	}

156	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
157		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
158			short := map[View]string{
159				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
160				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
161			}
162			var builder strings.Builder
163			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
164			builder.WriteString(prefix)
165			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
166			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
167			for index, view := range Views {
168				if index > 0 {
169					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
170					builder.WriteString(separator)
171					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
172				}
173				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
174				if compact {
175					name = short[view]
176				}
177				label := name

179					label = " " + name + " "
180				}
181				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
182				if view == m.view {
183					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
184				}
185				from := x
186				builder.WriteString(rendered)
187				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
188				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
189			}
190			if summary {
191				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
192			}
193			if m.filter != "" {
194				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
195			}
196			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
197		}
198	
199		layout := build(false, true)
200		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
201			layout = build(false, false)
202		}
203		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
204			layout = build(true, false)
205		}
206		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
207			return layout
208		}
209	
210		prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
211		name := strings.ToUpper(m.view.String())
212		line := prefix + styleSelected.Render(name)
213		layout = headerLayout{
214			line: line,
215			tabs: []tabHit{{view: m.view, from: lipgloss.Width(prefix), to: lipgloss.Width(line)}},
216		}
217		if m.filter != "" {
218			available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(layout.line) - 4
219			if available > 1 {
220				layout.line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
221			}
222		}
223		return layout
224	}

230	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
231	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
232	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
233		h := m.listHeight()
234		if n <= h {
235			return 0, n
236		}
237		from = m.at() - h/2
238		if from < 0 {
239			from = 0
240		}
241		if from+h > n {
242			from = n - h
243		}
244		return from, from + h
245	}

423	// New builds the dashboard.
424	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
425		in := textinput.New()
426		in.CharLimit = 200
427		cloneSpinner := spinner.MiniDot
428		cloneSpinner.FPS = 200 * time.Millisecond
429	
430		m := Model{
431			actions:            actions,
432			rows:               rows,
433			repos:              repos,
434			input:              in,
435			remoteCloneSpinner: spinner.New(spinner.WithSpinner(cloneSpinner)),
436			width:              100,
437			height:             30,
438			firstViewReady:     make(chan struct{}),
439			firstViewOnce:      &sync.Once{},
440		}
441		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
442			m.toolGeneration = 1
443		}
444		if rows != nil {
445			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
446		}
447		if repos != nil {
448			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
449		}
450		return m
451	}
452	
453	// WithTrace observes performance boundaries without controlling model state.
454	func (m Model) WithTrace(trace *perftrace.Recorder) Model {
455		m.trace = trace
456		return m
457	}
458	
459	// WithContext bounds asynchronous read/probe commands to one dashboard run.
460	func (m Model) WithContext(ctx context.Context) Model {
461		m.runContext = ctx
462		return m
463	}
464	
465	// WithRemotes seeds the lazy forge view from a fresh on-disk cache. The first
466	// switch is then instant; r still refreshes explicitly.
467	func (m Model) WithRemotes(rows []RemoteRow) Model {
468		m.replaceRemotes(rows)
469		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRemote, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
470		return m
471	}
472	
473	// WithFleet seeds cached fleet rows while the first live refresh remains lazy.
474	func (m Model) WithFleet(rows []FleetRow) Model {
475		m.fleet = rows
476		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewFleet, perftrace.SourceCache, perftrace.FreshnessStale, true)
477		return m
478	}
479	
480	// WithRemotesStale marks seeded rows for background refresh on first visit.
481	func (m Model) WithRemotesStale(stale bool) Model {
482		if stale {
483			m.loads[int(ViewRemote)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
484		}
485		return m
486	}
487	
488	// WithTries seeds the Try view, primarily for tests and embedded callers. The
489	// production dashboard loads it with the other local inventories in Init.
490	func (m Model) WithTries(rows []TryRow) Model {
491		m.tries = rows
492		m.matchRemoteLocals()
493		m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTries, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
494		return m
495	}
496	
497	// BeginLoading makes Init load task, repository, and Try data asynchronously. This lets
498	// the alternate screen appear immediately instead of blocking on dozens of Git
499	// probes before Bubble Tea starts.
500	func (m Model) BeginLoading() Model {
501		m.initialLoad = true
502		m.beginLocalLoads(loadInitial)
503		return m
504	}
505	
506	// Chosen reports a directory the caller should cd into after the program
507	// exits, or "" when there is none.
508	func (m Model) Chosen() string { return m.chosen }
509	
510	// Activation reports the runtime handle to switch/attach after the dashboard
511	// has restored the terminal, or "" when the user quit normally.
512	func (m Model) Activation() string { return m.activate }
513	
514	// CurrentView reports which list is showing.
515	func (m Model) CurrentView() View { return m.view }
516	
517	// CapabilityScope reports whether SKILLS and MCP are scoped to the startup
518	// context or all accepted repositories.
519	func (m Model) CapabilityScope() CapabilityScope { return m.capabilityScope }
520	
521	// Init implements tea.Model.
522	func (m Model) Init() tea.Cmd {
523		commands := []tea.Cmd{textinput.Blink}
524		if m.initialLoad {
525			commands = append(commands, m.reload())
526		}
527		if len(m.actions.Tools) > 0 {
528			commands = append(commands, m.probeTools())
529		}
530		if m.actions.LoadRemoteCache != nil {
531			commands = append(commands, m.loadRemoteCache())
532		}
533		if m.actions.LoadFleetCache != nil {
534			commands = append(commands, m.loadFleetCache())
535		}
536		if m.actions.AfterFirstView != nil {
537			commands = append(commands, m.runAfterFirstView())
538		}
539		return tea.Batch(commands...)
540	}

2847	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2848		n := m.count()
2849		page := m.listHeight() / 2
2850		if page < 1 {
2851			page = 1
2852		}
2853	
2854		if m.remoteClone.active() {
2855			if msg.String() == "q" || msg.String() == "ctrl+c" {
2856				if !m.remoteClone.canceling {
2857					m.remoteClone.canceling = true
2858					if m.remoteClone.cancel != nil {
2859						m.remoteClone.cancel()
2860					}
2861				}
2862				return m, nil
2863			}
2864			switch msg.String() {
2865			case "j", "down", "ctrl+n", "k", "up", "ctrl+p",
2866				"ctrl+d", "pgdown", "ctrl+u", "pgup", "g", "home", "G", "end",
2867				"tab", "l", "right", "shift+tab", "h", "left", "/", "0":
2868				// Navigation and filtering remain available while the mutation runs.
2869			case "esc":
2870				if m.filter == "" && len(m.states) == 0 {
2871					return m, nil
2872				}
2873			default:
2874				return m, nil
2875			}
2876		}
2877	
2878		switch msg.String() {
2879		case "q", "ctrl+c":
2880			m.quitting = true
2881			return m, tea.Quit
2882		case "esc":
2883			// One escape clears whatever narrowing is in effect before quitting
2884			// becomes the meaning of the key.
2885			if m.filter != "" || len(m.states) > 0 {
2886				m.filter, m.states = "", nil
2887				m.setAt(0)
2888				return m, nil
2889			}
2890			m.quitting = true
2891			return m, tea.Quit
2892	
2893		// Vim-style movement, with the arrow equivalents alongside.
2894		case "j", "down", "ctrl+n":
2895			m.setAt(m.at() + 1)
2896		case "k", "up", "ctrl+p":
2897			m.setAt(m.at() - 1)
2898		case "ctrl+d", "pgdown":
2899			m.setAt(m.at() + page)
2900		case "ctrl+u", "pgup":
2901			m.setAt(m.at() - page)
2902		case "g", "home":
2903			m.setAt(0)
2904		case "G", "end":
2905			m.setAt(n - 1)
2906	
2907		// View switching. h/l double as left/right between views, since a list has
2908		// no horizontal axis of its own.
2909		case "tab", "l", "right":
2910			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+1)%len(Views)]
2911			return m.afterViewSwitch()
2912		case "shift+tab", "h", "left":
2913			m.view = Views[(int(m.view)+len(Views)-1)%len(Views)]

2915	
2916		case "/":

23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

+	m.loads[int(view)] = viewLoadState{generation: generation}

+func capabilityFileEditorProcess(path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
+	path = config.Expand(path)
+	file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
+	}
+	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
+	}
+	proc, _, err := editorProcess(path, "")
+	return proc, err
+}

423	// New builds the dashboard.
424	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
425		in := textinput.New()
426		in.CharLimit = 200
427		cloneSpinner := spinner.MiniDot
428		cloneSpinner.FPS = 200 * time.Millisecond
429	
430		m := Model{
431			actions:            actions,
432			rows:               rows,
433			repos:              repos,
434			input:              in,
435			remoteCloneSpinner: spinner.New(spinner.WithSpinner(cloneSpinner)),
436			width:              100,
437			height:             30,
438			firstViewReady:     make(chan struct{}),
439			firstViewOnce:      &sync.Once{},
440		}
441		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
442			m.toolGeneration = 1
443		}
444		if rows != nil {
445			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
446		}
447		if repos != nil {
448			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
449		}
450		return m
451	}

482	func applyBundledIntegrity(row *Skill) {

493			row.Installations[index].Integrity = status

495			if status == IntegrityDrifted {

497				row.IntegrityDetail = detail
498			} else if status == IntegrityUnknown && row.Integrity != IntegrityDrifted {

505	func bundledIntegrity(directory string, files map[string][]byte) (Integrity, string) {
506		for relative, want := range files {
507			got, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), filepath.Join(directory, relative), int64(len(want))+1)
508			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
509				return IntegrityDrifted, "bundled skill differs; run `dev skill install`"
510			}
511		}
512		return IntegrityVerified, "all embedded files match this dev binary"
513	}

520		}
521		if integrity == IntegrityDrifted {
522			return UpdateAvailable, detail
523		}
524		return UpdateFailed, detail

241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||

143	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
144	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
145	
146	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
147	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
148	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
149	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
150		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
151		for _, found := range repositories {
152			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
153				targets = append(targets, target)
154			}
155		}
156		return Dedupe(targets)
157	}
158	
159	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
160	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
161	
162	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
163	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
164	// other target builders.
165	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
166		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
167		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
168			current = ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)
169			out = append(out, current)
170		}
171		return Dedupe(out)
172	}
173	
174	// ReconcileCurrent preserves the exact current checkout while applying the
175	// canonical repository's configured navigation identity when it is known.
176	func ReconcileCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) Target {
177		for _, target := range targets {
178			if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
179				current.RepoName = target.RepoName
180				current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
181				current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
182				if comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot) == comparablePath(current.CheckoutRoot) {
183					current.CheckoutRoot = target.CheckoutRoot
184				}
185				break
186			}
187		}
188		return current
189	}
190	
191	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
192	// concrete main-checkout targets.
193	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
194		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
199	}
200	
201	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
202	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
203	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
204		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
205		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
206		for _, target := range targets {
207			key := target.Key()
208			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
209				continue
210			}
211			seen[key] = struct{}{}
212			out = append(out, target)
213		}
214		Sort(out)
215		return out
216	}
217	
218	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
219	func Sort(targets []Target) {
220		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
221			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
222			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
223			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
224				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
225			}
226			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
227				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
228			}
229			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
230				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
231			}
232			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
233				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
234			}
235			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
236				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
237			}
238			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
239		})

41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))

53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {

55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}

70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))

75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {

94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}

100		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
101			return lines
102		}
103		return append(lines, label+": "+value)
104	}

1	package tui
2	
3	import tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
4	
5	const mouseWheelRows = 3
6	
7	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
8		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
9		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
10			return m, nil
11		}
12		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
13			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
14		}
15		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
16			return m, nil
17		}
18	
19		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
20			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
21				return m, nil
22			}
23			delta := mouseWheelRows
24			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
25				delta = -delta
26			}
27			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
28			return m, nil
29		}
30		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
31			return m, nil
32		}
33	
34		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
35			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
36				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
37					continue
38				}
39				if m.view == hit.view {
40					return m, nil
41				}
42				m.view = hit.view
43				return m.afterViewSwitch()
44			}
45			return m, nil
46		}
47	
48		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
49		if !ok {
50			return m, nil
51		}
52		switch event.Button {
53		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
54			m.setAt(row)
55		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
56			m.setAt(row)
57			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
58				m = m.openActionMenu()
59			}
60		}
61		return m, nil
62	}
63	
64	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
65		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
66			return 0, false
67		}
68		count := m.count()
69		from, to := m.window(count)
70		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
71		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
72			return 0, false
73		}
74		return from + y - first, true
75	}
76	
77	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
78		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
79			return false
80		}
81		from, to := m.window(m.count())
82		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
83		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
84	}
85	
86	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
87		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
88			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
89				return m, nil
90			}
91			delta := 1
92			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
93				delta = -1
94			}
95			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
96			return m, nil
97		}
98		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
99			return m, nil
100		}
101		first := 4
102		if m.overlay.detail != "" {
103			first++
104		}
105		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
106			m.overlay = overlayState{}
107			return m, nil
108		}
109		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
110		return m.runOverlayAction()
111	}

1	# Context
2	
3	The dashboard is keyboard-first today, so a user cannot click a visible tab or row and there is no common row-action surface. SKILLS and MCP correctly default to the exact startup context, but there is no session-level way to inspect every repository; MCP also lets the `SERVER` column consume all extra terminal width, which pushes `TRANSPORT`, `STATE`, and `SOURCE` far away on wide screens. Finally, capability rows expose configuration paths but cannot open or copy those files.
4	
5	Add mouse input as an enhancement without weakening keyboard behavior, keep startup-context capability discovery as the default, offer a shared context/all toggle, compact MCP’s table, and give SKILLS/MCP explicit local-file open/copy actions. Per the requested local-tool behavior, raw configuration copying is supported as an explicit action; it never uploads or contacts a server, but the UI/docs will note that the entire file may contain credentials and enters the system clipboard.
6	
7	## 1. Add shared mouse geometry and dispatch
8	
9	- Start the dashboard with `tea.WithMouseCellMotion()` beside `tea.WithAltScreen()` in `internal/cli/tui.go`. This supports clicks, releases, drag, and wheel without enabling noisy all-motion tracking; Bubble Tea restores terminal mouse state on exit.
10	- Add focused mouse logic in a new `internal/tui/mouse.go` and route `tea.MouseMsg` from `Model.Update` with the same precedence as keyboard input:
11	  - active note/input/help/form/confirmation/stat/copy modes do not pass clicks through to the list;
12	  - the common action menu handles its own clicks and wheel;
13	  - an active clone still permits tab switching, row selection, and wheel navigation, but not context actions.
14	- Define the interaction contract:
15	  - unmodified left-button press on a rendered tab switches directly to it and calls existing `afterViewSwitch` so lazy loading and cursor clamping remain intact;
16	  - unmodified left-button press on a visible data row selects only;
17	  - unmodified right-button press selects the row and opens its action menu;
18	  - wheel up/down over the list body moves three rows through existing `setAt`; horizontal wheel, motion, releases, extra buttons, and modified clicks are ignored;
19	  - do not infer double-clicks or open rows on click—Enter/`o` and menu actions remain the explicit activation paths.
20	- Refactor `internal/tui/view.go:renderHeader` into one pure header-layout helper returning both the rendered line and visible tab cell spans. Compute spans with `lipgloss.Width` so full, summary-free, compact, and current-tab-only layouts cannot drift from hit testing.
21	- Derive row hitboxes from existing `listPreambleLines`, `listHeight`, and `window` results. Map only rendered data rows (`2 + listPreambleLines()` onward) back to `window.from + offset`; reject the header, loading banner, scroll note, detail, and footer. Do not persist coordinates from a prior `View`, so resize/filter/load changes recompute geometry from current model state.
22	
23	## 2. Generalize the row action menu for every tab
24	
25	- Evolve the Try-only menu in `internal/tui/overlay.go` into a generic full-screen row action overlay while retaining the existing form/confirmation overlays.
26	- Represent menu entries with a small `listAction` enum and fixed-size value arrays in `overlayState`; do not store closures, maps, or shared mutable slices in the value-copied Bubble Tea model.
27	- Pin the menu to a `selectionToken` containing the view and a stable row identity (task ID; canonical repo plus checkout path; host plus repo path; Try catalog ID; existing remote identity; Skill scope/checkout/path/name; MCP agent/scope/config path/project/plugin/name). Re-resolve before execution and fail closed if a refresh removed or changed the target instead of acting on the current cursor index.
28	- Extract menu-visible behavior from `updateList` into a shared `runListAction(actionID)` dispatcher. Keyboard bindings and right-click choices call the same action implementation; mouse code must not invoke domain callbacks directly or synthesize key messages.
29	- Build each menu from actions that are actually legal for that row, omitting unavailable choices rather than rendering misleading disabled entries. Reuse the existing operations across all tabs: open, notes/task lifecycle, worktree expansion/metadata/start/copy/stats, fleet open, Try lifecycle, remote clone/open, Skill add/check/update/config actions, and MCP config actions. Destructive or multi-step actions continue through their existing prompt/form/confirmation flow.
30	- In the menu, left-clicking an option selects and executes it, wheel moves the menu cursor by one, clicking outside closes it, and all keyboard `j/k`, Enter, and Escape behavior remains available.
31	
32	## 3. Add a shared SKILLS/MCP context/all scope
33	
34	- Add an exported value enum in `internal/tui` (startup context vs all repositories) and a `capabilityScope` field on `Model`, defaulting to startup context.
35	- Change `Actions.ReloadSkills`, `ReloadSkillsWithRepos`, `ReloadMCP`, and `ReloadMCPWithRepos` to receive that scope. Capture it in `reloadSkills`, `reloadUpdatedSkill`, and `reloadMCP` so every producer is bound to the generation and scope that started it.
36	- Bind uppercase `A` in both SKILLS and MCP to toggle the shared session-only scope; lowercase `a` remains Skill installation. Show `A scope:context` or `A scope:all` in both footers/help and reserve `A` in `internal/config/config.go` so an external tool cannot shadow it.
37	- On toggle, cancel and generation-bump both capability loads, clear old-scope rows/errors/warnings/check state and reset both cursors. Immediately load the current capability view; leave the other invalidated so it preserves existing lazy-load behavior and loads under the new scope when visited. If REPOS is still loading, use the existing waiting path; if it failed terminally, surface that dependency error. Late results from the old scope must be rejected by existing generation checks.
38	- Extend `internal/cli/tui.go:tuiCapabilityTargets` with scope policy:
