3739	// afterViewSwitch lazily loads optional inventories only when their view is
3740	// first opened, so starting the dashboard never waits on the network, a forge
3741	// CLI, or Node tooling.
3742	func (m Model) afterViewSwitch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3743		m.setAt(m.at())
3744		switch m.view {
3745		case ViewFleet:
3746			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewFleet) {
3747				m.beginViewLoad(ViewFleet, loadVisit)
3748				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewFleet); err != nil {
3749					fleet := m.viewLoad(ViewFleet)
3750					m.applyViewResult(ViewFleet, fleet.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
3751					return m, nil
3752				}
3753				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewFleet) {
3754					m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "waiting for local repositories…")
3755					return m, nil
3756				}
3757				m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "loading configured dev hosts…")
3758				return m, m.reloadFleet()
3759			}
3760		case ViewRemote:
3761			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewRemote) {
3762				m.beginViewLoad(ViewRemote, loadVisit)
3763				m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "refreshing remote repositories…")
3764				return m, m.reloadRemote()
3765			}
3766		case ViewSkills:
3767			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewSkills) {
3768				m.beginViewLoad(ViewSkills, loadVisit)
3769				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewSkills); err != nil {
3770					state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
3771					m.applyViewResult(ViewSkills, state.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
3772					return m, nil

3777				}

3809	func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3810		switch msg.String() {

3812			m.mode = modeList
3813			m.input.Blur()
3814			m.filter = ""
3815			m.setAt(0)
3816			return m, nil
3817		case "enter":
3818			m.mode = modeList
3819			m.input.Blur()
3820			return m, nil
3821		}
3822		var cmd tea.Cmd
3823		m.input, cmd = m.input.Update(msg)
3824		// Filtering live is the point: seeing the list narrow as you type is what
3825		// makes it faster than remembering an exact name.
3826		m.filter = m.input.Value()
3827		m.setAt(0)
3828		return m, cmd

707	func traceOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
708		switch {

711		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
712			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
713		default:

722	func batchCommands(commands ...tea.Cmd) tea.Cmd {
723		filtered := commands[:0]
724		for _, command := range commands {
725			if command != nil {
726				filtered = append(filtered, command)
727			}
728		}
729		switch len(filtered) {
730		case 0:
731			return nil
732		case 1:
733			return filtered[0]
734		default:
735			return tea.Batch(filtered...)
736		}
737	}

781	func (m Model) probeTools() tea.Cmd {
782		generation := m.toolGeneration
783		tools := append([]Tool(nil), m.actions.Tools...)
784		ctx := m.baseContext()
785		return func() tea.Msg {
786			finish := m.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProducerTools, perftrace.Fields{Generation: generation})
787			jobs := make(chan int, len(tools))
788			for index := range tools {
789				jobs <- index
790			}
791			close(jobs)
792			var workers sync.WaitGroup
793			for range min(2, len(tools)) {
794				workers.Go(func() {
795					for index := range jobs {
796						available := true
797						if tools[index].Probe != nil {
798							available = tools[index].Probe(ctx)
799						}
800						if ctx.Err() != nil {
801							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnknown
802						} else if available {
803							tools[index].Availability = ToolAvailable
804						} else {
805							tools[index].Availability = ToolUnavailable
806						}
807					}
808				})
809			}
810			workers.Wait()
811			finish(traceOutcome(ctx.Err()))
812			return toolsMsg{generation: generation, tools: tools}
813		}
814	}

23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())

32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.

34			h--
35		}

37	}

301		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
302		if len(items) == 0 {
303			if m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading {
304				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
305			}
306			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
307				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
308		}
309		columns := m.repoColumns()
310	
311		var b strings.Builder
312		var headers []string
313		for _, c := range columns {
314			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
315		}
316		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
317	
318		from, to := m.window(len(items))
319		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
320			item := items[i]
321			r := item.Repo
322			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
323			for _, c := range columns {
324				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
325			}
326			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
327			styled := line
328			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
329				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
330					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
331				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
332					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
333					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
334				}
335			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
336				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
337			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
338				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
339			}
340			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
341		}
342		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
343		return b.String()
344	}

346	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
347		r := item.Repo
348		checkout, child := item.checkout()
349		if !child {
350			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
351				marker := "▸ "
352				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
353					marker = "▾ "
354				}
355				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
356			}
357			if name == "live" {
358				return parentLiveColumn(r)
359			}
360			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
361		}
362	
363		switch name {
364		case "repo":
365			connector := "├─ "
366			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
367				connector = "└─ "
368			}
369			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
370			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
371				label = checkout.Branch()
372			}
373			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
374				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
375			}
376			return connector + label
377		case "branch":
378			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
379				return branch
380			}
381			return "(detached)"
382		case "git":
383			switch {
384			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
385				return "prunable"
386			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
387				return "locked"
388			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
389				return "?"
390			default:
391				return checkout.Status.Summary()
392			}
393		case "live":
394			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
395		case "latest":
396			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
397		case "worktrees":
398			return "—"
399		case "tasks":
400			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
401				return "?"
402			}
403			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
404		case "notes":
405			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
406				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
407			}
408			return "—"
409		case "category":
410			return "—"
411		case "path":
412			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413		}
414		return ""
415	}
416	
417	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
418		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
419			return "?"
420		}
421		sessions := r.Sessions()
422		if len(sessions) == 0 {
423			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
424		}
425		if len(sessions) > 1 {
426			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
427		}
428		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
429		if status != "" {
430			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
431		}
432		return r.Runtime
433	}
434	
435	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
436		if runtimeErr != nil {
437			return "?"
438		}
439		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
440			return "closed"
441		}
442		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
443			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
444		}
445		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
446			return runtimeName + ":" + status
447		}
448		return runtimeName
449	}
450	
451	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
452		if len(tasks) == 0 {
453			return "—"
454		}
455		counts := map[task.State]int{}
456		for _, t := range tasks {
457			counts[t.State]++
458		}
459		var parts []string
460		for _, state := range task.States {
461			if counts[state] > 0 {
462				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
463			}
464		}
465		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
466	}
467	
468	type repoColumnSpec struct {
469		name, header string
470		width, min   int
471	}
472	
473	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
474		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
475		if len(names) == 0 {
476			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
477		}
478		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
479			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
480			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
481			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
482			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
483			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
484			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
485			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
486			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
487			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
488			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
489			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
490			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
491		}
492		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
493		for _, name := range names {
494			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
495				columns = append(columns, c)
496			}
497		}
498		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
499		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
500		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
501		for _, c := range columns {
502			total += c.width
503		}
504		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
505			for i := range columns {
506				if columns[i].name != preferred {
507					continue
508				}
509				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
510				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
511				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
512				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
513					columns[i].width--
514					total--
515				}
516			}
517			if total <= m.width {
518				break
519			}
520		}
521		return columns
522	}
523	
524	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
525		switch name {
526		case "repo":
527			return r.Repo.Display()
528		case "branch":
529			if r.Repo.Bare {
530				return "(bare)"
531			}
532			return r.Status.Branch
533		case "git":
534			if r.Repo.Bare {
535				return "—"
536			}
537			return r.Status.Summary()
538		case "remote":
539			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
540				return "?"
541			}
542			return r.Topology.Summary()
543		case "size":
544			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
545		case "live":
546			if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
547				return "?"
548			}
549			if !r.Live {
550				return "—"
551			}
552			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
553				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
554			}
555			return r.Runtime
556		case "latest":
557			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
558		case "worktrees":
559			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
560				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
561			}
562			return "—"
563		case "tasks":
564			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
565				return "?"
566			}
567			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
568				return tasks
569			}
570			return "—"
571		case "notes":
572			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
573				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
574			}
575			return "—"
576		case "category":
577			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
578				return r.Repo.Category
579			}
580			return "—"
581		case "path":
582			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
583		}
584		return ""
585	}
586	
587	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
588		if at.IsZero() {
589			return "—"
590		}
591		d := time.Since(at)
592		switch {
593		case d < time.Hour:
594			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
595		case d < 24*time.Hour:
596			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
597		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
598			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
599		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
600			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
601		default:
602			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
603		}
604	}
605	
606	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
607		s = pad(s, width)
608		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
609			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
610		}
611		return s
612	}

614	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
615		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
616			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
617		}
618		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
619		if len(rows) == 0 {
620			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
621				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
622			}
623			if m.filter != "" {
624				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
625			}
626			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
627		}
628		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
629		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
630		if descW < 12 {
631			descW = 12
632		}
633	
634		var b strings.Builder
635		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
636			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
637		}
638		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
639			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
640		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
641		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
642			r := rows[i]
643			pending := m.remoteCloneTargets(r)
644			local := "—"
645			if pending {
646				local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " repo"
647				if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRunning {
648					local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " clone"
649				}
650			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
651				local = "inspect"
652			} else if r.Cloned() {
653				local = "yes"
654				if r.LocalKind != "" {
655					local = string(r.LocalKind)
656					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
657						local = "repo"
658					}
659				}
660			}
661			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
662			if vis == "" {
663				vis = "—"
664			}
665			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
666				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
667				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
668			styled := line
669			if r.Cloned() || pending {
670				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
671			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
672				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
673			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
674				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
675			}
676			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
677		}
678		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
679		return b.String()
680	}

682	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
683		rows := m.visibleFleet()
684		if len(rows) == 0 {
685			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
686				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
687			}
688			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
689				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
690			}
691			if !m.showLocalFleet {
692				for _, row := range m.fleet {
693					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
694						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
695					}
696				}
697			}
698			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
699		}
700		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
701		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
702		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
703		if pathW < 12 {
704			pathW = 12
705		}
706		var b strings.Builder
707		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
708			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
709		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
710		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
711			row := rows[i]
712			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
713			if row.Repository != nil {
714				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
715				if row.Repository.Live {
716					live = row.Repository.Runtime
717					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
718						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
719					}
720				}
721				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
722			}
723			state := string(row.State)
724			if row.FromCache {
725				state = "stale"
726			}
727			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
728				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
729				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
730			styled := line
731			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
732				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
733			} else if row.State != "ok" {
734				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
735			}
736			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
737		}
738		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
739		return b.String()
740	}
741	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {
742		state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
743		rows := m.visibleSkills()
744		if state.loading && len(m.skills) == 0 {
745			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading agent skills…") + "\n"
746		}
747		if len(rows) == 0 {
748			if !state.hasSnapshot {
749				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Agent skills load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
750			}
751			if m.filter != "" {
752				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
753			}
754			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skills found. Press a to open the installer.") + "\n"
755		}
756	
757		var headers []string
758		var values func(agentskill.Skill) []string
759		switch {
760		case m.width >= 110:
761			repoW, scopeW, skillW, installW, updateW, agentW := 16, 7, 20, 9, 10, 20
762			sourceW := max(12, m.width-96)
763			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW), fitCell("SOURCE", sourceW)}
764			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
765				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW), fitCell(skillSource(row), sourceW)}
766			}
767		case m.width >= 82:
768			repoW, scopeW, installW, updateW := 16, 7, 9, 10
769			flex := max(28, m.width-54)
770			skillW, agentW := flex/2, flex-flex/2
771			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW)}
772			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
773				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW)}
774			}
775		default:
776			repoW, updateW := 14, 10
777			skillW := max(12, m.width-30)
778			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW)}
779			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
780				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW)}
781			}
782		}
783	
784		var b strings.Builder
785		if state.loading {
786			message := "Showing installed skills while refreshing…"
787			if m.skillsChecking {
788				message = "Showing installed skills while checking sources…"
789			}
790			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render(message) + "\n")
791		}
792		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
793		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
794		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
795			row := rows[i]
796			line := strings.Join(values(row), "  ")
797			styled := line
798			switch row.UpdateStatus {
799			case agentskill.UpdateAvailable, agentskill.UpdateMissing, agentskill.UpdateFailed:
800				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
801			case agentskill.UpdateCurrent:
802				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
803			case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
804				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
805			}
806			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
807		}
808		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
809		return b.String()
810	}

812	func skillInstallState(row agentskill.Skill) string {
813		if row.Presence == agentskill.PresenceMissing {
814			return "missing"
815		}
816		switch row.Integrity {
817		case agentskill.IntegrityVerified:
818			return "verified"
819		case agentskill.IntegrityDrifted:
820			return "drifted"
821		default:
822			return "present"
823		}
824	}

826	func (m Model) mcpServerWidth(minimum, available int) int {

828		for _, row := range m.mcp {

830		}
831		maximum := max(minimum, min(32, available))
832		return clamp(preferred, minimum, maximum)

1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}
76

239	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
240	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
242			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
243			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
244			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||

249			return false
250		}
251		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
252			return false
253		}
254		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
255			return false
256		}
257		return true
258	}

262		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))

265				out = append(out, row)
266			}
267		}

277			for n := range ak {
278				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
279					return ak[n] < bk[n]
280				}
281			}

187			})

190		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
191		count := rows
192		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
193			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
194			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,

201	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
202	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
203	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
204		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
205	
206		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
207		if generation != state.generation {
208			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
209				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
210				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
211			})
212			return false
213		}
214	
215		state.loading = false
216		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
217		state.outcome = outcome
218		if valid {
219			state.hasSnapshot = true
220			state.source = source
221			state.freshness = freshness
222			state.actionable = actionable
223			count := rows
224			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
225				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
226				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
227				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
228			})
229		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
230			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
231		}
232		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
233		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
234			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
235			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
236			Generation: generation,
237		})
238		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
239			cancel()
240			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
241			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
242		}
243		return true
244	}

247		if err != nil {

249		}
250		return perftrace.FreshnessFresh
251	}

253	func resultOutcome(valid bool, err error) perftrace.Outcome {
254		switch {
255		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
256			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
257		case err != nil && valid:
258			return perftrace.OutcomePartial
259		case err != nil || !valid:
260			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
261		default:
262			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
263		}
264	}

276		return !state.hasSnapshot || state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessStale || state.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeFailed
277	}

1326	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {

1426	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
1427		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1428		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1429			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1430			if structured {
1431				var field string
1432				switch key {
1433				case "repo":
1434					field = row.Repository
1435				case "agent":
1436					field = string(row.Agent)
1437				case "scope":
1438					field = string(row.Scope)
1439				case "transport":
1440					field = string(row.Transport)
1441				case "managed":
1442					field = string(row.Source)
1443				case "state":
1444					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1445				default:
1446					field = ""
1447				}
1448				if field != "" {
1449					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1450						return false
1451					}
1452					continue
1453				}
1454			}
1455			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1456				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1457				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1458				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1459			}, " "))
1460			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1461				return false
1462			}
1463		}
1464		return true
1465	}

1483				return -1
1484			case x < y:
1485				return 1
1486			default:
1487				return 0
1488			}
1489		}

1492				return 0
1493			}

1496			}

1498		}

1500			if a.LastActivity.Equal(b.LastActivity) {
1501				return 0
1502			}
1503			if a.LastActivity.After(b.LastActivity) {
1504				return -1
1505			}
1506			return 1
1507		}
1508	
1509		switch sortBy {
1510		case "name":
1511			return nameCmp
1512		case "latest":
1513			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1514				return c
1515			}
1516		case "git":
1517			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1518				return c
1519			}
1520			if c := descInt(a.Status.Changed, b.Status.Changed); c != 0 {
1521				return c
1522			}
1523		case "size":
1524			switch {
1525			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage == nil:
1526				return -1
1527			case a.Usage == nil && b.Usage != nil:
1528				return 1
1529			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes > b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1530				return -1
1531			case a.Usage != nil && b.Usage != nil && a.Usage.OwnedBytes < b.Usage.OwnedBytes:
1532				return 1
1533			}
1534		case "tasks":

1536				return c
1537			}
1538			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1539				return c
1540			}
1541		default: // activity

1543				return c
1544			}
1545			if c := descBool(a.Live, b.Live); c != 0 {
1546				return c
1547			}
1548			if c := descBool(a.Status.Dirty(), b.Status.Dirty()); c != 0 {
1549				return c
1550			}
1551			if c := descInt(len(a.Tasks), len(b.Tasks)); c != 0 {
1552				return c
1553			}
1554			if c := latest(); c != 0 {
1555				return c
1556			}
1557		}
1558		return nameCmp
1559	}

1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}

3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"os"
7		"syscall"
8	)
9	
10	func openRegularForRead(root *os.Root, name string) (*os.File, error) {
11		// O_NONBLOCK prevents a regular-to-FIFO rename race from hanging the
12		// process. O_NOFOLLOW rejects a final-component link before post-open
13		// identity checks run.
14		return root.OpenFile(name, os.O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NONBLOCK|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
15	}

 The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
 
 ## [Unreleased]
 
+### Added
+
+- The dashboard now supports cell-motion mouse input: left-click selects rows or
+  switches visible tabs, the wheel moves three rows, and right-click opens the
+  selected row's existing actions without making a click implicitly open it.
+- SKILLS and MCP share a session-only `A` context/all scope toggle and can open
+  the selected local configuration in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` or copy its path,
+  sanitized summary, and explicitly requested raw file. Raw file copy is bounded
+  to 1 MiB but may put credentials and other declarations into the system
+  clipboard. `A` is now a reserved TUI tool key.
+
+### Changed
+
+- MCP caps its content-responsive `SERVER` column at 32 cells, keeping transport,
+  state, and source columns together instead of pushing them to the far edge of a
+  wide terminal.
+

87		if view == ViewRepos {
88			m.prepareRepoDependentsForReload()
89		}
90		index := int(view)
91		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
92			cancel()
93		}
94		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
95		m.loadContexts[index] = ctx
96		m.loadCancels[index] = cancel
97		if view == ViewRepos && m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
98			// A newer REPOS generation may supersede the clone-triggered refresh.
99			// Cancellation must always follow the generation that can complete it.
100			m.remoteClone.cancel = cancel
101		}
102		state := &m.loads[index]
103		state.generation++
104		state.cause = cause
105		state.requested = true
106		state.loading = true
107		state.outcome = ""
108		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = nil
109		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = ""
110		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadRequested, perftrace.Fields{
111			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageRequested, Generation: state.generation,
112		})
113		return state.generation
114	}
115	
116	func (m *Model) beginLocalLoads(cause loadCause) (tasks, repos, tries uint64) {
117		if m.localCancel != nil {
118			m.localCancel()
119		}
120		m.localContext, m.localCancel = context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
121		m.localGeneration++
122		tasks = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTasks, cause)
123		repos = m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, cause)
124		tries = m.beginViewLoad(ViewTries, cause)
125		if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
126			// Production's shared loader reads localContext rather than the per-view
127			// context created above, so cancellation follows the actual producer.
128			m.remoteClone.cancel = m.localCancel
129		}
130		return tasks, repos, tries
131	}

135			return m.localContext
136		}
137		return m.baseContext()
138	}

147	func (m *Model) invalidateView(view View) {
148		index := int(view)
149		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
150			cancel()
151		}
152		m.loadCancels[index], m.loadContexts[index] = nil, nil
153		state := &m.loads[index]
154		state.generation++
155		state.requested = false
156		state.loading = false
157		state.outcome = ""
158		if state.hasSnapshot {
159			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
160		}
161		m.viewErrors[index] = nil
162		m.viewStatuses[index] = ""
163	}

169		}

172	func (m *Model) seedViewSnapshot(view View, source perftrace.Source, freshness perftrace.Freshness, actionable bool) {
173		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
174		state.hasSnapshot = true
175		state.source = source
176		state.freshness = freshness
177		state.outcome = perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
178		state.actionable = actionable

181	func (m *Model) applyCacheSeed(view View, generation uint64, rows int, freshness perftrace.Freshness) bool {
182		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
183		if generation != state.generation {
184			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
185				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
186				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
187			})
188			return false
189		}
190		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
191		count := rows
192		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
193			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
194			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,
195			Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuccess, Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
196		})
197		return true
198	}

200	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
201	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
202	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
203	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
204		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
205	
206		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
207		if generation != state.generation {
208			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
209				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
210				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
211			})
212			return false
213		}
214	
215		state.loading = false
216		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)

219			state.hasSnapshot = true
220			state.source = source
221			state.freshness = freshness

223			count := rows
224			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
225				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
226				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
227				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
228			})
229		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
230			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
231		}
232		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
233		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
234			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
235			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,

237		})

3994				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: err} }
3995			}
3996			return tea.ExecProcess(process, func(err error) tea.Msg {
3997				if err != nil {
3998					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("fleet open: %w", err)}
3999				}
4000				return actionMsg{status: "returned from " + row.Host}
4001			})
4002		}
4003		return nil
4004	}

4006	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
4007	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
4008	// the dashboard is displaying.
4009	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
4010		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
4011			if t.Key != key {
4012				continue
4013			}
4014			if t.Probe != nil && t.Availability != ToolAvailable {
4015				detail := "availability is still being checked"
4016				if t.Availability == ToolUnavailable {
4017					detail = "is not installed"
4018				}
4019				return func() tea.Msg {
4020					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s %s", t.Command[0], detail)}
4021				}
4022			}
4023			dir := m.currentDir()
4024			if dir == "" {
4025				return func() tea.Msg {
4026					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
4027				}
4028			}
4029			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
4030			c.Dir = dir
4031			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
4032				if err != nil {
4033					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)}
4034				}
4035				return actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name, forceSizes: true}
4036			})
4037		}
4038		return nil
4039	}
4040	
4041	// Tools lists the external programs available on this machine, so the footer
4042	// only advertises bindings that will actually work.
4043	func (m Model) Tools() []Tool {
4044		var out []Tool
4045		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
4046			if t.Probe == nil || t.Availability == ToolAvailable {
4047				out = append(out, t)
4048			}
4049		}
4050		return out
4051	}

4053	// Summary counts the task states, for the header line.
4054	func (m Model) Summary() string {
4055		counts := map[task.State]int{}
4056		for _, r := range m.rows {
4057			counts[r.Task.State]++
4058		}
4059		var parts []string

4061			if counts[s] > 0 {
4062				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s %d %s", s.Icon(), counts[s], s))
4063			}
4064		}
4065		repoCount := 0

4067			if !row.IsTry() {
4068				repoCount++

4070		}
4071		if repoCount > 0 {

4073		}
4074		if len(m.tries) > 0 {
4075			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d tries", len(m.tries)))
4076		}
4077		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
4078			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d remote", len(m.remotes)))
4079		}
4080		if count := m.fleetCount(); count > 0 {
4081			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d fleet", count))
4082		}
4083		if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).hasSnapshot {
4084			project, global := 0, 0
4085			for _, row := range m.skills {
4086				if row.Scope == agentskill.ScopeProject {
4087					project++

4089					global++

4092			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%dP/%dG skills", project, global))

4096		}
4097		if len(parts) == 0 {
4098			return "no tasks"
4099		}
4100		return strings.Join(parts, "   ")
4101	}

261	func scanLocation(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, target agenttarget.Target, location physicalScanLocation) ([]scannedSkill, []Diagnostic) {
262		entries, err := os.ReadDir(location.Path)
263		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
264			return nil, nil
265		}
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, []Diagnostic{decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
268				Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: location.Path,
269				Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not read skills directory: %v", err),
270			}, target)}
271		}
272		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
273	
274		var skills []scannedSkill
275		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
276		for _, entry := range entries {
277			if ctx.Err() != nil {
278				break
279			}
280			child := filepath.Join(location.Path, entry.Name())
281			info, err := os.Stat(child)
282			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
283				continue
284			}
285			if err != nil {
286				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
287					Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: child,
288					Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect skill directory: %v", err),
289				}, target))
290				continue
291			}
292			if !info.IsDir() {
293				continue
294			}
295			name, present, err := readSkillName(filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"))
296			if !present {
297				continue
298			}
299			if err != nil {
300				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
301					Kind: DiagnosticSkillFrontmatter, Scope: scope,
302					Path: filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"), Message: err.Error(),
303				}, target))
304				continue
305			}
306			physical := child
307			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child); err == nil {
308				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
309			}
310			var logicalPaths, agentIDs []string
311			for _, logical := range location.Logical {
312				logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, filepath.Join(logical.Path, entry.Name()))
313				agentIDs = append(agentIDs, logical.AgentIDs...)
314			}
315			logicalPaths = uniqueSorted(logicalPaths)
316			agentIDs = uniqueSorted(agentIDs)
317			installation := Installation{
318				RealPath: physical, LogicalPaths: logicalPaths, AgentIDs: agentIDs,
319				Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs), Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
320			}
321			if len(logicalPaths) > 0 {
322				installation.Path = logicalPaths[0]
323			}
324			skills = append(skills, scannedSkill{Name: name, Installation: installation})
325		}
326		return skills, diagnostics
327	}
328	
329	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
330		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(filename)

332			return "", false, nil
333		}
334		if errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular) {
335			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
336		}
337		if err != nil {
338			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
339		}

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"

15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"

19	
20	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
21	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
22	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
23	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
24	type Target struct {
25		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
26		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
27		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
28		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
29		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
30	}
31	
32	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
33	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
34	func (t Target) Key() string {
35		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
36	}
37	
38	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
39	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
40	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
41	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
42		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
43		if err == nil {
44			return target, nil
45		}
46		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
47			return Target{}, ctxErr
48		}
49		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
50			return Target{}, err
51		}
52		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
53		if pathErr != nil {
54			return Target{}, pathErr
55		}
56		name := filepath.Base(root)
57		return Target{
58			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
59			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
60		}, nil
61	}
62	
63	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
64	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
65		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
66		if err != nil {
67			return Target{}, err
68		}
69		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
70		if err != nil {
71			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
72		}
73		return fromGit(found)
74	}
75	
76	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
77	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
78	// worktree path is preserved.
79	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
80		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Target{}, err
83		}
84		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
85		if err != nil {
86			return Target{}, err
87		}
88		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
89		// An explicit linked-worktree path keeps the main repository identity from
90		// Git, but its checkout root remains the navigation path the caller selected.
91		switch {
92		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath):
93			if found.Name != "" {
94				target.RepoName = found.Name
95			}
96			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
97				target.RepoDisplay = display
98			}
99			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
100			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
101		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot):
102			target.CheckoutRoot = navigationPath(found.Path)
103		}
104		return target, nil
105	}
106	
107	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
108	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
109		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
110	}
111	
112	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
113	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
114	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
115	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
116		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
117			return Target{}, false
118		}
119		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
120		commonDir := found.CommonDir
121		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
122			return Target{}, false
123		}
124		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
125		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
126		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
127		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
128		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
129		name := found.Name
130		if name == "" {
131			name = filepath.Base(repository)
132		}
133		display := found.Display()
134		if display == "" {
135			display = name
136		}
137		return Target{
138			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
139			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
140		}, true
141	}

143	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
144	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
145	
146	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
147	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
148	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
149	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
150		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
151		for _, found := range repositories {
152			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
153				targets = append(targets, target)
154			}
155		}
156		return Dedupe(targets)
157	}
158	
159	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
160	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }

162	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
163	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
164	// other target builders.
165	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
166		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
167		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
168			current = ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)
169			out = append(out, current)
170		}
171		return Dedupe(out)
172	}
173	
174	// ReconcileCurrent preserves the exact current checkout while applying the
175	// canonical repository's configured navigation identity when it is known.
176	func ReconcileCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) Target {
177		for _, target := range targets {
178			if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
179				current.RepoName = target.RepoName
180				current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
181				current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
182				if comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot) == comparablePath(current.CheckoutRoot) {
183					current.CheckoutRoot = target.CheckoutRoot

185				break

187		}
188		return current
189	}

193	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
194		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())

201	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout

203	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
204		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
205		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))

211			seen[key] = struct{}{}
212			out = append(out, target)
213		}
214		Sort(out)
215		return out
216	}

func (m Model) updateCopy(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	if msg.String() == "esc" {
		m.mode = modeList
		return m, nil
	}
	item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
	if !ok {
		m.mode = modeList
		return m, nil
	}
	checkoutIndex := -1
	if item.child() {
		checkoutIndex = item.CheckoutIndex
	}

	var payload, label string
	switch msg.String() {
	case "y":
		payload = inventory.FormatRepoContext(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
		if item.child() {
			label = "worktree context"
		} else {
			label = "repo context"
		}
	case "p":
		label = "checkout path"
		if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
			payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Worktree.Path
		} else {
			payload = item.Repo.Repo.Path
		}
	case "b":
		label = "branch"
		if checkoutIndex >= 0 {
			payload = item.Repo.Context.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Branch()
		} else if main, found := item.Repo.Context.Main(); found {
			payload = main.Branch()
		} else {
			payload = item.Repo.Status.Branch
		}
		if payload == "" {
			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("selected checkout has detached HEAD")
			return m, nil
		}
	case "s":
		label = "runtime sessions"
		payload = inventory.FormatSessions(item.Repo.Context, checkoutIndex)
		if payload == "" {
			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no live runtime sessions to copy")
			return m, nil
		}
	case "w":
		label = "worktree paths"
		payload = inventory.LinkedWorktreePaths(item.Repo.Context)
		if payload == "" {
			m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("no linked worktrees to copy")
			return m, nil
		}
	default:
		m.mode, m.err = modeList, fmt.Errorf("unknown copy key %q", msg.String())
		return m, nil
	}

	m.mode = modeList
	if m.actions.Copy == nil {
		m.err = fmt.Errorf("clipboard integration is unavailable; use `dev repo context`")
		return m, nil
	}
	return m, func() tea.Msg {
		err := m.actions.Copy(payload)
		if err != nil {
			return copyMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w; use `dev repo context` as a fallback", label, err)}
		}
		return copyMsg{status: "copied " + label}
	}
}

func (m Model) selectedRepoName() string {
	if r, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
		return r.Task.Repo
	}
	if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
		return item.Repo.Repo.Name
	}
	if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok && r.Item.Live.Repo != nil {
		return r.Item.Live.Repo.Name
	}
	if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
		if r.LocalName != "" {
			return filepath.Base(r.LocalName)
		}
		return r.Repo.Name
	}
	return ""
}

func (m Model) loadStats(repo string) tea.Cmd {
	return func() tea.Msg {
		panel, err := m.actions.LoadStats(m.baseContext(), repo)
		return statsMsg{panel: panel, err: err}
	}
}

func (m Model) updateStats(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	switch msg.String() {
	case "q", "ctrl+c":
		m.quitting = true
		return m, tea.Quit
	case "esc", "H":
		m.mode, m.stats, m.err, m.status = modeList, nil, nil, ""
		return m, nil
	case "r":
		repo := ""
		if m.stats != nil {
			repo = m.stats.Repo
		}
		if repo == "" {
			repo = m.selectedRepoName()
		}
		m.stats, m.status = nil, "loading activity…"
		return m, m.loadStats(repo)
	case "b":
		repo := ""
		if m.stats != nil {
			repo = m.stats.Repo
		}
		if repo == "" {
			repo = m.selectedRepoName()
		}
		if repo == "" || m.actions.BackfillStats == nil {
			return m, nil
		}
		m.status = "backfilling this repository from Git history…"
		return m, func() tea.Msg {
			err := m.actions.BackfillStats(context.Background(), repo)
			return statsBackfilledMsg{repo: repo, err: err}
		}
	}
	return m, nil
}

func (m Model) viewUsesRepos(view View) bool {
	switch view {
	case ViewFleet:
		return m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil
	case ViewSkills:
		return m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil
	case ViewMCP:
		return m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil
	default:
		return false
	}

258		return rows, diagnostics
259	}
260	
261	func scanLocation(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, target agenttarget.Target, location physicalScanLocation) ([]scannedSkill, []Diagnostic) {
262		entries, err := os.ReadDir(location.Path)
263		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
264			return nil, nil
265		}
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, []Diagnostic{decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
268				Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: location.Path,
269				Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not read skills directory: %v", err),
270			}, target)}
271		}
272		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
273	
274		var skills []scannedSkill
275		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
276		for _, entry := range entries {
277			if ctx.Err() != nil {
278				break
279			}
280			child := filepath.Join(location.Path, entry.Name())
281			info, err := os.Stat(child)
282			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
283				continue
284			}
285			if err != nil {
286				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
287					Kind: DiagnosticSkillUnreadable, Scope: scope, Path: child,
288					Message: fmt.Sprintf("could not inspect skill directory: %v", err),
289				}, target))
290				continue
291			}
292			if !info.IsDir() {
293				continue
294			}
295			name, present, err := readSkillName(filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"))
296			if !present {
297				continue
298			}
299			if err != nil {
300				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, decorateDiagnostic(Diagnostic{
301					Kind: DiagnosticSkillFrontmatter, Scope: scope,
302					Path: filepath.Join(child, "SKILL.md"), Message: err.Error(),
303				}, target))
304				continue
305			}
306			physical := child
307			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(child); err == nil {
308				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
309			}
310			var logicalPaths, agentIDs []string
311			for _, logical := range location.Logical {
312				logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, filepath.Join(logical.Path, entry.Name()))
313				agentIDs = append(agentIDs, logical.AgentIDs...)
314			}
315			logicalPaths = uniqueSorted(logicalPaths)
316			agentIDs = uniqueSorted(agentIDs)
317			installation := Installation{
318				RealPath: physical, LogicalPaths: logicalPaths, AgentIDs: agentIDs,
319				Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs), Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
320			}
321			if len(logicalPaths) > 0 {
322				installation.Path = logicalPaths[0]
323			}
324			skills = append(skills, scannedSkill{Name: name, Installation: installation})
325		}
326		return skills, diagnostics
327	}
328	
329	func readSkillName(filename string) (string, bool, error) {
330		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(filename)
331		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
332			return "", false, nil
333		}
334		if errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular) {
335			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md is not a regular file")
336		}
337		if err != nil {
338			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", err)
339		}
340		defer file.Close()
341	
342		// Bound only the frontmatter, not the skill body. A valid skill may have a
343		// large reference body, and inventory never needs to read it.
344		reader := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(file, maxFrontmatterBytes+1))
345		first, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
346		consumed := int64(len(first))
347		if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
348			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", readErr)
349		}
350		first = strings.TrimPrefix(first, string(rune(0xfeff)))
351		if strings.TrimSpace(first) != "---" {
352			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md must begin with YAML frontmatter")
353		}
354		var frontmatter strings.Builder
355		closed := false
356		for {
357			line, lineErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
358			consumed += int64(len(line))
359			if consumed > maxFrontmatterBytes {
360				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter exceeds %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
361			}
362			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "---" {
363				closed = true
364				break
365			}
366			frontmatter.WriteString(line)
367			if lineErr != nil {
368				if errors.Is(lineErr, io.EOF) {
369					break
370				}
371				return "", true, fmt.Errorf("could not read SKILL.md: %w", lineErr)
372			}
373		}
374		if !closed {
375			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("SKILL.md frontmatter is not closed within %d bytes", maxFrontmatterBytes)
376		}
377		var metadata struct {
378			Name        string `yaml:"name"`
379			Description string `yaml:"description"`
380		}
381		if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(frontmatter.String()), &metadata); err != nil {
382			return "", true, fmt.Errorf("invalid SKILL.md YAML frontmatter: %w", err)
383		}
384		metadata.Name = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Name)
385		metadata.Description = strings.TrimSpace(metadata.Description)
386		if metadata.Name == "" || metadata.Description == "" {
387			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter requires name and description")
388		}
389		if len(metadata.Name) > 256 || normalizedName(metadata.Name) == "" || !safeDisplayValue(metadata.Name) {
390			return "", true, errors.New("SKILL.md frontmatter name is invalid")
391		}
392		return metadata.Name, true, nil
393	}
394	
395	func buildPresentRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, name string, group *skillAggregate, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata, matched bool) Skill {
396		installations := make([]Installation, 0, len(group.Installations))
397		for _, installation := range group.Installations {
398			installation.LogicalPaths = uniqueSorted(installation.LogicalPaths)
399			installation.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(installation.AgentIDs)
400			installation.Attribution = registryAttribution(installation.AgentIDs)
401			installations = append(installations, *installation)
402		}
403		sort.Slice(installations, func(i, j int) bool {
404			if installations[i].RealPath != installations[j].RealPath {
405				return installations[i].RealPath < installations[j].RealPath
406			}
407			return installations[i].Path < installations[j].Path
408		})
409		var agents []string
410		for _, installation := range installations {
411			agents = append(agents, installation.AgentIDs...)
412		}
413		agentIDs := uniqueSorted(agents)
414		agents = agentDisplayNames(agentIDs)
415		row := Skill{
416			Name: name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot,
417			Agents: agents, Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
418			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Installations: installations, Presence: PresencePresent,
419			Integrity: IntegrityUnknown, Attribution: registryAttribution(agentIDs),
420			RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
421			ManagedBy: ManagedByExternal, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnknown,
422			UpdateDetail: "not tracked by the skills CLI",
423		}
424		if len(installations) > 0 {
425			row.Path = installations[0].Path
426		}
427		if directManagedSkillName(name) {
428			if name == skill.Name {
429				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
430				row.Source = "dev binary"
431				applyBundledIntegrity(&row)
432				row.UpdateStatus, row.UpdateDetail = bundledStatus(row.Integrity, row.IntegrityDetail)
433			} else {
434				row.UpdateDetail = "name is reserved for the binary-managed dev-cli skill"
435			}
436			return row
437		}
438		if matched {
439			copy := lock
440			row.Lock = &copy
441			row.ManagedBy = ManagedBySkills
442			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnchecked
443			row.UpdateDetail = ""
444			row.Source, row.SourceURL = sourceDisplay(lock.Source), sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL)
445			row.SourceType = safeSourceType(lock.SourceType)
446			return row
447		}
448		if len(candidates) > 1 {
449			row.UpdateDetail = "ambiguous normalized lock names; no lock entry selected"
450		}
451		return row
452	}
453	
454	func buildMissingRow(scope Scope, scopeRoot string, target agenttarget.Target, lock LockMetadata, candidates []LockMetadata) Skill {
455		copy := lock
456		row := Skill{
457			Name: lock.Name, Scope: scope, ScopeRoot: scopeRoot, Agents: []string{},
458			Source: sourceDisplay(lock.Source), SourceURL: sourceDisplay(lock.SourceURL),
459			SourceType: safeSourceType(lock.SourceType),
460			ManagedBy:  ManagedBySkills, UpdateStatus: UpdateUnchecked,
461			Repository: target.RepoDisplay, RepositoryPath: target.RepoPath,
462			Checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, Presence: PresenceMissing, Integrity: IntegrityUnknown,
463			Attribution: registryAttribution(nil), RegistryVersion: RegistryVersion,
464			Lock: &copy, LockCandidates: append([]LockMetadata(nil), candidates...),
465		}
466		if directManagedSkillName(lock.Name) {
467			row.Lock = nil
468			if lock.Name == skill.Name {
469				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByDev
470				row.Source, row.SourceURL, row.SourceType = "dev binary", "", ""
471				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateAvailable
472				row.UpdateDetail = "bundled skill is missing; run `dev skill install`"
473			} else {
474				row.ManagedBy = ManagedByExternal
475				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
476				row.UpdateDetail = "name is reserved for the binary-managed dev-cli skill"
477			}
478		}
479		return row

430	## Configuration
431	
432	```bash
433	dev config init
434	dev config show
435	dev config path
436	dev config scaffolds init
437	dev config scaffolds show
438	dev config scaffolds path
439	dev config scaffolds edit
440	
441	dev fleet config init      # user-authored primary remotes.toml
442	dev fleet config show      # effective primary + generated remotes.d merge
443	dev fleet config edit      # primary only
444	dev ssh init               # report dedicated OpenSSH Include plan
445	dev ssh init --apply       # install it after confirmation
446	```
447	
448	`config init` detects local roots and writes explicit defaults. A missing config file is allowed; the built-in defaults keep core Git behavior usable, but generated config is recommended because it makes machine policy reviewable.
449	
450	Key sections:
451	
452	| Section | Controls |
453	|---|---|
454	| `[paths]` | scan roots, project/tries/worktree roots, worktree template, state path |
455	| `[runtime]` | `auto`, Herdr, tmux, Zellij, or none plus metadata settings |
456	| `[worktree]` | local ignored-file provisioning, linked dirs, setup commands, strategies, timeout |
457	| `[local_files]` | host ceilings for portable files; project overlays provide the separate off-machine candidate allowlist |
458	| `[forge]` / `[[forge.azure_devops]]` | complete remote inventory cache TTL and opt-in Azure organization/project targets |
459	| `[picker]` | optional external selector argv; empty selects the built-in picker |
460	| `[bootstrap]` | recursion, symlink handling, index/layout policy |
461	| `[tui]` / `[[tui.tools]]` | columns, sorting, and external-tool bindings |
462	| `[stats]` | sampler and optional WakaTime import |
463	| `[update]` | `check` (default `true`) — allow the once-a-day "newer release available" hint and its background cache refresh; `DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` overrides it |
464	| `[[agent]]`, `[agent.run]`, `[agent.open]` | host-only names, optional descriptions, global default selection, and independent batch/foreground prompt launchers; no built-in entries |
465	
466	Interactive repository selection uses one direct argv vector, never shell source:
467	
468	```toml
469	[picker]
470	command = ["fzf", "--height=60%", "--layout=reverse", "--border", "--prompt", "{prompt}> "]
471	```
472	
473	The executable must implement a line-selector contract: candidates arrive on
474	stdin and the selected original line is returned on stdout. The default is
475	`fzf`; compatible selectors can replace the entire array. A missing executable
476	falls back to dev's Bubble Tea picker, and `command = []` forces that fallback.
477	This is global host policy and cannot be overridden by a repository. Non-TTY
478	callers retain deterministic line prompts.
479	
480	`DEV_TUI_TRACE=/absolute/new-file.json` enables a one-run TUI startup/readiness
481	trace. The target must be absolute and must not exist; dev never overwrites it.
482	The private bounded document is written after TUI teardown and contains relative
483	categorical timings plus aggregate row counts rather than names, paths, or raw
484	payloads. It is not configuration,
485	cache, durable stats, stdout, or network telemetry. For TUI invocations, the
486	optional update-cache network refresh is also deferred until the initial view
487	has returned.
488	
489	Repository quick-note Markdown is durable under configured `paths.state_dir/notes`, which defaults to `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes`. The full-text index at `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is disposable and rebuilds from those files; changing `paths.state_dir` does not move the cache.

250	```
251	
252	Archive is a reversible same-filesystem move under `tries_root/.dev`; it does
253	not reclaim disk space. Phase 1 has no evict/delete action. The catalog keeps a
254	stable ID, per-host location, tags/note, last-opened time and graduation
255	history; Git and size facts remain live/derived.
256	
257	REMOTE:
258	
259	```
260	n / N      notes, only when a local clone exists
261	enter / o  open an existing local clone
262	c          confirm an absent repo; then enter stays or o opens after clone
263	q / ctrl-c request cancellation while clone/refresh/open is pending
264	r          refresh configured forge CLIs, replacing the cache
265	```
266	
267	SKILLS:
268	
269	```
270	a          open the interactive installer (default personal skill catalog)
271	c          check lock-managed Git sources without installing updates
272	u          confirm and update only the selected lock-managed skill
273	A          toggle shared context/all repository scope for this TUI session
274	e          open selected SKILL.md, or the lock file for a missing skill
275	y          p path · s safe summary · u source URL · f whole raw file
276	r          reload local project/global state without network access
277	```
278	
279	The detail pane separates repository/checkout, local presence/integrity, agent
280	compatibility, source, manager, and upstream freshness. Filters include
281	`repo:api`, `scope:global`, `agent:Codex`, `presence:missing`, and
282	`update:update_available`.
283	
284	MCP:
285	
286	```
287	A          toggle the same context/all repository scope
288	e          open the selected declaration's ConfigPath
289	y          p path · s safe summary · f whole raw config file
290	r          reload static declarations; no server is started or probed
291	```
292	
293	The MCP detail pane contains sanitized config/source/transport/policy facts,
294	exact Claude local project identity, bounded credential-reference summaries, and
295	redaction markers—never raw args, environment/header/OAuth values, indirect file
296	content, or connection health. That normalization still governs rows, safe
297	summaries, and JSON. Explicit `yf` instead reads the entire local source file (up
298	to 1 MiB) into the system clipboard; it performs no network access but may copy
299	credentials and other declarations from the same file.
300	
301	## Heatmap and editors
302	
303	```
304	H   open the selected repository's one-year activity heatmap
305	    b backfills only that repo; r rereads stats; H / esc returns
306	
307	e   edit effective dev config on ordinary views; edit the selected capability file on SKILLS/MCP
308	r   reparse config and reload local/remote data and tool bindings
309	```
310	
311	An empty heatmap is actionable: press `b` to derive only the selected repo's
312	history into stats.db and automatically redraw. `r` does not manufacture data;
313	it rereads what collectors/backfill have stored.
314	
315	Returning from an ordinary-view `e` live-reloads dev config; returning from a
316	SKILLS/MCP editor reloads only that capability inventory. Changes to scan roots, worktree
317	policy, forge cache settings and `[[tui.tools]]` take effect immediately. A
318	runtime backend change needs a restart because existing callbacks and sessions
319	belong to the backend the TUI opened with; the status line says so rather than
320	pretending to switch underneath a live workspace.
