```text
221	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
222	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
223	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
224	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
225		if ctx == nil {
226			ctx = context.Background()
227		}
228		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
229		result := Result{
230			Declarations: make([]Declaration, 0),
231			Diagnostics:  make([]Diagnostic, 0),
232			Coverage:     defaultCoverage(),
233		}
234		type cachedRead struct {
235			ready  chan struct{}
236			result readResult
237		}
238		var readMu sync.Mutex
239		reads := map[string]*cachedRead{}
240		readSource := func(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
241			key := spec.path + "\x00" + spec.projectRoot
242			readMu.Lock()
243			entry := reads[key]
244			if entry == nil {
245				entry = &cachedRead{ready: make(chan struct{})}
246				reads[key] = entry
247				readMu.Unlock()
248				entry.result = s.readSource(ctx, spec)
249				close(entry.ready)
250				return entry.result
251			}
252			readMu.Unlock()
253			select {
254			case <-ctx.Done():
255				return readResult{}
256			case <-entry.ready:
257				return entry.result
258			}
259		}
260	
261		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
262			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
263				finalizeResult(&result)
264				return result, err
265			}
266			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets, readSource)
267			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
268			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
269		}
270		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
271			finalizeResult(&result)
272			return result, err
273		}
274	
275		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
276		jobs := make(chan int)
277		workers := s.options.Concurrency
278		if workers > len(targets) {
279			workers = len(targets)
280		}
281		var wg sync.WaitGroup
282		for range workers {
283			wg.Add(1)
284			go func() {
285				defer wg.Done()
286				for {
287					select {
288					case <-ctx.Done():
289						return
290					case index, ok := <-jobs:
291						if !ok {
292							return
293						}
294						for _, spec := range s.projectSources(targets[index]) {
295							if ctx.Err() != nil {
296								return
297							}
298							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil, readSource)
299							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
300							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
301						}
302					}
303				}
304			}()
305		}
306		for index := range targets {
307			select {
308			case jobs <- index:
309			case <-ctx.Done():
310				close(jobs)
311				wg.Wait()
312				for _, partial := range projectResults {
313					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
314					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
315				}
316				finalizeResult(&result)
317				return result, ctx.Err()
318			}
319		}
320		close(jobs)
321		wg.Wait()
322		for _, partial := range projectResults {
323			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
324			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
325		}
326		finalizeResult(&result)
327		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
328			return result, err
329		}
330		return result, nil
331	}

333	func normalizeOptions(options Options) Options {
334		if options.WorkingDirectory == "" {
335			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
336		}
337		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
338			options.XDGConfigHome = ""
339		}
340		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
341			options.CodexHome = ""
342		}
343		if options.GeminiCLIHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.GeminiCLIHome) {
344			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
345		}
346		for _, path := range []*string{&options.ClaudeUserConfigPath, &options.ClaudeUserSettingsPath, &options.ClaudeManagedConfigPath} {
347			if *path != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(*path) {
348				*path = ""
349			}

352		for _, path := range options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths {

354				managedSettings = append(managedSettings, filepath.Clean(path))
355			}
356		}
357		options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths = managedSettings
358		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {

360		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
361			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
362		}
363		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {

367		}
368		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {

370		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
371			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
372		}
373		return options
374	}

510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)

516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {

527		switch spec.adapter {

530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {

548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:

558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:

560		default:

562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics

572	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
573		return Diagnostic{
574			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
575			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout,
576			LocalProjectPath: spec.localProjectPath, ConfigPath: spec.path,
577			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
578		}
579	}

581	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
582		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
583		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
584			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
585			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
586			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
587			for n := range ak {
588				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
589					return ak[n] < bk[n]
590				}
591			}
592			return false
593		})
594	}
```

```text
17	func (s *Scanner) readSourceFromDisk(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {

19			return readResult{}
20		}

29			return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}

33			if err != nil || !inside {

39		if err != nil {

41			case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
42				return readResult{}
43			case errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrNotRegular):
44				return readResult{code: DiagnosticNotRegular}
45			default:
46				return readResult{code: DiagnosticUnreadable}
47			}

49		defer file.Close()

57			}

59			currentInfo, statErr := os.Stat(currentPath)

79	// resolveBoundedSymlinks follows symlinks in every path component while placing
80	// a small deterministic bound on cycles and unusually deep chains.
81	func resolveBoundedSymlinks(filename string, limit int) (string, error) {
82		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(filename)
83		if err != nil {
84			return "", err
85		}
86		return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(absolute), limit, 0)
87	}
88	
89	func resolveSymlinkPath(absolute string, limit, followed int) (string, error) {
90		volume := filepath.VolumeName(absolute)
91		root := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
92		relative := strings.TrimPrefix(absolute, root)
93		components := strings.FieldsFunc(relative, func(r rune) bool { return r == rune(filepath.Separator) })
94		current := root
95		for index, component := range components {
96			candidate := filepath.Join(current, component)
97			info, err := os.Lstat(candidate)
98			if err != nil {
99				return "", err
100			}
101			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0 {
102				current = candidate
103				continue
104			}
105			if followed >= limit {
106				return "", errSymlinkLimit
107			}
108			target, err := os.Readlink(candidate)
109			if err != nil {
110				return "", err
111			}
112			if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
113				target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(candidate), target)
114			}
115			if index+1 < len(components) {
116				target = filepath.Join(target, filepath.Join(components[index+1:]...))
117			}
118			target, err = filepath.Abs(target)
119			if err != nil {
120				return "", err
121			}
122			return resolveSymlinkPath(filepath.Clean(target), limit, followed+1)
123		}
124		return filepath.Clean(current), nil
125	}
```

```text
10	func openRegularForRead(root *os.Root, name string) (*os.File, error) {
11		// O_NONBLOCK prevents a regular-to-FIFO rename race from hanging the
12		// process. O_NOFOLLOW rejects a final-component link before post-open
13		// identity checks run.
14		return root.OpenFile(name, os.O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NONBLOCK|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
15	}
```

```text
1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}
76
```

```text
215			Agents:                 []Agent{AgentClaudeCode, AgentCodex, AgentCursor, AgentGeminiCLI, AgentOpenCode},
216			StaticDeclarationsOnly: true,
217			OmittedSources: []string{

222			},

226	// Filter selects declarations for CLI or TUI consumers. Empty fields are
227	// wildcards; Enabled and HasCredentials distinguish an omitted filter from false.
228	type Filter struct {
229		Agent          Agent
230		Scope          Scope
231		Source         DeclarationSource
232		Transport      Transport
233		Repository     string
234		NameContains   string
235		Enabled        *bool
236		HasCredentials *bool
237	}
238	
239	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
240	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
242			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
243			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
244			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
245			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
246			return false
247		}
248		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
249			return false
250		}
251		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
252			return false
253		}
254		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
255			return false
256		}
257		return true
258	}
259	
260	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
261	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
262		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
263		for _, row := range rows {
264			if f.Match(row) {
265				out = append(out, row)
266			}
267		}
268		return out
269	}
270	
271	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
272	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
273		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
274			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
275			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
276			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
277			for n := range ak {
278				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
279					return ak[n] < bk[n]
280				}
281			}
282			return false
283		})
284	}
285	
286	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {
287		switch scope {
288		case ScopeProject:
289			return "0-project"
290		case ScopeLocal:
291			return "1-local"
292		case ScopeUser:
293			return "2-user"
294		case ScopeCustom:
295			return "3-custom"
296		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
297			return "4-system-defaults"
298		case ScopeSystemOverride:
299			return "5-system-override"
300		case ScopeManaged:
301			return "6-managed"
302		default:
303			return "9-" + string(scope)
304		}
305	}
```

```text
24	
25	// Options supplies host paths and resource bounds. Use DefaultOptions for a
26	// real host scan. NewScanner intentionally does not fill omitted host paths, so
27	// callers and tests can select exactly which user/system sources are visible.
28	type Options struct {
29		HomeDir                    string
30		WorkingDirectory           string
31		XDGConfigHome              string
32		CodexHome                  string
33		OpenCodeConfigPath         string
34		OpenCodeConfigDir          string
35		GeminiCLIHome              string
36		ClaudeUserConfigPath       string
37		ClaudeUserSettingsPath     string
38		ClaudeManagedConfigPath    string
39		ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths []string
40		GeminiSystemDefaultsPath   string
41		GeminiSystemSettingsPath   string
42		OpenCodeManagedConfigPaths []string
43		Concurrency                int
44		MaxFileBytes               int64
45		MaxSymlinkDepth            int
46	}
47	
48	// DefaultOptions resolves only documented static file locations. In
49	// particular, it ignores OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT and never requests remote
50	// .well-known configuration.
51	func DefaultOptions() Options {
52		home, homeErr := os.UserHomeDir()
53		if homeErr != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
54			home = ""
55		}
56		cwd, _ := os.Getwd()
57		xdg := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"))
58		if !filepath.IsAbs(xdg) && home != "" {
59			xdg = filepath.Join(home, ".config")
60		}
61		codexHome := os.Getenv("CODEX_HOME")
62		if codexHome == "" && home != "" {
63			codexHome = filepath.Join(home, ".codex")
64		}
65		claudeConfigDir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"))
66		claudeUserConfig := ""
67		if filepath.IsAbs(claudeConfigDir) {
68			claudeUserConfig = filepath.Join(claudeConfigDir, ".claude.json")
69		} else if home != "" {
70			claudeConfigDir = filepath.Join(home, ".claude")
71			claudeUserConfig = filepath.Join(home, ".claude.json")
72		} else {
73			claudeConfigDir = ""
74		}
75		claudeUserSettings := ""
76		if claudeConfigDir != "" {
77			claudeUserSettings = filepath.Join(claudeConfigDir, "settings.json")
78		}
79		// Gemini CLI documents ~/.gemini for user settings; it does not define a
80		// relocatable Gemini home for this file.
81		geminiHome := home
82	
83		defaultsPath := os.Getenv("GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_PATH")
84		settingsPath := os.Getenv("GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH")
85		managedDir := ""
86		claudeManaged := ""
87		claudeManagedSettings := ""
88		switch runtime.GOOS {
89		case "darwin":
90			if defaultsPath == "" {
91				defaultsPath = "/Library/Application Support/GeminiCli/system-defaults.json"

156	func managedPreferenceUsername(home string) string {
157		if current, err := user.Current(); err == nil {
158			username := strings.TrimSpace(current.Username)
159			if username != "" && filepath.Base(username) == username && !stringContainsControl(username) {
160				return username
161			}
162		}
163		username := filepath.Base(home)
164		if username == "" || username == "." || username == string(filepath.Separator) || stringContainsControl(username) {
165			return ""
166		}
167		return username

202	// Scanner is a reusable, read-only static declaration scanner.
203	type Scanner struct {
204		options    Options
205		readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult
206	}
207	
208	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
209	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
210		options = normalizeOptions(options)
211		s := &Scanner{options: options}
212		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk
213		return s
214	}
215	
216	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
217	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
218		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
219	}
220	
221	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
222	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
223	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
224	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
225		if ctx == nil {
226			ctx = context.Background()
227		}
228		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
229		result := Result{
230			Declarations: make([]Declaration, 0),
231			Diagnostics:  make([]Diagnostic, 0),
232			Coverage:     defaultCoverage(),
233		}
234		type cachedRead struct {
235			ready  chan struct{}
236			result readResult
237		}
238		var readMu sync.Mutex
239		reads := map[string]*cachedRead{}
240		readSource := func(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
241			key := spec.path + "\x00" + spec.projectRoot
242			readMu.Lock()
243			entry := reads[key]
244			if entry == nil {
245				entry = &cachedRead{ready: make(chan struct{})}
246				reads[key] = entry
247				readMu.Unlock()
248				entry.result = s.readSource(ctx, spec)
249				close(entry.ready)
250				return entry.result
251			}
252			readMu.Unlock()
253			select {
254			case <-ctx.Done():
255				return readResult{}
256			case <-entry.ready:
257				return entry.result
258			}
259		}
260	
261		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
262			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
263				finalizeResult(&result)
264				return result, err
265			}
266			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets, readSource)
267			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
268			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
269		}
270		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
271			finalizeResult(&result)
272			return result, err
273		}
274	
275		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
276		jobs := make(chan int)
277		workers := s.options.Concurrency
278		if workers > len(targets) {
279			workers = len(targets)
280		}
281		var wg sync.WaitGroup
282		for range workers {
283			wg.Add(1)
284			go func() {
285				defer wg.Done()
286				for {
287					select {
288					case <-ctx.Done():
289						return
290					case index, ok := <-jobs:
291						if !ok {
292							return
293						}
294						for _, spec := range s.projectSources(targets[index]) {
295							if ctx.Err() != nil {
296								return
297							}
298							rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, nil, readSource)
299							projectResults[index].Declarations = append(projectResults[index].Declarations, rows...)
300							projectResults[index].Diagnostics = append(projectResults[index].Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
301						}
302					}
303				}
304			}()
305		}
306		for index := range targets {
307			select {
308			case jobs <- index:
309			case <-ctx.Done():
310				close(jobs)
311				wg.Wait()
312				for _, partial := range projectResults {
313					result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
314					result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
315				}
316				finalizeResult(&result)
317				return result, ctx.Err()
318			}
319		}
320		close(jobs)
321		wg.Wait()
322		for _, partial := range projectResults {
323			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
324			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
325		}
326		finalizeResult(&result)
327		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
328			return result, err
329		}
330		return result, nil
331	}

333	func normalizeOptions(options Options) Options {
334		if options.WorkingDirectory == "" {
335			options.WorkingDirectory, _ = os.Getwd()
336		}
337		if options.XDGConfigHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.XDGConfigHome) {
338			options.XDGConfigHome = ""
339		}
340		if options.CodexHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.CodexHome) {
341			options.CodexHome = ""
342		}
343		if options.GeminiCLIHome != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(options.GeminiCLIHome) {
344			options.GeminiCLIHome = ""
345		}
346		for _, path := range []*string{&options.ClaudeUserConfigPath, &options.ClaudeUserSettingsPath, &options.ClaudeManagedConfigPath} {
347			if *path != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(*path) {
348				*path = ""
349			}
350		}
351		managedSettings := make([]string, 0, len(options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths))
352		for _, path := range options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths {
353			if filepath.IsAbs(path) {
354				managedSettings = append(managedSettings, filepath.Clean(path))
355			}
356		}
357		options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths = managedSettings
358		if options.Concurrency <= 0 {
359			options.Concurrency = defaultConcurrency
360		} else if options.Concurrency > maximumConcurrency {
361			options.Concurrency = maximumConcurrency
362		}
363		if options.MaxFileBytes <= 0 {
364			options.MaxFileBytes = DefaultMaxFileBytes
365		} else if options.MaxFileBytes > maximumMaxFileBytes {
366			options.MaxFileBytes = maximumMaxFileBytes
367		}
368		if options.MaxSymlinkDepth <= 0 {
369			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = defaultSymlinkDepth
370		} else if options.MaxSymlinkDepth > maximumSymlinkDepth {
371			options.MaxSymlinkDepth = maximumSymlinkDepth
372		}
373		return options
374	}

376	func normalizeTargets(targets []Target, cwd string) []Target {
377		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
378		for _, target := range targets {
379			if strings.TrimSpace(target.CheckoutRoot) == "" {
380				continue
381			}
382			checkout := target.CheckoutRoot
383			if !filepath.IsAbs(checkout) {
384				checkout = filepath.Join(cwd, checkout)
385			}
386			absolute, err := filepath.Abs(checkout)
387			if err != nil {
388				continue
389			}
390			target.CheckoutRoot = filepath.Clean(absolute)
391			if target.RepoPath == "" {
392				target.RepoPath = target.CheckoutRoot
393			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(target.RepoPath) {
394				target.RepoPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cwd, target.RepoPath))
395			}
396			target.RepoDisplay = strings.TrimSpace(target.RepoDisplay)
397			if target.RepoDisplay == "" {
398				target.RepoDisplay = target.RepoName
399			}
400			if target.CommonDir == "" {
401				target.CommonDir = target.RepoPath
402			}
403			out = append(out, target)
404		}
405		return agenttarget.Dedupe(out)
406	}

452		add(sourceSpec{agent: AgentGeminiCLI, scope: ScopeSystemOverride, source: SourceManaged, path: s.options.GeminiSystemSettingsPath, adapter: adapterGemini})
453		for _, path := range s.options.OpenCodeManagedConfigPaths {

463	func (s *Scanner) projectSources(target Target) []sourceSpec {
464		base := sourceSpec{
465			scope: ScopeProject, source: SourceDirect, repository: target.RepoDisplay,
466			repositoryPath: target.RepoPath, checkout: target.CheckoutRoot, projectRoot: target.CheckoutRoot,
467		}
468		makeSpec := func(agent Agent, relative string, adapter adapterKind) sourceSpec {
469			spec := base
470			spec.agent = agent
471			spec.path = filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relative))
472			spec.adapter = adapter
473			return spec
474		}
475		approvalSpec := func(path string, scope Scope, source DeclarationSource, confined bool) sourceSpec {
476			spec := base
477			spec.agent = AgentClaudeCode
478			spec.scope = scope
479			spec.source = source
480			spec.path = path
481			if !confined {
482				spec.projectRoot = ""
483			}
484			return spec
485		}
486		claude := makeSpec(AgentClaudeCode, ".mcp.json", adapterClaudeProject)
487		addApproval := func(path string, scope Scope, source DeclarationSource, confined bool) {
488			if strings.TrimSpace(path) != "" {
489				claude.approvalSources = append(claude.approvalSources, approvalSpec(path, scope, source, confined))
490			}
491		}
492		addApproval(s.options.ClaudeUserSettingsPath, ScopeUser, SourceDirect, false)
493		addApproval(filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.json"), ScopeProject, SourceDirect, true)
494		addApproval(filepath.Join(target.CheckoutRoot, ".claude", "settings.local.json"), ScopeLocal, SourceDirect, true)
495		for _, path := range s.options.ClaudeManagedSettingsPaths {
496			addApproval(path, ScopeManaged, SourceManaged, false)
497		}
498		return []sourceSpec{
499			claude,
500			makeSpec(AgentCodex, ".codex/config.toml", adapterCodex),
501			makeSpec(AgentCursor, ".cursor/mcp.json", adapterCursor),
502			makeSpec(AgentGeminiCLI, ".gemini/settings.json", adapterGemini),
503			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
504			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, "opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
505			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.json", adapterOpenCode),
506			makeSpec(AgentOpenCode, ".opencode/opencode.jsonc", adapterOpenCode),
507		}
508	}

510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)
512		if !read.present {
513			if read.code == "" {
514				return nil, nil
515			}
516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {
518				localSpec := spec
519				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
520				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, read.code))
521			}
522			return nil, diagnostics
523		}
524		var rows []Declaration
525		var codes []DiagnosticCode
526		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
527		switch spec.adapter {
528		case adapterClaudeProject:
529			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {
532				approval := readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
533				switch {
534				case approval.code != "":
535					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
536				case approval.present:
537					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
538					if code != "" {
539						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
540					} else {
541						approvalState.merge(enabled, disabled, enableAll)
542					}
543				}
544			}
545			applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, approvalState.enabled, approvalState.disabled, approvalState.enableAll)
546		case adapterClaudeUser:
547			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:
557			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
559			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
560		default:
561			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics
570	}
571	
572	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
573		return Diagnostic{
574			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
575			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout,
576			LocalProjectPath: spec.localProjectPath, ConfigPath: spec.path,
577			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
578		}
579	}
580	
581	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
582		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
583		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
584			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
585			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
586			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
587			for n := range ak {
588				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
589					return ak[n] < bk[n]
590				}
591			}
592			return false
593		})
594	}
```

```text
103	func parseClaudeUser(data []byte, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode, []Diagnostic) {
104		var document claudeDocument
105		if code := decodeJSON(data, &document); code != "" {
106			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
107			if len(targets) > 0 {
108				localSpec := spec
109				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
110				localDiagnostics = append(localDiagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
111			}
112			return nil, []DiagnosticCode{code}, localDiagnostics
113		}
114		rows, codes := convertClaudeServers(document.MCPServers, spec, nil)
115		if len(document.Projects) == 0 || len(targets) == 0 {
116			return rows, codes, nil
117		}
118		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
119	
120		projectKeys := make([]string, 0, len(document.Projects))
121		for projectPath := range document.Projects {
122			projectKeys = append(projectKeys, projectPath)
123		}
124		sort.Strings(projectKeys)
125		for _, projectPath := range projectKeys {
126			target, ok := matchClaudeTarget(projectPath, targets)
127			if !ok {
128				continue
129			}
130			localSpec := spec
131			localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
132			localSpec.repository = target.RepoDisplay
133			localSpec.repositoryPath = target.RepoPath
134			localSpec.checkout = target.CheckoutRoot
135			localSpec.localProjectPath = filepath.Clean(projectPath)
136			localSpec.projectRoot = ""
137			var project claudeProject
138			if code := decodeJSON(document.Projects[projectPath], &project); code != "" {
139				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
140				continue
141			}
142			state := &claudeProjectState{
143				enabled:  normalizeNameSet(project.EnabledMCPServers),
144				disabled: normalizeNameSet(project.DisabledMCPServers),
145			}
146			localRows, localCodes := convertClaudeServers(project.MCPServers, localSpec, state)
147			rows = append(rows, localRows...)
148			for _, code := range localCodes {
149				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, code))
150			}
151		}
152		return rows, codes, diagnostics
153	}

160	func convertClaudeServers(raw map[string]json.RawMessage, spec sourceSpec, state *claudeProjectState) ([]Declaration, []DiagnosticCode) {
161		var rows []Declaration
162		var codes []DiagnosticCode
163		for _, rawName := range sortedRawNames(raw) {
164			row, ok := newDeclaration(spec, rawName)

168			}

171				codes = append(codes, code)

173			}
174			convertClaudeServer(&row, server)
175			if state != nil {
176				enabled, disabled := state.enabled[row.Name], state.disabled[row.Name]
177				switch {
178				case enabled && disabled:
179					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
180					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
181					addCoverage(&row, DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration)
182				case enabled:
183					value := true
184					row.Enabled = &value
185					addPolicy(&row, PolicyAllowed, "declared", 0)
186				case disabled:
187					value := false
188					row.Enabled = &value
189					addPolicy(&row, PolicyExcluded, "declared", 0)
190				}
191			}
192			finalizeDeclaration(&row)
193			rows = append(rows, row)
194		}
195		return rows, codes
196	}

198	func convertClaudeServer(row *Declaration, server claudeServer) {
199		setCommand(row, server.Command)
200		inspectArguments(row, server.Args)
201		inspectEnvironment(row, server.Env)
202		setEndpoint(row, server.URL)
203		inspectHeaders(row, server.Headers)
204		inspectHelper(row, strings.TrimSpace(server.HeadersHelper) != "")
205		if server.AlwaysLoad != nil {
206			addBooleanPolicy(row, PolicyAlwaysLoad, *server.AlwaysLoad)
207		}
208		if server.OAuth != nil {
209			addPolicy(row, PolicyOAuth, "configured", 0)
210			inspectOAuthValue(row, "client-id", server.OAuth.ClientID)
211			inspectOAuthValue(row, "metadata-url", server.OAuth.AuthServerMetadataURL)
212			inspectOAuthValue(row, "scopes", server.OAuth.Scopes)
213		}
214	
215		typeName := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(server.Type))
216		hasCommand := strings.TrimSpace(server.Command) != ""
217		hasURL := strings.TrimSpace(server.URL) != ""
218		if hasCommand && hasURL {
219			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticConflictingTransport)
220		}
221		switch typeName {
222		case "stdio":
223			if hasCommand {
224				row.Transport = TransportStdio
225			}
226		case "http":
227			if hasURL {
228				row.Transport = TransportHTTP
229			}
230		case "streamable-http":
231			if hasURL {
232				row.Transport = TransportStreamableHTTP
233			}
234		case "sse":
235			if hasURL {
236				row.Transport = TransportSSE
237			}
238		case "ws", "websocket":
239			if hasURL {
240				row.Transport = TransportWebSocket
241			}
242		case "":
243			if hasCommand && !hasURL {
244				row.Transport = TransportStdio
245			}
246		}
247		if row.Transport == TransportUnknown {
248			addCoverage(row, DiagnosticUnknownTransport)
249		}
250	}

271	func matchClaudeTarget(projectPath string, targets []Target) (Target, bool) {
272		if projectPath == "" || stringContainsControl(projectPath) {
273			return Target{}, false
274		}
275		candidate, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
276		if err != nil {
277			return Target{}, false
278		}
279		candidate = filepath.Clean(candidate)
280		candidateCanonical := candidate
281		if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(candidate); err == nil {
282			candidateCanonical = resolved
283		}
284	
285		for _, target := range targets {
286			checkout := filepath.Clean(target.CheckoutRoot)
287			checkoutCanonical := checkout
288			if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout); err == nil {
289				checkoutCanonical = resolved
290			}
291			if candidate == checkout || candidateCanonical == checkoutCanonical {
292				return target, true
293			}
294		}
295	
296		bestIndex, bestDepth := -1, -1
297		for index, target := range targets {
298			inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.CheckoutRoot, candidate)
299			if err != nil || !inside {
300				continue
301			}
302			checkout := filepath.Clean(target.CheckoutRoot)
303			if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout); err == nil {
304				checkout = resolved
305			}
306			if depth := len(checkout); depth > bestDepth {
307				bestIndex, bestDepth = index, depth
308			}
309		}
310		if bestIndex >= 0 {
311			return targets[bestIndex], true
312		}
313		return Target{}, false
314	}

319		}
320		copy := *value
321		return &copy
322	}
```

```text
152	func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool {
153		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
154		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
155			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
156			if structured {
157				switch key {
158				case "tag":
159					if r.Asset == nil || !r.Asset.HasTag(value) {
160						return false
161					}
162					continue
163				case "remote":
164					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Topology.Summary()), value) {
165						return false
166					}
167					continue
168				case "size":
169					if !matchesSize(r.Usage, value) {
170						return false
171					}
172					continue
173				case "kind":
174					kind := catalog.KindRepository
175					if r.Asset != nil {
176						kind = r.Asset.Kind
177					}
178					if string(kind) != value {
179						return false
180					}
181					continue
182				}
183			}
184			if !strings.Contains(r.searchText(), term) {
185				return false
186			}
187		}
188		return true
189	}
```

```text
20		// the object observed by the caller.

22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.

28	
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}

109		}
110		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
111			return fmt.Errorf("root path changed: %w", ErrChanged)
112		}
113		return nil
114	}
115	
116	// VerifyChildRoot proves that name below parent still names the previously held
117	// child directory.
118	func VerifyChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
119		if parent == nil {
120			return errors.New("verify child root: nil parent")
121		}
122		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
123			return err
124		}
125		current, err := parent.Lstat(name)
126		if err != nil {
127			return err
128		}
129		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
130			return fmt.Errorf("component %q changed: %w", name, ErrChanged)
131		}
132		return nil
133	}
134	
135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166	
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186	
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}
205	
206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213	
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217	
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243	
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}
247
```

```text
228	type Filter struct {

239	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
240	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
241		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
242			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
243			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
244			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
245			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
246			return false
247		}
248		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
249			return false
250		}
251		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
252			return false
253		}
254		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
255			return false
256		}
257		return true
258	}
259	
260	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
261	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
262		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
263		for _, row := range rows {
264			if f.Match(row) {
265				out = append(out, row)
266			}
267		}
268		return out
269	}
270	
271	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
272	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
273		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
274			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
275			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
276			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
277			for n := range ak {
278				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
279					return ak[n] < bk[n]
280				}
281			}
282			return false
283		})
284	}
285	
286	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {

290		case ScopeLocal:
291			return "1-local"
292		case ScopeUser:
293			return "2-user"
294		case ScopeCustom:
295			return "3-custom"
296		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
297			return "4-system-defaults"
298		case ScopeSystemOverride:

300		case ScopeManaged:

314			return "configuration source is not a regular file"

323		case DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration:
```

603	Navigation is vim-style, arrows alongside:
604	
605	```
606	j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
607	g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
608	/          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
609	```
610	
611	Mouse cell tracking is enabled alongside the keyboard model. Left-click selects a
612	visible row or tab, the wheel moves three rows, and right-click selects a row then
613	opens the same available actions used by keyboard shortcuts. Clicks act on press;
614	release/motion and modified clicks are ignored, and repeated clicks never imply
615	open. Terminals that reserve tracked mouse input may require Shift/Option while
616	selecting text.
617	
618	`enter` opens a selected row only when its checkout is currently valid. Inside Herdr/tmux/Zellij it
619	switches the current client; outside it exits the dashboard and attaches to
620	the target session. A COLD worktree task requires `dev resume`; a missing or
621	unregistered worktree requires `dev sweep` first so artifacts can be salvaged

```text
84	// Task is one change stream. Field names are the TOML keys.
85	type Task struct {
86		// ID is derived from repo and branch; it is the filename stem and is not
87		// stored inside the file.
88		ID string `toml:"-"`
89	
90		// Name is the human label ("atp security recovery").
91		Name string `toml:"name"`
92		// Repo is the repository's display name.
93		Repo string `toml:"repo"`
94		// RepoPath is the main checkout, the directory git commands run in.
95		RepoPath string `toml:"repo_path"`
96		// Branch is the change stream's identity — the one durable handle that
97		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
98		Branch string `toml:"branch"`
99		// Base is the ref the branch was created from, recorded so `dev done` can
100		// integrate without re-guessing.
101		Base string `toml:"base"`
102		// WorktreePath is the linked checkout, empty when the task works directly
103		// in the main checkout or has gone cold.
104		WorktreePath string `toml:"worktree_path"`
105		// Mode says whether this task uses a worktree, a branch in the canonical
106		// checkout, or the current branch directly. Older entries infer it.
107		Mode CheckoutMode `toml:"mode"`
108	
109		State State `toml:"state"`
110		// Owner is the hostname that last held this task hot. One writer per
111		// branch at a time avoids two machines diverging the same history.
112		Owner string `toml:"owner"`
113		// Next is the single most valuable field in the file: what to do when you
114		// come back. Without it, parking a task still loses the thread.
115		Next string   `toml:"next"`
116		Note string   `toml:"note"`
117		Tags []string `toml:"tags"`
118	
119		// AgentSession reserves a resumable agent context ("claude:<uuid>"). The
120		// production start/park/resume flow does not yet capture or attach it.
121		AgentSession string `toml:"agent_session"`
122		// RuntimeHandle is the last known runtime session id (e.g. a Herdr
123		// workspace id). RuntimeName records which backend owns that opaque handle.
124		// Both are advisory and must be revalidated against live checkout coverage.
125		RuntimeHandle string `toml:"runtime_handle"`
126		RuntimeName   string `toml:"runtime_name"`
127	
128		Created time.Time `toml:"created"`
129		Updated time.Time `toml:"updated"`
130	
131		// storedRevision is populated only by Store after a successful read/write.
132		// It never enters TOML or Revision and lets legacy Save callers participate
133		// in compare-and-swap without adding a persisted field older binaries erase.
134		storedRevision string

137	// Revision returns a deterministic fingerprint of the task identity and every
138	// field represented by its TOML record. It is deliberately computed rather
139	// than persisted: older dev binaries can continue to read and rewrite task
140	// files without erasing a revision field they do not know about.
141	func (t Task) Revision() string {
142		hash := sha256.New()
143		writeString := func(value string) {
144			var length [8]byte
145			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
146			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
147			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(value))
148		}
149		writeTime := func(value time.Time) {
150			writeString(value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
151		}
152	
153		writeString("dev-task-revision-v1")
154		writeString(t.ID)
155		writeString(t.Name)
156		writeString(t.Repo)
157		writeString(t.RepoPath)
158		writeString(t.Branch)
159		writeString(t.Base)
160		writeString(t.WorktreePath)
161		writeString(string(t.Mode))
162		writeString(string(t.State))
163		writeString(t.Owner)
164		writeString(t.Next)
165		writeString(t.Note)
166		writeString(fmt.Sprint(len(t.Tags)))
167		for _, tag := range t.Tags {
168			writeString(tag)
169		}
170		writeString(t.AgentSession)
171		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
172		writeString(t.RuntimeName)
173		writeTime(t.Created)
174		writeTime(t.Updated)
175	
176		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
177	}
```

```text
1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
17	)
18	
19	// Repo is one discovered repository.
20	type Repo struct {
21		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
22		Name string
23		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
24		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
25		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
26		Path string
27		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
28		RealPath string
29		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
30		Symlink bool
31		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
32		Root string
33		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
34		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
35		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
36		// projects consistently.
37		Category string
38		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory; CommonDir is shared
39		// by every linked worktree of the clone.
40		GitDir    string
41		CommonDir string
42		MainRoot  string
43		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
44		Bare bool
45		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
46		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
47		// initialise them.
48		HasGit bool
49	}
50	
51	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
52	func (r Repo) Display() string {
53		if r.Category == "" {
54			return r.Name
55		}
56		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
57	}
58	
59	// Options tunes discovery.
60	type Options struct {
61		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
62		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
63		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
64		MaxDepth int
65		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
66		IncludeNonRepos bool
67		// Fast avoids per-repository git subprocesses. It is intended for shell
68		// completion: direct .git-file checkouts are skipped as linked worktrees and
69		// symlink aliases are deduplicated by their physical path.
70		Fast bool
71	}
72	
73	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
74	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
75	
76	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.
77	func CompletionOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3, Fast: true} }
78	
79	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
80	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
81	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
82		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
83		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
84		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
85		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
86	}
87	
88	// PathDiscoverableFromRoot reports whether the normal discovery walk can reach
89	// a repository at candidate from root. It mirrors the walk's depth and skipped
90	// directory policy without requiring the not-yet-created repository to exist.
```

```text
208	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
209	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add

211	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
212		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
213		for _, tag := range tags {
214			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
215			if tag != "" {
216				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
217			}
218		}
219		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
220		for tag := range seen {
221			out = append(out, tag)
222		}
223		sort.Strings(out)
224		return out
225	}
```

```text
1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}
```

```text
30	// the Program resumes. It's useful for spawning other interactive applications
31	// such as editors and shells from within a Program.

33	// To produce the command, pass an *exec.Cmd and a function which returns

50	func ExecProcess(c *exec.Cmd, fn ExecCallback) Cmd {
51		return Exec(wrapExecCommand(c), fn)

58	// ExecCommand can be implemented to execute things in a blocking fashion in

65	}

74	// interface.

102	func (p *Program) exec(c ExecCommand, fn ExecCallback) {
103		if err := p.ReleaseTerminal(); err != nil {
104			// If we can't release input, abort.
105			if fn != nil {
106				go p.Send(fn(err))
107			}
108			return
109		}
110	
111		c.SetStdin(p.input)
112		c.SetStdout(p.output)
113		c.SetStderr(os.Stderr)
114	
115		// Execute system command.
116		if err := c.Run(); err != nil {
117			p.renderer.resetLinesRendered()
118			_ = p.RestoreTerminal() // also try to restore the terminal.
119			if fn != nil {
120				go p.Send(fn(err))
121			}
122			return
123		}
124

126		p.renderer.resetLinesRendered()
127	
128		// Have the program re-capture input.

132		}
```

```text
1426	func mcpMatches(row agentmcp.Declaration, query string) bool {
1427		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1428		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1429			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1430			if structured {
1431				var field string
1432				switch key {
1433				case "repo":
1434					field = row.Repository
1435				case "agent":
1436					field = string(row.Agent)
1437				case "scope":
1438					field = string(row.Scope)
1439				case "transport":
1440					field = string(row.Transport)
1441				case "managed":
1442					field = string(row.Source)
1443				case "state":
1444					field = mcpDeclarationState(row)
1445				default:
1446					field = ""
1447				}
1448				if field != "" {
1449					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(field), value) {
1450						return false
1451					}
1452					continue
1453				}
1454			}
1455			search := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
1456				row.Name, string(row.Agent), string(row.Scope), row.Repository,
1457				row.RepositoryPath, row.Checkout, string(row.Source), row.Plugin,
1458				string(row.Transport), mcpDeclarationState(row), row.Endpoint, row.Command,
1459			}, " "))
1460			if !strings.Contains(search, term) {
1461				return false
1462			}
1463		}
1464		return true
1465	}
```

```text
118			_ = p.RestoreTerminal() // also try to restore the terminal.
```

```text
45	func newTUICmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

48			Short: "Interactive dashboard over the inventory",
49			Long: `Browse and act on your work in progress.
50	
51	Shows exactly what "dev ls" shows, from the same code path, plus the ability
52	to open, park and annotate a task without retyping its name.
53	
54	Seven lists, switched with tab:
55	
56	  TASKS   change streams dev is tracking — what am I working on
57	  REPOS   durable repositories under the scan roots — what do I have here
58	  FLEET   repositories and active work across configured SSH machines
59	  TRY     scratch experiments and retained lifecycle history
60	  REMOTE  repositories visible through configured forge CLIs — what can I clone/open
61	  SKILLS  startup-context/global agent skills; A toggles all repositories
62	  MCP     startup-context static declarations; A toggles all repositories
63	
64	Navigation is vim-style, with arrows and mouse alongside:
65	
66	  j k        move                 ctrl+d ctrl+u   half a page
67	  g G        top / bottom         h l / tab       previous / next view
68	  /          filter as you type   esc             clear, then quit
69	  left click select row/tab       wheel            move three rows
70	  right click selected row actions; click never opens a row directly
71	
72	Actions depend on the list:
73	
74	  TASKS   enter open · p park · c edit next
75	  REPOS   enter ad hoc · space worktrees · m metadata · s worktree task · d direct task
76	  FLEET   enter Herdr/SSH open · Git changes are read-only here
77	  TRY     enter open · n create · space lifecycle/metadata actions
78	  REMOTE  enter open local · c clone after confirmation
79	  SKILLS  a add · c check · u update · e open file · y copy · A context/all
80	  MCP     e open config · y copy · A context/all · r reload static declarations
81	
82	  y       REPOS yy/yp/yb/ys/yw; SKILLS/MCP yp path · ys summary · yf raw file
83	  H       selected repo heatmap; b backfills it when empty
84	  e       edit the current view's config/file; returning reloads that source
85	  O / R   cycle / reverse REPOS or TRY sort
86	  r       reload config + data     1 / 2 / 3  hot / warm / cold
87	  0       clear filters            a include history  ? help  q quit

102	func newTUIToolsCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
103		return &cobra.Command{
104			Use:   "tools",

106			Long: `Show which programs the dashboard will hand the terminal to.
107	
108	Bindings come from [[tui.tools]] in the config; with none configured, the
109	built-in set applies. A configured list replaces the defaults entirely, so
110	what is bound is always exactly what is written down.
111	
112	Add your own — an editor, a script, anything you already reach for:
113

115	    key  = "V"

118	
119	    [[tui.tools]]
120	    key  = "B"
121	    name = "vibe"
122	    run  = "vibe"
123	
124	The command runs through your shell in the selected row's checkout, so
125	arguments, environment variables and your own scripts all behave as typed.
126	Set interactive = true only for aliases/functions from your shell rc; that
127	binding runs through $SHELL -lic and the mode is shown in this listing.`,
128			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
129			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
130				configured := len(app.Cfg.TUI.Tools) > 0
131				source := "built-in defaults"
132				if configured {
133					source = config.Contract(app.Cfg.Source)
134				}
135				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "tool bindings from %s\n\n", source)
136	
137				t := app.newTable("KEY", "NAME", "MODE", "RUNS", "AVAILABLE")
138				style := app.outStyle()
139				configuredTools := app.Cfg.EffectiveTools()
140				for i, tool := range externalTools(app) {
141					status := "yes"
142					if tool.Probe != nil && !tool.Probe(ctxOf()) {
143						status = style.warning("no — not on PATH")
144					} else {
145						status = style.success(status)
146					}
147					// Command is [shell, -c/-lic, run]; show the run itself.
148					run := tool.Command[len(tool.Command)-1]
149					mode := "shell"
150					if i < len(configuredTools) && configuredTools[i].Interactive {
151						mode = "interactive"
152					}
153					t.Add(tool.Key, tool.Name, mode, run, status)
154				}
155				t.Render(app.Out)
156	
157				if !configured {
158					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nOverride them with [[tui.tools]] in your config; see \"dev tui tools --help\".")
159				}
160				fmt.Fprintln(app.Err, "\nA tool cannot take a key the dashboard already uses; dev reports the clash on load.")
161				return nil
162			},
163		}

166	// interactive reports whether a real terminal is attached. Piping `dev` into
167	// anything must produce the plain listing, not terminal control sequences.
168	func interactive() bool {
169		for _, f := range []*os.File{os.Stdin, os.Stdout} {
170			info, err := f.Stat()
171			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeCharDevice == 0 {
172				return false
173			}
174		}
175		return true
176	}

196	func tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app *App, name string) (string, error) {
197		projectRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot)
198		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(projectRoot, name)
199		if err != nil {
200			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
201		}
202		return destination, nil
203	}
204	
205	func cloneRemoteFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, row tui.RemoteRow) (string, error) {
206		destination, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app, row.Repo.Name)
207		if err != nil {
208			return "", err
209		}
210		discoverable, err := repositoryPathDiscoverable(app.Cfg, destination)
211		if err != nil {
212			return "", fmt.Errorf("verify REMOTE clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
213		}
214		if !discoverable {
215			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is outside paths.scan_roots/repo_paths; add paths.project_root to scan_roots before cloning from REMOTE",
216				config.Contract(destination))
217		}
218		if _, err := os.Lstat(destination); err == nil {
219			return destination, fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots/repo_paths or move it before cloning", config.Contract(destination))
220		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
221			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
222		}
223		acquired, err := repo.Acquire(ctx, repo.AcquireRequest{
224			Kind: repo.AcquireClone, Name: row.Repo.Name,
225			CloneRef: row.Repo.CloneURL, Destination: destination,
226		})
227		if err != nil {
228			if _, statErr := os.Lstat(destination); statErr == nil {
229				return destination, fmt.Errorf("%w; inspect the destination now present at %s before retrying", err, config.Contract(destination))
230			}
231			return "", err
232		}
233		return acquired.Path, nil
234	}

236	func startDirectFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, row tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
237		if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, row.Repo.Path); err != nil {
238			return "", err
239		}
240		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, row.Repo.Path)
241		if err != nil {
242			return "", err
243		}
244		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
245			return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
246		}
247		id := task.MakeID(row.Repo.Name, status.Branch)
248		replaceDoneRevision := ""
249		existing, err := existingTaskForStart(app.Tasks, id)
250		if err != nil {
251			return "", err
252		}
253		if existing != nil && existing.State != task.Done {
254			return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
255		}
256		if existing != nil {
257			replaceDoneRevision = existing.Revision()
258		}
259		handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, row.Repo.Path, row.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
260		if err != nil {
261			return "", err
262		}
263		tracked := &task.Task{
264			Name: name, Repo: row.Repo.Name, RepoPath: row.Repo.Path,
265			Branch: status.Branch, Base: status.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
266			State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
267		}
268		setTaskRuntime(tracked, rt, handle)
269		if replaceDoneRevision != "" {
270			err = app.Tasks.ReplaceDone(tracked, replaceDoneRevision)
271		} else {
272			err = app.Tasks.Save(tracked)
273		}
274		if err != nil {
275			if handle.Created && handle.Handle != "" {
276				_ = rt.Close(ctx, handle.Handle)
277			}
278			return "", err
279		}
280		annotate(app, rt, tracked)
281		return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, status.Branch), nil
282	}

643			LoadStats: func(ctx context.Context, repoName string) (tui.StatsPanel, error) {
644				active := appState.Current()
645				store, err := stats.Open(stats.Path(active.Cfg.StateDir()))
646				if err != nil {
647					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
648				}
649				defer store.Close()
650				until := time.Now()
651				since := until.AddDate(-1, 0, 0)
652				totals, err := store.DayTotals(stats.Query{
653					Since: since, Until: until, Repo: repoName, ExactRepo: true,
654				})
655				if err != nil {
656					return tui.StatsPanel{}, err
657				}
658				seconds, days := 0, 0
659				for _, value := range totals {
660					seconds += value
661					if value > 0 {
662						days++
663					}
664				}
665				return tui.StatsPanel{
666					Repo: repoName, Seconds: seconds, ActiveDays: days,
667					Since: since, Until: until,
668					Heatmap: stats.Heatmap(totals, stats.HeatmapOptions{
669						Since: since, Until: until, Legend: true, WeekdayLabels: true,
670					}),
671				}, nil
672			},

681				if err != nil {

683				}
684				defer store.Close()
685				_, err = stats.BackfillGit(ctx, store, []repo.Repo{r}, time.Now().AddDate(-1, 0, 0), "")
686				return err
687			},

706			ReloadConfig: func(ctx context.Context) (tui.ConfigUpdate, string, error) {
707				currentRuntime, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
708				if err != nil {
709					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
710				}
711				oldRuntime := currentRuntime.Name()
712				next, err := appState.Prepare(ctx)
713				if err != nil {
714					return tui.ConfigUpdate{}, "", err
715				}
716				status := "config + data reloaded"
717				if nextRuntime := next.Runtime().Name(); nextRuntime != oldRuntime {
718					status += fmt.Sprintf("; restart TUI to switch runtime %s → %s", oldRuntime, nextRuntime)
719				}
720				return tui.ConfigUpdate{
721					Apply:       func() { appState.Commit(next) },
722					Tools:       externalTools(next),
723					RepoColumns: next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
724					RepoSort:    next.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
725					RepoReverse: next.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
726				}, status, nil
727			},
728		}
729	
730		// Enter the alternate screen immediately. Local inventory is loaded by
731		// Init in the background rather than making the terminal appear frozen
732		// while dozens of repos are probed.
733		model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
734		finishSetup(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
735		app.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIProgramRunBegin, perftrace.Fields{})
736		final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen(), tea.WithMouseCellMotion()).Run()
737		cancelRun()
738		app.finishTrace()
739		if err != nil {
740			return err
741		}
742		// A directory choice can only be honoured once the alternate screen is
743		// torn down, and only by the shell wrapper.
744		if m, ok := final.(tui.Model); ok {
745			if dir := m.Chosen(); dir != "" {
746				return app.cdDirective(dir)
747			}
748			if handle := m.Activation(); handle != "" {
749				rt, resolveErr := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctxOf())
750				if resolveErr != nil {
751					return resolveErr
752				}
753				return activateRuntime(ctxOf(), rt, handle)
754			}
755		}
756		return nil
757	}

767	// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe either what an agent
768	// launched from the startup context would see or every accepted repository.
769	// Global sources are still scanned once by the domain collectors.
770	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {
771		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
772		for _, row := range locals {
773			if !row.IsTry() {
774				repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
775			}
776		}
777		targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
778		if scope == tui.CapabilityAllRepositories {
779			return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
780		}
781		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" && current.CommonDir != "" &&
782			!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
783			return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
784		}
785		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
786	}
```
