```text
196	func tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app *App, name string) (string, error) {
197		projectRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot)
198		destination, err := pathx.JoinChild(projectRoot, name)
199		if err != nil {
200			return "", fmt.Errorf("remote repository name %q is not a safe clone destination: %w", name, err)
201		}
202		return destination, nil
203	}
204	
205	func cloneRemoteFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, row tui.RemoteRow) (string, error) {
206		destination, err := tuiRemoteCloneDestination(app, row.Repo.Name)
207		if err != nil {
208			return "", err
209		}
210		discoverable, err := repositoryPathDiscoverable(app.Cfg, destination)
211		if err != nil {
212			return "", fmt.Errorf("verify REMOTE clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
213		}
214		if !discoverable {
215			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is outside paths.scan_roots/repo_paths; add paths.project_root to scan_roots before cloning from REMOTE",
216				config.Contract(destination))
217		}
218		if _, err := os.Lstat(destination); err == nil {
219			return destination, fmt.Errorf("%s already exists; add it to scan_roots/repo_paths or move it before cloning", config.Contract(destination))
220		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
221			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect clone destination %s: %w", config.Contract(destination), err)
222		}
223		acquired, err := repo.Acquire(ctx, repo.AcquireRequest{
224			Kind: repo.AcquireClone, Name: row.Repo.Name,
225			CloneRef: row.Repo.CloneURL, Destination: destination,
226		})
227		if err != nil {
228			if _, statErr := os.Lstat(destination); statErr == nil {
229				return destination, fmt.Errorf("%w; inspect the destination now present at %s before retrying", err, config.Contract(destination))
230			}
231			return "", err
232		}
233		return acquired.Path, nil
234	}

236	func startDirectFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, row tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
237		if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, row.Repo.Path); err != nil {
238			return "", err
239		}
240		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, row.Repo.Path)
241		if err != nil {
242			return "", err
243		}
244		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
245			return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
246		}
247		id := task.MakeID(row.Repo.Name, status.Branch)
248		replaceDoneRevision := ""
249		existing, err := existingTaskForStart(app.Tasks, id)
250		if err != nil {
251			return "", err
252		}
253		if existing != nil && existing.State != task.Done {
254			return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
255		}
256		if existing != nil {
257			replaceDoneRevision = existing.Revision()
258		}
259		handle, err := rt.Open(ctx, row.Repo.Path, row.Repo.Name+"/"+name)
260		if err != nil {
261			return "", err
262		}
263		tracked := &task.Task{
264			Name: name, Repo: row.Repo.Name, RepoPath: row.Repo.Path,
265			Branch: status.Branch, Base: status.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
266			State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),
267		}
268		setTaskRuntime(tracked, rt, handle)
269		if replaceDoneRevision != "" {
270			err = app.Tasks.ReplaceDone(tracked, replaceDoneRevision)
271		} else {
272			err = app.Tasks.Save(tracked)
273		}
274		if err != nil {
275			if handle.Created && handle.Handle != "" {
276				_ = rt.Close(ctx, handle.Handle)
277			}
278			return "", err
279		}
280		annotate(app, rt, tracked)
281		return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, status.Branch), nil
282	}

284	func runTUI(app *App) error {
285		app.traceTUI = true
286		runCtx, cancelRun := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
287		defer cancelRun()
288		finishSetup := app.trace.Start(perftrace.TUISetup, perftrace.Fields{})
289		// --color, NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb governed every other surface but stopped
290		// at the dashboard, which resolved its own palette independently.
291		tui.SetColorEnabled(app.outStyle().enabled)
292		appState := newTUIAppState(app)
293		runtimeResolver := newTUIRuntimeResolver(app)
294		projectRootResolver := newTUIProjectRootResolver(app.trace, runCtx)
295		localLoader := newTUILocalLoader(app, runtimeResolver)
296		localLoader.current = appState.Current
297	
298		reload := func(ctx context.Context) ([]inventory.Row, error) {
299			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
300			if err != nil {
301				return nil, err
302			}
303			tasks, err := appState.Current().Tasks.List()
304			if err != nil {
305				return nil, err
306			}
307			return inventory.Collect(ctx, tasks, rt, inventory.Options{}), nil
308		}
309		reloadRepos := func(ctx context.Context) ([]tui.RepoRow, error) {
310			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
311			if err != nil {
312				return nil, err
313			}
314			// Keep Try repositories in the model's local snapshot so cached REMOTE
315			// rows can be matched and cleared correctly. The REPOS view filters them.
316			return collectReposWithOptions(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, repoCollectOptions{IncludeTries: true})
317		}
318		reloadRemote := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
319			return collectRemotesForRows(ctx, appState.Current(), locals)
320		}
321		reloadFleet := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.FleetRow, error) {
322			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
323			if err != nil {
324				return nil, err
325			}
326			snapshot := fleetSnapshotFromRepoRows(locals, rt.Name())
327			results, _, err := collectFleet(ctx, appState.Current(), fleetCollectOptions{LocalSnapshot: &snapshot})
328			return fleetRows(results), err
329		}
330		capabilityTargets := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow, scope tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agenttarget.Target, error) {
331			current, err := projectRootResolver.ResolveTarget(ctx)
332			if err != nil {
333				return nil, err
334			}
335			return tuiCapabilityTargets(locals, current, scope), nil
336		}
337		reloadSkills := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow, scope tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agentskill.Skill, error) {
338			targets, err := capabilityTargets(ctx, locals, scope)
339			if err != nil {
340				return nil, err
341			}
342			result, err := inventory.CollectAgentSkills(ctx, targets, inventory.AgentSkillOptions{})
343			if err != nil {
344				return result.Skills, err
345			}
346			if len(result.Diagnostics) > 0 {
347				return result.Skills, tui.LoadWarning{Message: fmt.Sprintf("%d skill inventory diagnostic(s); run `dev skill list --all` for details", len(result.Diagnostics))}
348			}
349			return result.Skills, nil
350		}
351		reloadMCP := func(ctx context.Context, locals []tui.RepoRow, scope tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
352			targets, err := capabilityTargets(ctx, locals, scope)
353			if err != nil {
354				return nil, err
355			}
356			result, err := agentmcp.Scan(ctx, targets)
357			if err != nil {
358				return result.Declarations, err
359			}
360			if len(result.Diagnostics) > 0 {
361				return result.Declarations, tui.LoadWarning{Message: fmt.Sprintf("%d MCP inventory diagnostic(s); run `dev mcp list --all` for details", len(result.Diagnostics))}
362			}
363			return result.Declarations, nil
364		}
365		reloadTries := func(ctx context.Context, includeAll bool) ([]tui.TryRow, error) {
366			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
367			if err != nil {
368				return nil, err
369			}
370			return collectTries(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, includeAll)
371		}
372		openResolved := func(ctx context.Context, dir, label, statusLabel string) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
373			rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
374			if err != nil {
375				return tui.OpenResult{}, err
376			}
377			handle, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, dir, label)
378			if err != nil {
379				return tui.OpenResult{}, err
380			}
381			if rt.Name() == "none" {
382				return tui.OpenResult{Directory: dir}, nil
383			}
384			if statusLabel == "" {
385				statusLabel = label
386			}
387			return tui.OpenResult{
388				Status:        fmt.Sprintf("%s open in %s (%s)", statusLabel, rt.Name(), handle.Handle),
389				RuntimeHandle: handle.Handle,
390			}, nil
391		}
392	
393		actions := tui.Actions{
394			Reload:                reload,
395			ReloadRepos:           reloadRepos,
396			ReloadRemoteWithRepos: reloadRemote,
397			ReloadFleetWithRepos:  reloadFleet,
398			ReloadSkillsWithRepos: reloadSkills,
399			ReloadMCPWithRepos:    reloadMCP,
400			LoadRemoteCache: func(context.Context) tui.RemoteCacheResult {
401				rows, found, stale := cachedRemoteRows(appState.Current())
402				return tui.RemoteCacheResult{Rows: rows, Found: found, Stale: stale}
403			},
404			LoadFleetCache: func(context.Context) tui.FleetCacheResult {
405				rows := cachedFleetRows(appState.Current())
406				return tui.FleetCacheResult{Rows: rows, Found: len(rows) > 0}
407			},
408			AfterFirstView: func(context.Context) {
409				if app.deferredReleaseRefresh {
410					app.refreshReleaseDetached()
411				}
412			},
413			CheckSkills: func(ctx context.Context, rows []agentskill.Skill) []agentskill.Skill {
414				return agentskill.CheckUpdates(ctx, rows)
415			},
416			AddSkill: func() (*agentskill.MutationCommand, error) {
417				projectRoot, ok := projectRootResolver.Current()
418				if !ok {
419					return nil, errors.New("project root is still loading")
420				}
421				return agentskill.AddCommand(context.Background(), projectRoot, agentskill.DefaultSource)
422			},
423			UpdateSkill: func(row agentskill.Skill) (*agentskill.MutationCommand, error) {
424				projectRoot := row.Checkout
425				if row.Scope == agentskill.ScopeGlobal || projectRoot == "" {
426					var ok bool
427					projectRoot, ok = projectRootResolver.Current()
428					if !ok {
429						return nil, errors.New("project root is still loading")
430					}
431				}
432				managedName := row.Name
433				if row.Lock != nil {
434					managedName = row.Lock.Name
435				}
436				return agentskill.UpdateCommand(context.Background(), projectRoot, managedName, row.Scope)
437			},
438			Repos: tui.RepoActions{
439				Patch: func(ctx context.Context, row tui.RepoRow, tags []string, note string) (string, error) {
440					active := appState.Current()
441					remove := []string(nil)
442					if row.Asset != nil {
443						remove = append(remove, row.Asset.Tags...)
444					}
445					marked, err := patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx, active, row.Repo, tags, remove, &note)
446					if err != nil {
447						return "", err
448					}
449					return "updated metadata for " + marked.Title(), nil
450				},
451			},
452			Tries: tui.TryActions{
453				Reload: reloadTries,
454				Apply: func(ctx context.Context, request tui.TryRequest) (tui.TryActionResult, error) {
455					rt, err := runtimeResolver.Resolve(ctx)
456					if err != nil {
457						return tui.TryActionResult{}, err
458					}
459					return applyTryAction(ctx, appState.Current(), rt, request)
460				},
461			},
462			Notes: tui.NoteActions{
463				List: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget) ([]*note.Note, error) {
464					active := appState.Current()
465					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
466					if err != nil {
467						return nil, err
468					}
469					return active.Notes.List(entry.ID)
470				},
471				Search: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget, query string) ([]*note.Note, error) {
472					active := appState.Current()
473					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
474					if err != nil {
475						return nil, err
476					}
477					return active.Notes.Search(query, entry.ID, 100)
478				},
479				Add: func(ctx context.Context, target tui.NoteTarget, body string) (string, error) {
480					active := appState.Current()
481					entry, _, err := ensureNoteRepository(ctx, active, target)
482					if err != nil {
483						return "", err
484					}
485					n, err := active.Notes.Add(ctx, entry.ID, entry.Title(), body, nil)
486					if err != nil {
487						return "", err
488					}
489					return "added note " + n.ID[:8] + " to " + entry.Title(), nil
490				},
491				Delete: func(ctx context.Context, n *note.Note) (string, error) {
492					if err := appState.Current().Notes.Delete(ctx, n.ID); err != nil {
493						return "", err
494					}
495					return "deleted note " + n.ID[:8], nil
496				},
497				Edit: func(n *note.Note) (tui.NoteEdit, error) {
498					return prepareTUINoteEdit(appState.Current(), n)
499				},
500			},
501			Sizes: tui.SizeActions{
502				Start: func(ctx context.Context, targets []diskusage.Target, force bool) diskusage.Load {
503					return appState.Current().Sizes.Start(ctx, targets, force)
504				},
505				Cancel: func(loadID uint64) { appState.Current().Sizes.Cancel(loadID) },
506			},
507			Local:       tui.LocalActions{Start: localLoader.Start},
508			Tools:       externalTools(app),
509			RepoColumns: app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoColumns(),
510			RepoSort:    app.Cfg.EffectiveRepoSort(),
511			RepoReverse: app.Cfg.TUI.Repos.Reverse,
512			Copy:        clipboard.WriteAll,
513			ReadFile:    readTUICapabilityFile,
514			OpenFile:    capabilityFileEditorProcess,
515	
516			// Open is navigation-only. The model rejects missing/unregistered and
517			// cold worktree tasks before this callback so reconciliation and writer
518			// ownership remain explicit `dev sweep` / `dev resume` operations.
519			Open: func(ctx context.Context, t *task.Task) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
520				checkout := checkoutOf(t)
521				if _, err := os.Stat(checkout); err != nil {
522					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout — run `dev resume %s`", t.Title(), t.ID)
523				}
524				// Enter is navigation only. Claiming a writer is an explicit
525				// `dev resume`/start action with collision checks.
526				return openResolved(ctx, checkout, t.Title(), "")
527			},
528	
529			OpenRepo: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
530				return openResolved(ctx, r.Repo.Path, r.Repo.Name, "")
531			},
532	
533			OpenCheckout: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RepoRow, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
534				branch := checkout.Branch()
535				if branch == "" {
536					branch = filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
537				}
538				label := r.Repo.Name + "/" + branch
539				return openResolved(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, label, "")
540			},
541	
542			OpenRemote: func(ctx context.Context, r tui.RemoteRow) (tui.OpenResult, error) {
543				if r.LocalPath == "" {
544					return tui.OpenResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s has no local checkout; press c to clone it", r.Repo.FullName)
545				}
546				return openResolved(ctx, r.LocalPath, r.Repo.Name, r.Repo.FullName)
547			},
548	
549			OpenFleet: func(ctx context.Context, row tui.FleetRow) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
```

```text
100	func expectedTransition(mode task.CheckoutMode, state task.State, action Action) TransitionRule {
101		rule := TransitionRule{Mode: mode, Source: state, Action: action}
102		allow := func(target task.State, preserving, removes bool, milestone Milestone) TransitionRule {
103			rule.Allowed = true
104			rule.Target = target
105			rule.StatePreserving = preserving
106			rule.RemovesTask = removes
107			rule.Milestone = milestone
108			return rule
109		}
110	
111		if mode == task.ModeDirect && state == task.Cold {
112			return rule
113		}
114		if action == Retire && state == task.Done {
115			return allow("", false, true, MilestoneRetired)
116		}
117		if state == task.Done || state == task.Cold && action != Resume {
118			return rule
119		}
120	
121		switch action {
122		case ParkWarm:
123			if state == task.Hot {
124				return allow(task.Warm, false, false, MilestoneNone)
125			}
126			if state == task.Warm {
127				return allow(task.Warm, true, false, MilestoneNone)
128			}
129		case ParkCold:
130			if mode != task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
131				return allow(task.Cold, false, false, MilestoneNone)
132			}
133		case Resume:
134			if state == task.Warm || mode != task.ModeDirect && state == task.Cold {
135				return allow(task.Hot, false, false, MilestoneNone)
136			}
137		case CompleteDirect:
138			if mode == task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
139				return allow(task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
140			}
141		case CompleteFF, VerifyMerged:
142			if mode != task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
143				return allow(task.Done, false, false, MilestoneMerged)
144			}
145		case ReviewHandoff:
146			if mode != task.ModeDirect && (state == task.Hot || state == task.Warm) {
147				return allow(state, true, false, MilestoneReviewReady)
148			}
149		}
150		return rule
151	}
```

```text
15	// PlanSpec is action-handler construction input. Authority holds additional
16	// exact identities such as status, runtime, artifact, or remote fingerprints.
17	// BuildPlan copies every map and slice.
18	type PlanSpec struct {
19		Authority         map[string]string
20		Conditions        []Condition
21		Effects           []Effect
22		RetainedResources []string
23		Confirmation      Confirmation
24		FallbackCommand   string
25		Summary           string
26		DisplayedAt       time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Plan is an immutable-by-interface proposal bound to one request and one
30	// authority fingerprint. Collection accessors always return copies.
31	type Plan struct {
32		PlanID                 string
33		AuthorityFingerprint   string
34		Request                Request
35		Locator                Locator
36		Action                 Action
37		Source                 task.State
38		Target                 task.State
39		HasPersistedTransition bool
40		StatePreserving        bool
41		RemovesTask            bool
42		Availability           Availability
43		Confirmation           Confirmation
44		ExpectedMilestone      Milestone
45		FallbackCommand        string
46		Summary                string
47		DisplayedAt            time.Time
48	
49		authority  Fields
50		conditions []Condition
51		effects    []Effect
52		retained   StringList
53	}
54	
55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}
107	
108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}
117	
118	// AuthorityFields returns a mutable copy of the extra authority identities.
119	func (p Plan) AuthorityFields() map[string]string { return p.authority.Map() }
120	
121	// Conditions returns the ordered conditions as a mutable copy.
122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }
123	
124	// Effects returns independent copies of the ordered effects.
125	func (p Plan) Effects() []Effect { return cloneEffects(p.effects) }
126	
127	// RetainedResources returns the resources intentionally left after Apply.
128	func (p Plan) RetainedResources() []string { return p.retained.Values() }
129	
130	// InputConditions returns required operator input without conflating it with a
131	// safety override.
132	func (p Plan) InputConditions() []Condition {
133		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
134			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict == VerdictNeedsInput
135		})
136	}
137	
138	// BlockingConditions returns every required, non-input condition that prevents
139	// READY. Advisory conditions are intentionally absent.
140	func (p Plan) BlockingConditions() []Condition {
141		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput
144		})
145	}
146	
147	// AdvisoryConditions returns non-authorizing evidence for display.
148	func (p Plan) AdvisoryConditions() []Condition {
149		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
150			return condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory
151		})
152	}
153	
154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
```

```text
36	func newLifecycleSession(ctx context.Context, app *App, resolve lifecycleTaskResolver) (lifecycleSession, error) {

82				s.Locator.TaskID, result.Milestone, flow.MilestoneRetired)
```

```text
331	// handleCommands runs commands in a goroutine and sends the result to the
332	// program's message channel.
333	func (p *Program) handleCommands(cmds chan Cmd) chan struct{} {
334		ch := make(chan struct{})
335	
336		go func() {
337			defer close(ch)
338	
339			for {
340				select {
341				case <-p.ctx.Done():
342					return
343	
344				case cmd := <-cmds:
345					if cmd == nil {
346						continue
347					}
348	
349					// Don't wait on these goroutines, otherwise the shutdown
350					// latency would get too large as a Cmd can run for some time
351					// (e.g. tick commands that sleep for half a second). It's not
352					// possible to cancel them so we'll have to leak the goroutine
353					// until Cmd returns.
354					go func() {
355						// Recover from panics.
356						if !p.startupOptions.has(withoutCatchPanics) {
357							defer func() {
358								if r := recover(); r != nil {
359									p.recoverFromGoPanic(r)
360								}
361							}()
362						}
363	
364						msg := cmd() // this can be long.
365						p.Send(msg)
366					}()
367				}
368			}
369		}()
370	
371		return ch
372	}
```

```text
1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}
```

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-09-04 05:03:40Z)**_

The renderer behavior is explicit in Bubble Tea v1.3.10: when `len(newLines) > height`, it replaces the frame with the last `height` lines (`newLines[len(newLines)-height:]`) before painting from the alternate-screen home position. I’m now constructing a no-working-tree-change reproduction through Go’s overlay mechanism to pin down the logical-to-visible offset and resulting mis-click, rather than relying only on static inference.

51	`internal/cli` assembles commands, parses flags, invokes services, and renders output. Keep policy out of command handlers; it belongs in independently testable domain packages:
52	
53	- `config` owns defaults, TOML overlays, validation, and XDG paths.
54	- `gitx` is the Git porcelain boundary and canonicalizes repository identity through the shared Git common directory.
55	- `task` persists only human intent Git cannot derive: task mode/state, owner, next action, and runtime hints. Lifecycle callers use exact-record revisions and locked compare-and-update/delete transactions rather than treating a previously read task as current.
56	- `wt` owns managed linked-worktree creation, placement, provisioning plans, and safe removal. 59	- `repo` discovers and deduplicates repositories; `inventory` joins repositories, Git state, tasks, all registered worktrees, and live runtime data. CLI listings and UI projections consume this joined view.

62	- `note` stores multiple repository thoughts as durable Markdown keyed by catalog ID and maintains a rebuildable SQLite FTS index. It is distinct from task context and the catalog's single metadata summary.
63	- `tui` owns Bubble Tea state/rendering only. `internal/cli/tui.go` injects callbacks to the same services used by non-interactive commands.
64	- `stats` is durable SQLite data; `diskusage`, note FTS, and forge/gitignore data are regenerable caches. Do not treat stats as cache.
65	- `forge` wraps optional `gh`, `glab`, and Azure CLI integrations and must degrade to local Git behavior when they are unavailable.

Task-backed park/resume/completion/retirement and exact unmanaged Adopt/Remove policy belong in `taskflow`; CLI commands, the dashboard, `sweep`, and `flowtui` are adapters. Preserve report-before-apply and no-data-loss ordering, including the isolated compatibility paths that have not migrated to taskflow.

71	State is split intentionally:
72	
73	- Git remotes/branches are durable code truth.
74	- Worktrees are disposable local checkouts.
75	- Runtime sessions are per-host and re-derivable.
76	- Task TOML and catalog assets hold only intent/identity that Git cannot answer.
77	- Repository quick-note Markdown is durable sidecar data; `notes.db` is only its disposable search index.

80	- Fleet intent is the merged primary `remotes.toml` plus generated sibling `remotes.d` fragments. A generated fragment exists only after explicit `dev ssh setup --fleet` and a fresh ordinary alias login; controller caches and each remote machine's paths/tasks/runtime remain re-derivable or host-local.
81	
82	## Behavioral contracts
83	
84	- Task modes are `worktree`, `branch`, and `direct`; lifecycle states are `hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done`. READY/REVIEW/MERGED/RETIRED are action readiness or result milestones, never extra persisted states.
85	- Persisted intent, observed facts, and guarded action plans are separate layers. Unknown, failed, skipped, loading, or stale observations never become a false clean/closed fact.
86	- Use an explicit base for branch/worktree creation. Do not infer a safe base from whichever branch happens to be checked out.
87	- Never nest a managed worktree inside a repository. Removing a worktree does not remove its branch, and dirty removal stays opt-in.
88	- Cold parking requires committed, pushed, reconstructible work before runtime/worktree cleanup.
89	- A taskflow Plan is bound to the exact task revision and repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact identities shown at Plan time. Apply must lock, reload, and revalidate those identities; a changed revision or authority produces a stale-plan result with no new effect.
90	- Managed rows receive only legal mode/state lifecycle actions. An unmanaged linked checkout may be adopted by metadata-only task creation or removed only when exact, clean, unclaimed, non-harness, and branch-preserving; canonical, harness-owned, ambiguous/conflicting, locked, prunable, or incompletely observed rows fail closed for destructive actions.
91	- Local repository refresh must not contact remotes. Fetching refs and querying a forge are explicit network actions, and review evidence is run-local manual evidence limited to portable existence/state/draft/URL/provider/time fields; never infer review decisions or checks.
92	- Reconciliation flows such as `sweep`, command-level `adopt`, and bootstrap organization plans report before applying changes. Direct actions such as `wt rm`, `tries archive`, and `cache clear` mutate immediately after their own safety checks; do not treat them as previews. `dev flow` is plan-first regardless of the adapted command's normal CLI interaction.
93	- Raw Git and configured external tools remain outside dev-mediated locks, revalidation, and safety guarantees. Existing expert CLI flags remain compatibility surface even when the preview flow deliberately omits them.
94	- A recognized agent in a canonical checkout occupies it regardless of whether its status is working, idle, done, or unknown. Shared-writer overrides require coordinated disjoint ownership.
95	- A parallel launch target is only the exact root pane returned for a newly created first-class Herdr worktree; reused/fallback/unverified surfaces fail closed.
96	- `dev ls --json` is an external automation contract. Add fields rather than renaming/removing existing fields; apply the same compatibility care to other documented structured output.
97	- Quick notes attach to the canonical repository through catalog identity. Markdown is durable, note deletion requires confirmation, and clearing/rebuilding note FTS must never delete source files.
98	- SSH initialization is report-before-apply; managed host changes are confined to canonical dev-owned fragments. Full bootstrap requires an explicit existing key or explicit generation, registers fleet only behind `--fleet`, and reports interrupted remote installation as unknown rather than pretending to roll it back.
99	- Filesystem transitions must retain path traversal/symlink, same-filesystem, source revalidation, and rollback/reconciliation checks.

```text
20	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
21	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
22	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
23	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
24	type Target struct {
25		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
26		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
27		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
28		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
29		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
30	}
31	
32	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
33	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
34	func (t Target) Key() string {
35		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
36	}
37	
38	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
39	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
40	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
41	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
42		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
43		if err == nil {
44			return target, nil
45		}
46		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
47			return Target{}, ctxErr
48		}
49		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
50			return Target{}, err
51		}
52		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
53		if pathErr != nil {
54			return Target{}, pathErr
55		}
56		name := filepath.Base(root)
57		return Target{
58			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
59			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
60		}, nil
61	}
62	
63	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
64	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
65		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
66		if err != nil {
67			return Target{}, err
68		}
69		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
70		if err != nil {
71			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
72		}
73		return fromGit(found)
74	}
75	
76	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
77	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
78	// worktree path is preserved.
79	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
80		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Target{}, err
83		}
84		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
85		if err != nil {
86			return Target{}, err
87		}
88		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
89		// An explicit linked-worktree path keeps the main repository identity from
90		// Git, but its checkout root remains the navigation path the caller selected.
91		switch {
92		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath):
93			if found.Name != "" {
94				target.RepoName = found.Name
95			}
96			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
97				target.RepoDisplay = display
98			}
99			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
100			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
101		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot):
102			target.CheckoutRoot = navigationPath(found.Path)
103		}
104		return target, nil
105	}
106	
107	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
108	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
109		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
110	}
111	
112	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
113	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
114	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
115	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
116		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
117			return Target{}, false
118		}
119		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
120		commonDir := found.CommonDir
121		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
122			return Target{}, false
123		}
124		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
125		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
126		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
127		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
128		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
129		name := found.Name
130		if name == "" {
131			name = filepath.Base(repository)
132		}
133		display := found.Display()
134		if display == "" {
135			display = name
136		}
137		return Target{
138			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
139			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
140		}, true
141	}
142	
143	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
144	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
145	
146	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
147	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
148	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
149	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
150		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
151		for _, found := range repositories {
152			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
153				targets = append(targets, target)
154			}
155		}
156		return Dedupe(targets)
157	}
158	
159	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
160	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }
161	
162	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
163	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
164	// other target builders.
165	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
166		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)

174	// ReconcileCurrent preserves the exact current checkout while applying the

177		for _, target := range targets {
```

```text
137		return m.baseContext()
138	}
139	
140	func (m *Model) finishLocalLoad() {
141		if m.localCancel != nil {
142			m.localCancel()
143			m.localCancel, m.localContext = nil, nil
144		}
145	}
146	
147	func (m *Model) invalidateView(view View) {
148		index := int(view)
149		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
150			cancel()
151		}
152		m.loadCancels[index], m.loadContexts[index] = nil, nil
153		state := &m.loads[index]
154		state.generation++
155		state.requested = false
156		state.loading = false
157		state.outcome = ""
158		if state.hasSnapshot {
159			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
160		}
161		m.viewErrors[index] = nil
162		m.viewStatuses[index] = ""
163	}
164	
165	func (m *Model) beginTryLoads(includeRepos bool, cause loadCause) {
166		m.beginViewLoad(ViewTries, cause)
167		if includeRepos {
168			m.beginViewLoad(ViewRepos, cause)
169		}
170	}
171	
172	func (m *Model) seedViewSnapshot(view View, source perftrace.Source, freshness perftrace.Freshness, actionable bool) {
173		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
174		state.hasSnapshot = true
175		state.source = source
176		state.freshness = freshness
177		state.outcome = perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
178		state.actionable = actionable
179	}
180	
181	func (m *Model) applyCacheSeed(view View, generation uint64, rows int, freshness perftrace.Freshness) bool {
182		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
183		if generation != state.generation {
184			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
185				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
186				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
187			})
188			return false
189		}
190		m.seedViewSnapshot(view, perftrace.SourceCache, freshness, true)
191		count := rows
192		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
193			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageCacheAccepted,
194			Source: perftrace.SourceCache, Freshness: freshness,
195			Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuccess, Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
196		})
197		return true
198	}
199	
200	// applyViewResult accepts only the current request generation. valid says the
201	// producer returned a real snapshot; it is independent of slice nil-ness so a
202	// successful empty result can replace older rows.
203	func (m *Model) applyViewResult(view View, generation uint64, valid bool, source perftrace.Source,
204		freshness perftrace.Freshness, rows int, err error, actionable bool) bool {
205	
206		state := &m.loads[int(view)]
207		if generation != state.generation {
208			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewResultDiscarded, perftrace.Fields{
209				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageDiscarded,
210				Generation: generation, Outcome: perftrace.OutcomeSuperseded,
211			})
212			return false
213		}
214	
215		state.loading = false
216		outcome := resultOutcome(valid, err)
217		state.outcome = outcome
218		if valid {
219			state.hasSnapshot = true
220			state.source = source
221			state.freshness = freshness
222			state.actionable = actionable
223			count := rows
224			m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{
225				View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageSnapshotAccepted,
226				Source: source, Freshness: freshness, Outcome: outcome,
227				Generation: generation, Rows: &count,
228			})
229		} else if state.hasSnapshot {
230			state.freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
231		}
232		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = err
233		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadFinished, perftrace.Fields{
234			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageFinished,
235			Source: state.source, Freshness: state.freshness, Outcome: outcome,
236			Generation: generation,
237		})
238		if cancel := m.loadCancels[int(view)]; cancel != nil {
239			cancel()
240			m.loadCancels[int(view)] = nil
241			m.loadContexts[int(view)] = nil
242		}
243		return true
244	}
245	
246	func resultFreshness(err error) perftrace.Freshness {
247		if err != nil {
248			return perftrace.FreshnessStale
249		}
250		return perftrace.FreshnessFresh
251	}
252	
253	func resultOutcome(valid bool, err error) perftrace.Outcome {
254		switch {
255		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
256			return perftrace.OutcomeCanceled
257		case err != nil && valid:
258			return perftrace.OutcomePartial
259		case err != nil || !valid:
260			return perftrace.OutcomeFailed
261		default:
262			return perftrace.OutcomeSuccess
263		}
264	}
265	
266	func (m Model) viewLoad(view View) viewLoadState { return m.loads[int(view)] }
267	
268	func (m Model) viewNeedsLoad(view View) bool {
269		state := m.viewLoad(view)
270		if state.loading {
271			return false
272		}
273		if state.hasSnapshot && state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh {
274			return false
275		}
276		return !state.hasSnapshot || state.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessStale || state.outcome == perftrace.OutcomeFailed
277	}
278	
279	func (m *Model) setViewStatus(view View, status string) {
280		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = status
281	}
282	
283	func (m Model) viewError(view View) error { return m.viewErrors[int(view)] }
284	
285	func (m Model) viewStatus(view View) string { return m.viewStatuses[int(view)] }
286	
287	func (v View) traceView() perftrace.View { return perftrace.View(v.String()) }
```

```text
95	// configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
96	// it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
97	// which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
98	func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {

102		}

105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, "", false, err
107		}
108		proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editor)
109		return proc, chosen, created, err
110	}

113		path = config.Expand(path)
114		file, _, err := safefile.OpenRegular(path)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
117		}
118		if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
120		}

125	// ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
126	// Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
127	func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
128		info, err := os.Stat(path)
129		switch {
130		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
131			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
132		case err == nil:
133			return false, nil
134		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
135			return false, err
136		}
137		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
138			return false, err
139		}
140		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
141		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
142			return false, err
143		}
144		return true, nil
145	}
146	
147	func editorProcess(path, override string) (*exec.Cmd, string, error) {
148		chosen, err := resolveEditor(override)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, "", err
151		}
152		command := chosen + " " + shellQuote(path)
153		return exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", command), chosen, nil
154	}
155	
156	func resolveEditor(override string) (string, error) {
157		for _, candidate := range []string{override, os.Getenv("VISUAL"), os.Getenv("EDITOR")} {
158			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
159				return candidate, nil
160			}
161		}
162		for _, candidate := range []string{"nvim", "vim", "vi"} {
163			if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
164				return candidate, nil
165			}
166		}
167		return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
168	}
```

```text
10	// posixInit and fishInit define the wrapper that makes `dev resume` able to
11	// leave the user *inside* the checkout. The binary keeps its real stdout so a
12	// terminal still opens the TUI and a pipe still receives plain output; a
13	// private file carries only the requested parent-directory change.
14	const posixInit = `# dev shell integration — add to your rc file:
15	#   eval "$(dev shell-init %[2]s)"
16	export DEV_SHELL_INIT=1
17	dev() {
18	  # Commands outside the navigation surface need no side channel. Besides
19	  # avoiding two subprocesses, this keeps them working when TMPDIR is stale.
20	  case "${1:-}" in
21	    __complete|__completeNoDesc|--help|-h|--version|--skill|completion|config|doctor|done|retire|prepare|artifact|git|edit|gitignore|ignore|help|list|ls|park|skill|shell-init|cache|stats|status|sweep|adopt|bootstrap)
22	      command %[1]s "$@" || return $?
23	      return 0
24	      ;;
25	  esac
26	
27	  local __dev_cd_file __dev_dir __dev_status
28	  if ! __dev_cd_file="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dev-cd.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)"; then
29	    __dev_cd_file="$(mktemp "/tmp/dev-cd.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)" || {
30	      printf 'dev: cannot create the shell directory side channel\n' >&2
31	      return 1
32	    }
33	  fi
34	
35	  __dev_status=0
36	  DEV_SHELL_CD_FD=3 command %[1]s "$@" 3>"$__dev_cd_file" || __dev_status=$?
37	  if [ $__dev_status -eq 0 ] && [ -s "$__dev_cd_file" ]; then
38	    if IFS= read -r -d '' __dev_dir < "$__dev_cd_file"; then
39	      if [ -n "$__dev_dir" ]; then
40	        builtin cd -- "$__dev_dir" || __dev_status=$?
41	      fi
42	    else
43	      __dev_status=1
44	    fi
45	  fi
46	  rm -f -- "$__dev_cd_file" || :
47	  return $__dev_status
48	}
49	`
50	
51	const fishInit = `# dev shell integration — add to config.fish:
52	#   dev shell-init fish | source
53	set -gx DEV_SHELL_INIT 1
54	function dev
55	    set -l __dev_command ""
56	    if test (count $argv) -gt 0
57	        set __dev_command $argv[1]
58	    end
59	    if contains -- "$__dev_command" __complete __completeNoDesc --help -h --version --skill completion config doctor done retire prepare artifact git edit gitignore ignore help list ls park skill shell-init cache stats status sweep adopt bootstrap
60	        command %[1]s $argv
61	        return $status
62	    end
63	
64	    set -l __dev_tmpdir /tmp
65	    set -q TMPDIR; and set __dev_tmpdir $TMPDIR
66	    set -l __dev_cd_file (mktemp "$__dev_tmpdir/dev-cd.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)
67	    if test $status -ne 0
68	        set __dev_cd_file (mktemp "/tmp/dev-cd.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)
69	    end
70	    if test -z "$__dev_cd_file"
71	        printf 'dev: cannot create the shell directory side channel\n' >&2
72	        return 1
73	    end
74	
75	    set -lx DEV_SHELL_CD_FD 3
76	    command %[1]s $argv 3>"$__dev_cd_file"
77	    set -l __dev_status $status
78	    if test $__dev_status -eq 0; and test -s "$__dev_cd_file"
79	        if read -z -l __dev_dir < "$__dev_cd_file"
80	            if test -n "$__dev_dir"
81	                builtin cd -- "$__dev_dir"
82	                set __dev_status $status
83	            end
84	        else
85	            set __dev_status 1
86	        end
87	    end
88	    rm -f -- "$__dev_cd_file"
89	    return $__dev_status

95	// file in DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE and reads the NUL-terminated path back after dev
96	// exits, rather than reading fd 3.
97	const powershellInit = `# dev shell integration — add to your PowerShell profile:
98	#   Invoke-Expression (& dev shell-init powershell | Out-String)
99	$env:DEV_SHELL_INIT = "1"
100	function dev {
101	    $__dev_exe = %[1]s
102	    $__dev_direct = @('__complete','__completeNoDesc','--help','-h','--version','--skill','completion','config','doctor','done','retire','prepare','artifact','git','edit','gitignore','ignore','help','list','ls','park','skill','shell-init','cache','stats','status','sweep','adopt','bootstrap')
103	    if ($args.Count -gt 0 -and $__dev_direct -contains $args[0]) {
104	        & $__dev_exe @args
105	        return
106	    }
107	    $__dev_cd_file = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
108	    try {
109	        $env:DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE = $__dev_cd_file
110	        & $__dev_exe @args
111	        $__dev_status = $LASTEXITCODE
112	        if ($__dev_status -eq 0 -and (Get-Item -LiteralPath $__dev_cd_file).Length -gt 0) {
113	            $__dev_dir = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($__dev_cd_file).TrimEnd([char]0)
114	            if ($__dev_dir) { Set-Location -LiteralPath $__dev_dir }
115	        }
116	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = $__dev_status
117	    } finally {
118	        Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -LiteralPath $__dev_cd_file
119	        Remove-Item -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Env:\DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE
120	    }
121	}
122	`

127			Short: "Print the shell wrapper that lets dev change your directory",
128			Long: `Print a shell function that wraps the dev binary.
129	
130	dev commands that move you into a checkout (resume, try, wt open with the
131	"none" runtime) pass the destination through a private side channel, because a
132	child process cannot change its parent's working directory. The wrapper reads
133	that path and changes directory without evaluating shell code. POSIX shells
134	receive it on a child-only file descriptor; PowerShell reads it from a temp
135	file, since Windows shells do not inherit the descriptor.
136	
137	Add to your shell rc file:
138	
139	    eval "$(dev shell-init zsh)"                              # bash and zsh
140	    dev shell-init fish | source                              # fish
141	    Invoke-Expression (& dev shell-init powershell | Out-String)  # PowerShell`,
142			Args:      cobra.ExactArgs(1),
143			ValidArgs: []string{"bash", "zsh", "fish", "powershell", "pwsh"},
144			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
145				self, err := os.Executable()
146				if err != nil || self == "" {
147					self = "dev"
148				}
149				switch args[0] {
150				case "bash", "zsh":
151					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, posixInit, shellQuote(self), args[0])
152				case "fish":
153					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, fishInit, shellQuote(self))
154				case "powershell", "pwsh":

156				default:
157					return fmt.Errorf("unsupported shell %q: want bash, zsh, fish or powershell", args[0])
158				}
159				return nil
160			},
161		}

163	}
```

```text
18	func TestCDDirectiveUsesPrivateDescriptor(t *testing.T) {
19		path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "directive")
20		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
21		if err != nil {
22			t.Fatal(err)
23		}
24		defer file.Close()
25		// cdDirective owns and closes the inherited descriptor. Give it a duplicate
26		// so the original os.File retains independent ownership and its finalizer
27		// can never close an unrelated descriptor that the OS reused.
28		ownedFD, err := unix.Dup(int(file.Fd()))
29		if err != nil {
30			t.Fatal(err)
31		}
32		t.Setenv("DEV_SHELL_CD_FD", strconv.Itoa(ownedFD))
33	
34		var out, errOut bytes.Buffer
35		app := &App{Out: &out, Err: &errOut}
36		dir := "/tmp/a\ndirectory"
37		if err := app.cdDirective(dir); err != nil {
38			t.Fatal(err)
39		}
40	
41		body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
42		if err != nil {
43			t.Fatal(err)
44		}
45		if string(body) != dir+"\x00" {
46			t.Errorf("directive file = %q, want NUL-terminated path %q", body, dir)
47		}
48		if out.Len() != 0 || errOut.Len() != 0 {
49			t.Errorf("descriptor transport should not write streams: stdout=%q stderr=%q", out.String(), errOut.String())
50		}
51	}

53	func TestPosixShellWrapperPreservesStreamsStatusAndCD(t *testing.T) {
54		fake, tmp, target := writeFakeDev(t)
55		for _, shell := range []string{"bash", "zsh"} {
56			path, err := exec.LookPath(shell)
57			if err != nil {
58				t.Logf("%s not installed; skipping", shell)
59				continue
60			}
61			t.Run(shell, func(t *testing.T) {
62				wrapper := fmt.Sprintf(posixInit, shellQuote(fake), shell)
63				script := wrapper + `
64	dev stream
65	stream_status=$?
66	dev fail
67	fail_status=$?
68	set -e
69	dev cd "$DEV_TEST_TARGET"
70	cd_status=$?
71	printf 'stream_status=%s\nfail_status=%s\ncd_status=%s\npwd=%s\n' \
72	  "$stream_status" "$fail_status" "$cd_status" "$PWD"
73	dev __complete
74	if [ -n "$(find "$TMPDIR" -name 'dev-cd.*' -print -quit)" ]; then
75	  printf 'leaked=yes\n'
76	else
77	  printf 'leaked=no\n'
78	fi
79	`
80				cmd := exec.Command(path)
81				cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(script)
82				cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "TMPDIR="+tmp, "DEV_TEST_TARGET="+target)
83				var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
84				cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
85				if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
86					t.Fatalf("run wrapper: %v\nstdout:\n%s\nstderr:\n%s", err, stdout.String(), stderr.String())
87				}
88				for _, want := range []string{
89					"streamed stdout\n", "stream_status=0\n", "fail_status=7\n",
90					"cd_status=0\n", "pwd=" + target + "\n", "completion-direct\n", "leaked=no\n",
91				} {
92					if !strings.Contains(stdout.String(), want) {
93						t.Errorf("stdout missing %q:\n%s", want, stdout.String())
94					}
95				}
96				if !strings.Contains(stderr.String(), "streamed stderr\n") {
97					t.Errorf("stderr was not passed through:\n%s", stderr.String())
98				}
99			})
100		}
101	}

181	func writeFakeDev(t *testing.T) (path, tmp, target string) {
182		t.Helper()
183		root := t.TempDir()
184		tmp = filepath.Join(root, "tmp")
185		target = filepath.Join(root, "target with spaces\nand a newline")
186		if err := os.MkdirAll(tmp, 0o755); err != nil {
187			t.Fatal(err)
188		}
189		if err := os.MkdirAll(target, 0o755); err != nil {
190			t.Fatal(err)
191		}
192		path = filepath.Join(root, "fake dev")
193		body := `#!/bin/sh
194	case "${1:-}" in
195	  stream)
196	    printf 'streamed stdout\n'
197	    printf 'streamed stderr\n' >&2
198	    ;;
199	  fail)
200	    exit 7
201	    ;;
202	  status)
203	    printf 'status-direct\n'
204	    ;;
205	  cd)
206	    printf '%s\0' "$2" >&3
207	    ;;
208	  __complete|__completeNoDesc)
209	    if [ -n "${DEV_SHELL_CD_FD:-}" ]; then
210	      printf 'completion-wrapped\n'
211	    else
212	      printf 'completion-direct\n'
213	    fi
214	    ;;
215	esac
216	`
217		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o755); err != nil {
218			t.Fatal(err)
219		}
220		return path, tmp, target
221	}
```

```text
61	func projectScanLocations(root string, definitions []AgentDefinition, document lockDocument) []physicalScanLocation {
62		logical := make([]logicalScanLocation, 0, len(definitions))
63		for _, definition := range definitions {
64			if definition.ProjectSkillsDir == "" {
65				continue
66			}
67			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
68				Path: filepath.Join(root, definition.ProjectSkillsDir), AgentIDs: []string{definition.ID},
69			})
70		}
71		subagents := map[string]bool{}
72		for _, entry := range document.Entries {
73			for _, subagent := range entry.Subagents {
74				if safePathComponent(subagent) {
75					subagents[subagent] = true
76				}
77			}
78		}
79		subagentRoot := filepath.Join(root, "agent", "subagents")
80		if entries, err := os.ReadDir(subagentRoot); err == nil {
81			for _, entry := range entries {
82				if !safePathComponent(entry.Name()) {
83					continue
84				}
85				if info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(subagentRoot, entry.Name())); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
86					subagents[entry.Name()] = true
87				}
88			}
89		}
90		for subagent := range subagents {
91			logical = append(logical, logicalScanLocation{
92				Path:     filepath.Join(subagentRoot, subagent, "skills"),
93				AgentIDs: []string{"eve"},
94			})
95		}
96		return dedupeScanLocations(logical)
97	}

99	func safePathComponent(value string) bool {

103	func globalScanLocations(definitions []AgentDefinition) []physicalScanLocation {
104		logical := make([]logicalScanLocation, 0, len(definitions))
105		for _, definition := range definitions {

115	
116	// dedupeScanLocations first coalesces identical registry paths, then aliases to
117	// the same physical directory. The latter retains every logical path and agent
118	// attribution while ensuring the directory is read only once.
119	func dedupeScanLocations(input []logicalScanLocation) []physicalScanLocation {
120		byLogical := map[string]*logicalScanLocation{}
121		for _, location := range input {
122			path := filepath.Clean(location.Path)
123			current := byLogical[path]
124			if current == nil {
125				copy := logicalScanLocation{Path: path}
126				byLogical[path] = &copy
127				current = &copy
128			}
129			current.AgentIDs = append(current.AgentIDs, location.AgentIDs...)
130		}
131		logicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byLogical))
132		for path := range byLogical {
133			logicalPaths = append(logicalPaths, path)
134		}
135		sort.Strings(logicalPaths)
136	
137		byPhysical := map[string]*physicalScanLocation{}
138		for _, path := range logicalPaths {
139			logical := *byLogical[path]
140			logical.AgentIDs = uniqueSorted(logical.AgentIDs)
141			physical := path
142			if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path); err == nil {
143				physical = filepath.Clean(resolved)
144			}
145			group := byPhysical[physical]
146			if group == nil {
147				group = &physicalScanLocation{Path: physical}
148				byPhysical[physical] = group
149			}
150			group.Logical = append(group.Logical, logical)
151		}
152		physicalPaths := make([]string, 0, len(byPhysical))
153		for path := range byPhysical {
154			physicalPaths = append(physicalPaths, path)
155		}
156		sort.Strings(physicalPaths)
157		result := make([]physicalScanLocation, 0, len(physicalPaths))
158		for _, path := range physicalPaths {
159			group := byPhysical[path]
160			sort.Slice(group.Logical, func(i, j int) bool { return group.Logical[i].Path < group.Logical[j].Path })
161			result = append(result, *group)
162		}
163		return result
164	}

238			rows = append(rows, buildPresentRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, name, group, lock, candidates, matched))
239		}
240	
241		lockGroups := document.namesByNormalized()
242		lockNormalized := make([]string, 0, len(lockGroups))
243		for normalized := range lockGroups {
244			lockNormalized = append(lockNormalized, normalized)
245		}
246		sort.Strings(lockNormalized)
247		for _, normalized := range lockNormalized {
248			if consumedLocks[normalized] {
249				continue
250			}
251			candidates := document.candidates(normalized)
252			if len(candidates) == 0 {
253				continue
254			}
255			selected := candidates[0]
256			rows = append(rows, buildMissingRow(scope, scopeRoot, target, selected, candidates))
257		}
258		return rows, diagnostics
259	}
```

```text
204		options    Options
205		readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult
206	}

208	// NewScanner creates a scanner for explicitly supplied host paths.
209	func NewScanner(options Options) *Scanner {
210		options = normalizeOptions(options)
211		s := &Scanner{options: options}
212		s.readSource = s.readSourceFromDisk
213		return s
214	}
215	
216	// Scan uses documented host defaults.
217	func Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
218		return NewScanner(DefaultOptions()).Scan(ctx, targets)
219	}
220	
221	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
222	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
223	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
224	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
225		if ctx == nil {
226			ctx = context.Background()
227		}
228		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)
229		result := Result{
230			Declarations: make([]Declaration, 0),
231			Diagnostics:  make([]Diagnostic, 0),
232			Coverage:     defaultCoverage(),
233		}
234		type cachedRead struct {
235			ready  chan struct{}
236			result readResult
237		}
238		var readMu sync.Mutex
239		reads := map[string]*cachedRead{}
240		readSource := func(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
241			key := spec.path + "\x00" + spec.projectRoot
242			readMu.Lock()
243			entry := reads[key]
244			if entry == nil {
245				entry = &cachedRead{ready: make(chan struct{})}
246				reads[key] = entry
247				readMu.Unlock()
248				entry.result = s.readSource(ctx, spec)
249				close(entry.ready)
250				return entry.result
251			}
252			readMu.Unlock()
253			select {
254			case <-ctx.Done():
255				return readResult{}
256			case <-entry.ready:
257				return entry.result
258			}
259		}
```

```text
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {

18		}

22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}

41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")

53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {

56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
```

```text
64		}
65		if e.Reason != "" && e.Cause != nil {
66			return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s: %v", prefix, e.Reason, e.Cause)
67		}
```

```text
295	func presentLifecycleRequestError(selected task.Task, action flow.Action, err error) error {
296		var transition *flow.InvalidTransitionError
297		if !errors.As(err, &transition) {
298			return err
299		}
300		if action == flow.ParkCold && selected.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
301			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; park it warm or finish it: %w",
302				selected.Title(), selected.Branch, err)
303		}
304		if action == flow.Retire {
305			return fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first: %w", selected.ID, selected.State, err)
306		}
307		return err
308	}
309	
310	func presentLifecycleApplyError(plan flow.Plan, err error) error {
311		if !errors.Is(err, flow.ErrPlanNotReady) {
312			return err
313		}
314		blocking := append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...)
315		for _, condition := range blocking {
316			switch condition.Code {
317			case flow.ConditionCheckoutClean:
318				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
319					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s).\nCommit them, or re-run with --force to discard them: %w",
320						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
321				}
322				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
323					return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\nCommit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically: %w",
324						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), err)
325				}
326			case flow.ConditionBranchPublished, flow.ConditionBranchPushed:
327				if plan.Action == flow.ParkCold {
328					return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`: %w",
329						plan.Locator.Branch, condition.Evidence, err)
330				}
331			case flow.ConditionTaskClaims:
332				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
333					return fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task metadata (%s).\nUse managed dev park/dev retire, or reconcile the task claim before removing this checkout: %w",
334						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
335				}
336			case flow.ConditionTaskInventory:
337				if plan.Action == flow.RemoveCheckout {
338					return fmt.Errorf("cannot prove %s is unmanaged because task inventory is incomplete (%s).\nRepair or reconcile task metadata before using dev park/dev retire or removing this checkout: %w",
339						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), condition.Evidence, err)
340				}
341			case flow.ConditionOwner:
342				if plan.Action == flow.Resume {
343					owner := plan.AuthorityFields()["task.owner"]
344					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\nMake sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership: %w",
345						plan.Locator.TaskID, owner, err)
346				}
347			case flow.ConditionAgentOccupancy:
348				if plan.Action == flow.Resume && strings.HasPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ") {
349					occupant := strings.TrimPrefix(condition.Evidence, "checkout is occupied by ")
350					return fmt.Errorf("%s is already occupied by %s; use a separate worktree, or pass --allow-shared-checkout only after coordinating disjoint file ownership: %w",
351						config.Contract(plan.Locator.CheckoutPath), occupant, err)
352				}
353			}
354		}
```

```text
114	### TRY and REMOTE
115	
116	TRY handles low-cost experiments, reversible archive/restore, marking, and graduation. Archive is organization, not deletion or disk reclamation.
117	
118	REMOTE loads lazily so startup does not wait for the network. Its private XDG
119	cache is decoded after the first view and holds the complete paginated inventory.
120	Fresh rows require no network; stale rows stay searchable while background
121	refresh runs. Oversized/malformed payloads and caches fingerprinted for another
122	configured GH/GL host or Azure target are ignored. GitLab uses explicit
123	`GITLAB_HOST`/`GLAB_HOST` (default `gitlab.com`) instead of inferring a host from
124	cwd; successful empty inventories clear old rows. Enter opens an existing local
125	clone. For an absent repository, `c` confirms a path-confined `project_root`
126	destination; `enter` clones and stays in the dashboard, while `o` clones and
127	opens afterward. A `project_root` outside the configured REPOS discovery
128	roots/depth is rejected before mutation. An animated row/status marker remains
129	visible through Git clone and the local-only, generation-guarded REPOS refresh;
130	`q`/Ctrl-C requests cancellation without abandoning the in-flight result. Once
131	accepted, REMOTE marks the checkout as `repo` and REPOS can search it
132	immediately. If Git leaves a destination after failure, REMOTE marks its exact
133	path `inspect` instead of deleting it or offering a misleading retry. `r` forces a forge refresh.
134	Use `/vis:private` for an exact visibility filter. Notes are enabled only after
135	a REMOTE row resolves to a local clone. TRY keeps lowercase `n` for creating a
136	new Try rather than a repository note.
137
```

```text
221	// Scan returns all static declarations it can decode and fixed diagnostics for
222	// individual source failures. Cancellation is the only normal top-level scan
223	// failure and is returned as ctx.Err(), with any rows already collected.
224	func (s *Scanner) Scan(ctx context.Context, targets []Target) (Result, error) {
225		if ctx == nil {
226			ctx = context.Background()
227		}
228		targets = normalizeTargets(targets, s.options.WorkingDirectory)

236			result readResult
237		}
238		var readMu sync.Mutex
239		reads := map[string]*cachedRead{}
240		readSource := func(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec) readResult {
241			key := spec.path + "\x00" + spec.projectRoot
242			readMu.Lock()
243			entry := reads[key]
244			if entry == nil {
245				entry = &cachedRead{ready: make(chan struct{})}
246				reads[key] = entry
247				readMu.Unlock()
248				entry.result = s.readSource(ctx, spec)
249				close(entry.ready)
250				return entry.result
251			}
252			readMu.Unlock()
253			select {
254			case <-ctx.Done():
255				return readResult{}
256			case <-entry.ready:

258			}

261		for _, spec := range s.hostSources() {
262			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
263				finalizeResult(&result)
264				return result, err
265			}
266			rows, diagnostics := s.scanSource(ctx, spec, targets, readSource)
267			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, rows...)
268			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
269		}
270		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
271			finalizeResult(&result)
272			return result, err
273		}
274	
275		projectResults := make([]Result, len(targets))
276		jobs := make(chan int)
277		workers := s.options.Concurrency
278		if workers > len(targets) {

320		close(jobs)
321		wg.Wait()
322		for _, partial := range projectResults {
323			result.Declarations = append(result.Declarations, partial.Declarations...)
324			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, partial.Diagnostics...)
325		}
326		finalizeResult(&result)
327		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
328			return result, err
329		}
330		return result, nil
331	}

510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)
512		if !read.present {
513			if read.code == "" {
514				return nil, nil
515			}
516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {
518				localSpec := spec
519				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
520				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, read.code))
521			}
522			return nil, diagnostics
523		}
524		var rows []Declaration
525		var codes []DiagnosticCode
526		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
527		switch spec.adapter {
528		case adapterClaudeProject:
529			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {
532				approval := readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
533				switch {
534				case approval.code != "":
535					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
536				case approval.present:
537					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
538					if code != "" {
539						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
540					} else {
541						approvalState.merge(enabled, disabled, enableAll)
542					}
543				}
544			}
545			applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, approvalState.enabled, approvalState.disabled, approvalState.enableAll)
546		case adapterClaudeUser:
547			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:
557			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
559			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
560		default:
561			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics
570	}
571	
572	func diagnosticFor(spec sourceSpec, code DiagnosticCode) Diagnostic {
573		return Diagnostic{
574			Agent: spec.agent, Scope: spec.scope, Repository: spec.repository,
575			RepositoryPath: spec.repositoryPath, Checkout: spec.checkout,
576			LocalProjectPath: spec.localProjectPath, ConfigPath: spec.path,
577			Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
578		}
579	}
580	
581	func finalizeResult(result *Result) {
582		SortDeclarations(result.Declarations)
583		sort.SliceStable(result.Diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
584			a, b := result.Diagnostics[i], result.Diagnostics[j]
585			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Code)}
586			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Code)}
587			for n := range ak {
588				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
589					return ak[n] < bk[n]
590				}
591			}
592			return false
593		})
594	}
```

```text
1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}
76
```
