```text
+package tui
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
+	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/agentskill"
+	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
+	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
+	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
+)
+
+type listAction uint8
+
+const (
+	listActionOpen listAction = iota
+	listActionAddNote
+	listActionBrowseNotes
+	listActionPark
+	listActionEditNext
+	listActionToggleWorktrees
+	listActionRepoMetadata
+	listActionStartWorktree
+	listActionStartDirect
+	listActionCopy
+	listActionStats
+	listActionRemoteClone
+	listActionSkillUpdate
+	listActionOpenCapabilityFile
+	listActionCopyCapabilityPath
+	listActionCopyCapabilitySummary
+	listActionCopySkillSourceURL
+	listActionCopyCapabilityRaw
+	listActionTryMark
+	listActionTryDeprecate
+	listActionTryReactivate
+	listActionTryArchive
+	listActionTryRestore
+	listActionTryGraduate
+)
+
+type selectionToken struct {
+	view View
+	key  string
+}
+
+func repoItemKey(item repoItem) string {
+	key := repoKey(item.Repo) + "\x00"
+	if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
+		return key + checkout.Worktree.Path
+	}
+	return key
+}
+
+func fleetRowKey(row FleetRow) string {
+	path := ""
+	if row.Repository != nil {
+		path = row.Repository.Path
+	}
+	return row.Host + "\x00" + path
+}
+
+func skillRowKey(row agentskill.Skill) string {
+	lockFile := ""
+	if row.Lock != nil {
+		lockFile = row.Lock.File
+	}
+	return strings.Join([]string{string(row.Scope), row.Checkout, row.Path, lockFile, row.Name}, "\x00")
+}
+
+func (m Model) currentSelectionToken() (selectionToken, bool) {
+	switch m.view {
+	case ViewTasks:
+		row, ok := m.currentTask()
+		if !ok || row.Task == nil {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: row.Task.ID}, true
+	case ViewRepos:
+		row, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
+		if !ok {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: repoItemKey(row)}, true
+	case ViewFleet:
+		row, ok := m.currentFleet()
+		if !ok {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: fleetRowKey(row)}, true
+	case ViewTries:
+		row, ok := m.currentTry()
+		if !ok {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: row.Item.ID}, true
+	case ViewRemote:
+		row, ok := m.currentRemote()
+		if !ok {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: remoteRowKey(row)}, true
+	case ViewSkills:
+		row, ok := m.currentSkill()
+		if !ok {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: skillRowKey(row)}, true
+	case ViewMCP:
+		row, ok := m.currentMCP()
+		if !ok {
+			return selectionToken{}, false
+		}
+		return selectionToken{view: m.view, key: row.IdentityKey()}, true
+	default:
+		return selectionToken{}, false
+	}
+}
+
+func (m *Model) selectToken(token selectionToken) bool {
+	if m.view != token.view {
+		return false
+	}
+	switch token.view {
+	case ViewTasks:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleTasks() {
+			if row.Task != nil && row.Task.ID == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case ViewRepos:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
+			if repoItemKey(row) == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case ViewFleet:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleFleet() {
+			if fleetRowKey(row) == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case ViewTries:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleTries() {
+			if row.Item.ID == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case ViewRemote:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleRemotes() {
+			if remoteRowKey(row) == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case ViewSkills:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleSkills() {
+			if skillRowKey(row) == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	case ViewMCP:
+		for i, row := range m.visibleMCP() {
+			if row.IdentityKey() == token.key {
+				m.setAt(i)
+				return true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func (m Model) selectionHeading() (string, string) {
+	if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
+		return row.Task.Title(), contract(row.Checkout)
+	}
+	if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
+		if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
+			return item.Repo.Repo.Display() + "/" + filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path), contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
+		}
+		return item.Repo.Repo.Display(), contract(item.Repo.Repo.Path)
+	}
+	if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
+		if row.Repository != nil {
+			return row.Host + "/" + row.Repository.Display, contract(row.Repository.Path)
+		}
+		return row.Host, string(row.State)
+	}
+	if row, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
+		return row.Item.DisplayName(), contract(row.Item.Live.CurrentPath)
+	}
+	if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
+		detail := row.Repo.URL
+		if row.LocalPath != "" {
+			detail = contract(row.LocalPath)
+		}
+		return row.Repo.FullName, detail
+	}
+	if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
+		path, _ := skillFilePath(row)
+		return row.Name, contract(path)
+	}
+	if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
+		return row.Name, contract(row.ConfigPath)
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+
+func (m Model) openActionMenu() Model {
+	token, ok := m.currentSelectionToken()
+	if !ok {
+		return m
+	}
+	subject, detail := m.selectionHeading()
+	overlay := overlayState{
+		kind: overlayActionMenu, title: strings.ToUpper(m.view.String()) + " actions",
+		subject: subject, detail: detail, selection: token,
+	}
+
+	switch m.view {
+	case ViewTasks:

+
+func (m Model) addNoteOptions(overlay *overlayState) {
+	if _, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); !ok {
+		return
+	}
+	if m.actions.Notes.Add != nil {
+		overlay.addOption(listActionAddNote, "add note")
+	}
+	if m.actions.Notes.List != nil {
+		overlay.addOption(listActionBrowseNotes, "browse notes")
+	}
+}
+
+func (m Model) addStatsOption(overlay *overlayState) {
+	if m.selectedRepoName() != "" && m.actions.LoadStats != nil {
+		overlay.addOption(listActionStats, "open activity heatmap")
+	}
+}
+
+func (m Model) runOverlayAction() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 || m.overlay.optionIndex >= m.overlay.optionCount {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
+	token := m.overlay.selection
+	if !m.selectToken(token) {
+		m.overlay = overlayState{}
+		m.err = fmt.Errorf("selected row changed while its action menu was open")
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	m.overlay = overlayState{}
+	return m.runListAction(action)
+}
+
+func (m Model) runListAction(action listAction) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	switch action {
+	case listActionOpen:
+		return m, m.openSelected()
+	case listActionAddNote:
+		if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
+			return m.openNoteAdd(target, false)
+		}
+	case listActionBrowseNotes:
+		if target, ok := m.selectedNoteTarget(); ok {
+			return m.openNotes(target)
+		}
+	case listActionPark:

+			return m.prompt(modeConfirmPark, "", "what to do when you come back")

+		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
+			target := *row.Task
+			m.taskPromptTarget = &target
+			return m.prompt(modeEditNext, row.Task.Next, "next action")
+		}
+	case listActionToggleWorktrees:
+		return m.toggleSelectedRepo()

+		if row, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
+			return m.openRepoForm(row)
+		}
+	case listActionStartWorktree:
+		if row, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
+			m.repoPromptTarget, m.repoPromptSet = row, true
+			return m.prompt(modeStartTask, "", "name for the new worktree task")
+		}
+	case listActionStartDirect:
+		if row, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
+			m.repoPromptTarget, m.repoPromptSet = row, true
+			return m.prompt(modeStartDirect, "", "name for direct work on current branch")
+		}
+	case listActionCopy:
+		token, ok := m.currentSelectionToken()
+		if !ok {
+			return m, nil
+		}
+		m.copySelection = token
+		m.mode, m.err, m.status = modeCopy, nil, ""
+		return m, nil
+	case listActionStats:
+		repo := m.selectedRepoName()
+		if repo != "" && m.actions.LoadStats != nil {
+			m.mode, m.stats, m.status = modeStats, nil, "loading activity…"
+			return m, m.loadStats(repo)
+		}
+	case listActionRemoteClone:
+		return m.promptSelectedRemoteClone()
+	case listActionSkillUpdate:
+		return m.promptSelectedSkillUpdate()
+	case listActionOpenCapabilityFile:
+		return m.openSelectedCapabilityFile()
+	case listActionCopyCapabilityPath:
+		return m.copyCapabilityValue("p")
+	case listActionCopyCapabilitySummary:
+		return m.copyCapabilityValue("s")
+	case listActionCopySkillSourceURL:
+		return m.copyCapabilityValue("u")
+	case listActionCopyCapabilityRaw:
+		return m.copyCapabilityValue("f")
+	case listActionTryMark, listActionTryDeprecate, listActionTryReactivate,
+		listActionTryArchive, listActionTryRestore, listActionTryGraduate:
+		return m.runTryListAction(action)
+	}
+	return m, nil
+}
+
+func (m Model) toggleSelectedRepo() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
+	if !ok || item.Repo.Worktrees == 0 {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
+		m.err = item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if item.child() {
+		for i := m.repoCursor - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
+			if !m.visibleRepoItems()[i].child() {
+				m.repoCursor = i
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	m.toggleRepo(item.Repo)
+	return m, nil
+}
+
+func (m Model) promptSelectedRemoteClone() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	row, ok := m.currentRemote()
+	if !ok || row.Cloned() {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if row.CloneProblemPath != "" {
+		if _, err := os.Lstat(row.CloneProblemPath); err == nil {
+			m.err = fmt.Errorf("inspect or move the existing clone destination at %s before retrying", config.Contract(row.CloneProblemPath))
+			return m, nil
+		}
+		m.setRemoteCloneProblem(row, "")
+	}
+	if !m.reposReadyForClone() {
+		m.setViewStatus(ViewRemote, "wait for local repositories to finish loading")
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	m.remoteClonePrompt = row
+	return m.prompt(modeConfirmClone, row.Repo.FullName, "enter clone; o clone and open; esc cancel")
+}
+
+func (m Model) promptSelectedSkillUpdate() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading {
+		m.setViewStatus(ViewSkills, "wait for the current skill reload/check to finish")
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	row, ok := m.currentSkill()
+	if !ok {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if !agentskill.CanUpdate(row) {
+		m.err = fmt.Errorf("%s has no update-safe provider lock", row.Name)
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	m.skillUpdateTarget = row
+	m.mode = modeConfirmSkillUpdate
+	return m, nil
+}
+
+func (m Model) openSelectedCapabilityFile() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	path, err := m.capabilityFilePath()
+	if err != nil {
+		m.err = err
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if m.actions.EditFile == nil {
+		m.err = fmt.Errorf("opening capability files is unavailable")
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	edit, err := m.actions.EditFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		m.err = err
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if edit.Command == nil {
+		m.err = fmt.Errorf("capability editor returned no process")
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	view := m.view
+	m.status = "editing " + config.Contract(path) + "…"
+	return m, tea.ExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
+		if edit.Complete != nil {
+			runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
+		}
+		return afterExec(capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: view, err: runErr})
+	})
+}
+
+func (m Model) runTryListAction(action listAction) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	row, ok := m.currentTry()
+	if !ok {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	var tryAction TryAction
+	switch action {
+	case listActionTryMark:
+		tryAction = TryMark
+	case listActionTryDeprecate:
+		tryAction = TryDeprecate
+	case listActionTryReactivate:
+		tryAction = TryReactivate
+	case listActionTryArchive:
+		tryAction = TryArchive
+	case listActionTryRestore:
+		tryAction = TryRestore
+	case listActionTryGraduate:
+		tryAction = TryGraduate
+	}
+	switch tryAction {
+	case TryMark, TryRestore, TryGraduate:
+		return m.openTryForm(tryAction, row)
+	case TryArchive:
+		return m.openTryConfirmation(tryAction, row)
+	case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
+		m.status = string(tryAction) + " in progress…"
+		return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: tryAction, ID: row.Item.ID})
+	default:
+		return m, nil
+	}
+}

index 0000000..f5046fc

+++ b/internal/tui/mouse.go
@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+package tui
+
+import tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
+
+const mouseWheelRows = 3
+
+// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
+// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
+// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
+func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
+	if m.height <= 0 {
+		return false
+	}
+	if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
+		return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
+	}
+
+	n := m.count()
+	listLines := m.listPreambleLines()
+	if n > 0 {
+		visible := min(n, m.listHeight())
+		listLines += visible
+		if visible < n {
+			listLines++
+		}
+	}
+	total := 2 + listLines + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
+	return total <= m.height
+}
+
+func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
+	if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
+		if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
+			return m, nil
+		}
+		return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
+	}
+	if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+
+	if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
+		if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
+			return m, nil
+		}
+		delta := mouseWheelRows
+		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
+			delta = -delta
+		}
+		m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+
+	if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
+		for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
+			if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
+				continue
+			}
+			if m.view == hit.view {
+				return m, nil
+			}
+			m.view = hit.view
+			return m.afterViewSwitch()
+		}
+		return m, nil
+	}
+
+	row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
+	if !ok {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	switch event.Button {
+	case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
+		m.setAt(row)
+	case tea.MouseButtonRight:
+		m.setAt(row)
+		if !m.remoteClone.active() {
+			m = m.openActionMenu()
+		}
+	}
+	return m, nil
+}
+
+func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
+	if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	count := m.count()
+	from, to := m.window(count)
+	first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
+	if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	return from + y - first, true
+}
+
+func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
+	if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
+		return false
+	}
+	from, to := m.window(m.count())
+	first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
+	return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
+}
+
+func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
+		if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
+			return m, nil
+		}
+		delta := 1
+		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
+			delta = -1
+		}
+		m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
+	if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
+		m.overlay = overlayState{}
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
+	return m.runOverlayAction()
+}
```

```text
+func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
+	logical := filepath.Clean(path)
+	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(logical)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	source, observed, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	original, readErr := safefile.ReadAll(context.Background(), source, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+	closeErr := source.Close()
+	if readErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)
+	}
+	if closeErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), closeErr)
+	}
+
+	working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	workingPath := working.Name()
+	cleanup := true
+	defer func() {
+		if cleanup {
+			_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+		}
+	}()
+	if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	cleanup = false
+
+	return tui.CapabilityEdit{
+		Command: process,
+		Complete: func(runErr error) error {
+			if runErr != nil {
+				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+				return runErr
+			}
+			edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if bytes.Equal(edited, original) {
+				return os.Remove(workingPath)
+			}
+			root, err := os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			defer root.Close()
+			if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
+				context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
+			); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			return os.Remove(workingPath)
+		},
+	}, nil
+}
```

```text
+func TestMCPWideLayoutCapsServerColumn(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []agentmcp.Declaration{
+		{Name: strings.Repeat("server", 10), Agent: agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode, Scope: agentmcp.ScopeProject, Transport: agentmcp.TransportStdio},
+	}
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, nil)
+	actions.ReloadMCP = func(context.Context, tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
+		return rows, nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, nil, nil)
+	m = send(m, tea.WindowSizeMsg{Width: 200, Height: 30})
+	m = send(m, key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"))
+
+	var header string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			header = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if header == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP header missing:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(m.View(), rows[0].Name) {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP detail omitted the full server name:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if got := lipgloss.Width(header); got != 126 {
+		t.Fatalf("wide MCP header width = %d, want 126 with a 32-cell SERVER cap:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+	if got := strings.Index(header, "TRANSPORT"); got > 82 {
+		t.Fatalf("TRANSPORT starts at cell %d; SERVER still absorbed wide-screen padding:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+
+	m = send(m, key("/"))
+	for _, msg := range typeText("server") {
+		m = send(m, msg)
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("enter"))
+	var filteredHeader string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			filteredHeader = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if lipgloss.Width(filteredHeader) != lipgloss.Width(header) {
+		t.Fatalf("filter shifted MCP columns:\nbefore: %s\nafter:  %s", header, filteredHeader)
+	}
+}

+	}
+	m = send(m, key("A"))
+	if m.CapabilityScope() != tui.CapabilityStartupContext || !strings.Contains(m.View(), "mcp-context") || strings.Contains(m.View(), "mcp-all") {

+	m = send(m, key("h"))
+	if !strings.Contains(m.View(), "skill-context") || strings.Contains(m.View(), "skill-all") {

+	}
+	if got, want := fmt.Sprint(skillScopes), "[context all context]"; got != want {

+	}
+	if got, want := fmt.Sprint(mcpScopes), "[context all context]"; got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP scopes = %s, want %s", got, want)
+	}
```

```text
18		}

25		}

29			}

53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {

56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),

68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))

70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))

75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}

82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))

95		}

97	}
```

```text
5	const mouseWheelRows = 3
6	
7	// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
8	// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		n := m.count()
19		listLines := m.listPreambleLines()
20		if n > 0 {
21			visible := min(n, m.listHeight())
22			listLines += visible
23			if visible < n {
24				listLines++
25			}
26		}
27		total := 2 + listLines + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		return total <= m.height
29	}
30	
31	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
32		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
33		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
37			if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
38				return m, nil
39			}
40			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
41		}
42		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
43			return m, nil
44		}
45		if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
46			return m, nil
47		}
48	
49		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
50			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
51				return m, nil
52			}
53			delta := mouseWheelRows
54			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
55				delta = -delta
56			}
57			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
58			return m, nil
59		}
60		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
61			return m, nil
62		}
63	
64		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
65			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
66				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
67					continue
68				}
69				if m.view == hit.view {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.view = hit.view
73				return m.afterViewSwitch()
74			}
75			return m, nil
76		}
77	
78		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
79		if !ok {
80			return m, nil
81		}
82		switch event.Button {
83		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
84			m.setAt(row)
85		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
86			m.setAt(row)
87			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
88				m = m.openActionMenu()
89			}
90		}
91		return m, nil
92	}
93	
94	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
95		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
96			return 0, false
97		}
98		count := m.count()
99		from, to := m.window(count)
100		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
101		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
102			return 0, false
103		}
104		return from + y - first, true
105	}
106	
107	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
108		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
109			return false
110		}
111		from, to := m.window(m.count())
112		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
113		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
114	}
115	
116	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
117		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
118			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
119				return m, nil
120			}
121			delta := 1
122			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
123				delta = -1
124			}
125			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
126			return m, nil
127		}
128		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
132		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
133			m.overlay = overlayState{}
134			return m, nil
135		}
136		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
137		return m.runOverlayAction()
138	}
```

```text
+func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
+	logical := filepath.Clean(path)
+	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(logical)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	source, observed, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	original, readErr := safefile.ReadAll(context.Background(), source, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+	closeErr := source.Close()
+	if readErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)
+	}
+	if closeErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), closeErr)
+	}
+
+	working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	workingPath := working.Name()
+	cleanup := true
+	defer func() {
+		if cleanup {
+			_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+		}
+	}()
+	if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	cleanup = false
+
+	return tui.CapabilityEdit{
+		Command: process,
+		Complete: func(runErr error) error {
+			if runErr != nil {
+				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+				return runErr
+			}
+			edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if bytes.Equal(edited, original) {
+				return os.Remove(workingPath)
+			}
+			root, err := os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			defer root.Close()
+			if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
+				context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
+			); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			return os.Remove(workingPath)
+		},
+	}, nil
+}
```

```text
7	// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
8	// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		n := m.count()
19		listLines := m.listPreambleLines()
20		if n > 0 {
21			visible := min(n, m.listHeight())
22			listLines += visible
23			if visible < n {
24				listLines++
25			}
26		}
27		total := 2 + listLines + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		return total <= m.height
29	}

31	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
32		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
33		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
37			if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
38				return m, nil
39			}
40			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
41		}
42		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
43			return m, nil
44		}
45		if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
46			return m, nil
47		}
48	
49		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
50			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
51				return m, nil
52			}
53			delta := mouseWheelRows
54			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
55				delta = -delta
56			}
57			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
58			return m, nil
59		}
60		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
61			return m, nil
62		}
63	
64		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
65			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
66				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
67					continue
68				}
69				if m.view == hit.view {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.view = hit.view
73				return m.afterViewSwitch()
74			}
75			return m, nil
76		}
77	
78		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
79		if !ok {
80			return m, nil
81		}
82		switch event.Button {
83		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
84			m.setAt(row)
85		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
86			m.setAt(row)
87			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
88				m = m.openActionMenu()
89			}
90		}
91		return m, nil
92	}
93	
94	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
95		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
96			return 0, false
97		}
98		count := m.count()
99		from, to := m.window(count)
100		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
101		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
102			return 0, false
103		}
104		return from + y - first, true
105	}
106	
107	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
108		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
109			return false
110		}
111		from, to := m.window(m.count())
112		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
113		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
114	}
115	
116	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
117		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
118			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
119				return m, nil
120			}
121			delta := 1
122			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
123				delta = -1
124			}
125			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
126			return m, nil
127		}
128		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
132		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
133			m.overlay = overlayState{}
134			return m, nil
135		}
136		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
137		return m.runOverlayAction()
138	}
```

```text
+func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
+	logical := filepath.Clean(path)
+	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(logical)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	source, observed, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	original, readErr := safefile.ReadAll(context.Background(), source, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+	closeErr := source.Close()
+	if readErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)
+	}
+	if closeErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), closeErr)
+	}
+
+	working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	workingPath := working.Name()
+	cleanup := true
+	defer func() {
+		if cleanup {
+			_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+		}
+	}()
+	if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	cleanup = false
+
+	return tui.CapabilityEdit{
+		Command: process,
+		Complete: func(runErr error) error {
+			if runErr != nil {
+				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+				return runErr
+			}
+			edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if bytes.Equal(edited, original) {
+				return os.Remove(workingPath)
+			}
+			root, err := os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			defer root.Close()
+			if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
+				context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
+			); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			return os.Remove(workingPath)
+		},
+	}, nil
+}
```

```text
+func TestMCPWideLayoutCapsServerColumn(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []agentmcp.Declaration{
+		{Name: strings.Repeat("server", 10), Agent: agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode, Scope: agentmcp.ScopeProject, Transport: agentmcp.TransportStdio},
+	}
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, nil)
+	actions.ReloadMCP = func(context.Context, tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
+		return rows, nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, nil, nil)
+	m = send(m, tea.WindowSizeMsg{Width: 200, Height: 30})
+	m = send(m, key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"))
+
+	var header string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			header = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if header == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP header missing:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(m.View(), rows[0].Name) {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP detail omitted the full server name:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if got := lipgloss.Width(header); got != 126 {
+		t.Fatalf("wide MCP header width = %d, want 126 with a 32-cell SERVER cap:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+	if got := strings.Index(header, "TRANSPORT"); got > 82 {
+		t.Fatalf("TRANSPORT starts at cell %d; SERVER still absorbed wide-screen padding:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+
+	m = send(m, key("/"))
+	for _, msg := range typeText("server") {
+		m = send(m, msg)
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("enter"))
+	var filteredHeader string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			filteredHeader = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if lipgloss.Width(filteredHeader) != lipgloss.Width(header) {
+		t.Fatalf("filter shifted MCP columns:\nbefore: %s\nafter:  %s", header, filteredHeader)
+	}
+}
```

```text
14	func mouseMessage(x, y int, button tea.MouseButton, action tea.MouseAction) tea.MouseMsg {
15		return tea.MouseMsg(tea.MouseEvent{X: x, Y: y, Button: button, Action: action})
16	}
17	
18	func applyMouse(model Model, message tea.MouseMsg) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
19		updated, command := model.Update(message)
20		return updated.(Model), command
21	}
22	
23	func mouseTaskRows(count int) []inventory.Row {
24		rows := make([]inventory.Row, count)
25		for i := range rows {
26			rows[i] = inventory.Row{
27				Task:     &task.Task{ID: fmt.Sprintf("task-%02d", i), Name: fmt.Sprintf("task-%02d", i), State: task.Hot},
28				Checkout: fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/task-%02d", i), CheckoutExists: true,
29			}
30		}
31		return rows
32	}

34	func TestMouseClicksResponsiveTabSpans(t *testing.T) {
35		for _, width := range []int{100, 42} {
36			model := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
37			model.width = width
38			layout := model.buildHeaderLayout()
39			if len(layout.tabs) != len(Views) {
40				t.Fatalf("width %d rendered %d tabs, want %d", width, len(layout.tabs), len(Views))
41			}
42			for _, hit := range layout.tabs {
43				candidate := model
44				candidate, _ = applyMouse(candidate, mouseMessage((hit.from+hit.to)/2, 0, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
45				if candidate.view != hit.view {
46					t.Errorf("width %d click [%d,%d) selected %s, want %s", width, hit.from, hit.to, candidate.view, hit.view)
47				}
48			}
49		}
50	
51		model := New(Actions{}, nil, nil)
52		model.width = 9
53		layout := model.buildHeaderLayout()
54		if len(layout.tabs) != 1 || layout.tabs[0].view != ViewTasks {
55			t.Fatalf("current-only layout tabs = %+v", layout.tabs)
56		}
57		model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(model.width-1, 0, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
58		if model.view != ViewTasks {
59			t.Fatalf("click outside current-only tab changed view to %s", model.view)
60		}
61	}

63	func TestMouseSelectsOnlyVisibleDataRows(t *testing.T) {
64		rows := mouseTaskRows(20)
65		opened := 0
66		model := New(Actions{Open: func(context.Context, *task.Task) (OpenResult, error) {
67			opened++
68			return OpenResult{}, nil
69		}}, rows, nil)

72		from, _ := model.window(len(rows))

75		model, _ = applyMouse(model, mouseMessage(4, firstY+1, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
76		if model.at() != from+1 || opened != 0 {
77			t.Fatalf("row click selected=%d want=%d opened=%d", model.at(), from+1, opened)
78		}
79		selected := model.at()
80		for _, message := range []tea.MouseMsg{
81			mouseMessage(4, firstY, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionRelease),
82			mouseMessage(4, firstY, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionMotion),
83			mouseMessage(4, 2, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress),
84			mouseMessage(4, firstY+model.listHeight()+2, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress),
85		} {
86			model, _ = applyMouse(model, message)
87		}
88		if model.at() != selected || opened != 0 {

90		}

92		if opened != 0 {

94		}
95	}
```

```text
1	package tui

11	
12	func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {
13		if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
14			return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
17			return row.Lock.File, nil
18		}
19		return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}
34	
35	func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
36		lines := []string{
37			"name: " + row.Name,
38			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
39		}
40		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
51	}
52	
53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
54		lines := []string{
55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}
59		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
60		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
61		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
62		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
63		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
64		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
65		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
66		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
67		if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
69		}
70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
73			for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
74				value := string(credential.Kind)
75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
84			for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
85				redactions[i] = string(redaction)
86			}
87			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
88		}
89		if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
90			coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
91			for i, item := range row.Coverage {
92				coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
93			}
94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}
98	
99	func (m Model) copyBindingHelp() string {
100		if m.view == ViewRepos {
101			return "y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths"
102		}
103		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
104		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil {
105			parts = append(parts, "p file path")
106		}
107		parts = append(parts, "s safe summary")
108		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok && row.SourceURL != "" {
109			parts = append(parts, "u source URL")
110		}
111		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil && m.actions.ReadFile != nil {
112			parts = append(parts, "f raw file")
113		}
114		return strings.Join(parts, " · ")
115	}
116	
117	func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {
118		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
119			return lines
120		}
121		return append(lines, label+": "+value)
122	}
```

```text
181	func (m Model) selectionHeading() (string, string) {
182		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
183			return row.Task.Title(), contract(row.Checkout)
184		}
185		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
186			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
187				return item.Repo.Repo.Display() + "/" + filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path), contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
188			}
189			return item.Repo.Repo.Display(), contract(item.Repo.Repo.Path)
190		}
191		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
192			if row.Repository != nil {
193				return row.Host + "/" + row.Repository.Display, contract(row.Repository.Path)
194			}
195			return row.Host, string(row.State)
196		}
197		if row, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
198			return row.Item.DisplayName(), contract(row.Item.Live.CurrentPath)
199		}
200		if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
201			detail := row.Repo.URL
202			if row.LocalPath != "" {
203				detail = contract(row.LocalPath)
204			}
205			return row.Repo.FullName, detail
206		}
207		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
208			path, _ := skillFilePath(row)
209			return row.Name, contract(path)
210		}
211		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
212			return row.Name, contract(row.ConfigPath)
213		}
214		return "", ""
215	}

375		if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 || m.overlay.optionIndex >= m.overlay.optionCount {
376			return m, nil
377		}
378		action := m.overlay.options[m.overlay.optionIndex]
379		token := m.overlay.selection

381			m.overlay = overlayState{}

384		}

464	func (m Model) toggleSelectedRepo() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
465		item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()
466		if !ok || item.Repo.Worktrees == 0 {
467			return m, nil

470			m.err = item.Repo.Context.WorktreeErr
471			return m, nil

482		return m, nil
```

```text
7	// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
8	// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		n := m.count()
19		listLines := m.listPreambleLines()
20		if n > 0 {
21			visible := min(n, m.listHeight())
22			listLines += visible
23			if visible < n {
24				listLines++
25			}
26		}
27		total := 2 + listLines + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		return total <= m.height
29	}

89			}
90		}
91		return m, nil
92	}
93	
94	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
95		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
96			return 0, false
97		}
98		count := m.count()
99		from, to := m.window(count)
100		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
101		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
102			return 0, false
103		}
104		return from + y - first, true
105	}
106	
107	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
108		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
109			return false
110		}
111		from, to := m.window(m.count())
112		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
113		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
114	}
115	
116	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
117		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
118			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
119				return m, nil
120			}
121			delta := 1
122			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
123				delta = -1
124			}
125			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
126			return m, nil
127		}
128		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
132		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
133			m.overlay = overlayState{}
134			return m, nil
135		}
136		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
137		return m.runOverlayAction()
138	}
139
```

8	
9	# TUI, repositories, quick notes, and bootstrap
10	
11	Bare `dev` opens an interactive dashboard when standard input/output are terminals. When piped, it prints the plain task listing so shell composition remains predictable.
12	
13	There are two independent full-screen models. Bare `dev` / `dev tui` is the
14	seven-view inventory dashboard below. Preview-labelled `dev flow [repo]` is a
15	TTY-only, plan-first lifecycle view for one canonical repository; it is not a
16	dashboard tab or mode.
17	
18	## Seven views
19	
20	| View | Question | Source |
21	|---|---|---|
22	| TASKS | What am I working on? | task registry plus live Git/runtime facts |
23	| REPOS | What durable repositories exist here? | configured scan roots and local catalog |
24	| FLEET | What exists and is active on configured machines? | accepted local REPOS snapshot plus remote `dev` snapshots over SSH |
25	| TRY | Which experiments can I resume, archive, or graduate? | experiment catalog plus live facts |
26	| REMOTE | What can I open or clone? | authenticated `gh`/`glab` inventories and cache |
27	| SKILLS | Which skills would an agent launched from this context read? | context-first targets plus an `A` all-repositories toggle |
28	| MCP | Which MCP declarations would that context expose? | sanitized static configuration with the same shared scope |
29	
30	The initial TASKS frame is built before runtime auto-detection, project-root
31	lookup, cache decoding, shell tool probes, or the optional release refresh can
32	finish. TASKS, REPOS, and TRY then publish independently from one shared local
33	cycle. REMOTE, FLEET, SKILLS, and MCP stay lazy. Each requested view has a generation:
34	`r` supersedes the previous read, late results are ignored, failed refreshes keep
35	usable rows visible, and a successful empty result removes obsolete rows. Cache
36	acceptance and current live completion are distinct; there is no all-tabs-ready
37	state for optional views that may never be opened.
38	
39	Use an absolute path that does not exist for a one-run diagnostic trace:
40	
41	```bash
42	DEV_TUI_TRACE=/tmp/dev-tui-trace.json dev
43	```
44	
45	The private, bounded JSON is written after the alternate screen is restored. It
46	contains relative timings, aggregate row counts, and categorical
47	view/generation/outcome fields, never repository/task/host/tool names, paths,
48	commands, key values, URLs, handles, or
49	raw errors. It is not `stats.db` and is never sent anywhere.
50	`tui.initial_view_returned` means the Bubble Tea view string was built, not that
51	the terminal rasterized it.
52	
53	Switch with `tab`, `h`/`l`, arrows, or left-click a visible tab. A left-button
54	press selects a visible row without opening it, the wheel moves three rows, and a
55	right-button press selects a row then opens its available actions. Modified
56	clicks, motion, releases, and repeated-click activation are ignored; Enter/`o`
57	remains the explicit open action. Some terminals require Shift/Option for native
58	text selection while mouse tracking is enabled. Keyboard movement, filtering,
59	help, and mode exit remain unchanged.
60	
61	## Common actions
62	
63	### TASKS
64	
65	```text
66	enter/o   open the selected task
67	p         park warm and enter the next action
68	c         edit the next action
69	n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
70	1/2/3     HOT/WARM/COLD filters
71	```
72	
73	A COLD worktree task must be rebuilt with `dev resume`; the dashboard does not silently recreate it through a generic open action. A missing or unregistered worktree points to `dev sweep` first, so unique agent artifacts are reported for salvage before the task is resumed or reaped. Enter never opens an abandoned artifact-only directory. At 97 or more terminal cells the TASKS table includes a display-width-aware `REPO` column; narrower layouts retain the previous columns and show repo/path in detail.
74	
75	### Repository flow
76	
77	```bash
78	dev flow              # exact current surface, or picker outside Git
79	dev flow api          # explicit repository
80	```
81	
82	Flow lists every registered worktree plus task-only COLD/DONE rows and labels
83	canonical/managed/unmanaged/harness/task-only/conflict topology. Use `j/k` for
84	rows, `h/l` for actions, Tab for panel focus, Enter to build a plan, then `y` or
85	the displayed typed token to approve only a READY plan. `r` reloads local facts;
86	`R` offers explicit fetch, review query, or both. Startup and `r` never use the
87	network.
88	
89	The plan separates persisted HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE intent from live evidence,
90	shows remediation/fallback for blocked actions, and is revalidated against the
91	exact task revision and Git/worktree/runtime/artifact identity before Apply.
92	Partial effects remain in a result ledger. Eligible unmanaged rows can be
93	metadata-only Adopted or cleanly Removed while preserving their branch;
94	canonical/harness/conflict destruction fails closed. See [Repository lifecycle
95	flow](repository-flow.md) for action and compatibility boundaries.
96	
97	### REPOS
98	
99	```text
100	enter/o   ad-hoc open without creating a task
101	space     expand linked worktrees
102	m         edit repository tags/summary
103	n/N       quick-add / browse repository notes
104	d         track direct work on the current branch
105	s         start isolated work: branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
106	H         open the repository activity heatmap
107	y         open copy/context actions
108	```
109	
110	Expanded rows explain every linked worktree, including harness-owned `(ephemeral)` and otherwise unmanaged `(external)` checkouts. The LIVE column shows runtime activity separately from task state.
111	
112	`dev repo context [repo]` emits the same agent-ready Markdown context available from the TUI copy menu, including paths, Git/worktree/runtime facts, and tasks. `--json` adds the schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract; `--refresh` is the only form that live-probes optional forge and configured fleet sources.
113	
114	### TRY and REMOTE
115	
116	TRY handles low-cost experiments, reversible archive/restore, marking, and graduation. Archive is organization, not deletion or disk reclamation.
117	
118	REMOTE loads lazily so startup does not wait for the network. Its private XDG
119	cache is decoded after the first view and holds the complete paginated inventory.
120	Fresh rows require no network; stale rows stay searchable while background
121	refresh runs. Oversized/malformed payloads and caches fingerprinted for another
122	configured GH/GL host or Azure target are ignored. GitLab uses explicit
123	`GITLAB_HOST`/`GLAB_HOST` (default `gitlab.com`) instead of inferring a host from
124	cwd; successful empty inventories clear old rows. Enter opens an existing local
125	clone. For an absent repository, `c` confirms a path-confined `project_root`
126	destination; `enter` clones and stays in the dashboard, while `o` clones and
127	opens afterward. A `project_root` outside the configured REPOS discovery
128	roots/depth is rejected before mutation. An animated row/status marker remains
129	visible through Git clone and the local-only, generation-guarded REPOS refresh;
130	`q`/Ctrl-C requests cancellation without abandoning the in-flight result. Once
131	accepted, REMOTE marks the checkout as `repo` and REPOS can search it
132	immediately. If Git leaves a destination after failure, REMOTE marks its exact
133	path `inspect` instead of deleting it or offering a misleading retry. `r` forces a forge refresh.
134	Use `/vis:private` for an exact visibility filter. Notes are enabled only after
135	a REMOTE row resolves to a local clone. TRY keeps lowercase `n` for creating a
136	new Try rather than a repository note.
137	
138	### CLI repository pickers
139	
140	Bare `dev repo clone` opens a picker over the existing private forge cache. It
141	uses each provider's exact clone URL, never refreshes the network implicitly,
142	and keeps a manual URL/path/`owner/name` choice. A stale or incomplete cache is
143	still selectable with a warning; populate or replace it explicitly:
144	
145	```bash
146	dev repo remote --refresh
147	dev repo clone
148	```
149	
150	Outside a checkout, bare `dev start` uses the same picker UI over fast live
151	local discovery, then fully resolves the selected repository before planning a
152	task. Inside a repository it retains the immediate current-repository default
153	without scanning every configured root. The default
154	external selector is `fzf`; a missing executable falls back to the built-in
155	Bubble Tea list, and `[picker] command = []` forces that list. Compatible
156	external commands receive candidates on stdin and must return one unchanged
157	line on stdout. Non-TTY callers retain line prompts and never receive picker UI.
158	
159	The repository's `contrib/television/dev-remote-repos.toml` and
160	`contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash` compose over the same public source instead of
161	creating another inventory:
162	
163	```bash
164	dev repo remote --refresh                 # populate once or refresh deliberately
165	ref="$(tv dev-remote-repos)" && [ -n "$ref" ] && dev repo clone "$ref"
166	source contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash
167	dev-repo-clone-fzf
168	```
169	
170	Both external recipes require `jq`, read `dev repo remote --cached --json`, and
171	pass one quoted clone URL to `dev repo clone`. They are examples to copy or
172	symlink; dev does not modify Television, shell, or chezmoi configuration.
173	
174	### FLEET
175	
176	FLEET also loads lazily. It keeps valid cached rows usable while waiting for the
177	current REPOS generation to be accepted, reuses that snapshot for the local host
178	instead of scanning repositories again, and then fans out to configured SSH
179	hosts. This machine is hidden by default because REPOS already provides the
180	richer local inventory; press `a` to include/hide local rows. Press `r` to
181	supersede an older request and force a live reload. Changing any endpoint field,
182	including SSH port, invalidates that host's cache. None of this changes
183	`dev fleet list`, whose non-interactive output continues to include this machine.
184	
185	## Repository quick notes
186	
187	On TASKS and REPOS, lowercase `n` opens a one-line quick-add prompt and uppercase `N` opens the selected repository's notes overlay. A child worktree resolves to the same canonical repository through catalog identity.
188	
189	```text
190	j/k       move
191	/         search body, tags, and repository
192	Enter     expand or collapse the Markdown body
193	a or n    add another note
194	e         edit the body in VISUAL/EDITOR
195	d         enter confirmation; y deletes
196	Esc       return without changing data
197	```
198	
199	The optional REPOS column `notes` shows a count. It is off by default because the table is width-constrained. Repository detail shows the count and latest preview when notes exist; task detail does so when the task resolves to a loaded repository row.
200	
201	The same source-of-truth workflow is available without the TUI:
202	
203	```bash
204	dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
205	dev note list api
206	dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
207	dev note show <id-or-prefix>
208	dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
209	dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # confirms
210	dev note path api
211	dev note reindex
212	```
213	
214	A note ID prefix must be unique and at least eight characters.
215	
216	Markdown under configured `paths.state_dir/notes` is durable; `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` is only a rebuildable search index. See the [complete generated command reference](../reference/commands-config.md#complete-generated-command-reference) for exact flags.
217	
218	SKILLS and MCP both load lazily after the current REPOS generation is accepted.
219	Inside Git they scan only the exact startup checkout plus global/user sources,
220	matching what an agent launched there can read and excluding unrelated projects.
221	Outside Git their startup context retains the cross-repository inventory,
222	scanning every accepted REPOS target plus the ordinary startup directory.
223	Uppercase `A` switches both views between that context and all accepted
224	repositories for this TUI session; old-scope rows are cleared before a guarded
225	reload, and the other capability view remains lazy. Refreshes keep usable rows
226	visible, warning-only partial inventories stay fresh, and a visible capability
227	view resumes automatically after REPOS recovers.
228	
229	SKILLS reads the versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry and lock files
230	natively—no Node, `skills`, npm, `npx`, agent detector, or project code runs.
231	Same-named project/global/repository rows remain distinct. Presence and embedded
232	`dev-cli` integrity are local facts; update state is a separate lock-recorded
233	upstream comparison. `c` is the explicit grouped Git source check, `a` opens the
234	upstream interactive installer, and `u` confirms before updating only the
235	selected lock-managed skill in that row's checkout. The check hashes Git object
236	bytes without populating a checkout; locale-dependent non-ASCII folder hashes stay
237	unverifiable. Mutations require a directly installed `skills` executable, skip
238	repository-local npm shims, reject source-less locks, and serialize cooperating
239	`dev` processes. Filters include `repo:`, `scope:`, `agent:`, `update:`,
240	`presence:`, and `integrity:`. Press `e` to open the row's primary installed `SKILL.md` (or
241	lock file for a missing row). The `y` menu copies the file path (`p`), safe
242	summary (`s`), sanitized source URL (`u`), or whole raw file (`f`).
243	
244	MCP reads static declarations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and
245	OpenCode. It preserves file/scope rows and exact Claude local project keys instead
246	of guessing a generally effective configuration; only Claude's documented
247	user/project/local/managed project approvals are resolved. An absolute
248	`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` relocates Claude user sources. Configured/enabled/disabled
249	never means connected or healthy. Provider-specific environment reference names
250	and finite OAuth facts remain, while values, raw arguments, URL
251	credentials/path/query/fragment, and indirect file content are discarded before
252	rows enter the model. The scanner never runs a server, helper, URL, or agent MCP
253	command. Filters include `repo:`,
254	`agent:`, `scope:`, `transport:`, `managed:`, and `state:`; `r` only rereads
255	static files. Press `e` to open the selected declaration's `ConfigPath`; the `y`
256	menu copies its path (`p`), sanitized declaration (`s`), or the entire raw file
257	(`f`). Raw copy is a local regular-file read capped at 1 MiB and performs no
258	network access, but it can put credentials and other declarations from that file
259	into the system clipboard. Rows and structured output remain sanitized. `e`
260	edits a private working copy and guarded-atomically replaces only the unchanged
261	observed source; a conflict preserves the working copy and reports its recovery
262	path.
263	
264	## External tools
265	
266	```bash
267	dev tui tools
268	```
269	
270	Configured tools run through `$SHELL` in the selected checkout while the alternate screen is suspended. `interactive = true` uses `$SHELL -lic` so local aliases/functions can resolve; use a real executable on `PATH` when the binding must be portable. Availability probes run in a bounded background load after the first view; rendering never starts a login shell, and unresolved bindings fail closed.
271	
272	```toml
273	[[tui.tools]]
274	key = "L"
275	name = "lazygit"
276	run = "lazygit"
277	```
278	
279	Keys are case-sensitive and cannot shadow globally owned dashboard bindings. `A` remains configurable for compatibility, but the SKILLS/MCP scope toggle takes precedence on those views. Returning from an editor can reload most config; switching runtime backend requires restarting the TUI.
280	
281	## Inventory an existing machine
282	
283	Start with a report:
284	
285	```bash
286	dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
287	dev bootstrap ~/code --json
288	```
289	
290	The scanner identifies canonical checkouts, linked worktrees, bare repositories, and symlink aliases, then deduplicates them by Git identity.
291	
292	The recommended organization layer is a non-destructive symlink index:
293	
294	```bash
295	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
296	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
297	```
298	
299	Physical moves are a separate, stricter mode. A move plan blocks dirty repositories, linked worktrees, live sessions/current working directories, aliases that would break, occupied destinations, and cross-filesystem renames. If any row is blocked, apply moves none.
300	
301	## Adopt work already in flight
302	
303	Bootstrap answers **where repositories are**. Adoption answers **which existing branches, worktrees, and sessions are active work**:
304	
305	```bash
306	dev adopt
307	dev adopt --apply
308	```
309	
310	Adopt reports by default and only writes task entries after `--apply` plus confirmation. It does not move, rename, or delete checkouts, and it excludes recognized harness-ephemeral worktrees.
311

59	
60	### TASKS

68	```
69	
70	COLD worktree task 必須透過 `dev resume` 重建；TUI 不會用 generic open action 靜默重建。若 worktree 已遺失或不再由 Git 註冊，必須先執行 `dev sweep`，讓它在 resume 或 reap 前回報需要 salvage 的 agent artifacts。Enter 不會開啟只剩 artifacts 的 abandoned directory。Terminal 寬度至少 97 cells 時，TASKS table 會顯示 display-width-aware `REPO` column；更窄時保留原 columns，並在 detail 顯示 repo/path。
71	
72	### REPOS
73	
74	```text
75	enter/o   ad-hoc open，不建立 task
76	space     展開 linked worktrees
77	m         編輯 repository tags/summary
78	n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
79	d         追蹤目前 branch 的 direct work
80	s         啟動 isolated work：branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
81	H         開啟 repository activity heatmap
82	y         開啟 copy/context actions
83	```
84	
85	展開後會顯示每個 linked worktree，包括 harness-owned `(ephemeral)` 與未受管理的 `(external)` checkout。LIVE column 將 runtime activity 與 task state 分開。
86	
87	`dev repo context [repo]` 會輸出 TUI copy menu 相同的 agent-ready Markdown context，包含 paths、Git/worktree/runtime facts 與 tasks。`--json` 加入 schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract；只有 `--refresh` 會 live-probe optional forge 與 configured fleet sources。
88	
89	### 獨立 Repository Flow
90	
91	```text
92	dev flow [repo]         依 cwd 或明確 repo 開啟 canonical repository
93	j/k 或 Up/Down          選 surface row
94	h/l 或 Left/Right       選 action
95	Enter                   只建立 plan
96	r                       只更新 local facts
97	R                       明確選 fetch refs、query review 或 both
98	```
99	
100	Flow 的 `CANONICAL`、`MANAGED`、`UNMANAGED`、`HARNESS`、`TASK-ONLY` 與 `CONFLICT` rows 各有不同 action set。只有 READY plan 經 `y` 或 exact typed token 的第二次 confirmation 後才 Apply；沒有 generic force、dirty discard、`--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime` 或 shared-writer override。Runtime `none` 顯示為 unobserved，不會被解讀成已證明沒有 session。Result 會保留 partial step ledger，Apply 後再 fresh local reload。
101	
102	### TRY 與 REMOTE
103	
104	TRY 管理低成本 experiment、可逆 archive/restore、mark 與 graduation。Archive 是整理，不是 deletion 或 disk reclamation。
105	
106	REMOTE 延遲載入，因此 startup 不等待 network。Private XDG cache 會在 first
107	view 後 decode，並保存完整 paginated inventory；fresh rows 不需要 network，
108	stale rows 仍可搜尋並在背景 refresh。Oversized／malformed payload，以及
109	fingerprint 屬於其他 configured GH/GL host 或 Azure target 的 cache 都會被忽略。
110	GitLab 使用 explicit `GITLAB_HOST`／`GLAB_HOST`（預設 `gitlab.com`），不從 cwd
111	推測 host；成功但為空的 inventory 會清除舊 rows。Enter 開啟既有 local clone。
112	對尚未 clone 的 repository，`c` 會確認受限於 `project_root` 的 destination；
113	`enter` 執行 clone 並留在 dashboard，`o` 則在 clone 後開啟。若 `project_root`
114	超出 configured REPOS discovery roots/depth，會在 mutation 前拒絕。Git clone 與
115	local-only、generation-guarded REPOS refresh 期間，row 與 status 會持續顯示 animated
116	marker；`q`／Ctrl-C 會要求取消，但不會拋棄 in-flight result。Snapshot 接受後，REMOTE
117	會標成 `repo`，REPOS 也能立即搜尋。若 Git 失敗後留下 destination，REMOTE 會把
118	exact path 標成 `inspect`，不會自動刪除或提供誤導性的 retry。`r` 才會
119	強制更新 forge inventories。使用 `/vis:private` 可精確過濾 visibility。只有 REMOTE row
120	能解析到 local clone 時才能使用 notes。TRY 保留 lowercase `n` 建立新 Try，不會改成
121	repository note。
122	
123	### CLI repository pickers
124	
125	Bare `dev repo clone` 會對既有 private forge cache 開啟 picker。它使用各 provider
126	的 exact clone URL，絕不 implicit refresh network，並保留 manual URL/path/`owner/name`
127	選項。Stale 或 incomplete cache 仍可選，但會顯示 warning；cache 必須明確 populate
128	或 replace：
129	
130	```bash
131	dev repo remote --refresh
132	dev repo clone
133	```
134	
135	在 checkout 外，bare `dev start` 使用相同 picker UI 選 fast live local discovery
136	的結果，之後才 full resolve 選定 repository 並規劃 task。在 repository 內則保留
137	immediate current-repository default，不掃描所有 configured roots。Default external selector 是 `fzf`；
138	executable 缺少時 fallback 到 built-in Bubble Tea list，`[picker] command = []` 會
139	強制使用 built-in。相容 external command 從 stdin 讀 candidates，並須在 stdout
140	原樣回傳一行。Non-TTY caller 保留 line prompt，絕不收到 picker UI。
141	
142	Repository 的 `contrib/television/dev-remote-repos.toml` 與
143	`contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash` 會組合相同 public source，不建立另一份 inventory：
144	
145	```bash
146	dev repo remote --refresh                 # 只在明確要求時 populate／refresh
147	ref="$(tv dev-remote-repos)" && [ -n "$ref" ] && dev repo clone "$ref"
148	source contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash
149	dev-repo-clone-fzf
150	```
151	
152	兩個 external recipe 都需要 `jq`、只讀 `dev repo remote --cached --json`，並將
153	一個 quoted clone URL 傳給 `dev repo clone`。它們是供 copy 或 symlink 的範例；
154	dev 不會修改 Television、shell 或 chezmoi config。
155	
156	### FLEET
157	
158	FLEET 同樣延遲載入。等待目前的 REPOS generation 被接受時，仍可使用 valid
159	cached rows；接受後會重用該 snapshot 作為 local host 資料，不再重掃
160	repositories，接著才 fan out 到設定的 SSH hosts。它預設隱藏本機，因為 REPOS
161	已提供較完整的 local inventory；按 `a` 可顯示或隱藏 local rows。按 `r` 會
162	supersede 舊 request 並強制執行 live reload。任何 endpoint field（包含 SSH
163	port）改變都會讓該 host cache 失效。這不會改變 `dev fleet list`：其
164	non-interactive output 仍包含本機與所有已設定的 remote hosts。
165	
166	## Repository quick notes
167	
168	在 TASKS 與 REPOS，lowercase `n` 開啟單行 quick-add prompt，uppercase `N` 開啟選取 repository 的 notes overlay。Child worktree 會透過 catalog identity 解析到同一個 canonical repository。
169	
170	```text
171	j/k       移動
172	/         搜尋 body、tags 與 repository
173	Enter     展開或收合 Markdown body
174	a or n    新增另一則 note
175	e         用 VISUAL/EDITOR 編輯 body
176	d         進入確認；y 才刪除
177	Esc       不改資料並返回
178	```
179	
180	可選的 REPOS column `notes` 顯示數量。Table 寬度有限，因此預設不啟用。Notes 存在時，repository detail 顯示數量與最新 preview；task 能解析到已載入 repository row 時，task detail 才會顯示。
181	
182	不使用 TUI 也能操作同一份 source of truth：
183	
184	```bash
185	dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
186	dev note list api
187	dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
188	dev note show <id-or-prefix>
189	dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
190	dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # 會確認
191	dev note path api
192	dev note reindex
193	```
194	
195	Note ID prefix 必須唯一，且至少八個字元。
196	
197	Configured `paths.state_dir/notes` 下的 Markdown 是 durable data；`$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` 只是可重建的 search index。精確 flags 請見[命令與設定 reference](../reference/commands-config.md)中的完整 generated command reference。
198	
199	SKILLS 與 MCP 都會等目前 REPOS generation 被接受後才延遲載入。在 Git 內，兩者只掃描
200	exact startup checkout 加 global/user sources，符合從該處啟動 agent 實際會讀到的內容，
201	不再混入無關 projects。在 Git 外，startup context 保留 cross-repository inventory，掃描
202	所有 accepted REPOS targets 加 ordinary startup directory。Uppercase `A` 會在本次 TUI
203	session 讓兩個 view 共用 context/all-repositories scope；切換時先清掉舊 scope rows，再以
204	generation guard reload，而未顯示的另一個 capability view 仍維持 lazy。Refresh 時會保留
205	可用 rows；warning-only partial inventory 仍維持 fresh，且 visible capability view 會在
206	REPOS recovery 後自動繼續載入。
207	
208	SKILLS 直接讀取 versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry 與 lock files；
209	不會執行 Node、`skills`、npm、`npx`、agent detector 或 project code。同名
210	project/global/repository rows 保持分開。Presence 與 embedded `dev-cli` integrity
211	是 local facts；update state 則是獨立的 lock-recorded upstream comparison。`c`
212	是明確且 grouped 的 Git source check；`a` 開啟 upstream interactive installer；
213	`u` 先確認，再於該 row 的 checkout 更新選取且受 lock 管理的 skill。Check 直接
214	hash Git object bytes，不建立 checkout；依 locale 排序的 non-ASCII folder hash
215	維持 unverifiable。Mutation 需要直接安裝的 `skills` executable，會跳過
216	repository-local npm shim、拒絕 source-less lock，並在 cooperating `dev` processes
217	之間 serialized。Filters 包含 `repo:`、`scope:`、`agent:`、`update:`、
218	`presence:` 與 `integrity:`。按 `e` 會開啟 row 的 primary installed `SKILL.md`（missing row
219	則開 lock file）；`y` menu 可複製 file path (`p`)、safe summary (`s`)、sanitized
220	source URL (`u`) 或整份 raw file (`f`)。
221	
222	MCP 會讀取 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 與 OpenCode 的 static
223	declarations。它保留 file/scope rows 與 exact Claude local project key，不猜測
224	一般化的 effective config；只有 Claude documented user/project/local/managed
225	project approvals 會被解析。Absolute `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 會搬移 Claude user
226	sources。Configured/enabled/disabled 不代表 connected 或 healthy。Provider-specific
227	environment reference names 與有限 OAuth facts 會保留；其 values、raw arguments、
228	URL credentials/path/query/fragment 與 indirect file content 都會在 row 進入 model
229	前被丟棄。Scanner 不會執行 server、helper、URL 或 agent MCP command。Filters 包含 `repo:`、`agent:`、`scope:`、`transport:`、
230	`managed:` 與 `state:`；`r` 只重讀 static files。按 `e` 會開啟 selected declaration
231	的 `ConfigPath`；`y` menu 可複製 path (`p`)、sanitized declaration (`s`) 或整份 raw
232	file (`f`)。Raw copy 只讀 local regular file、上限 1 MiB 且不使用 network，但可能把
233	同檔的 credentials 與其他 declarations 放進 system clipboard；rows 與 structured
234	output 仍維持 sanitized。`e` 會編輯 private working copy，並只在 observed source
235	identity 未改變時 guarded-atomically replace；發生 conflict 時會保留 working copy
236	並回報 recovery path。
237	
238	## External tools
239	
240	```bash
241	dev tui tools
242	```
243	
244	設定的 tool 會在暫停 alternate screen 後，透過 `$SHELL` 於選取 checkout 執行。`interactive = true` 使用 `$SHELL -lic`，讓 local aliases/functions 能解析；跨機器需要 portability 時應使用 `PATH` 中的真實 executable。Availability probe 會在 first view 後以 bounded background load 執行；rendering 不會啟動 login shell，尚未解析的 binding 會 fail closed。
245	
246	```toml
247	[[tui.tools]]
248	key = "L"
249	name = "lazygit"
250	run = "lazygit"
251	```
252	
253	Key 區分大小寫，且不能覆蓋 globally owned dashboard binding。為相容既有設定，`A` 仍可配置，但在 SKILLS/MCP view 會優先執行 scope toggle。離開 editor 後可 reload 多數 config；更換 runtime backend 需要重啟 TUI。
254	
255	Configured tool 是刻意保留的 escape hatch：它在選取 checkout 執行任意 configured command，不會自動繼承 `dev flow` 的 PlanID、conditions、agent occupancy 或 revalidation guards。Raw Git／forge command 也是同樣邊界；operator 必須自行確認其 safety。
256	
257	## Inventory 現有機器
258	
259	先產生 report：
260	
261	```bash
262	dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
263	dev bootstrap ~/code --json
264	```
265	
266	Scanner 會辨識 canonical checkout、linked worktree、bare repository 與 symlink alias，再依 Git identity 去重。
267	
268	建議的 organization layer 是 non-destructive symlink index：
269	
270	```bash
271	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
272	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
273	```
274	
275	Physical move 是另一個更嚴格的 mode。Move plan 會阻擋 dirty repository、linked worktree、live session/current working directory、會損壞的 alias、occupied destination 與 cross-filesystem rename；任一 row blocked 時，apply 不會移動任何 repository。
276	
277	## Adopt 進行中的工作
278	
279	Bootstrap 回答 **repository 在哪裡**；adoption 回答 **哪些既有 branch、worktree 與 session 正在工作**：
280	
281	```bash
282	dev adopt
283	dev adopt --apply
284	```
285	
286	Adopt 預設只回報；只有 `--apply` 加確認後才寫 task entry。它不會移動、改名或刪除 checkout，也會排除已辨識的 harness-ephemeral worktree。

7	## Seven views
8	
9	Switch with `tab`, `l`/`h`, right/left, or by left-clicking a visible tab:
10	
11	| View | Answers | Data source |
12	|---|---|---|
13	| TASKS | What am I working on? | task registry + live Git/runtime state |
14	| REPOS | What durable repositories exist here? | configured scan roots + asset catalog |
15	| FLEET | What exists and is active on my other machines? | remote `dev` snapshots over SSH |
16	| TRY | Which experiments can I resume, archive or graduate? | experiment catalog + live Git/runtime state |
17	| REMOTE | What can I open or clone? | authenticated forge CLI inventories |
18	| SKILLS | Which skills would an agent launched from this context read? | context-first targets plus an `A` all-repositories toggle |
19	| MCP | Which MCP declarations would that agent context expose? | sanitized static agent configuration with the same shared scope |
20	
21	The initial TASKS frame is built before runtime auto-detection, project-root
22	lookup, cache decoding, shell tool probes or the optional release refresh can
23	finish. TASKS, REPOS and TRY then publish independently from one shared local
24	load cycle; optional REMOTE, FLEET, SKILLS and MCP work remains lazy. Each view
25	has its own generation: `r` supersedes the old read, late results are ignored,
26	failed refreshes keep usable rows, and a successful empty result clears old
27	rows. Warning-only SKILLS/MCP diagnostics remain fresh partial snapshots instead
28	of causing revisit loops; a visible dependent view automatically resumes after
29	REPOS recovers. Cached rows and current live results are separate readiness
30	stages; there is no all-tabs-ready state for views that may never be opened.
31	
32	Mouse tracking supplements rather than replaces the keyboard model. A left-button
33	press selects a visible row or tab, the wheel moves three rows, and a right-button
34	press selects a row then opens its available action menu. Releases, motion,
35	modified clicks, and repeated-click activation are ignored; Enter/`o` remains the
36	explicit open action. Depending on the terminal, hold Shift/Option for native text
37	selection while tracking is enabled.

39	## Repository lifecycle preview
40	
41	`dev flow [repo]` is a separate preview-labelled, full-screen TUI; it does not
42	share the dashboard model above and requires terminal input/output. In any
43	canonical or linked checkout, bare `dev flow` opens the canonical repository and
44	focuses that exact surface. Outside Git it opens a filterable repository picker;
45	an explicit repo overrides cwd.
46	
47	Its rows are every Git-registered worktree plus task-only records, including

49	`task-only`, and `conflict`. The center keeps persisted HOT/WARM/COLD/DONE intent
50	separate from observed Git/runtime/artifact evidence. The right side offers exact
51	managed lifecycle plans, or metadata-only Adopt and clean branch-preserving
52	Remove for eligible unmanaged linked checkouts. Canonical checkout removal,
53	harness cleanup, and destructive conflict resolution fail closed.
54	
55	```text
56	j/k or arrows row    h/l or arrows action    Tab focus    Enter plan
57	r local facts only   R fetch/query/both       ? help       Esc back
58	```
59

61	plus Enter. Apply revalidates the task revision and repository/checkout/ref/

66	run-local and limited to refs plus review existence/state/draft/URL/provider/time,
67	not review decisions or checks.

89	`n` for a low-cost experiment.

106	destination is labelled `inspect` with its exact path; dev does not delete it

111	both scan only the exact startup checkout and read user/global sources once, so
