767	// tuiCapabilityTargets makes SKILLS and MCP describe either what an agent
768	// launched from the startup context would see or every accepted repository.
769	// Global sources are still scanned once by the domain collectors.
770	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {
771		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))
772		for _, row := range locals {
773			if !row.IsTry() {
774				repositories = append(repositories, row.Repo)
775			}
776		}
777		targets := agenttarget.FromRepositories(repositories)
778		if scope == tui.CapabilityAllRepositories {
779			return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
780		}
781		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" && current.CommonDir != "" &&
782			!sameCleanPath(current.CheckoutRoot, current.CommonDir) {
783			return []agenttarget.Target{agenttarget.ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)}
784		}
785		return agenttarget.WithCurrent(targets, current)
786	}

136	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {

138		if d < time.Hour {

154	// buildHeaderLayout renders the tab strip and records the exact cell spans it
155	// used, so mouse hit testing cannot drift from responsive labels or styles.
156	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
157		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
158			short := map[View]string{
159				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
160				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
161			}
162			var builder strings.Builder
163			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
164			builder.WriteString(prefix)
165			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
166			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
167			for index, view := range Views {
168				if index > 0 {
169					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
170					builder.WriteString(separator)
171					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
172				}
173				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
174				if compact {
175					name = short[view]
176				}
177				label := name
178				if !compact {
179					label = " " + name + " "
180				}
181				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
182				if view == m.view {
183					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
184				}
185				from := x
186				builder.WriteString(rendered)
187				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
188				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
189			}
190			if summary {
191				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
192			}
193			if m.filter != "" {
194				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
195			}
196			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
197		}
198	
199		layout := build(false, true)
200		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
201			layout = build(false, false)
202		}
203		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
204			layout = build(true, false)
205		}
206		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
207			return layout
208		}
209	
210		prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
211		name := strings.ToUpper(m.view.String())
212		line := prefix + styleSelected.Render(name)
213		layout = headerLayout{
214			line: line,
215			tabs: []tabHit{{view: m.view, from: lipgloss.Width(prefix), to: lipgloss.Width(line)}},
216		}
217		if m.filter != "" {
218			available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(layout.line) - 4
219			if available > 1 {
220				layout.line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
221			}
222		}
223		return layout
224	}

226	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
227	// is another one — is never in doubt.
228	func (m Model) renderHeader() string { return m.buildHeaderLayout().line + "\n" }

230	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
231	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
232	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
233		h := m.listHeight()
234		if n <= h {
235			return 0, n
236		}
237		from = m.at() - h/2
238		if from < 0 {
239			from = 0
240		}
241		if from+h > n {
242			from = n - h
243		}
244		return from, from + h
245	}

148	func (m Model) updateOverlay(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
149		switch m.overlay.kind {
150		case overlayHelp:
151			switch message.String() {
152			case "esc", "?", "q":
153				m.overlay = overlayState{}
154			}
155			return m, nil
156	
157		case overlayActionMenu:
158			switch message.String() {
159			case "esc", "q":
160				m.overlay = overlayState{}
161				return m, nil
162			case "j", "down":
163				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
164					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
165				}
166				return m, nil
167			case "k", "up":
168				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
169					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
170				}
171				return m, nil
172			case "enter":
173				return m.runOverlayAction()
174			}
175			return m, nil
176	
177		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
178			switch message.String() {
179			case "esc":
180				m.overlay = overlayState{}
181				m.err = nil
182				return m, nil
183			case "tab", "down":
184				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
185			case "shift+tab", "up":
186				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
187			case "enter":
188				return m.submitTryOverlay()
189			}
190			index := m.overlay.fieldIndex
191			input, command := m.overlay.fields[index].input.Update(message)
192			m.overlay.fields[index].input = input
193			return m, command
194		}
195		return m, nil
196	}

198	func (m Model) submitTryOverlay() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {

216	
217		request := TryRequest{Action: m.overlay.action, ID: m.overlay.target.Item.ID}
218		switch m.overlay.action {
219		case TryCreate:
220			request.Name, request.Clone = value("name"), value("clone")
221			if request.Name == "" && request.Clone == "" {
222				m.err = fmt.Errorf("a new Try needs a name or clone reference")

230			request.NoGit = !gitInit
231		case TryMark:
232			request.Tags = splitTagInput(value("tags"))
233			request.Note = value("note")
234		case TryRestore:
235			request.To = value("to")
236		case TryGraduate:
237			request.Category, request.Name = value("category"), value("name")
238		case TryArchive:

240				m.err = fmt.Errorf("confirmation must be exactly YES")
241				return m, nil
242			}
243		default:
244			m.err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported Try form action %q", m.overlay.action)
245			return m, nil
246		}
247		m.overlay = overlayState{}
248		m.err = nil
249		m.status = string(request.Action) + " in progress…"
250		return m, m.applyTry(request)
251	}

314			}

317			}
318			builder.WriteString("\n\n  " + styleHelp.Render("tab field · enter submit · esc cancel"))
319		}

98	// configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
99	// it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
100	// which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
101	func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
102		path := app.configPath
103		if path == "" {
104			path = config.ConfigFile()
105		}
106		path = config.Expand(path)
107		created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, "", false, err

111		proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editor)
112		return proc, chosen, created, err
113	}

115	func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
116		logical := filepath.Clean(path)
117		resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(logical)
118		if err != nil {
119			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
120		}
121		source, observed, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
122		if err != nil {
123			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
124		}
125		original, readErr := safefile.ReadAll(context.Background(), source, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
126		closeErr := source.Close()
127		if readErr != nil {
128			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)
129		}
130		if closeErr != nil {
131			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), closeErr)
132		}
133	
134		working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
135		if err != nil {
136			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
137		}
138		workingPath := working.Name()
139		cleanup := true
140		defer func() {
141			if cleanup {
142				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
143			}
144		}()
145		if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
146			_ = working.Close()
147			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
148		}
149		if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
150			_ = working.Close()
151			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
152		}
153		if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
154			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
155		}
156		process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
157		if err != nil {
158			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
159		}
160		cleanup = false
161	
162		return tui.CapabilityEdit{
163			Command: process,
164			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
165				if runErr != nil {
166					_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
167					return runErr
168				}
169				edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
170				if err != nil {
171					return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
172				}

179				}

183				); err != nil {
184					return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
185				}
186				return os.Remove(workingPath)
187			},
188		}, nil
189	}

191	// ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
192	// Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
193	func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
194		info, err := os.Stat(path)
195		switch {
196		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
197			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
198		case err == nil:
199			return false, nil
200		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
201			return false, err
202		}
203		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
204			return false, err
205		}
206		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
207		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
208			return false, err
209		}
210		return true, nil
211	}
212	
213	func editorProcess(path, override string) (*exec.Cmd, string, error) {
214		chosen, err := resolveEditor(override)
215		if err != nil {
216			return nil, "", err
217		}
218		command, err := fleetEditorCommand(chosen, path)
219		return command, chosen, err
220	}
221	
222	func resolveEditor(override string) (string, error) {
223		for _, candidate := range []string{override, os.Getenv("VISUAL"), os.Getenv("EDITOR")} {
224			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
225				return candidate, nil
226			}
227		}
228		for _, candidate := range []string{"nvim", "vim", "vi"} {
229			if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
230				return candidate, nil
231			}
232		}
233		return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
234	}

12	func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {
13		if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
14			return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
17			return row.Lock.File, nil
18		}
19		return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}

35	func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
36		lines := []string{
37			"name: " + row.Name,
38			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
39		}
40		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
51	}
52	
53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
54		lines := []string{
55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}
59		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
60		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
61		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
62		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
63		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
64		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
65		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
66		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
67		if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
69		}
70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
73			for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
74				value := string(credential.Kind)
75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
84			for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
85				redactions[i] = string(redaction)
86			}
87			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
88		}
89		if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
90			coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
91			for i, item := range row.Coverage {
92				coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
93			}
94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}

99	func (m Model) copyBindingHelp() string {
100		if m.view == ViewRepos {
101			return "y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths"
102		}
103		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
104		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil {
105			parts = append(parts, "p file path")
106		}
107		parts = append(parts, "s safe summary")
108		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok && row.SourceURL != "" {
109			parts = append(parts, "u source URL")
110		}
111		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil && m.actions.ReadFile != nil {
112			parts = append(parts, "f raw file")
113		}
114		return strings.Join(parts, " · ")
115	}

117	func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {
118		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
119			return lines
120		}
121		return append(lines, label+": "+value)
122	}

562			tryAction = TryDeprecate
563		case listActionTryReactivate:
564			tryAction = TryReactivate
565		case listActionTryArchive:
566			tryAction = TryArchive
567		case listActionTryRestore:

569		case listActionTryGraduate:
570			tryAction = TryGraduate

577		case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:

579			return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: tryAction, ID: row.Item.ID})
580		default:
581			return m, nil
582		}
583	}

1	package tui

3	import tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
4	
5	const mouseWheelRows = 3
6	
7	// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
8	// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		n := m.count()
19		listLines := m.listPreambleLines()
20		if n > 0 {
21			visible := min(n, m.listHeight())
22			listLines += visible
23			if visible < n {
24				listLines++
25			}
26		}
27		total := 2 + listLines + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		return total <= m.height
29	}
30	
31	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
32		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
33		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
37			if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
38				return m, nil
39			}
40			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
41		}
42		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
43			return m, nil
44		}
45		if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
46			return m, nil
47		}
48	
49		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
50			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
51				return m, nil
52			}
53			delta := mouseWheelRows
54			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
55				delta = -delta
56			}
57			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
58			return m, nil
59		}
60		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
61			return m, nil
62		}
63	
64		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
65			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
66				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
67					continue
68				}
69				if m.view == hit.view {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.view = hit.view
73				return m.afterViewSwitch()
74			}
75			return m, nil
76		}
77	
78		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
79		if !ok {
80			return m, nil
81		}
82		switch event.Button {
83		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
84			m.setAt(row)
85		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
86			m.setAt(row)
87			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
88				m = m.openActionMenu()
89			}
90		}
91		return m, nil
92	}
93	
94	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
95		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
96			return 0, false
97		}
98		count := m.count()
99		from, to := m.window(count)
100		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
101		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
102			return 0, false
103		}
104		return from + y - first, true
105	}
106	
107	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
108		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
109			return false
110		}
111		from, to := m.window(m.count())
112		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
113		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
114	}
115	
116	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
117		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
118			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
119				return m, nil
120			}
121			delta := 1
122			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
123				delta = -1
124			}
125			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
126			return m, nil
127		}
128		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
132		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
133			m.overlay = overlayState{}
134			return m, nil
135		}
136		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
137		return m.runOverlayAction()
138	}

1	package tui
2	
3	import tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
4	
5	const mouseWheelRows = 3
6	
7	// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
8	// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		n := m.count()
19		listLines := m.listPreambleLines()
20		if n > 0 {
21			visible := min(n, m.listHeight())
22			listLines += visible
23			if visible < n {
24				listLines++
25			}
26		}
27		total := 2 + listLines + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		return total <= m.height
29	}
30	
31	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
32		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
33		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
37			if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
38				return m, nil
39			}
40			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
41		}
42		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
43			return m, nil
44		}
45		if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
46			return m, nil
47		}
48	
49		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
50			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
51				return m, nil
52			}
53			delta := mouseWheelRows
54			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
55				delta = -delta
56			}
57			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
58			return m, nil
59		}
60		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
61			return m, nil
62		}
63	
64		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
65			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
66				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
67					continue
68				}
69				if m.view == hit.view {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.view = hit.view
73				return m.afterViewSwitch()
74			}
75			return m, nil
76		}
77	
78		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
79		if !ok {
80			return m, nil
81		}
82		switch event.Button {
83		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
84			m.setAt(row)
85		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
86			m.setAt(row)
87			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
88				m = m.openActionMenu()
89			}
90		}
91		return m, nil
92	}
93	
94	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
95		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
96			return 0, false
97		}
98		count := m.count()
99		from, to := m.window(count)
100		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
101		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
102			return 0, false
103		}
104		return from + y - first, true
105	}
106	
107	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
108		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
109			return false
110		}
111		from, to := m.window(m.count())
112		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
113		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
114	}
115	
116	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
117		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
118			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
119				return m, nil
120			}
121			delta := 1
122			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
123				delta = -1
124			}
125			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
126			return m, nil
127		}
128		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
132		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
133			m.overlay = overlayState{}
134			return m, nil
135		}
136		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
137		return m.runOverlayAction()
138	}

12	func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {
13		if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
14			return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
17			return row.Lock.File, nil
18		}
19		return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}

35	func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
36		lines := []string{
37			"name: " + row.Name,
38			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
39		}
40		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
51	}
52	
53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
54		lines := []string{
55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}
59		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
60		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
61		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
62		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
63		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
64		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
65		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
66		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
67		if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
69		}
70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
73			for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
74				value := string(credential.Kind)
75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
84			for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
85				redactions[i] = string(redaction)
86			}
87			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
88		}
89		if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
90			coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
91			for i, item := range row.Coverage {
92				coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
93			}
94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}

99	func (m Model) copyBindingHelp() string {

102		}
103		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
104		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil {
105			parts = append(parts, "p file path")

107		parts = append(parts, "s safe summary")

109			parts = append(parts, "u source URL")

111		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil && m.actions.ReadFile != nil {

117	func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {

119			return lines
120		}
121		return append(lines, label+": "+value)

81		if err := os.WriteFile(editor, []byte("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'edited\\n' > \"$1\"\n"), 0o755); err != nil {
82			t.Fatal(err)
83		}
84		t.Setenv("VISUAL", editor)
85	
86		edit, err := prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path)
87		if err != nil {
88			t.Fatal(err)
89		}
90		runErr := edit.Command.Run()
91		if err := edit.Complete(runErr); err != nil {
92			t.Fatal(err)
93		}
94		body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
95		if err != nil || string(body) != "edited\n" {
96			t.Fatalf("edited source = %q, %v", body, err)
97		}
98		info, err := os.Stat(path)
99		if err != nil {
100			t.Fatal(err)
101		}
102		if info.Mode().Perm() != 0o640 {
103			t.Fatalf("edited source mode = %v", info.Mode().Perm())
104		}
105	
106		edit, err = prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			t.Fatal(err)
109		}
110		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("external\n"), 0o640); err != nil {
111			t.Fatal(err)
112		}
113		if err := os.WriteFile(editor, []byte("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'user-edited\\n' > \"$1\"\n"), 0o755); err != nil {
114			t.Fatal(err)
115		}
116		runErr = edit.Command.Run()
117		err = edit.Complete(runErr)
118		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "working copy preserved at") {
119			t.Fatalf("conflicting edit = %v", err)
120		}
121		body, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
122		if readErr != nil || string(body) != "external\n" {
123			t.Fatalf("conflict overwrote external source = %q, %v", body, readErr)
124		}
125		if remainder, ok := strings.CutPrefix(err.Error(), "replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at "); ok {
126			if recovery, _, found := strings.Cut(remainder, ": "); found {
127				_ = os.Remove(recovery)
128			}
129		}
130	}

+func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
+	logical := filepath.Clean(path)
+	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(logical)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	source, observed, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	original, readErr := safefile.ReadAll(context.Background(), source, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+	closeErr := source.Close()
+	if readErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)
+	}
+	if closeErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), closeErr)
+	}
+
+	working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	workingPath := working.Name()
+	cleanup := true
+	defer func() {
+		if cleanup {
+			_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+		}
+	}()
+	if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	cleanup = false
+
+	return tui.CapabilityEdit{
+		Command: process,
+		Complete: func(runErr error) error {
+			if runErr != nil {
+				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+				return runErr
+			}
+			edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if bytes.Equal(edited, original) {
+				return os.Remove(workingPath)
+			}
+			root, err := os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			defer root.Close()
+			if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
+				context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
+			); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			return os.Remove(workingPath)
+		},
+	}, nil
+}

+func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {

2866	func (m Model) updateList(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
2867		n := m.count()

2878						m.remoteClone.cancel()

2881				return m, nil

2884			case "j", "down", "ctrl+n", "k", "up", "ctrl+p",
2885				"ctrl+d", "pgdown", "ctrl+u", "pgup", "g", "home", "G", "end",

3739	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
3740		fresh := valid && err == nil
3741		var commands []tea.Cmd
3742		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
3743			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
3744				continue
3745			}
3746			state := m.viewLoad(view)
3747			if state.loading || m.view == view {
3748				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
3749				if fresh {
3750					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
3751					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
3752					continue
3753				}
3754				dependencyErr := err
3755				if dependencyErr == nil {
3756					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
3757				}
3758				current := m.viewLoad(view)
3759				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
3760				continue
3761			}
3762			if state.hasSnapshot {
3763				m.invalidateView(view)
3764			}
3765		}
3766		return batchCommands(commands...)
3767	}

3980	func (m Model) openSelected() tea.Cmd {
3981		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {

3983				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: err} }
3984			}
3985			t := row.Task
3986			return func() tea.Msg {
3987				opened, err := m.actions.Open(context.Background(), t)
3988				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3989			}
3990		}
3991		if r, ok := m.currentRepo(); ok {
3992			return func() tea.Msg {
3993				opened, err := m.actions.OpenRepo(context.Background(), r)
3994				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
3995			}
3996		}
3997		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
3998			checkout, _ := item.checkout()
3999			dir := checkout.Worktree.Path
4000			return func() tea.Msg {
4001				if !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
4002					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("worktree checkout is missing or prunable: %s", dir)}
4003				}
4004				if m.actions.OpenCheckout == nil {
4005					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("opening linked worktrees is unavailable")}
4006				}
4007				opened, err := m.actions.OpenCheckout(context.Background(), item.Repo, checkout)
4008				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
4009			}
4010		}
4011		if r, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
4012			if !r.Present() {
4013				return func() tea.Msg {
4014					return tryActionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("Try %s is %s on this host", r.Item.DisplayName(), r.Where())}
4015				}
4016			}
4017			return m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: TryOpen, ID: r.Item.ID})
4018		}
4019		if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
4020			if !r.Cloned() {
4021				return nil // c is the explicit clone action
4022			}
4023			return func() tea.Msg {
4024				opened, err := m.actions.OpenRemote(context.Background(), r)
4025				return actionMsg{status: opened.Status, cd: opened.Directory, activate: opened.RuntimeHandle, err: err}
4026			}

4028		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil && m.actions.OpenFleet != nil {
4029			process, err := m.actions.OpenFleet(context.Background(), row)
4030			if err != nil {
4031				return func() tea.Msg { return actionMsg{err: err} }
4032			}
4033			return tea.ExecProcess(process, func(err error) tea.Msg {

4036				}
4037				return afterExec(actionMsg{status: "returned from " + row.Host})
4038			})
4039		}
4040		return nil
4041	}

4043	// launchTool hands the terminal to an external program running in the selected
4044	// row's checkout, then reloads — the tool may well have changed the git state
4045	// the dashboard is displaying.
4046	func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd {
4047		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
4048			if t.Key != key {
4049				continue
4050			}
4051			if t.Probe != nil && t.Availability != ToolAvailable {
4052				detail := "availability is still being checked"
4053				if t.Availability == ToolUnavailable {
4054					detail = "is not installed"
4055				}
4056				return func() tea.Msg {
4057					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s %s", t.Command[0], detail)}
4058				}
4059			}
4060			dir := m.currentDir()
4061			if dir == "" {
4062				return func() tea.Msg {
4063					return actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("nothing selected with a checkout on disk")}
4064				}
4065			}
4066			c := exec.Command(t.Command[0], t.Command[1:]...)
4067			c.Dir = dir
4068			return tea.ExecProcess(c, func(err error) tea.Msg {
4069				if err != nil {
4070					return afterExec(actionMsg{err: fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", t.Name, err)})
4071				}
4072				return afterExec(actionMsg{status: "back from " + t.Name, forceSizes: true})
4073			})
4074		}
4075		return nil
4076	}
4077	
4078	// Tools lists the external programs available on this machine, so the footer
4079	// only advertises bindings that will actually work.
4080	func (m Model) Tools() []Tool {
4081		var out []Tool
4082		for _, t := range m.actions.Tools {
4083			if t.Probe == nil || t.Availability == ToolAvailable {
4084				out = append(out, t)
4085			}
4086		}
4087		return out
4088	}

19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually

21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

434	// New builds the dashboard.
435	func New(actions Actions, rows []inventory.Row, repos []RepoRow) Model {
436		in := textinput.New()
437		in.CharLimit = 200
438		cloneSpinner := spinner.MiniDot
439		cloneSpinner.FPS = 200 * time.Millisecond
440	
441		m := Model{
442			actions:            actions,
443			rows:               rows,
444			repos:              repos,
445			input:              in,
446			remoteCloneSpinner: spinner.New(spinner.WithSpinner(cloneSpinner)),
447			width:              100,
448			height:             30,
449			firstViewReady:     make(chan struct{}),
450			firstViewOnce:      &sync.Once{},
451		}
452		if len(actions.Tools) > 0 {
453			m.toolGeneration = 1
454		}
455		if rows != nil {
456			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewTasks, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
457		}
458		if repos != nil {
459			m.seedViewSnapshot(ViewRepos, perftrace.SourceLive, perftrace.FreshnessFresh, true)
460		}
461		return m
462	}
463

3669		if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(view); err != nil {
3670			state := m.viewLoad(view)
3671			m.applyViewResult(view, state.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
3672			return m, nil
3673		}
3674		if m.viewWaitsForRepos(view) {
3675			m.setViewStatus(view, "waiting for local repositories…")
3676			return m, nil
3677		}
3678		m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
3679		return m, m.reloadDependentView(view)
3680	}
3681	
3682	func (m Model) viewUsesRepos(view View) bool {
3683		switch view {
3684		case ViewFleet:
3685			return m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil
3686		case ViewSkills:
3687			return m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil
3688		case ViewMCP:
3689			return m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil
3690		default:
3691			return false
3692		}
3693	}
3694	
3695	func (m Model) viewWaitsForRepos(view View) bool {
3696		return m.viewUsesRepos(view) && m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).loading
3697	}
3698	
3699	func (m Model) dependentReposUnavailable(view View) error {
3700		if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
3701			return nil
3702		}
3703		repos := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
3704		if repos.loading || (repos.hasSnapshot && repos.freshness == perftrace.FreshnessFresh) {
3705			return nil
3706		}
3707		if err := m.viewError(ViewRepos); err != nil {
3708			return fmt.Errorf("local repository inventory: %w", err)
3709		}
3710		return errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
3711	}
3712	
3713	func dependentLoadingStatus(view View) string {
3714		switch view {
3715		case ViewFleet:
3716			return "loading configured dev hosts…"
3717		case ViewSkills:
3718			return "loading agent skills…"
3719		case ViewMCP:
3720			return "loading MCP declarations…"
3721		default:
3722			return "loading…"
3723		}
3724	}
3725	
3726	func (m Model) reloadDependentView(view View) tea.Cmd {
3727		switch view {
3728		case ViewFleet:
3729			return m.reloadFleet()
3730		case ViewSkills:
3731			return m.reloadSkills()
3732		case ViewMCP:
3733			return m.reloadMCP()
3734		default:
3735			return nil
3736		}
3737	}
3738	
3739	func (m *Model) afterReposResult(valid bool, err error) tea.Cmd {
3740		fresh := valid && err == nil
3741		var commands []tea.Cmd
3742		for _, view := range []View{ViewFleet, ViewSkills, ViewMCP} {
3743			if !m.viewUsesRepos(view) {
3744				continue
3745			}
3746			state := m.viewLoad(view)
3747			if state.loading || m.view == view {
3748				m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
3749				if fresh {
3750					m.setViewStatus(view, dependentLoadingStatus(view))
3751					commands = append(commands, m.reloadDependentView(view))
3752					continue
3753				}
3754				dependencyErr := err
3755				if dependencyErr == nil {
3756					dependencyErr = errors.New("local repository inventory is unavailable")
3757				}
3758				current := m.viewLoad(view)
3759				m.applyViewResult(view, current.generation, false, "", "", 0, dependencyErr, false)
3760				continue
3761			}
3762			if state.hasSnapshot {
3763				m.invalidateView(view)
3764			}
3765		}
3766		return batchCommands(commands...)
3767	}
3768	
3769	// afterViewSwitch lazily loads optional inventories only when their view is
3770	// first opened, so starting the dashboard never waits on the network, a forge
3771	// CLI, or Node tooling.
3772	func (m Model) afterViewSwitch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
3773		m.setAt(m.at())
3774		switch m.view {
3775		case ViewFleet:
3776			if m.viewNeedsLoad(ViewFleet) {
3777				m.beginViewLoad(ViewFleet, loadVisit)
3778				if err := m.dependentReposUnavailable(ViewFleet); err != nil {
3779					fleet := m.viewLoad(ViewFleet)
3780					m.applyViewResult(ViewFleet, fleet.generation, false, "", "", 0, err, false)
3781					return m, nil
3782				}
3783				if m.viewWaitsForRepos(ViewFleet) {
3784					m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "waiting for local repositories…")
3785					return m, nil
3786				}
3787				m.setViewStatus(ViewFleet, "loading configured dev hosts…")
3788				return m, m.reloadFleet()
3789			}

505	func (m Model) promptSelectedSkillUpdate() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
506		if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading {

526			m.err = err
527			return m, nil
528		}
529		if m.actions.EditFile == nil {

534		if err != nil {
535			m.err = err
536			return m, nil
537		}
538		if edit.Command == nil {
539			m.err = fmt.Errorf("capability editor returned no process")
540			return m, nil
541		}
542		view := m.view
543		m.status = "editing " + config.Contract(path) + "…"
544		return m, tea.ExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
545			if edit.Complete != nil {
546				runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
547			}
548			return afterExec(capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: view, err: runErr})
549		})
550	}

560			tryAction = TryMark
561		case listActionTryDeprecate:
562			tryAction = TryDeprecate
563		case listActionTryReactivate:
564			tryAction = TryReactivate
565		case listActionTryArchive:

567		case listActionTryRestore:

569		case listActionTryGraduate:
570			tryAction = TryGraduate
571		}

574			return m.openTryForm(tryAction, row)
575		case TryArchive:
576			return m.openTryConfirmation(tryAction, row)
577		case TryDeprecate, TryReactivate:
578			m.status = string(tryAction) + " in progress…"
579			return m, m.applyTry(TryRequest{Action: tryAction, ID: row.Item.ID})
580		default:
581			return m, nil
582		}
583	}

117		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
118			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
119				return m, nil
120			}
121			delta := 1
122			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
123				delta = -1
124			}
125			m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + delta + m.overlay.optionCount) % m.overlay.optionCount
126			return m, nil
127		}
128		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		first := m.buildActionMenuLayout().firstOptionY
132		if event.Y < first || event.Y >= first+m.overlay.optionCount {
133			m.overlay = overlayState{}
134			return m, nil
135		}
136		m.overlay.optionIndex = event.Y - first
137		return m.runOverlayAction()

154	// buildHeaderLayout renders the tab strip and records the exact cell spans it

156	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
157		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
158			short := map[View]string{
159				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
160				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
161			}
162			var builder strings.Builder
163			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
164			builder.WriteString(prefix)
165			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
166			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
167			for index, view := range Views {
168				if index > 0 {
169					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
170					builder.WriteString(separator)
171					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
172				}
173				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
174				if compact {
175					name = short[view]
176				}
177				label := name
178				if !compact {
179					label = " " + name + " "
180				}
181				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
182				if view == m.view {
183					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
184				}
185				from := x
186				builder.WriteString(rendered)
187				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
188				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
189			}
190			if summary {
191				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
192			}
193			if m.filter != "" {
194				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
195			}
196			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
197		}
198	
199		layout := build(false, true)
200		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
201			layout = build(false, false)
202		}
203		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
204			layout = build(true, false)
205		}
206		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
207			return layout
208		}
209

219			if available > 1 {

231	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
232	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
233		h := m.listHeight()
234		if n <= h {

236		}
237		from = m.at() - h/2
238		if from < 0 {
239			from = 0
240		}
241		if from+h > n {
242			from = n - h
243		}
244		return from, from + h

1	// Package agenttarget resolves the repository checkouts inspected by agent
2	// configuration inventories. It deliberately contains no skill, MCP, or UI
3	// policy so those domains can share one definition of a target.
4	package agenttarget
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
18	)
19	
20	// Target identifies one concrete checkout of one repository. RepoPath is the
21	// repository's main navigation path (which may be a configured symlink alias),
22	// while CheckoutRoot is the exact worktree to inspect. Linked worktrees share
23	// RepoPath and CommonDir but remain distinct targets through CheckoutRoot.
24	type Target struct {
25		RepoName     string `json:"repo_name"`
26		RepoDisplay  string `json:"repo_display"`
27		RepoPath     string `json:"repo_path"`
28		CheckoutRoot string `json:"checkout_root"`
29		CommonDir    string `json:"common_dir"`
30	}
31	
32	// Key is stable for one checkout of one clone. It is intentionally stricter
33	// than gitx.Repo.Key, which identifies the clone regardless of checkout.
34	func (t Target) Key() string {
35		return comparablePath(t.CommonDir) + "\x00" + comparablePath(t.CheckoutRoot)
36	}
37	
38	// Current resolves the checkout containing cwd. A linked worktree remains the
39	// target checkout; outside Git, the absolute directory remains a useful project
40	// scope for agents that support configuration in ordinary folders.
41	func Current(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (Target, error) {
42		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, cwd)
43		if err == nil {
44			return target, nil
45		}
46		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
47			return Target{}, ctxErr
48		}
49		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
50			return Target{}, err
51		}
52		root, pathErr := absoluteDirectory(cwd)
53		if pathErr != nil {
54			return Target{}, pathErr
55		}
56		name := filepath.Base(root)
57		return Target{
58			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: root,
59			CheckoutRoot: root, CommonDir: root,
60		}, nil
61	}
62	
63	// ResolvePath resolves an explicit path to the checkout containing it.
64	func ResolvePath(ctx context.Context, value string) (Target, error) {
65		absolute, err := absoluteDirectory(value)
66		if err != nil {
67			return Target{}, err
68		}
69		found, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
70		if err != nil {
71			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
72		}
73		return fromGit(found)
74	}
75	
76	// ResolveRepository resolves an explicit repository reference using repo's
77	// normal name/path rules, then probes the selected path so an explicit linked
78	// worktree path is preserved.
79	func ResolveRepository(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
80		found, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, roots, ref)
81		if err != nil {
82			return Target{}, err
83		}
84		target, err := ResolvePath(ctx, found.Path)
85		if err != nil {
86			return Target{}, err
87		}
88		// A named canonical repository contributes its configured alias/category.
89		// An explicit linked-worktree path keeps the main repository identity from
90		// Git, but its checkout root remains the navigation path the caller selected.
91		switch {
92		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.RepoPath):
93			if found.Name != "" {
94				target.RepoName = found.Name
95			}
96			if display := found.Display(); display != "" {
97				target.RepoDisplay = display
98			}
99			target.RepoPath = navigationPath(found.Path)
100			target.CheckoutRoot = target.RepoPath
101		case comparablePath(found.Path) == comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot):
102			target.CheckoutRoot = navigationPath(found.Path)
103		}
104		return target, nil
105	}
106	
107	// ResolveRepo is a concise compatibility name for ResolveRepository.
108	func ResolveRepo(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Target, error) {
109		return ResolveRepository(ctx, roots, ref)
110	}
111	
112	// FromRepository converts one canonical repo discovery result without another
113	// filesystem walk or Git process. Bare and non-Git inventory entries have no
114	// checkout to inspect and are skipped.
115	func FromRepository(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) {
116		if !found.HasGit || found.Bare {
117			return Target{}, false
118		}
119		checkout := firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath)
120		commonDir := found.CommonDir
121		if checkout == "" || commonDir == "" {
122			return Target{}, false
123		}
124		// Preserve the first discovery root's navigation alias. CommonDir remains
125		// physical identity, so aliases still deduplicate correctly.
126		checkout = navigationPath(checkout)
127		repository := navigationPath(firstNonEmpty(found.Path, found.MainRoot, found.RealPath, checkout))
128		commonDir = canonicalPath(commonDir)
129		name := found.Name
130		if name == "" {
131			name = filepath.Base(repository)
132		}
133		display := found.Display()
134		if display == "" {
135			display = name
136		}
137		return Target{
138			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: display, RepoPath: repository,
139			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
140		}, true
141	}
142	
143	// FromRepo is a concise compatibility name for FromRepository.
144	func FromRepo(found repo.Repo) (Target, bool) { return FromRepository(found) }
145	
146	// FromRepositories converts an already-discovered repository inventory. This is
147	// the --all-style path: callers can reuse repo.Discover output and avoid a
148	// second walk. Bare and non-Git entries are omitted.
149	func FromRepositories(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target {
150		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(repositories))
151		for _, found := range repositories {
152			if target, ok := FromRepository(found); ok {
153				targets = append(targets, target)
154			}
155		}
156		return Dedupe(targets)
157	}
158	
159	// FromRepos is a concise compatibility name for FromRepositories.
160	func FromRepos(repositories []repo.Repo) []Target { return FromRepositories(repositories) }

162	// WithCurrent appends the startup checkout when it is distinct from the
163	// canonical repository inventory, then returns the same deterministic order as
164	// other target builders.
165	func WithCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) []Target {
166		out := append([]Target(nil), targets...)
167		if current.CheckoutRoot != "" {
168			current = ReconcileCurrent(targets, current)
169			out = append(out, current)
170		}
171		return Dedupe(out)
172	}
173	
174	// ReconcileCurrent preserves the exact current checkout while applying the
175	// canonical repository's configured navigation identity when it is known.
176	func ReconcileCurrent(targets []Target, current Target) Target {
177		for _, target := range targets {
178			if comparablePath(target.CommonDir) == comparablePath(current.CommonDir) {
179				current.RepoName = target.RepoName
180				current.RepoDisplay = target.RepoDisplay
181				current.RepoPath = target.RepoPath
182				if comparablePath(target.CheckoutRoot) == comparablePath(current.CheckoutRoot) {
183					current.CheckoutRoot = target.CheckoutRoot
184				}
185				break
186			}
187		}
188		return current
189	}
190	
191	// All discovers configured repository roots once and converts the result to
192	// concrete main-checkout targets.
193	func All(ctx context.Context, roots []string) ([]Target, error) {
194		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, roots, repo.DefaultOptions())
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		return FromRepositories(repositories), nil
199	}
200	
201	// Dedupe returns one deterministic entry per common-directory plus checkout
202	// root. The first value supplies display metadata when aliases collide.
203	func Dedupe(targets []Target) []Target {
204		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
205		out := make([]Target, 0, len(targets))
206		for _, target := range targets {
207			key := target.Key()
208			if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
209				continue
210			}
211			seen[key] = struct{}{}
212			out = append(out, target)
213		}
214		Sort(out)
215		return out
216	}
217	
218	// Sort orders targets by display name, repository, checkout, then common dir.
219	func Sort(targets []Target) {
220		sort.SliceStable(targets, func(i, j int) bool {
221			left, right := targets[i], targets[j]
222			leftDisplay, rightDisplay := strings.ToLower(left.RepoDisplay), strings.ToLower(right.RepoDisplay)
223			if leftDisplay != rightDisplay {
224				return leftDisplay < rightDisplay
225			}
226			if left.RepoDisplay != right.RepoDisplay {
227				return left.RepoDisplay < right.RepoDisplay
228			}
229			if left.RepoName != right.RepoName {
230				return left.RepoName < right.RepoName
231			}
232			if left.RepoPath != right.RepoPath {
233				return left.RepoPath < right.RepoPath
234			}
235			if left.CheckoutRoot != right.CheckoutRoot {
236				return left.CheckoutRoot < right.CheckoutRoot
237			}
238			return left.CommonDir < right.CommonDir
239		})
240	}
241	
242	func fromGit(found gitx.Repo) (Target, error) {
243		if found.Bare || found.Root == "" {
244			return Target{}, errors.New("repository has no working checkout")
245		}
246		repository := canonicalPath(found.MainRoot)
247		checkout := canonicalPath(found.Root)
248		commonDir := canonicalPath(found.GitCommonDir)
249		name := found.Name
250		if name == "" {
251			name = filepath.Base(repository)
252		}
253		return Target{
254			RepoName: name, RepoDisplay: name, RepoPath: repository,
255			CheckoutRoot: checkout, CommonDir: commonDir,
256		}, nil
257	}
258	
259	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
260		for _, value := range values {
261			if value != "" {
262				return value
263			}
264		}
265		return ""
266	}
267	
268	func absoluteDirectory(value string) (string, error) {
269		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
270		if err != nil {
271			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target path %q: %w", value, err)
272		}
273		if info, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil && !info.IsDir() {
274			absolute = filepath.Dir(absolute)
275		}
276		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
277	}
278	
279	func navigationPath(value string) string {
280		if value == "" {
281			return ""
282		}
283		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
284		if err == nil {
285			value = absolute
286		}
287		return filepath.Clean(value)
288	}
289	
290	func canonicalPath(value string) string {
291		if value == "" {
292			return ""
293		}
294		if resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(value); err == nil {
295			return resolved
296		}
297		return navigationPath(value)
298	}
299	
300	func comparablePath(value string) string {
301		return canonicalPath(value)
302	}
303
```

+func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
+	logical := filepath.Clean(path)
+	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(logical)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	source, observed, err := safefile.OpenRegular(resolved)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	original, readErr := safefile.ReadAll(context.Background(), source, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+	closeErr := source.Close()
+	if readErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)
+	}
+	if closeErr != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("close capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), closeErr)
+	}
+
+	working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	workingPath := working.Name()
+	cleanup := true
+	defer func() {
+		if cleanup {
+			_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+		}
+	}()
+	if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	cleanup = false
+
+	return tui.CapabilityEdit{
+		Command: process,
+		Complete: func(runErr error) error {
+			if runErr != nil {
+				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+				return runErr
+			}
+			edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if bytes.Equal(edited, original) {
+				return os.Remove(workingPath)
+			}
+			root, err := os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			defer root.Close()
+			if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
+				context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
+			); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			return os.Remove(workingPath)
+		},
+	}, nil
+}

 ## [Unreleased]
 
+### Added
+
+- The dashboard now supports cell-motion mouse input: left-click selects rows or
+  switches visible tabs, the wheel moves three rows, and right-click opens the
+  selected row's existing actions without making a click implicitly open it.
+- SKILLS and MCP share a session-only `A` context/all scope toggle and can open
+  the selected local configuration in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` or copy its path,
+  sanitized summary, and explicitly requested raw file. Raw file copy is bounded
+  to 1 MiB but may put credentials and other declarations into the system
+  clipboard. A configured `A` tool remains available on other views; capability
+  views give the scope toggle precedence.
+
+### Changed
+
+- MCP caps its content-responsive `SERVER` column at 32 cells, keeping transport,
+  state, and source columns together instead of pushing them to the far edge of a
+  wide terminal.
+
 ## [0.2.12] - 2026-09-04

128			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), readErr)

146			_ = working.Close()

150			_ = working.Close()
151			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
152		}
153		if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
154			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err

191	// ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
192	// Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
193	func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
194		info, err := os.Stat(path)
195		switch {
196		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
197			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
198		case err == nil:
199			return false, nil
200		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
201			return false, err
202		}
203		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
204			return false, err
205		}
206		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
207		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
208			return false, err
209		}
210		return true, nil
211	}

23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

12	)
13	
14	func fleetEditorCommand(editor, path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
15		arguments, err := windows.DecomposeCommandLine(editor)
16		if err != nil {
17			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse Windows editor command: %w", err)
18		}
19		if len(arguments) == 0 || arguments[0] == "" {
20			return nil, errors.New("Windows editor command is empty")
21		}
22		return exec.Command(arguments[0], append(arguments[1:], path)...), nil
23	}
24	
25	// replaceProcessWithShell starts an interactive shell in the current working
26	// directory. Windows has no exec(2), so dev runs the shell as a child that
27	// inherits the console and then exits with the shell's status when it returns.
28	func replaceProcessWithShell() error {
29		shell := os.Getenv("COMSPEC")
30		if shell == "" {
31			shell = "cmd.exe"
32		}
33		cmd := exec.Command(shell)
34		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
35		err := cmd.Run()
36		var exit *exec.ExitError
37		if errors.As(err, &exit) {
38			os.Exit(exit.ExitCode())
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return err
42		}
43		os.Exit(0)
44		return nil
45	}
46

194	// IdentityKey identifies one declaration at one normalized source location.
195	// Runtime state and sanitized payload fields are intentionally excluded so a
196	// refresh can update them without making the row look like a different source.
197	func (d Declaration) IdentityKey() string {
198		return strings.Join([]string{
199			string(d.Agent), string(d.Scope), d.Repository, d.RepositoryPath, d.Checkout,
200			d.LocalProjectPath, d.ConfigPath, string(d.Source), d.Plugin, d.Name,
201		}, "\x00")
202	}
203	
204	// Target is shared with native skill inventory so repository and linked-
205	// checkout identity cannot drift between the two domains.
206	type Target = agenttarget.Target
207

209	// metadata, not a claim about which agents are installed on the host.

1	// Package safefile provides bounded reads that reject non-regular files
2	// without blocking on repository-controlled FIFOs.
3	package safefile
4	
5	import (
6		"bytes"
7		"context"
8		"errors"
9		"io"
10		"os"
11	)
12	
13	var (
14		ErrNotRegular = errors.New("file is not regular")
15		ErrTooLarge   = errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
16	)
17	
18	// OpenRegular opens path without blocking on Unix special files and verifies
19	// the opened descriptor rather than trusting a path-level stat.
20	func OpenRegular(path string) (*os.File, os.FileInfo, error) {
21		file, err := openReadOnly(path)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, nil, err
24		}
25		info, err := file.Stat()
26		if err != nil {
27			_ = file.Close()
28			return nil, nil, err
29		}
30		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
31			_ = file.Close()
32			return nil, nil, ErrNotRegular
33		}
34		return file, info, nil
35	}
36	
37	// ReadAll reads at most max bytes from an already verified descriptor.
38	func ReadAll(ctx context.Context, file *os.File, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
39		if ctx == nil {
40			ctx = context.Background()
41		}
42		var body bytes.Buffer
43		chunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
44		for {
45			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
46				return nil, err
47			}
48			n, readErr := file.Read(chunk)
49			if n > 0 {
50				if int64(body.Len()+n) > max {
51					return nil, ErrTooLarge
52				}
53				_, _ = body.Write(chunk[:n])
54			}
55			if readErr != nil {
56				if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
57					return body.Bytes(), nil
58				}
59				return nil, readErr
60			}
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// ReadRegular opens and reads a regular file under a hard byte bound.
65	func ReadRegular(ctx context.Context, path string, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
66		file, info, err := OpenRegular(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		defer file.Close()
71		if info.Size() > max {
72			return nil, ErrTooLarge
73		}
74		return ReadAll(ctx, file, max)
75	}
76

119	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
120	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
121	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
122	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
123	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
124	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
125	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
126	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
127		if root == nil {
128			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
129		}
130		if observed == nil {
131			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
132		}
133		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
140		if err != nil {
141			return nil, err
142		}
143		defer func() {
144			if stagedName != "" {
145				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
146			}
147		}()
148		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
152			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
153		}
154		stagedName = ""
155		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
158		}
159		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
160			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
161		}
162		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
163			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
164		}
165		return published, nil
166	}
167	
168	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
169	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
170		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
172		}
173		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
174	}
175	
176	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
177		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
178		if err != nil {
179			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
180		}
181		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
182			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
183		}
184		return nil
185	}
186	
187	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
188		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
189			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
190		}
191		var name string
192		var writer *os.File
193		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
194			candidate, err := randomStageName()
195			if err != nil {
196				return "", nil, err
197			}
198			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
199			if err == nil {
200				name = candidate
201				break
202			}
203			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
204				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
205			}
206		}
207		if writer == nil {
208			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
209		}
```

14	func fleetEditorCommand(editor, path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
15		arguments, err := windows.DecomposeCommandLine(editor)
16		if err != nil {
17			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse Windows editor command: %w", err)
18		}
19		if len(arguments) == 0 || arguments[0] == "" {
20			return nil, errors.New("Windows editor command is empty")
21		}
22		return exec.Command(arguments[0], append(arguments[1:], path)...), nil
23	}
24	
25	// replaceProcessWithShell starts an interactive shell in the current working
26	// directory. Windows has no exec(2), so dev runs the shell as a child that
27	// inherits the console and then exits with the shell's status when it returns.
28	func replaceProcessWithShell() error {
29		shell := os.Getenv("COMSPEC")
30		if shell == "" {
31			shell = "cmd.exe"
32		}
33		cmd := exec.Command(shell)
34		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
35		err := cmd.Run()
36		var exit *exec.ExitError
37		if errors.As(err, &exit) {
38			os.Exit(exit.ExitCode())
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return err
42		}
43		os.Exit(0)
44		return nil
45	}

+func TestMCPWideLayoutCapsServerColumn(t *testing.T) {
+	rows := []agentmcp.Declaration{
+		{Name: strings.Repeat("server", 10), Agent: agentmcp.AgentClaudeCode, Scope: agentmcp.ScopeProject, Transport: agentmcp.TransportStdio},
+	}
+	actions := newActions(&recorder{}, nil)
+	actions.ReloadMCP = func(context.Context, tui.CapabilityScope) ([]agentmcp.Declaration, error) {
+		return rows, nil
+	}
+	m := tui.New(actions, nil, nil)
+	m = send(m, tea.WindowSizeMsg{Width: 200, Height: 30})
+	m = send(m, key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"), key("tab"))
+
+	var header string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			header = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if header == "" {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP header missing:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(m.View(), rows[0].Name) {
+		t.Fatalf("MCP detail omitted the full server name:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if got := lipgloss.Width(header); got != 126 {
+		t.Fatalf("wide MCP header width = %d, want 126 with a 32-cell SERVER cap:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+	if got := strings.Index(header, "TRANSPORT"); got > 82 {
+		t.Fatalf("TRANSPORT starts at cell %d; SERVER still absorbed wide-screen padding:\n%s", got, header)
+	}
+
+	m = send(m, key("/"))
+	for _, msg := range typeText("server") {
+		m = send(m, msg)
+	}
+	m = send(m, key("enter"))
+	var filteredHeader string
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(m.View(), "\n") {
+		if strings.Contains(line, "SERVER") && strings.Contains(line, "TRANSPORT") {
+			filteredHeader = line
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if lipgloss.Width(filteredHeader) != lipgloss.Width(header) {
+		t.Fatalf("filter shifted MCP columns:\nbefore: %s\nafter:  %s", header, filteredHeader)
+	}
+}

12	func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {
13		if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
14			return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
17			return row.Lock.File, nil
18		}
19		return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}
34	
35	func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
36		lines := []string{
37			"name: " + row.Name,
38			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
39		}
40		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
51	}
52	
53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
54		lines := []string{
55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}
59		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
60		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
61		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
62		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
63		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
64		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
65		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
66		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
67		if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
69		}
70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
73			for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
74				value := string(credential.Kind)
75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
84			for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
85				redactions[i] = string(redaction)
86			}
87			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
88		}
89		if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
90			coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
91			for i, item := range row.Coverage {
92				coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
93			}
94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}
98	
99	func (m Model) copyBindingHelp() string {
100		if m.view == ViewRepos {
101			return "y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths"
102		}
103		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
104		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil {
105			parts = append(parts, "p file path")
106		}
107		parts = append(parts, "s safe summary")
108		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok && row.SourceURL != "" {
109			parts = append(parts, "u source URL")
110		}
111		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil && m.actions.ReadFile != nil {
112			parts = append(parts, "f raw file")
113		}
114		return strings.Join(parts, " · ")
115	}
116	
117	func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {
118		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
119			return lines
120		}
121		return append(lines, label+": "+value)
122	}

194	// IdentityKey identifies one declaration at one normalized source location.
195	// Runtime state and sanitized payload fields are intentionally excluded so a
196	// refresh can update them without making the row look like a different source.
197	func (d Declaration) IdentityKey() string {
198		return strings.Join([]string{
199			string(d.Agent), string(d.Scope), d.Repository, d.RepositoryPath, d.Checkout,
200			d.LocalProjectPath, d.ConfigPath, string(d.Source), d.Plugin, d.Name,
201		}, "\x00")
202	}
203	
204	// Target is shared with native skill inventory so repository and linked-
205	// checkout identity cannot drift between the two domains.
206	type Target = agenttarget.Target
207	
208	// Coverage states the fixed limits of this static inventory. It is product
209	// metadata, not a claim about which agents are installed on the host.
210	type Coverage struct {
211		Agents                 []Agent  `json:"agents"`
212		StaticDeclarationsOnly bool     `json:"static_declarations_only"`
213		OmittedSources         []string `json:"omitted_sources"`
214	}

217	type Result struct {

219		Diagnostics  []Diagnostic  `json:"diagnostics"`

221	}

225			Agents:                 []Agent{AgentClaudeCode, AgentCodex, AgentCursor, AgentGeminiCLI, AgentOpenCode},
226			StaticDeclarationsOnly: true,
227			OmittedSources: []string{

231				"inline OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT",

233		}
234	}
