346	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
347		r := item.Repo
348		checkout, child := item.checkout()
349		if !child {
350			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
351				marker := "▸ "
352				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
353					marker = "▾ "
354				}
355				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
356			}
357			if name == "live" {
358				return parentLiveColumn(r)
359			}
360			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
361		}
362	
363		switch name {
364		case "repo":
365			connector := "├─ "
366			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
367				connector = "└─ "
368			}
369			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
370			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
371				label = checkout.Branch()
372			}
373			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
374				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
375			}
376			return connector + label
377		case "branch":
378			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
379				return branch
380			}
381			return "(detached)"
382		case "git":
383			switch {
384			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
385				return "prunable"
386			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
387				return "locked"
388			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
389				return "?"
390			default:
391				return checkout.Status.Summary()
392			}
393		case "live":
394			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
395		case "latest":
396			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
397		case "worktrees":
398			return "—"
399		case "tasks":
400			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
401				return "?"
402			}
403			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
404		case "notes":
405			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
406				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
407			}
408			return "—"
409		case "category":
410			return "—"
411		case "path":
412			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413		}
414		return ""
415	}
416	
417	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
418		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
419			return "?"
420		}
421		sessions := r.Sessions()
422		if len(sessions) == 0 {
423			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
424		}
425		if len(sessions) > 1 {
426			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
427		}
428		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
429		if status != "" {
430			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
431		}
432		return r.Runtime
433	}
434	
435	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
436		if runtimeErr != nil {
437			return "?"
438		}
439		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
440			return "closed"
441		}
442		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
443			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
444		}
445		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
446			return runtimeName + ":" + status
447		}
448		return runtimeName
449	}
450	
451	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
452		if len(tasks) == 0 {
453			return "—"
454		}
455		counts := map[task.State]int{}
456		for _, t := range tasks {
457			counts[t.State]++
458		}
459		var parts []string
460		for _, state := range task.States {
461			if counts[state] > 0 {
462				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
463			}
464		}
465		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
466	}
467	
468	type repoColumnSpec struct {
469		name, header string
470		width, min   int
471	}
472	
473	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
474		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
475		if len(names) == 0 {
476			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
477		}
478		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
479			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
480			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
481			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
482			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
483			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
484			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
485			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
486			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
487			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
488			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
489			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
490			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
491		}
492		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
493		for _, name := range names {
494			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
495				columns = append(columns, c)
496			}
497		}
498		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
499		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
500		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
501		for _, c := range columns {
502			total += c.width
503		}
504		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
505			for i := range columns {
506				if columns[i].name != preferred {
507					continue
508				}
509				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
510				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
511				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
512				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
513					columns[i].width--
514					total--
515				}
516			}
517			if total <= m.width {
518				break
519			}
520		}
521		return columns
522	}
523	
524	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
525		switch name {
526		case "repo":
527			return r.Repo.Display()
528		case "branch":
529			if r.Repo.Bare {
530				return "(bare)"
531			}
532			return r.Status.Branch
533		case "git":
534			if r.Repo.Bare {
535				return "—"
536			}
537			return r.Status.Summary()
538		case "remote":
539			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
540				return "?"
541			}
542			return r.Topology.Summary()
543		case "size":
544			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
545		case "live":
546			if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
547				return "?"
548			}
549			if !r.Live {
550				return "—"
551			}
552			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
553				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
554			}
555			return r.Runtime
556		case "latest":
557			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
558		case "worktrees":
559			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
560				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
561			}
562			return "—"
563		case "tasks":
564			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
565				return "?"
566			}
567			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
568				return tasks
569			}
570			return "—"
571		case "notes":
572			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
573				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
574			}
575			return "—"
576		case "category":
577			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
578				return r.Repo.Category
579			}
580			return "—"
581		case "path":
582			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
583		}
584		return ""
585	}
586	
587	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
588		if at.IsZero() {
589			return "—"
590		}
591		d := time.Since(at)
592		switch {
593		case d < time.Hour:
594			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
595		case d < 24*time.Hour:
596			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
597		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
598			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
599		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
600			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
601		default:
602			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
603		}
604	}
605	
606	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
607		s = pad(s, width)
608		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
609			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
610		}
611		return s
612	}

614	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
615		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
616			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
617		}
618		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
619		if len(rows) == 0 {
620			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
621				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
622			}
623			if m.filter != "" {
624				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
625			}
626			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
627		}
628		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
629		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
630		if descW < 12 {
631			descW = 12
632		}
633	
634		var b strings.Builder
635		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
636			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
637		}
638		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
639			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
640		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
641		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
642			r := rows[i]
643			pending := m.remoteCloneTargets(r)
644			local := "—"
645			if pending {
646				local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " repo"
647				if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRunning {
648					local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " clone"
649				}
650			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
651				local = "inspect"
652			} else if r.Cloned() {
653				local = "yes"
654				if r.LocalKind != "" {
655					local = string(r.LocalKind)
656					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
657						local = "repo"
658					}
659				}
660			}
661			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
662			if vis == "" {
663				vis = "—"
664			}
665			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
666				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
667				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
668			styled := line
669			if r.Cloned() || pending {
670				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
671			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
672				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
673			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
674				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
675			}
676			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
677		}
678		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
679		return b.String()
680	}

682	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
683		rows := m.visibleFleet()
684		if len(rows) == 0 {
685			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
686				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
687			}
688			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
689				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
690			}
691			if !m.showLocalFleet {
692				for _, row := range m.fleet {
693					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
694						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
695					}
696				}
697			}
698			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
699		}
700		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
701		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
702		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
703		if pathW < 12 {
704			pathW = 12
705		}
706		var b strings.Builder
707		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
708			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
709		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
710		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
711			row := rows[i]
712			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
713			if row.Repository != nil {
714				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
715				if row.Repository.Live {
716					live = row.Repository.Runtime
717					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
718						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
719					}
720				}
721				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
722			}
723			state := string(row.State)
724			if row.FromCache {
725				state = "stale"
726			}
727			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
728				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
729				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
730			styled := line
731			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
732				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
733			} else if row.State != "ok" {
734				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
735			}
736			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
737		}
738		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
739		return b.String()
740	}
741	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {
742		state := m.viewLoad(ViewSkills)
743		rows := m.visibleSkills()
744		if state.loading && len(m.skills) == 0 {
745			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading agent skills…") + "\n"
746		}
747		if len(rows) == 0 {
748			if !state.hasSnapshot {
749				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Agent skills load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
750			}
751			if m.filter != "" {
752				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
753			}
754			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skills found. Press a to open the installer.") + "\n"
755		}
756	
757		var headers []string
758		var values func(agentskill.Skill) []string
759		switch {
760		case m.width >= 110:
761			repoW, scopeW, skillW, installW, updateW, agentW := 16, 7, 20, 9, 10, 20
762			sourceW := max(12, m.width-96)
763			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW), fitCell("SOURCE", sourceW)}
764			values = func(row agentskill.Skill) []string {
765				return []string{fitCell(dashCell(row.Repository), repoW), fitCell(string(row.Scope), scopeW), fitCell(row.Name, skillW), fitCell(skillInstallState(row), installW), fitCell(skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus), updateW), fitCell(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW), fitCell(skillSource(row), sourceW)}

913	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
914		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
915		for _, policy := range row.Policies {
916			part := string(policy.Kind)
917			if policy.Value != "" {
918				part += ":" + policy.Value
919			}
920			if policy.Count > 0 {
921				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
922			}
923			parts = append(parts, part)
924		}
925		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
926	}
927	
928	func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration, maxWidth int) string {
929		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
930		for index, credential := range row.Credentials {
931			part := string(credential.Kind)
932			if credential.Name != "" {
933				part += ":" + credential.Name
934			}
935			candidate := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), parts...), part), ", ")
936			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > maxWidth {
937				remaining := len(row.Credentials) - index
938				if len(parts) == 0 {
939					if remaining == 1 {
940						return pad(part, maxWidth)
941					}
942					return pad(fmt.Sprintf("%s, +%d", part, remaining-1), maxWidth)
943				}
944				return pad(strings.Join(parts, ", ")+fmt.Sprintf(", +%d", remaining), maxWidth)
945			}
946			parts = append(parts, part)
947		}
948		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
949	}

951	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
952		var parts []string
953		for _, item := range []struct {
954			label string
955			n     int
956		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
957			if item.n > 0 {
958				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
959			}
960		}
961		if len(parts) == 0 {
962			return "—"
963		}
964		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
965	}

999	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
1000		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
1001			return "—"
1002		}
1003		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
1004		switch {
1005		case d < 24*time.Hour:
1006			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
1007		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
1008			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
1009		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
1010			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1011		default:
1012			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1013		}
1014	}

1043	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
1044		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
1045		if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
1046			fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
1047		}
1048		avail := m.width - fixed
1049		if avail < 40 {
1050			avail = 40
1051		}
1052		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1053		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1054		next = avail - name - branch
1055		if next < 10 {
1056			next = 10
1057		}
1058		return name, branch, next
1059	}

1467	func (m Model) renderFooter() string {
1468		viewErr, viewStatus := m.viewError(m.view), m.viewStatus(m.view)
1469		var status string
1470		switch {
1471		case m.err != nil:
1472			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + m.err.Error())
1473		case m.remoteClone.active():
1474			status = styleLive.Render(m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " " + m.remoteCloneStatus())
1475		case viewErr != nil:
1476			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + viewErr.Error())
1477		case m.status != "":
1478			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + m.status)
1479		case viewStatus != "":
1480			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + viewStatus)
1481		}
1482	
1483		var bindings []string
1484		if m.remoteClone.active() {
1485			bindings = []string{"q cancel clone", "tab view", "/ filter", "j/k move"}
1486			var b strings.Builder
1487			if status != "" {
1488				b.WriteString("  " + status + "\n")
1489			}
1490			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render(wrapBindings(bindings, m.width-4)))
1491			return b.String()
1492		}
1493		switch m.view {
1494		case ViewRepos:
1495			sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1496			if sortBy == "" {
1497				sortBy = "activity"
1498			}
1499			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1500				sortBy += "↑"
1501			}
1502			if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
1503				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open worktree", "space collapse")
1504			} else {
1505				bindings = append(bindings, "enter ad hoc", "space worktrees", "m metadata", "n add note", "N notes", "s worktree task", "d direct task")
1506			}
1507			bindings = append(bindings, "O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1508		case ViewFleet:
1509			if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil {
1510				bindings = append(bindings, "enter remote open")
1511			}
1512			local := "hidden"
1513			if m.showLocalFleet {
1514				local = "shown"
1515			}
1516			bindings = append(bindings, "a local:"+local, "r refresh")
1517		case ViewTries:
1518			sortBy := m.trySort
1519			if sortBy == "" {
1520				sortBy = "activity"
1521			}
1522			if m.tryReverse {
1523				sortBy += "↑"
1524			}
1525			bindings = append(bindings, "enter open", "n new", "space actions", "a history",
1526				"O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1527		case ViewRemote:
1528			if m.remoteClone.active() {
1529				bindings = append(bindings, "q cancel clone")
1530			} else if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
1531				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open local", "n add note", "N notes")
1532			} else if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
1533				bindings = append(bindings, "inspect local destination")
1534			} else {
1535				bindings = append(bindings, "c clone")
1536			}
1537		case ViewSkills:

1539		case ViewMCP:
1540			bindings = append(bindings, "A scope:"+m.capabilityScope.String(), "r reload declarations")
1541		default:
1542			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1543				if command := taskRecoveryCommand(row); command != "" {
1544					bindings = append(bindings, "recovery "+command)
1545				} else {
1546					bindings = append(bindings, "enter open")
1547				}
1548				bindings = append(bindings, "n add note", "N notes")
1549				if row.Task.State == task.Hot || row.Task.State == task.Warm {
1550					bindings = append(bindings, "p park")

1552				bindings = append(bindings, "c next")

1588		return b.String()

1591	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1592	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1593	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1594		if width < 20 {
1595			width = 20
1596		}
1597		var lines []string
1598		cur := ""
1599		for _, it := range items {
1600			candidate := it
1601			if cur != "" {
1602				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1603			}
1604			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1605				lines = append(lines, cur)
1606				cur = it
1607				continue
1608			}
1609			cur = candidate
1610		}
1611		if cur != "" {
1612			lines = append(lines, cur)
1613		}
1614		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1615	}

1634	func shortAge(r inventory.Row) string {
1635		d := r.Age()
1636		switch {
1637		case d <= 0:
1638			return "—"
1639		case d.Hours() < 24:
1640			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
1641		case d.Hours() < 24*14:
1642			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
1643		case d.Hours() < 24*60:
1644			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1645		default:
1646			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1647		}
1648	}

1650	func colourState(s task.State, line string) string {
1651		switch s {
1652		case task.Hot:
1653			return styleHot.Render(line)
1654		case task.Warm:
1655			return styleWarm.Render(line)
1656		case task.Cold:
1657			return styleCold.Render(line)
1658		case task.Done:
1659			return styleDone.Render(line)
1660		}
1661		return line
1662	}

1664	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1665	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1666	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1667		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1668			return s
1669		}
1670		var b strings.Builder
1671		used := 0
1672		for _, r := range s {
1673			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1674			if used+w > n-1 {
1675				break
1676			}
1677			b.WriteRune(r)
1678			used += w
1679		}
1680		return b.String() + "…"
1681	}
1682	
1683	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
1684		if v < lo {
1685			return lo
1686		}
1687		if v > hi {
1688			return hi
1689		}
1690		return v
1691	}

12	func (m Model) baseContext() context.Context {
13		if m.runContext != nil {
14			return m.runContext
15		}
16		return context.Background()
17	}
18	
19	func (m Model) viewContext(view View) context.Context {
20		if ctx := m.loadContexts[int(view)]; ctx != nil {
21			return ctx
22		}
23		return m.baseContext()
24	}
25	
26	func (m *Model) beginConfigLoad() uint64 {
27		if m.configCancel != nil {
28			m.configCancel()
29		}
30		m.configGeneration++
31		m.configContext, m.configCancel = context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
32		return m.configGeneration
33	}
34	
35	func (m Model) configReadContext() context.Context {
36		if m.configContext != nil {
37			return m.configContext
38		}
39		return m.baseContext()
40	}

42	type loadCause string
43	
44	const (
45		loadInitial loadCause = "initial"
46		loadVisit   loadCause = "visit"
47		loadRefresh loadCause = "refresh"
48		loadConfig  loadCause = "config"
49		loadAction  loadCause = "action"
50	)
51	
52	// viewLoadState is deliberately plain value state. Model is copied by Bubble
53	// Tea, so request state must not hide a mutable map or shared slice.
54	type viewLoadState struct {
55		generation  uint64
56		cause       loadCause
57		requested   bool
58		loading     bool
59		hasSnapshot bool
60		source      perftrace.Source
61		freshness   perftrace.Freshness
62		outcome     perftrace.Outcome
63		actionable  bool
64	}
65	
66	func (m *Model) prepareRepoDependentsForReload() {
67		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewFleet, m.actions.ReloadFleetWithRepos != nil)
68		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewSkills, m.actions.ReloadSkillsWithRepos != nil)
69		m.prepareRepoDependentForReload(ViewMCP, m.actions.ReloadMCPWithRepos != nil)
70	}
71	
72	func (m *Model) prepareRepoDependentForReload(view View, enabled bool) {
73		if !enabled {
74			return
75		}
76		state := m.viewLoad(view)
77		switch {
78		case state.loading || m.view == view:
79			m.beginViewLoad(view, loadRefresh)
80			m.setViewStatus(view, "waiting for local repositories…")
81		case state.hasSnapshot:
82			m.invalidateView(view)
83		}
84	}
85	
86	func (m *Model) beginViewLoad(view View, cause loadCause) uint64 {
87		if view == ViewRepos {
88			m.prepareRepoDependentsForReload()
89		}
90		index := int(view)
91		if cancel := m.loadCancels[index]; cancel != nil {
92			cancel()
93		}
94		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(m.baseContext())
95		m.loadContexts[index] = ctx
96		m.loadCancels[index] = cancel
97		if view == ViewRepos && m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRefreshing {
98			// A newer REPOS generation may supersede the clone-triggered refresh.
99			// Cancellation must always follow the generation that can complete it.
100			m.remoteClone.cancel = cancel
101		}
102		state := &m.loads[index]
103		state.generation++
104		state.cause = cause
105		state.requested = true
106		state.loading = true
107		state.outcome = ""
108		m.viewErrors[int(view)] = nil
109		m.viewStatuses[int(view)] = ""
110		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewLoadRequested, perftrace.Fields{
111			View: view.traceView(), Stage: perftrace.StageRequested, Generation: state.generation,
112		})
113		return state.generation
114	}

118			m.localCancel()
119		}

526:+URL (`u`), or whole raw file (`f`). Editors use a private working copy and
527-+guarded replacement; an externally changed source is not overwritten and the

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-09-04 07:16:47Z)**_

CONFIRMED — Cost: low; 8 current `tea.ExecProcess` call sites all manually wrap `afterExec`, so there is no current omission, but future call sites can silently omit mouse restoration. Quote: `return updated, batchCommands(command, tea.EnableMouseCellMotion)` is reached only through `afterExec(message)`, while callers repeat `return afterExec(...)`. A shared `execProcessWithMouse` helper would enforce this invariant centrally.

1330	// taskRecoveryCommand returns the explicit lifecycle command required before
1331	// a task can be navigated to. Generic TUI open remains navigation-only: it
1332	// must not reconcile task state, claim a writer, or enter an artifact shell
1333	// that Git no longer recognizes as a worktree.
1334	func taskRecoveryCommand(row inventory.Row) string {
1335		if row.Task == nil {
1336			return ""
1337		}
1338		if row.WorktreeMissing || !row.CheckoutExists {
1339			return "dev sweep"
1340		}
1341		if row.Task.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && row.Task.WorktreePath == "" {
1342			return "dev resume " + row.Task.ID
1343		}
1344		return ""
1345	}
1346	
1347	func taskOpenBlocker(row inventory.Row) error {
1348		command := taskRecoveryCommand(row)
1349		if command == "" {
1350			return nil
1351		}
1352		switch {
1353		case row.WorktreeMissing:
1354			return fmt.Errorf("%s has a missing or unregistered worktree — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1355		case !row.CheckoutExists:
1356			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no checkout on disk — run `%s` first", row.Task.Title(), command)
1357		default:
1358			return fmt.Errorf("%s has no managed worktree — run `%s` to rebuild it", row.Task.Title(), command)
1359		}
1360	}

1372	func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool {
1373		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
1374		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
1375			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
1376			if structured {
1377				switch key {
1378				case "scope":
1379					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(row.Scope)), value) {
1380						return false
1381					}

CONFIRMED — Trigger: edit a capability file carrying an ACL, xattr, custom owner/group, or another hard link. `AtomicReplace` creates a fresh file in the target directory, applies only `Mode().Perm()`, then Darwin `rename` removes the destination link and publishes the staging inode. The edited path therefore loses the original ACL/xattrs and inode/hard-link identity; ownership/group become those assigned to the newly created staging file rather than being copied. This matches `AtomicReplace`’s intended atomic-publication contract, but violates normal metadata-preserving edit expectations for externally owned capability files.

510	func (s *Scanner) scanSource(ctx context.Context, spec sourceSpec, targets []Target, readSource func(context.Context, sourceSpec) readResult) ([]Declaration, []Diagnostic) {
511		read := readSource(ctx, spec)
512		if !read.present {
513			if read.code == "" {
514				return nil, nil
515			}
516			diagnostics := []Diagnostic{diagnosticFor(spec, read.code)}
517			if spec.adapter == adapterClaudeUser && len(targets) > 0 {
518				localSpec := spec
519				localSpec.scope = ScopeLocal
520				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(localSpec, read.code))
521			}
522			return nil, diagnostics
523		}
524		var rows []Declaration
525		var codes []DiagnosticCode
526		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
527		switch spec.adapter {
528		case adapterClaudeProject:
529			rows, codes = parseClaudeProject(read.data, spec)
530			approvalState := claudeProjectApprovalState{enabled: map[string]bool{}, disabled: map[string]bool{}}
531			for _, approvalSpec := range spec.approvalSources {
532				approval := readSource(ctx, approvalSpec)
533				switch {
534				case approval.code != "":
535					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, approval.code))
536				case approval.present:
537					enabled, disabled, enableAll, code := parseClaudeProjectApproval(approval.data)
538					if code != "" {
539						diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(approvalSpec, code))
540					} else {
541						approvalState.merge(enabled, disabled, enableAll)
542					}
543				}
544			}
545			applyClaudeProjectApproval(rows, approvalState.enabled, approvalState.disabled, approvalState.enableAll)
546		case adapterClaudeUser:
547			var localDiagnostics []Diagnostic
548			rows, codes, localDiagnostics = parseClaudeUser(read.data, spec, targets)
549			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, localDiagnostics...)
550		case adapterCodex:
551			rows, codes = parseCodex(read.data, spec)
552		case adapterCursor:
553			rows, codes = parseCursor(read.data, spec)
554		case adapterGemini:
555			rows, codes = parseGemini(read.data, spec)
556		case adapterOpenCode:
557			rows, codes = parseOpenCode(read.data, spec)
558		case adapterOpenCodePlist:
559			rows, codes = parseOpenCodePlist(read.data, spec)
560		default:
561			codes = []DiagnosticCode{DiagnosticMalformed}
562		}
563		if diagnostics == nil {
564			diagnostics = make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(codes))
565		}
566		for _, code := range codes {
567			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnosticFor(spec, code))
568		}
569		return rows, diagnostics
570	}

CONFIRMED — Each non-empty MCP render performs an extra full scan of all declarations: `for _, row := range m.mcp { preferred = max(preferred, lipgloss.Width(row.Name)) }`. Cost is `O(N + total server-name display-width work)` per render, including rows excluded by `visibleMCP()` filtering; thus key, spinner, and mouse redraws repeat it. Caching the maximum when the MCP snapshot changes preserves semantics and makes width lookup `O(1)`.

167				return m, nil
168			case "j", "down":
169				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
170					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
171				}
172				return m, nil
173			case "k", "up":
174				if m.overlay.optionCount > 0 {
175					m.overlay.optionIndex = (m.overlay.optionIndex + m.overlay.optionCount - 1) % m.overlay.optionCount
176				}
177				return m, nil

179				return m.runOverlayAction()
180			}
181			return m, nil
182	
183		case overlayRepoForm, overlayTryForm, overlayTryConfirm:
184			switch message.String() {
185			case "esc":
186				m.overlay = overlayState{}
187				m.err = nil
188				return m, nil
189			case "tab", "down":
190				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex + 1)
191			case "shift+tab", "up":
192				return m.focusOverlayField(m.overlay.fieldIndex - 1)
193			case "enter":

146	func (m Model) renderTries() string {
147		rows := m.visibleTries()
148		if len(rows) == 0 {
149			if m.viewLoad(ViewTries).loading {
150				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading experiments…") + "\n"
151			}
152			if m.filter != "" {
153				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No Try matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
154			}
155			if m.showAllTries {
156				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No experiment history recorded.") + "\n"
157			}
158			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No active Tries. Press n to create one, or a to include history.") + "\n"
159		}
160		contentWidth := m.width - 2
161		if contentWidth < 40 {
162			contentWidth = 40
163		}
164		var header string
165		var formatRow func(TryRow) string
166		switch {
167		case contentWidth >= 96:
168			nameWidth := clamp(contentWidth-78, 18, 36)
169			tagWidth := contentWidth - nameWidth - 68
170			header = fmt.Sprintf("  %-2s  %-*s  %-10s  %-10s  %-16s  %-7s  %-9s  %s",
171				"", nameWidth, "TRY", "PHASE", "WHERE", "GIT", "LAST", "SIZE", "TAGS")
172			formatRow = func(row TryRow) string {
173				return fmt.Sprintf("%-2s  %-*s  %-10s  %-10s  %-16s  %-7s  %-9s  %s",
174					row.Mark(), nameWidth, pad(row.Item.DisplayName(), nameWidth),
175					pad(string(row.Item.Phase), 10), pad(row.Where(), 10),
176					pad(tryGitSummary(row), 16), pad(tryActivityAge(row), 7),
177					pad(sizeCell(row.Usage, row.SizeError, row.SizeTarget), 9),
178					pad(strings.Join(row.Item.Tags, ","), tagWidth))
179			}
180		case contentWidth >= 72:
181			nameWidth := clamp(contentWidth-52, 16, 34)
182			header = fmt.Sprintf("  %-2s  %-*s  %-10s  %-14s  %-7s  %s",
183				"", nameWidth, "TRY", "WHERE", "GIT", "LAST", "SIZE")
184			formatRow = func(row TryRow) string {
185				return fmt.Sprintf("%-2s  %-*s  %-10s  %-14s  %-7s  %s",
186					row.Mark(), nameWidth, pad(row.Item.DisplayName(), nameWidth),
187					pad(row.Where(), 10), pad(tryGitSummary(row), 14),
188					pad(tryActivityAge(row), 7), sizeCell(row.Usage, row.SizeError, row.SizeTarget))
189			}
190		default:
191			nameWidth := clamp(contentWidth-25, 12, 30)
192			header = fmt.Sprintf("  %-2s  %-*s  %-8s  %s",
193				"", nameWidth, "TRY", "WHERE", "SIZE")
194			formatRow = func(row TryRow) string {
195				return fmt.Sprintf("%-2s  %-*s  %-8s  %s",
196					row.Mark(), nameWidth, pad(row.Item.DisplayName(), nameWidth),
197					pad(row.Where(), 8), sizeCell(row.Usage, row.SizeError, row.SizeTarget))
198			}
199		}
200	
201		var builder strings.Builder
202		builder.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(header) + "\n")
203		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
204		for index := from; index < to; index++ {
205			row := rows[index]
206			line := formatRow(row)
207			styled := line
208			switch {
209			case row.Where() != string(catalog.LocationPresent) || row.Item.Phase != catalog.PhaseActive:
210				styled = styleDim.Render(line)

212				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
213			case row.Live:
214				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
215			}
216			builder.WriteString(m.renderLine(index, line, styled))
217		}
218		builder.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
219		return builder.String()
220	}

CONFIRMED — Empty TASKS currently renders three lines, but frame geometry counts one:

> `lines := 1 // the table header, or the one-line empty/loading state`

versus:

> `return "  " + ...("No tasks recorded yet.\n") + "  " + ...("Press tab ...\n") + "  " + ...("Or run \`dev adopt\` ...\n")`

Thus `mouseFrameFits()` undercounts by two and can return true while Bubble Tea top-clips the frame; the hard-coded `event.Y == 0` can then treat a non-header visible line as the tab bar. Nonempty lists currently align, and the clickable action overlay shares `buildActionMenuLayout`; other overlays/stats/notes/forms reject mouse input. A shared side-effect-free frame layout should supply rendering, total height, tab spans, and list-row bounds.

195	// Runtime state and sanitized payload fields are intentionally excluded so a

197	func (d Declaration) IdentityKey() string {
198		return strings.Join([]string{

200			d.LocalProjectPath, d.ConfigPath, string(d.Source), d.Plugin, d.Name,

209	// metadata, not a claim about which agents are installed on the host.
210	type Coverage struct {

212		StaticDeclarationsOnly bool     `json:"static_declarations_only"`
213		OmittedSources         []string `json:"omitted_sources"`

236	// Filter selects declarations for CLI or TUI consumers. Empty fields are
237	// wildcards; Enabled and HasCredentials distinguish an omitted filter from false.
238	type Filter struct {
239		Agent          Agent
240		Scope          Scope
241		Source         DeclarationSource
242		Transport      Transport
243		Repository     string
244		NameContains   string
245		Enabled        *bool
246		HasCredentials *bool
247	}
248	
249	// Match reports whether a declaration satisfies f.
250	func (f Filter) Match(d Declaration) bool {
251		if f.Agent != "" && d.Agent != f.Agent ||
252			f.Scope != "" && d.Scope != f.Scope ||
253			f.Source != "" && d.Source != f.Source ||
254			f.Transport != "" && d.Transport != f.Transport ||
255			f.Repository != "" && d.Repository != f.Repository {
256			return false
257		}
258		if f.NameContains != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Name), strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(f.NameContains))) {
259			return false
260		}
261		if f.Enabled != nil && (d.Enabled == nil || *d.Enabled != *f.Enabled) {
262			return false
263		}
264		if f.HasCredentials != nil && (len(d.Credentials) > 0) != *f.HasCredentials {
265			return false
266		}
267		return true
268	}
269	
270	// FilterDeclarations returns matching rows without changing their order.
271	func FilterDeclarations(rows []Declaration, f Filter) []Declaration {
272		out := make([]Declaration, 0, len(rows))
273		for _, row := range rows {
274			if f.Match(row) {
275				out = append(out, row)
276			}
277		}
278		return out
279	}
280	
281	// SortDeclarations establishes the stable order used by Scan.
282	func SortDeclarations(rows []Declaration) {
283		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
284			a, b := rows[i], rows[j]
285			ak := []string{string(a.Agent), scopeSortKey(a.Scope), strings.ToLower(a.Repository), a.RepositoryPath, a.Checkout, a.LocalProjectPath, a.ConfigPath, string(a.Source), strings.ToLower(a.Plugin), a.Plugin, strings.ToLower(a.Name), a.Name}
286			bk := []string{string(b.Agent), scopeSortKey(b.Scope), strings.ToLower(b.Repository), b.RepositoryPath, b.Checkout, b.LocalProjectPath, b.ConfigPath, string(b.Source), strings.ToLower(b.Plugin), b.Plugin, strings.ToLower(b.Name), b.Name}
287			for n := range ak {
288				if ak[n] != bk[n] {
289					return ak[n] < bk[n]
290				}
291			}
292			return false
293		})
294	}
295	
296	func scopeSortKey(scope Scope) string {
297		switch scope {
298		case ScopeProject:
299			return "0-project"
300		case ScopeLocal:
301			return "1-local"
302		case ScopeUser:
303			return "2-user"
304		case ScopeCustom:
305			return "3-custom"
306		case ScopeSystemDefaults:
307			return "4-system-defaults"
308		case ScopeSystemOverride:
309			return "5-system-override"
310		case ScopeManaged:
311			return "6-managed"
312		default:
313			return "9-" + string(scope)
314		}
315	}
316	
317	func diagnosticMessage(code DiagnosticCode) string {
318		switch code {
319		case DiagnosticUnreadable:
320			return "configuration file could not be read"
321		case DiagnosticTooLarge:
322			return "configuration file exceeds the scan size limit"
323		case DiagnosticNotRegular:
324			return "configuration source is not a regular file"
325		case DiagnosticSymlinkLimit:
326			return "configuration symlink chain exceeds the scan limit"
327		case DiagnosticProjectSymlinkEscape:
328			return "project configuration resolves outside the checkout"
329		case DiagnosticMalformed:
330			return "configuration file could not be decoded"
331		case DiagnosticControlCharacter:
332			return "configuration contains an unsupported control character"
333		case DiagnosticInvalidDeclaration:
334			return "server declaration has an invalid field"
335		case DiagnosticInvalidName:
336			return "server declaration has an invalid name"
337		case DiagnosticUnknownTransport:
338			return "server transport cannot be determined statically"
339		case DiagnosticConflictingTransport:
340			return "server declaration contains conflicting transport fields"
341		case DiagnosticInvalidEndpoint:
342			return "server endpoint could not be represented safely"
343		case DiagnosticInvalidReference:
344			return "credential reference name is invalid"
345		case DiagnosticPluginDefinitionAbsent:
346			return "plugin override does not include the plugin server definition"
347		case DiagnosticTransportPrecedence:
348			return "lower-precedence transport fields were ignored"
349		default:
350			return "configuration could not be fully represented"
351		}
352	}
353

355		return CoverageDiagnostic{Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code)}

531		if m.actions.EditFile == nil {

537			m.err = err
538			return m, nil
539		}
540		if edit.Command == nil {
541			m.err = fmt.Errorf("capability editor returned no process")
542			return m, nil
543		}
544		view := m.view
545		m.status = "editing " + config.Contract(path) + "…"
546		return m, tea.ExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
547			if edit.Complete != nil {
548				runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
549			}
550			return afterExec(capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: view, err: runErr})
551		})
552	}

582		default:

181	func (m Model) selectionHeading() (string, string) {
182		if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
183			return row.Task.Title(), contract(row.Checkout)
184		}
185		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
186			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
187				return item.Repo.Repo.Display() + "/" + filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path), contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
188			}
189			return item.Repo.Repo.Display(), contract(item.Repo.Repo.Path)
190		}
191		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
192			if row.Repository != nil {
193				return row.Host + "/" + row.Repository.Display, contract(row.Repository.Path)
194			}
195			return row.Host, string(row.State)
196		}
197		if row, ok := m.currentTry(); ok {
198			return row.Item.DisplayName(), contract(row.Item.Live.CurrentPath)
199		}
200		if row, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok {
201			detail := row.Repo.URL
202			if row.LocalPath != "" {
203				detail = contract(row.LocalPath)
204			}
205			return row.Repo.FullName, detail
206		}
207		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
208			path, _ := skillFilePath(row)
209			return row.Name, contract(path)
210		}
211		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
212			return row.Name, contract(row.ConfigPath)
213		}
214		return "", ""
215	}

378			return m, nil

381		token := m.overlay.selection

383			m.overlay = overlayState{}

388		return m.runListAction(action)

**Evaluating identity mapping**

I'm considering how a structured identity can't easily be mapped to key value due to Declaration fields being strings. Instead, I wonder if a struct with exactly 10 comparable strings would work better, and it wouldn't require extra memory allocation. Caching the identity string in memory seems cheaper once loaded. Overall, I think this approach makes sense since the frequency of menu actions is relatively low.

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-09-04 07:19:43Z)**_

CONFIRMED — Cost: O(n) per confirmed MCP menu action; successful matching rebuilds the visible slice twice via `setAt`, plus one composite-string allocation per row through the selected row. This is human-triggered and usually tens of rows, so latency impact is low, but all-repository inventories can reach hundreds and structured/cached identity would reduce allocation. Quote: `for i, row := range m.visibleMCP() { if row.IdentityKey() == token.key { m.setAt(i) ... } }`

19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
20	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

136	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
137		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
138		if d < time.Hour {
139			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
140		}
141		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)

149	type headerLayout struct {
150		line string
151		tabs []tabHit
152	}

154	// buildHeaderLayout renders the tab strip and records the exact cell spans it
155	// used, so mouse hit testing cannot drift from responsive labels or styles.
156	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
157		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
158			short := map[View]string{
159				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
160				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
161			}
162			var builder strings.Builder
163			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
164			builder.WriteString(prefix)
165			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
166			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
167			for index, view := range Views {
168				if index > 0 {
169					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
170					builder.WriteString(separator)
171					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
172				}
173				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
174				if compact {
175					name = short[view]
176				}
177				label := name
178				if !compact {
179					label = " " + name + " "
180				}
181				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
182				if view == m.view {
183					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
184				}
185				from := x
186				builder.WriteString(rendered)
187				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
188				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
189			}
190			if summary {
191				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
192			}
193			if m.filter != "" {
194				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
195			}
196			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
197		}
198	
199		layout := build(false, true)
200		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
201			layout = build(false, false)
202		}
203		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
204			layout = build(true, false)
205		}
206		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
207			return layout
208		}
209	
210		prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
211		name := strings.ToUpper(m.view.String())
212		line := prefix + styleSelected.Render(name)
213		layout = headerLayout{
214			line: line,
215			tabs: []tabHit{{view: m.view, from: lipgloss.Width(prefix), to: lipgloss.Width(line)}},
216		}
217		if m.filter != "" {
218			available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(layout.line) - 4
219			if available > 1 {
220				layout.line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))
221			}
222		}
223		return layout
224	}

230	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
231	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
232	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
233		h := m.listHeight()
234		if n <= h {
235			return 0, n
236		}
237		from = m.at() - h/2
238		if from < 0 {
239			from = 0
240		}
241		if from+h > n {
242			from = n - h
243		}
244		return from, from + h
245	}

346	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
347		r := item.Repo
348		checkout, child := item.checkout()
349		if !child {
350			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
351				marker := "▸ "
352				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
353					marker = "▾ "
354				}
355				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
356			}
357			if name == "live" {
358				return parentLiveColumn(r)
359			}
360			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
361		}
362	
363		switch name {
364		case "repo":
365			connector := "├─ "
366			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
367				connector = "└─ "
368			}
369			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
370			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
371				label = checkout.Branch()
372			}
373			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
374				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
375			}
376			return connector + label
377		case "branch":
378			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
379				return branch
380			}
381			return "(detached)"
382		case "git":
383			switch {
384			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
385				return "prunable"
386			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
387				return "locked"
388			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
389				return "?"
390			default:
391				return checkout.Status.Summary()
392			}
393		case "live":
394			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout, r.Context.RuntimeErr)
395		case "latest":
396			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
397		case "worktrees":
398			return "—"
399		case "tasks":
400			if r.Context.TaskErr != nil {
401				return "?"
402			}
403			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
404		case "notes":
405			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
406				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
407			}
408			return "—"
409		case "category":
410			return "—"
411		case "path":
412			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
413		}
414		return ""
415	}

417	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
418		if r.Context.RuntimeErr != nil {
419			return "?"
420		}
421		sessions := r.Sessions()
422		if len(sessions) == 0 {
423			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
424		}
425		if len(sessions) > 1 {
426			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
427		}
428		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
429		if status != "" {
430			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
431		}
432		return r.Runtime

435	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout, runtimeErr error) string {
436		if runtimeErr != nil {
437			return "?"
438		}
439		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
440			return "closed"
441		}
442		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
443			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
444		}
445		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
446			return runtimeName + ":" + status
447		}
448		return runtimeName

451	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
452		if len(tasks) == 0 {
453			return "—"
454		}
455		counts := map[task.State]int{}
456		for _, t := range tasks {
457			counts[t.State]++
458		}
459		var parts []string
460		for _, state := range task.States {
461			if counts[state] > 0 {
462				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
463			}
464		}
465		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
466	}

468	type repoColumnSpec struct {
469		name, header string
470		width, min   int
471	}
472	
473	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
474		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
475		if len(names) == 0 {
476			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
477		}
478		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
479			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
480			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
481			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
482			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
483			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
484			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
485			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
486			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
487			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
488			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
489			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
490			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
491		}
492		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
493		for _, name := range names {
494			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
495				columns = append(columns, c)
496			}
497		}
498		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
499		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
500		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
501		for _, c := range columns {
502			total += c.width
503		}
504		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
505			for i := range columns {
506				if columns[i].name != preferred {
507					continue
508				}
509				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
510				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
511				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
512				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
513					columns[i].width--
514					total--
515				}
516			}
517			if total <= m.width {
518				break
519			}
520		}
521		return columns
522	}

533		case "git":

541			}

587	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
588		if at.IsZero() {
589			return "—"
590		}
591		d := time.Since(at)
592		switch {
593		case d < time.Hour:
594			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
595		case d < 24*time.Hour:
596			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
597		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
598			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
599		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
600			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
601		default:
602			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
603		}
604	}

606	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
607		s = pad(s, width)
608		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
609			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
610		}
611		return s
612	}

617		}
618		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
619		if len(rows) == 0 {
620			if !m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).hasSnapshot {
621				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
622			}
623			if m.filter != "" {
624				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
625			}
626			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
627		}
628		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
629		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
630		if descW < 12 {
631			descW = 12

633	
634		var b strings.Builder
635		if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading {
636			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
637		}
638		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
639			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
640		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
641		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
642			r := rows[i]
643			pending := m.remoteCloneTargets(r)
644			local := "—"
645			if pending {
646				local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " repo"
647				if m.remoteClone.phase == remoteCloneRunning {
648					local = m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " clone"
649				}
650			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
651				local = "inspect"
652			} else if r.Cloned() {
653				local = "yes"
654				if r.LocalKind != "" {
655					local = string(r.LocalKind)
656					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
657						local = "repo"
658					}
659				}
660			}
661			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
662			if vis == "" {
663				vis = "—"
664			}
665			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
666				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
667				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
668			styled := line
669			if r.Cloned() || pending {
670				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
671			} else if r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
672				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
673			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
674				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
675			}
676			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
677		}
678		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
679		return b.String()
680	}

682	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
683		rows := m.visibleFleet()
684		if len(rows) == 0 {
685			if m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).loading {
686				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
687			}
688			if !m.viewLoad(ViewFleet).hasSnapshot {
689				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
690			}
691			if !m.showLocalFleet {
692				for _, row := range m.fleet {
693					if row.Local && matches(row.searchText(), m.filter) {
694						return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote fleet rows. Press a to include this machine.") + "\n"
695					}
696				}
697			}
698			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
699		}
700		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
701		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
702		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
703		if pathW < 12 {
704			pathW = 12
705		}
706		var b strings.Builder
707		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
708			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
709		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
710		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
711			row := rows[i]
712			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
713			if row.Repository != nil {
714				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
715				if row.Repository.Live {
716					live = row.Repository.Runtime
717					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
718						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
719					}
720				}
721				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
722			}
723			state := string(row.State)
724			if row.FromCache {
725				state = "stale"
726			}
727			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
728				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
729				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
730			styled := line
731			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
732				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
733			} else if row.State != "ok" {
734				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
735			}
736			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
737		}
738		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
739		return b.String()
740	}

771			headers = []string{fitCell("REPO", repoW), fitCell("SCOPE", scopeW), fitCell("SKILL", skillW), fitCell("INSTALL", installW), fitCell("UPDATE", updateW), fitCell("AGENTS", agentW)}

913	func mcpPolicySummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
914		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Policies))
915		for _, policy := range row.Policies {
916			part := string(policy.Kind)
917			if policy.Value != "" {
918				part += ":" + policy.Value
919			}
920			if policy.Count > 0 {
921				part += fmt.Sprintf(":%d", policy.Count)
922			}
923			parts = append(parts, part)
924		}
925		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
926	}
927	
928	func mcpCredentialSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration, maxWidth int) string {
929		parts := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
930		for index, credential := range row.Credentials {
931			part := string(credential.Kind)
932			if credential.Name != "" {
933				part += ":" + credential.Name
934			}
935			candidate := strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), parts...), part), ", ")
936			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > maxWidth {
937				remaining := len(row.Credentials) - index
938				if len(parts) == 0 {
939					if remaining == 1 {
940						return pad(part, maxWidth)
941					}
942					return pad(fmt.Sprintf("%s, +%d", part, remaining-1), maxWidth)
943				}
944				return pad(strings.Join(parts, ", ")+fmt.Sprintf(", +%d", remaining), maxWidth)
945			}
946			parts = append(parts, part)
947		}
948		return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
949	}

951	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
952		var parts []string
953		for _, item := range []struct {
954			label string
955			n     int
956		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
957			if item.n > 0 {
958				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
959			}
960		}
961		if len(parts) == 0 {
962			return "—"
963		}
964		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
965	}

999	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
1000		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
1001			return "—"
1002		}
1003		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
1004		switch {
1005		case d < 24*time.Hour:
1006			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
1007		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
1008			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
1009		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
1010			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1011		default:
1012			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1013		}
1014	}

1043	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
1044		fixed := 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
1045		if m.width >= taskRepoBreakpoint {
1046			fixed += taskRepoWidth + 2
1047		}
1048		avail := m.width - fixed
1049		if avail < 40 {
1050			avail = 40
1051		}
1052		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1053		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
1054		next = avail - name - branch
1055		if next < 10 {
1056			next = 10
1057		}
1058		return name, branch, next
1059	}

1067				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to keep it · esc to clear")
1068		case modeEditNext:

1070				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to save · esc to cancel")
1071		case modeConfirmPark:

1073			if m.taskPromptTarget != nil {
1074				title = m.taskPromptTarget.Title()
1075			}
1076			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("park "+title) +
1077				"\n  next: " + m.input.View() +
1078				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to park (session closes, worktree stays) · esc to cancel")
1079		case modeStartTask:
1080			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("start work in "+m.repoPromptTarget.Repo.Name) +
1081				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
1082				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to create the branch, worktree and session · esc to cancel")
1083		case modeStartDirect:
1084			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("track direct work in "+m.repoPromptTarget.Repo.Name) +
1085				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
1086				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to track the current branch; no branch/worktree is created · esc to cancel")
1087		case modeConfirmClone:
1088			r := m.remoteClonePrompt
1089			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("clone "+r.Repo.FullName) +
1090				"\n  to: " + contract(filepath.Join("<project_root>", r.Repo.Name)) +
1091				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter clone and stay · o clone and open · esc cancel")
1092		case modeConfirmSkillUpdate:
1093			row := m.skillUpdateTarget
1094			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("update "+string(row.Scope)+" skill "+row.Name) +
1095				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to update this skill · esc to cancel")
1096		case modeCopy:

1098				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("press a second key · esc to cancel")

1100	
1101		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
1102			lines := []string{

1104				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("state"), row.State),

1111				)

1121				}
1122			}

1125			}
1126			return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
1127		}
1128		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
1129			lines := []string{
1130				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("server"), row.Name),
1131				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("repo"), dashCell(row.Repository)),

1467	func (m Model) renderFooter() string {
1468		viewErr, viewStatus := m.viewError(m.view), m.viewStatus(m.view)
1469		var status string
1470		switch {
1471		case m.err != nil:
1472			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + m.err.Error())
1473		case m.remoteClone.active():
1474			status = styleLive.Render(m.remoteCloneSpinner.View() + " " + m.remoteCloneStatus())
1475		case viewErr != nil:
1476			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + viewErr.Error())
1477		case m.status != "":
1478			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + m.status)
1479		case viewStatus != "":
1480			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + viewStatus)
1481		}
1482	
1483		var bindings []string
1484		if m.remoteClone.active() {
1485			bindings = []string{"q cancel clone", "tab view", "/ filter", "j/k move"}
1486			var b strings.Builder
1487			if status != "" {
1488				b.WriteString("  " + status + "\n")
1489			}
1490			b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render(wrapBindings(bindings, m.width-4)))
1491			return b.String()
1492		}
1493		switch m.view {
1494		case ViewRepos:
1495			sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1496			if sortBy == "" {
1497				sortBy = "activity"
1498			}
1499			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1500				sortBy += "↑"
1501			}
1502			if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
1503				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open worktree", "space collapse")
1504			} else {
1505				bindings = append(bindings, "enter ad hoc", "space worktrees", "m metadata", "n add note", "N notes", "s worktree task", "d direct task")
1506			}
1507			bindings = append(bindings, "O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1508		case ViewFleet:
1509			if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil {
1510				bindings = append(bindings, "enter remote open")
1511			}
1512			local := "hidden"
1513			if m.showLocalFleet {
1514				local = "shown"
1515			}
1516			bindings = append(bindings, "a local:"+local, "r refresh")
1517		case ViewTries:
1518			sortBy := m.trySort
1519			if sortBy == "" {
1520				sortBy = "activity"
1521			}
1522			if m.tryReverse {
1523				sortBy += "↑"
1524			}
1525			bindings = append(bindings, "enter open", "n new", "space actions", "a history",
1526				"O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1527		case ViewRemote:
1528			if m.remoteClone.active() {
1529				bindings = append(bindings, "q cancel clone")
1530			} else if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
1531				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open local", "n add note", "N notes")
1532			} else if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.CloneProblemPath != "" {
1533				bindings = append(bindings, "inspect local destination")
1534			} else {
1535				bindings = append(bindings, "c clone")
1536			}
1537		case ViewSkills:
1538			bindings = append(bindings, "a add", "c check", "u update selected", "A scope:"+m.capabilityScope.String())
1539		case ViewMCP:
1540			bindings = append(bindings, "A scope:"+m.capabilityScope.String(), "r reload declarations")
1541		default:
1542			if row, ok := m.currentTask(); ok {
1543				if command := taskRecoveryCommand(row); command != "" {
1544					bindings = append(bindings, "recovery "+command)
1545				} else {
1546					bindings = append(bindings, "enter open")
1547				}
1548				bindings = append(bindings, "n add note", "N notes")
1549				if row.Task.State == task.Hot || row.Task.State == task.Warm {
1550					bindings = append(bindings, "p park")
1551				}
1552				bindings = append(bindings, "c next")
1553			}
1554		}
1555		if m.view == ViewRepos || m.view == ViewSkills || m.view == ViewMCP {
1556			bindings = append(bindings, "y copy")
1557		}
1558		bindings = append(bindings, "tab view", "/ filter", "? help")
1559		if m.view != ViewSkills && m.view != ViewMCP {
1560			bindings = append(bindings, "H stats")
1561		}
1562		// `e` edits whichever configuration the current view is about.
1563		switch m.view {
1564		case ViewFleet:
1565			bindings = append(bindings, "e hosts")
1566		case ViewSkills, ViewMCP:
1567			if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil && m.actions.EditFile != nil {
1568				bindings = append(bindings, "e file")
1569			}
1570		default:
1571			bindings = append(bindings, "e config")
1572		}
1573		if m.view != ViewSkills && m.view != ViewMCP {
1574			for _, t := range m.Tools() {
1575				bindings = append(bindings, t.Key+" "+t.Name)
1576			}
1577		}
1578		if m.view != ViewSkills && m.view != ViewMCP {
1579			bindings = append(bindings, "1/2/3 state")
1580		}
1581		bindings = append(bindings, "0 clear", "r reload", "q quit")
1582	
1583		var b strings.Builder
1584		if status != "" {
1585			b.WriteString("  " + status + "\n")
1586		}
1587		b.WriteString("  " + styleHelp.Render(wrapBindings(bindings, m.width-4)))
1588		return b.String()
1589	}
1590	
1591	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1592	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1593	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1594		if width < 20 {
1595			width = 20
1596		}
1597		var lines []string
1598		cur := ""
1599		for _, it := range items {
1600			candidate := it
1601			if cur != "" {
1602				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1603			}
1604			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1605				lines = append(lines, cur)
1606				cur = it
1607				continue
1608			}
1609			cur = candidate
1610		}
1611		if cur != "" {
1612			lines = append(lines, cur)
1613		}
1614		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1615	}
1616	
1617	func gitColumn(r inventory.Row) string {
1618		switch {
1619		case r.StatusErr != nil:
1620			return "?"
1621		case !r.CheckoutExists:
1622			return "no dir"
1623		}
1624		return r.Status.Summary()
1625	}
1626	
1627	func nextColumn(r inventory.Row) string {
1628		if r.Task.Next == "" {
1629			return styleDim.Render("—")
1630		}
1631		return r.Task.Next
1632	}
1633	
1634	func shortAge(r inventory.Row) string {
1635		d := r.Age()
1636		switch {
1637		case d <= 0:
1638			return "—"
1639		case d.Hours() < 24:
1640			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
1641		case d.Hours() < 24*14:
1642			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
1643		case d.Hours() < 24*60:
1644			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
1645		default:
1646			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
1647		}
1648	}
1649	
1650	func colourState(s task.State, line string) string {
1651		switch s {
1652		case task.Hot:
1653			return styleHot.Render(line)
1654		case task.Warm:
1655			return styleWarm.Render(line)
1656		case task.Cold:
1657			return styleCold.Render(line)
1658		case task.Done:
1659			return styleDone.Render(line)
1660		}
1661		return line
1662	}
1663	
1664	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1665	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1666	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1667		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1668			return s
1669		}
1670		var b strings.Builder
1671		used := 0
1672		for _, r := range s {
1673			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1674			if used+w > n-1 {
1675				break
1676			}
1677			b.WriteRune(r)
1678			used += w
1679		}
1680		return b.String() + "…"
1681	}
1682	
1683	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
1684		if v < lo {
1685			return lo
1686		}
1687		if v > hi {
1688			return hi
1689		}
1690		return v
1691	}

23	// RepoRow is one repository as the dashboard shows it: what it is, plus how
24	// much of it is currently in flight.
25	//
26	// The repository view exists because the task list alone answers only half the
27	// question. On a machine with forty repositories and no tasks recorded yet,
28	// a task-only dashboard is empty — and the honest answer to "what do I have
29	// here?" has to come before "what am I working on?"
30	// RepoActions groups catalog metadata mutations for ordinary repositories.

33	}

45		Asset *catalog.Entry
46		// Context is the canonical checkout plus every linked worktree, enriched
47		// with task and runtime state. It is shared by the tree, copy actions and
48		// `dev repo context`, so those surfaces cannot disagree.
49		Context inventory.RepoContext
50		// LastActivity is the newest commit time in this checkout. It is a durable,
51		// cheap approximation of "when was this repo last touched" and is sortable.
52		LastActivity time.Time
53		// Worktrees is the number of linked worktrees, excluding the main checkout.
54		Worktrees int

67		// this local checkout without rescanning every repo when a cache opens.

72	// Sessions returns every runtime session attached to any checkout in this

74	func (r RepoRow) Sessions() []runtime.Session { return r.Context.Sessions() }

76	// HotTasks counts the repository's tasks that are currently hot.
77	// IsTry reports an ungraduated Try that should live in the dedicated TRY view,
78	// while remaining in the model's local snapshot for REMOTE matching.
79	func (r RepoRow) IsTry() bool {
80		return r.Asset != nil && r.Asset.Kind == catalog.KindTry && r.Asset.Experiment != nil &&
81			(r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseActive || r.Asset.Experiment.Phase == catalog.PhaseDeprecated)
82	}

84	func (r RepoRow) HotTasks() int {
85		n := 0
86		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
87			if t.State == task.Hot {
88				n++
89			}
90		}
91		return n
92	}

94	// StateSummary renders the repository's tasks as a compact per-state tally,
95	// which is what makes the list scannable at forty repositories.
96	func (r RepoRow) StateSummary() string {
97		if len(r.Tasks) == 0 {
98			return ""
99		}
100		counts := map[task.State]int{}
101		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
102			counts[t.State]++
103		}
104		var parts []string
105		for _, s := range task.States {
106			if counts[s] > 0 {
107				parts = append(parts, s.Icon()+strconv.Itoa(counts[s]))
108			}
109		}
110		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
111	}

113	// searchText is what a filter query matches against.
114	func (r RepoRow) searchText() string {
115		var b strings.Builder
116		b.WriteString(r.Repo.Display())
117		b.WriteString(" ")
118		b.WriteString(r.Status.Branch)
119		b.WriteString(" ")
120		b.WriteString(r.Topology.Summary())
121		for _, branch := range r.Topology.Branches {
122			b.WriteString(" ")
123			b.WriteString(branch.Branch)
124			b.WriteString(" ")
125			b.WriteString(branch.Upstream)
126		}
127		if r.Asset != nil {
128			b.WriteString(" ")
129			b.WriteString(string(r.Asset.Kind))
130			b.WriteString(" ")
131			b.WriteString(r.Asset.Note)
132			b.WriteString(" ")
133			b.WriteString(strings.Join(r.Asset.Tags, " "))
134		}
135		for _, t := range r.Tasks {
136			b.WriteString(" ")
137			b.WriteString(t.Title())
138			b.WriteString(" ")
139			b.WriteString(t.Branch)
140		}
141		for _, checkout := range r.Context.Checkouts {
142			b.WriteString(" ")
143			b.WriteString(checkout.Worktree.Path)
144			b.WriteString(" ")
145			b.WriteString(checkout.Branch())
146			b.WriteString(" ")
147			b.WriteString(string(checkout.Ownership))
148		}
149		return strings.ToLower(b.String())
150	}

152	func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool {
153		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
154		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
155			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
156			if structured {
157				switch key {
158				case "tag":
159					if r.Asset == nil || !r.Asset.HasTag(value) {
160						return false
161					}
162					continue
163				case "remote":
164					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Topology.Summary()), value) {
165						return false
166					}
167					continue
168				case "size":
169					if !matchesSize(r.Usage, value) {
170						return false
171					}
172					continue
173				case "kind":
174					kind := catalog.KindRepository
175					if r.Asset != nil {
176						kind = r.Asset.Kind
177					}
178					if string(kind) != value {
179						return false
180					}
181					continue
182				}
183			}
184			if !strings.Contains(r.searchText(), term) {
185				return false
186			}
187		}
188		return true
189	}
190	
191	// taskSearchText is what a filter query matches a task row against.
192	func taskSearchText(r inventory.Row) string {
193		t := r.Task
194		return strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
195			t.Title(), t.Repo, t.Branch, t.Next, t.Note, string(t.State),
196		}, " "))
197	}

199	// matches reports whether every whitespace-separated term of the query appears
200	// in the haystack.
201	//
202	// Term-wise rather than substring so "auth api" finds a task named "api token
203	// auth" — the order words come to mind in is rarely the order they appear in.
204	func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
205		return textmatch.Terms(haystack, query)
206	}

34	func TestMouseClicksResponsiveTabSpans(t *testing.T) {

41			}
42			for _, hit := range layout.tabs {
43				candidate := model
44				candidate, _ = applyMouse(candidate, mouseMessage((hit.from+hit.to)/2, 0, tea.MouseButtonLeft, tea.MouseActionPress))
45				if candidate.view != hit.view {
46					t.Errorf("width %d click [%d,%d) selected %s, want %s", width, hit.from, hit.to, candidate.view, hit.view)
47				}

CONFIRMED — `mouseFrameFits` undercounts the empty TASKS section by two lines: it uses `"listLines := m.listPreambleLines()"`, where `"lines := 1"`, but `emptyTasks()` renders three lines beginning `"No tasks recorded yet.\n"`. It can therefore approve a frame that Bubble Tea top-clips, while `mouseRow` still assumes `"first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()"`, allowing screen coordinates to target the wrong logical section.

`visibleMCP()` scans all `n` source rows and appends every visible declaration into a new slice; successful matching then calls `setAt()`, whose `count()` rebuilds that slice again. Each `Declaration` is approximately 336 bytes on 64-bit Go, so 1,000 visible rows require at least two 336 KB final backing arrays—672 KB—plus intermediate slice-growth allocations per executed menu option. Before reaching row `k`, it also performs `k` composite-string allocations through:

> `return strings.Join([]string{ ... 10 fields ... }, "\x00")`

Thus successful revalidation is O(n) scanning/copying plus O(k) identity construction; at row 1,000 that is 2,000 declaration copies and 1,000 composite keys. A stored structured identity or cached key would remove the per-row string construction; caching/indexing the filtered projection would also remove the dominant repeated slice rebuild.

761		if err != nil {
762			return "", err
763		}

766			return "", err

771			return "", err
772		}
773		return string(body), nil
774	}

779	func tuiCapabilityTargets(locals []tui.RepoRow, current agenttarget.Target, scope tui.CapabilityScope) []agenttarget.Target {
780		repositories := make([]repo.Repo, 0, len(locals))

14	func fleetEditorCommand(editor, path string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
15		arguments, err := windows.DecomposeCommandLine(editor)
16		if err != nil {
17			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse Windows editor command: %w", err)
18		}
19		if len(arguments) == 0 || arguments[0] == "" {
20			return nil, errors.New("Windows editor command is empty")
21		}
22		return exec.Command(arguments[0], append(arguments[1:], path)...), nil
23	}

25	// replaceProcessWithShell starts an interactive shell in the current working
26	// directory. Windows has no exec(2), so dev runs the shell as a child that
27	// inherits the console and then exits with the shell's status when it returns.
28	func replaceProcessWithShell() error {
29		shell := os.Getenv("COMSPEC")
30		if shell == "" {
31			shell = "cmd.exe"
32		}
33		cmd := exec.Command(shell)
34		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
35		err := cmd.Run()
36		var exit *exec.ExitError
37		if errors.As(err, &exit) {
38			os.Exit(exit.ExitCode())
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return err
42		}
43		os.Exit(0)
44		return nil
45	}
