```text
116	func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
117		logical := filepath.Clean(path)
118		resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(logical)
119		if err != nil {
120			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
121		}
122		root, err := os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
123		if err != nil {
124			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
125		}
126		completeOwnsRoot := false
127		defer func() {
128			if !completeOwnsRoot {
129				_ = root.Close()
130			}
131		}()
132		original, observed, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(
133			context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), nil, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes,
134		)
135		if err != nil {
136			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
137		}
138		originalSize := len(original)
139		originalDigest := sha256.Sum256(original)
140	
141		working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
142		if err != nil {
143			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
144		}
145		workingPath := working.Name()
146		cleanup := true
147		defer func() {
148			if cleanup {
149				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
150			}
151		}()
152		if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
153			_ = working.Close()
154			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
155		}
156		if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
157			_ = working.Close()
158			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
159		}
160		if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
161			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
162		}
163		original = nil
164		process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
165		if err != nil {
166			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
167		}
168		cleanup = false
169		completeOwnsRoot = true
170	
171		return tui.CapabilityEdit{
172			Command: process,
173			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
174				defer root.Close()
175				if runErr != nil {
176					_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
177					return runErr
178				}
179				edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
180				if err != nil {
181					return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)

184					return os.Remove(workingPath)

187					context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
188				); err != nil {
189					return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
190				}
```

```text
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		total := 2 + lineCount(m.renderCurrentList()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
19		return total <= m.height
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
23		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
24		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
25			return m, nil
26		}
27		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
28			if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
29				return m, nil
30			}
31			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
32		}
33		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
34			return m, nil
35		}
36		if !m.mouseFrameFits() {
37			return m, nil
38		}
39	
40		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
41			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
42				return m, nil
43			}
44			delta := mouseWheelRows
45			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
46				delta = -delta
47			}
48			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
49			return m, nil
50		}
51		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
52			return m, nil
53		}
54	
55		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
56			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
57				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
58					continue
59				}
60				if m.view == hit.view {
61					return m, nil
62				}
63				m.view = hit.view
64				return m.afterViewSwitch()
65			}
```

```text
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		total := 2 + lineCount(m.renderCurrentList()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
19		return total <= m.height
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
23		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
24		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
25			return m, nil
26		}
27		verticalWheel := event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown
28		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
29			menuPress := event.Action == tea.MouseActionPress && event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft
30			if (!verticalWheel && !menuPress) || !m.mouseFrameFits() {
31				return m, nil
32			}
33			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
34		}
35		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
36			return m, nil
37		}
38		rowPress := event.Action == tea.MouseActionPress &&
39			(event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonRight)
40		if (!verticalWheel && !rowPress) || !m.mouseFrameFits() {
41			return m, nil
42		}
43	
44		if verticalWheel {
45			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
46				return m, nil
47			}
48			delta := mouseWheelRows
49			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
50				delta = -delta
51			}
52			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
53			return m, nil
54		}
55		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
56			return m, nil
57		}
58	
59		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
60			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
61				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
62					continue
63				}
64				if m.view == hit.view {
65					return m, nil
66				}
67				m.view = hit.view
68				return m.afterViewSwitch()

70			return m, nil
71		}
72	
73		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
74		if !ok {
75			return m, nil
76		}
77		switch event.Button {
78		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
79			m.setAt(row)
80		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
81			m.setAt(row)

89	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
90		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
91			return 0, false
92		}
93		count := m.count()
94		from, to := m.window(count)
95		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
96		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
97			return 0, false
98		}
99		return from + y - first, true
100	}
101	
102	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
103		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
104			return false
105		}
106		from, to := m.window(m.count())
107		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
108		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
109	}

111	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
112		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
113			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
114				return m, nil
115			}

118				delta = -1

124			return m, nil

127		if !ok {

129			return m, nil
130		}
```

```text
466	func (m Model) toggleSelectedRepo() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
467		item, ok := m.currentRepoItem()

473			return m, nil
474		}

482		}
483		m.toggleRepo(item.Repo)
484		return m, nil
485	}
```

 `./internal/safefile/root.go`

```text
1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"io/fs"
13		"os"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
16	)
17	
18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28	
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63	
64	// OpenChildRoot opens one child directory through parent and proves that its
65	// name still identifies the held directory.
66	func OpenChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
67		if parent == nil {
68			return nil, nil, errors.New("open child root: nil parent")
69		}
70		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
71			return nil, nil, err
72		}
73		before, err := parent.Lstat(name)
74		if err != nil {
75			return nil, nil, err
76		}
77		if unsafeLink(before) {
78			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is a symlink or reparse point: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
79		}
80		if !before.IsDir() {
81			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a directory: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
82		}
83		child, err := parent.OpenRoot(name)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, nil, err
86		}
87		held, err := child.Stat(".")

209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&

218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {

228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
```

```text
635	scope rows before a generation-guarded reload. In SKILLS, `a` opens the upstream
636	interactive installer, `c` performs the opt-in read-only network check after the
637	local snapshot has loaded, and `u` confirms before updating only the selected
638	lock-managed skill in that row's checkout. Source checks hash Git object bytes
639	without running checkout filters; non-ASCII provider folder hashes that cannot be
640	reproduced portably remain unverifiable. Mutations skip repository-local PATH
641	shims and are serialized across `dev` processes. `r` reloads local state without
642	checking the network. MCP only filters/reloads static declarations; it never
643	starts a server or helper. On either capability view, `e` edits a private working copy and guarded-atomically
644	replaces the unchanged selected file; an external edit wins and the working copy
645	is preserved for recovery. `y` offers file copy choices. `?` opens the complete
646	context-sensitive key map. That makes
647	the branch/worktree and lifecycle costs explicit rather than silently applying
648	them to every directory.
```

```text
121	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
122	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
123	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
124	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
125	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
126	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
127		if root == nil {

138		}

143		defer func() {

150		}
151		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
152			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
153		}
154		stagedName = ""
155		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
158		}

160			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
161		}
162		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
163			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
164		}
165		return published, nil
166	}
```

 ```bash
+func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
+	logical := filepath.Clean(path)
+	resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(logical)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	completeOwnsRoot := false
+	defer func() {
+		if !completeOwnsRoot {
+			_ = root.Close()
+		}
+	}()
+	original, observed, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(
+		context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), nil, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes,
+	)
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
+	}
+	originalSize := len(original)
+	originalDigest := sha256.Sum256(original)
+
+	working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	workingPath := working.Name()
+	cleanup := true
+	defer func() {
+		if cleanup {
+			_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
+		}
+	}()
+	if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
+		_ = working.Close()
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	original = nil
+	process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
+	if err != nil {
+		return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
+	}
+	cleanup = false
+	completeOwnsRoot = true
+
+	return tui.CapabilityEdit{
+		Command: process,
+		Complete: func(runErr error) error {
+			defer root.Close()
+			if runErr != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("capability editor failed; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), runErr)
+			}
+			edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("read edited capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if len(edited) == originalSize && sha256.Sum256(edited) == originalDigest {
+				return os.Remove(workingPath)
+			}
+			currentResolved, err := pathx.Canonical(logical)
+			if err != nil || !sameCleanPath(currentResolved, resolved) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("capability file target changed; working copy preserved at %s: %w",
+					config.Contract(workingPath), errors.Join(err, safefile.ErrChanged))
+			}
+			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved), rootInfo); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("capability file directory changed; working copy preserved at %s: %w",
+					config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
+				context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
+			); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)
+			}
+			return os.Remove(workingPath)
+		},
+	}, nil
+}
 ```

```text
12	func skillFilePath(row agentskill.Skill) (string, error) {
13		if row.Presence != agentskill.PresenceMissing && strings.TrimSpace(row.Path) != "" {
14			return filepath.Join(row.Path, "SKILL.md"), nil
15		}
16		if row.Lock != nil && strings.TrimSpace(row.Lock.File) != "" {
17			return row.Lock.File, nil
18		}
19		return "", fmt.Errorf("skill %s has no local skill or lock file", row.Name)
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) capabilityFilePath() (string, error) {
23		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
24			return skillFilePath(row)
25		}
26		if row, ok := m.currentMCP(); ok {
27			if strings.TrimSpace(row.ConfigPath) == "" {
28				return "", fmt.Errorf("MCP server %s has no local config path", row.Name)
29			}
30			return row.ConfigPath, nil
31		}
32		return "", fmt.Errorf("the selected row has no capability config file")
33	}

35	func formatSkillSummary(row agentskill.Skill) string {
36		lines := []string{
37			"name: " + row.Name,
38			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
39		}
40		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
41		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
42		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "path", row.Path)
43		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "agents", strings.Join(row.Agents, ", "))
44		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "managed", string(row.ManagedBy))
45		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "presence", string(row.Presence))
46		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "integrity", string(row.Integrity))
47		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", row.Source)
48		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source_url", row.SourceURL)
49		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "update", string(row.UpdateStatus))
50		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
51	}
52	
53	func formatMCPSummary(row agentmcp.Declaration) string {
54		lines := []string{
55			"server: " + row.Name,
56			"agent: " + string(row.Agent),
57			"scope: " + string(row.Scope),
58		}
59		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "repository", row.Repository)
60		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "checkout", row.Checkout)
61		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "config", row.ConfigPath)
62		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "source", mcpSource(row))
63		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "state", mcpDeclarationState(row))
64		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "transport", string(row.Transport))
65		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "endpoint", row.Endpoint)
66		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "command", row.Command)
67		if row.ArgumentCount > 0 {
68			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("arguments: %d value(s) redacted", row.ArgumentCount))
69		}
70		lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "policies", mcpPolicySummary(row))
71		if len(row.Credentials) > 0 {
72			credentials := make([]string, 0, len(row.Credentials))
73			for _, credential := range row.Credentials {
74				value := string(credential.Kind)
75				if credential.Name != "" {
76					value += ":" + credential.Name
77				}
78				credentials = append(credentials, value)
79			}
80			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "credentials", strings.Join(credentials, ", "))
81		}
82		if len(row.Redactions) > 0 {
83			redactions := make([]string, len(row.Redactions))
84			for i, redaction := range row.Redactions {
85				redactions[i] = string(redaction)
86			}
87			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "redacted", strings.Join(redactions, ", "))
88		}
89		if len(row.Coverage) > 0 {
90			coverage := make([]string, len(row.Coverage))
91			for i, item := range row.Coverage {
92				coverage[i] = string(item.Code)
93			}
94			lines = appendSummaryLine(lines, "coverage", strings.Join(coverage, ", "))
95		}
96		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
97	}

99	func (m Model) copyBindingHelp() string {
100		if m.view == ViewRepos {
101			return "y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths"
102		}
103		parts := make([]string, 0, 4)
104		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil {
105			parts = append(parts, "p file path")
106		}
107		parts = append(parts, "s safe summary")
108		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok && row.SourceURL != "" {
109			parts = append(parts, "u source URL")
110		}
111		if _, err := m.capabilityFilePath(); err == nil && m.actions.ReadFile != nil {
112			parts = append(parts, "f raw file")
113		}
114		return strings.Join(parts, " · ")
115	}
116	
117	func appendSummaryLine(lines []string, label, value string) []string {
118		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
119			return lines
120		}
121		return append(lines, label+": "+value)
122	}
```

```text
1	package tui
2	
3	import tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
4	
5	const mouseWheelRows = 3
6	
7	// mouseFrameFits fails closed when Bubble Tea would drop top lines from an
8	// over-height frame. Screen-relative mouse coordinates cannot safely target
9	// logical header/list rows once that clipping occurs.
10	func (m Model) mouseFrameFits() bool {
11		if m.height <= 0 {
12			return false
13		}
14		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
15			return lineCount(m.renderOverlay()) <= m.height
16		}
17	
18		total := 2 + lineCount(m.renderCurrentList()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
19		return total <= m.height
20	}
21	
22	func (m Model) updateMouse(message tea.MouseMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
23		event := tea.MouseEvent(message)
24		if event.Shift || event.Alt || event.Ctrl {
25			return m, nil
26		}
27		verticalWheel := event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown
28		if m.overlay.kind == overlayActionMenu {
29			menuPress := event.Action == tea.MouseActionPress && event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft
30			if (!verticalWheel && !menuPress) || !m.mouseFrameFits() {
31				return m, nil
32			}
33			return m.updateActionMenuMouse(event)
34		}
35		if m.noteMode() || m.overlay.kind != overlayNone || m.mode != modeList {
36			return m, nil
37		}
38		rowPress := event.Action == tea.MouseActionPress &&
39			(event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonRight)
40		if (!verticalWheel && !rowPress) || !m.mouseFrameFits() {
41			return m, nil
42		}
43	
44		if verticalWheel {
45			if !m.mouseOverList(event.X, event.Y) {
46				return m, nil
47			}
48			delta := mouseWheelRows
49			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
50				delta = -delta
51			}
52			m.setAt(m.at() + delta)
53			return m, nil
54		}
55		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
56			return m, nil
57		}
58	
59		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonLeft && event.Y == 0 {
60			for _, hit := range m.buildHeaderLayout().tabs {
61				if event.X < hit.from || event.X >= hit.to {
62					continue
63				}
64				if m.view == hit.view {
65					return m, nil
66				}
67				m.view = hit.view
68				return m.afterViewSwitch()
69			}
70			return m, nil
71		}
72	
73		row, ok := m.mouseRow(event.X, event.Y)
74		if !ok {
75			return m, nil
76		}
77		switch event.Button {
78		case tea.MouseButtonLeft:
79			m.setAt(row)
80		case tea.MouseButtonRight:
81			m.setAt(row)
82			if !m.remoteClone.active() {
83				m = m.openActionMenu()
84			}
85		}
86		return m, nil
87	}
88	
89	func (m Model) mouseRow(x, y int) (int, bool) {
90		if x < 0 || x >= m.width {
91			return 0, false
92		}
93		count := m.count()
94		from, to := m.window(count)
95		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
96		if y < first || y >= first+(to-from) {
97			return 0, false
98		}
99		return from + y - first, true
100	}
101	
102	func (m Model) mouseOverList(x, y int) bool {
103		if x < 0 || x >= m.width || m.count() == 0 {
104			return false
105		}
106		from, to := m.window(m.count())
107		first := 2 + m.listPreambleLines()
108		return y >= 2 && y < first+(to-from)
109	}
110	
111	func (m Model) updateActionMenuMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
112		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp || event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
113			if m.overlay.optionCount == 0 {
114				return m, nil
115			}
116			delta := 1
117			if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
118				delta = -1
119			}
120			m.moveActionMenu(delta)
121			return m, nil
122		}
123		if event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress || event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft {
124			return m, nil
125		}
126		index, ok := m.actionMenuOptionAt(event.X, event.Y)
127		if !ok {
128			m.overlay = overlayState{}
129			return m, nil
130		}
131		m.overlay.optionIndex = index
132		return m.runOverlayAction()
133	}
134
```

```text
537			m.err = err
538			return m, nil
539		}
540		if edit.Command == nil {
541			m.err = fmt.Errorf("capability editor returned no process")
542			return m, nil
543		}
544		view := m.view
545		m.status = "editing " + config.Contract(path) + "…"
546		return m, runExecProcess(edit.Command, func(runErr error) tea.Msg {
547			if edit.Complete != nil {
548				runErr = edit.Complete(runErr)
549			}
550			return capabilityFileEditedMsg{view: view, err: runErr}
551		})
552	}
```

```text
31	func newConfigEditorCommand(app *App, use, short string) *cobra.Command {

39	If it does not exist, first generate the same machine-detected, fully commented
40	template as "dev config init". Editor resolution is explicit:
41	
42	    --editor → $VISUAL → $EDITOR → nvim → vim → vi
43	
44	An editor value may contain arguments (for example "code --wait"); it is

100	// configEditorProcess resolves the effective config and editor without running
101	// it. The CLI runs the process directly; the TUI passes it to tea.ExecProcess,
102	// which suspends the alternate screen and redraws after the editor exits.
103	func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
104		path := app.configPath
105		if path == "" {
106			path = config.ConfigFile()
107		}
108		path = config.Expand(path)
109		created, err := ensureConfigForEdit(path)
110		if err != nil {
111			return nil, "", false, err
112		}
113		proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editor)
114		return proc, chosen, created, err
115	}

117	func prepareTUICapabilityEdit(path string) (tui.CapabilityEdit, error) {
118		logical := filepath.Clean(path)
119		resolved, err := pathx.Canonical(logical)
120		if err != nil {
121			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
122		}
123		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(resolved))
124		if err != nil {
125			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("open capability file directory %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
126		}
127		completeOwnsRoot := false
128		defer func() {
129			if !completeOwnsRoot {
130				_ = root.Close()
131			}
132		}()
133		original, observed, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(
134			context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), nil, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes,
135		)
136		if err != nil {
137			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, fmt.Errorf("read capability file %s: %w", config.Contract(logical), err)
138		}
139		originalSize := len(original)
140		originalDigest := sha256.Sum256(original)
141	
142		working, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-capability-edit-*")
143		if err != nil {
144			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
145		}
146		workingPath := working.Name()
147		cleanup := true
148		defer func() {
149			if cleanup {
150				_ = os.Remove(workingPath)
151			}
152		}()
153		if _, err := working.Write(original); err != nil {
154			_ = working.Close()
155			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
156		}
157		if err := working.Sync(); err != nil {
158			_ = working.Close()
159			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
160		}
161		if err := working.Close(); err != nil {
162			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
163		}
164		original = nil
165		process, _, err := editorProcess(workingPath, "")
166		if err != nil {
167			return tui.CapabilityEdit{}, err
168		}
169		cleanup = false
170		completeOwnsRoot = true
171	
172		return tui.CapabilityEdit{
173			Command: process,
174			Complete: func(runErr error) error {
175				defer root.Close()
176				if runErr != nil {
177					return fmt.Errorf("capability editor failed; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), runErr)
178				}
179				edited, err := safefile.ReadRegular(context.Background(), workingPath, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
180				if err != nil {

193						config.Contract(workingPath), err)
194				}
195				if _, err := safefile.AtomicReplace(
196					context.Background(), root, filepath.Base(resolved), observed, edited, observed.Mode().Perm(),
197				); err != nil {
198					return fmt.Errorf("replace changed capability file; working copy preserved at %s: %w", config.Contract(workingPath), err)

202		}, nil

205	// ensureConfigForEdit generates a usable config before opening an absent path.
206	// Editing an empty file would hide every default the user is trying to change.
207	func ensureConfigForEdit(path string) (bool, error) {
208		info, err := os.Stat(path)
209		switch {
210		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
211			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a directory, not a config file", config.Contract(path))
212		case err == nil:
213			return false, nil
214		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
215			return false, err
216		}
217		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
218			return false, err
219		}
220		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
221		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
222			return false, err
223		}
224		return true, nil
225	}
226	
227	func editorProcess(path, override string) (*exec.Cmd, string, error) {
228		chosen, err := resolveEditor(override)
229		if err != nil {
230			return nil, "", err
231		}
232		command, err := fleetEditorCommand(chosen, path)
233		return command, chosen, err
234	}
235	
236	func resolveEditor(override string) (string, error) {
237		for _, candidate := range []string{override, os.Getenv("VISUAL"), os.Getenv("EDITOR")} {
238			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
239				return candidate, nil
240			}
241		}
242		for _, candidate := range []string{"nvim", "vim", "vi"} {
243			if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
244				return candidate, nil
245			}
246		}
247		return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
248	}
```

```text
267			return false
```

```text
19	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
20	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
21	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
22	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
23	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
24		// Header + its blank line, per-view list preamble, blank before detail,
25		// blank before footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and
26		// terminal width.
27		fixed := 2 + m.listPreambleLines() + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
28		h := m.height - fixed
29		if h < 3 {
30			return 3
31		}
32		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
33		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
34			h--
35		}
36		return h
37	}

39	func (m Model) listPreambleLines() int {
40		lines := 1 // the table header, or the one-line empty/loading state
41		switch m.view {
42		case ViewRemote:
43			if m.viewLoad(ViewRemote).loading && len(m.visibleRemotes()) > 0 {
44				lines++
45			}
46		case ViewSkills:
47			if m.viewLoad(ViewSkills).loading && len(m.visibleSkills()) > 0 {

50		case ViewMCP:

52				lines++

142		if d < time.Hour {

158	// buildHeaderLayout renders the tab strip and records the exact cell spans it
159	// used, so mouse hit testing cannot drift from responsive labels or styles.
160	func (m Model) buildHeaderLayout() headerLayout {
161		build := func(compact, summary bool) headerLayout {
162			short := map[View]string{
163				ViewTasks: "TSK", ViewRepos: "REP", ViewFleet: "FLT", ViewTries: "TRY",
164				ViewRemote: "REM", ViewSkills: "SKL", ViewMCP: "MCP",
165			}
166			var builder strings.Builder
167			prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
168			builder.WriteString(prefix)
169			x := lipgloss.Width(prefix)
170			hits := make([]tabHit, 0, len(Views))
171			for index, view := range Views {
172				if index > 0 {
173					separator := styleDim.Render("│")
174					builder.WriteString(separator)
175					x += lipgloss.Width(separator)
176				}
177				name := strings.ToUpper(view.String())
178				if compact {
179					name = short[view]
180				}
181				label := name
182				if !compact {
183					label = " " + name + " "
184				}
185				rendered := styleDim.Render(label)
186				if view == m.view {
187					rendered = styleSelected.Render(label)
188				}
189				from := x
190				builder.WriteString(rendered)
191				x += lipgloss.Width(rendered)
192				hits = append(hits, tabHit{view: view, from: from, to: x})
193			}
194			if summary {
195				builder.WriteString("   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary()))
196			}
197			if m.filter != "" {
198				builder.WriteString("   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter))
199			}
200			return headerLayout{line: builder.String(), tabs: hits}
201		}
202	
203		layout := build(false, true)
204		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
205			layout = build(false, false)
206		}
207		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) > m.width {
208			layout = build(true, false)
209		}
210		if lipgloss.Width(layout.line) <= m.width {
211			return layout
212		}
213	
214		prefix := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  "
215		name := strings.ToUpper(m.view.String())
216		line := prefix + styleSelected.Render(name)
217		layout = headerLayout{
218			line: line,
219			tabs: []tabHit{{view: m.view, from: lipgloss.Width(prefix), to: lipgloss.Width(line)}},
220		}
221		if m.filter != "" {
222			available := m.width - lipgloss.Width(layout.line) - 4
223			if available > 1 {
224				layout.line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+pad(m.filter, available-1))

226		}
227		return layout
228	}

234	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
235	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
236	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
```

```text
18	func applyMouse(model Model, message tea.MouseMsg) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
19		updated, command := model.Update(message)

21	}

28				Checkout: fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/task-%02d", i), CheckoutExists: true,
```

```text
119	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
120	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
121	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
122	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
123	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
124	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
125	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
126	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
127		if root == nil {
128			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
129		}
130		if observed == nil {
131			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
132		}
133		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)

142		}

149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
152			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
153		}
154		stagedName = ""
155		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
158		}
159		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
160			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
161		}
162		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
163			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
164		}
165		return published, nil
166	}
```

```text
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
```

```text
13	func resolverOutcome(err error) perftrace.Outcome {
14		if err != nil {

16		}

18	}
19	
20	// tuiRuntimeResolver moves runtime auto-detection off the first-view path while
21	// sharing exactly one result across inventory loads and actions.
22	type tuiRuntimeResolver struct {
23		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
24		resolve func() runtime.Runtime
25		once    sync.Once
26		ready   chan struct{}
27		rt      runtime.Runtime
28	}
29	
30	func newTUIRuntimeResolver(app *App) *tuiRuntimeResolver {
31		snapshot := *app
32		return &tuiRuntimeResolver{
33			trace: app.trace, resolve: snapshot.Runtime, ready: make(chan struct{}),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	func (r *tuiRuntimeResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (runtime.Runtime, error) {
38		r.once.Do(func() {
39			go func() {
40				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIRuntimeResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
41				r.rt = r.resolve()
42				finish(perftrace.OutcomeSuccess)
43				close(r.ready)
44			}()
45		})
46		if ctx == nil {
47			ctx = context.Background()
48		}
49		select {
50		case <-ctx.Done():
51			return nil, ctx.Err()
52		case <-r.ready:
53			return r.rt, nil
54		}
55	}
56	
57	// tuiProjectRootResolver keeps startup-context discovery lazy and shared by
58	// SKILLS/MCP reads and skill actions.
59	type tuiProjectRootResolver struct {
60		trace   *perftrace.Recorder
61		ctx     context.Context
62		getwd   func() (string, error)
63		resolve func(context.Context, string) (agenttarget.Target, error)
64		once    sync.Once
65		ready   chan struct{}
66		target  agenttarget.Target
67		err     error
68	}
69	
70	func newTUIProjectRootResolver(trace *perftrace.Recorder, ctx context.Context) *tuiProjectRootResolver {
71		if ctx == nil {
72			ctx = context.Background()
73		}
74		return &tuiProjectRootResolver{
75			trace: trace, ctx: ctx, getwd: os.Getwd, resolve: agenttarget.Current,
76			ready: make(chan struct{}),
77		}
78	}
79	
80	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) ResolveTarget(ctx context.Context) (agenttarget.Target, error) {
81		r.once.Do(func() {
82			go func() {
83				finish := r.trace.Start(perftrace.TUIProjectRootResolve, perftrace.Fields{})
84				cwd, err := r.getwd()
85				if err == nil {
86					r.target, err = r.resolve(r.ctx, cwd)
87				}
88				r.err = err
89				finish(resolverOutcome(err))
90				close(r.ready)
91			}()
92		})
93		if ctx == nil {
94			ctx = context.Background()
95		}
96		select {
97		case <-ctx.Done():
98			return agenttarget.Target{}, ctx.Err()
99		case <-r.ready:
100			return r.target, r.err
101		}
102	}
103	
104	func (r *tuiProjectRootResolver) Resolve(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
105		target, err := r.ResolveTarget(ctx)
106		return target.CheckoutRoot, err
107	}
```

```text
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

7	## [Unreleased]
8	
9	### Added
10	
11	- The dashboard now supports cell-motion mouse input: left-click selects rows or
12	  switches visible tabs, the wheel moves three rows, and right-click opens the
13	  selected row's existing actions without making a click implicitly open it.
14	- SKILLS and MCP share a session-only `A` context/all scope toggle and can open
15	  the selected local configuration in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` or copy its path,
16	  sanitized summary, and explicitly requested raw file. Raw file copy is bounded
17	  to 1 MiB but may put credentials and other declarations into the system
18	  clipboard. A configured `A` tool remains available on other views; capability
19	  views give the scope toggle precedence.
20	
21	### Changed
22	
23	- MCP caps its content-responsive `SERVER` column at 32 cells, keeping transport,
24	  state, and source columns together instead of pushing them to the far edge of a
25	  wide terminal.
26	
27	## [0.2.12] - 2026-09-04
28	
29	### Changed
30	
31	- The TUI SKILLS and MCP views are now startup-context-first. From a Git
32	  checkout they scan only the exact current worktree plus global/user sources,
33	  matching what an agent launched there can read instead of listing unrelated
34	  projects. Outside Git they retain the cross-repository inventory and include
35	  every accepted REPOS target.
36	
37	## [0.2.11] - 2026-09-04
38	
39	### Added
40	
41	- `dev pr list` shows the pull and merge requests you opened and the ones
42	  awaiting your review, and joins reported head branches to local task and
43	  checkout health. Account and per-repository surfaces remain explicit;
44	  personal per-repository queries may call once per requested role, engaged
45	  repositories bound the default local scope, and `--all-repos` widens it.
```
